import TGLExt.IALDGraviton
import TGLExt.PostoAdendo

/-!
# Candidata v394: ponte matricial da fonte ao setor de helicidade
[DERIVED/REAL apos build] Calculo exato no M2 concreto do kernel. A porta C e
star(IALDGraviton.phaseGate). O Hamiltoniano Hlig=-V0 sigma_x e transportado,
nao suposto igual ao gerador. Eg e pinching de DOIS blocos; nao e a compressao
PXP, nem o consumidor M4. As identificacoes fisicas dos parametros e unidades
permanecem contratos proprios. Nao se afirma atrator universal unico, rede
continua global, propagador avancado, observacao empirica ou mudanca de gate.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
open Matrix Complex
namespace TGLExt.TimeGravitonMatrix
noncomputable section
abbrev M2 := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

def C : M2 := star IALDGraviton.phaseGate
def sigmaY : M2 := !![0, -Complex.I; Complex.I, 0]
def Px : M2 := (1/2 : ℂ) • (1+hCrossC)
def PxMinus : M2 := (1/2 : ℂ) • (1-hCrossC)
def Hlig (V0 : ℝ) : M2 := (-(V0 : ℂ)) • hCrossC
def Hg (V0 : ℝ) : M2 := C * Hlig V0 * star C
def omega (V0 hbar : ℝ) : ℝ := V0/hbar

def Eg : M2 →ₗ[ℂ] M2 where
  toFun X := projPlus * X * projPlus + projMinus * X * projMinus
  map_add' X Y := by simp only [mul_add, add_mul]; noncomm_ring
  map_smul' c X := by simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add, RingHom.id_apply]

def blockPM : M2 →ₗ[ℂ] M2 where
  toFun X := projPlus * X * projMinus
  map_add' X Y := by simp only [mul_add, add_mul]
  map_smul' c X := by simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, RingHom.id_apply]

def blockMP : M2 →ₗ[ℂ] M2 where
  toFun X := projMinus * X * projPlus
  map_add' X Y := by simp only [mul_add, add_mul]
  map_smul' c X := by simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, RingHom.id_apply]

theorem Eg_apply (X : M2) : Eg X = projPlus*X*projPlus + projMinus*X*projMinus := rfl
theorem blockPM_apply (X : M2) : blockPM X = projPlus*X*projMinus := rfl
theorem blockMP_apply (X : M2) : blockMP X = projMinus*X*projPlus := rfl

macro "matrix_calc" : tactic =>
 `(tactic| (ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
  simp [C, IALDGraviton.phaseGate, sigmaY, Px, PxMinus, Hlig, Hg,
    Eg, blockPM, blockMP, hPlusC, hCrossC, rootPlus, rootMinus, genK, projPlus,
    projMinus, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.star_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct,
    Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, pow_two, Complex.ext_iff] <;>
    (repeat' constructor) <;> (first | ring | trivial)))

theorem C_entries : C = !![1,0;0,Complex.I] := by matrix_calc
theorem C_unitary : C * star C = 1 ∧ star C * C = 1 := by constructor <;> matrix_calc
theorem C_sigmaX : C * hCrossC * star C = sigmaY := by matrix_calc
theorem C_Px : C * Px * star C = projPlus := by matrix_calc
theorem C_Hlig (V0 : ℝ) : Hg V0 = (Complex.I * (V0 : ℂ)) • genK := by matrix_calc
theorem hamiltonian_spectral (V0 : ℝ) :
    Hg V0 = (-(V0 : ℂ)) • projPlus + (V0 : ℂ) • projMinus := by matrix_calc
theorem hamiltonian_selfadjoint (V0 : ℝ) : star (Hg V0) = Hg V0 := by matrix_calc

theorem hamiltonian_generator (V0 hbar : ℝ) :
    (-Complex.I/(hbar : ℂ)) • Hg V0 = ((V0/hbar : ℝ) : ℂ) • genK := by
  rw [C_Hlig, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring_nf
  simp [Complex.I_sq]

theorem pm_orthogonal : projMinus*projPlus = 0 := by matrix_calc
theorem projMinus_star : star projMinus = projMinus := by matrix_calc

theorem Eg_idem (X : M2) : Eg (Eg X) = Eg X := by matrix_calc
theorem Eg_projPlus : Eg projPlus = projPlus := by matrix_calc
theorem Eg_projMinus : Eg projMinus = projMinus := by matrix_calc
theorem Eg_rootPlus : Eg rootPlus = 0 := by matrix_calc
theorem Eg_rootMinus : Eg rootMinus = 0 := by matrix_calc
theorem Eg_one : Eg 1 = 1 := by matrix_calc
theorem Eg_trace (X : M2) : Matrix.trace (Eg X) = Matrix.trace X := by
  simp [Eg, projPlus, projMinus, genK, Matrix.trace_fin_two, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Complex.ext_iff] <;>
    (repeat' constructor) <;> (first | ring | trivial)

theorem four_blocks (X : M2) : Eg X + blockPM X + blockMP X = X := by matrix_calc
theorem blockPM_rootPlus : blockPM rootPlus = rootPlus := by matrix_calc
theorem blockMP_rootPlus : blockMP rootPlus = 0 := by matrix_calc
theorem blockPM_rootMinus : blockPM rootMinus = 0 := by matrix_calc
theorem blockMP_rootMinus : blockMP rootMinus = rootMinus := by matrix_calc

def sourceG : Fin 2 → ℂ := ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) • lightPlus
def transportedG : Fin 2 → ℂ := ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (![1,-1] : Fin 2 → ℂ)
def sourceRho : M2 := projPlus
def transportedRho : M2 := C * sourceRho * star C

theorem C_state : C.mulVec sourceG = transportedG := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [C, IALDGraviton.phaseGate, sourceG, transportedG, lightPlus,
    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.star_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal, Complex.ext_iff] <;> ring

theorem density_transport : transportedRho = PxMinus := by
  unfold transportedRho sourceRho
  matrix_calc

theorem transported_reading : Eg transportedRho = (1/2 : ℂ) • (1:M2) := by
  rw [density_transport]
  matrix_calc

theorem parity_preserved : C * hPlusC * star C = hPlusC := by matrix_calc

theorem angFamily_star (θ : ℝ) : star (angFamily θ) = (angFamily θ).transpose := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [angFamily, genK, Matrix.star_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply, Complex.ext_iff]

theorem rootPlus_phase (θ : ℝ) :
    angFamily θ * rootPlus * star (angFamily θ) =
      Complex.exp ((2*θ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • rootPlus := by
  rw [angFamily_star, the_tensor_squares_the_phase]
  congr 1
  rw [pow_two, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

theorem rootMinus_phase (θ : ℝ) :
    angFamily θ * rootMinus * star (angFamily θ) =
      Complex.exp ((-2*θ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • rootMinus := by
  have hp : Complex.exp (((-2*θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      ((Real.cos θ : ℂ) - (Real.sin θ : ℂ)*Complex.I)^2 := by
    have h : Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ)*Complex.I) =
        (Real.cos θ : ℂ) - (Real.sin θ : ℂ)*Complex.I := by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using (Complex.exp_mul_I (-(θ : ℂ)))
    rw [← h, pow_two, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hp, angFamily_star]
  faces

theorem phase_frequency (V0 hbar t : ℝ) :
    angFamily (omega V0 hbar*t) * rootPlus * star (angFamily (omega V0 hbar*t)) =
      Complex.exp ((2*(V0/hbar)*t : ℝ) * Complex.I) • rootPlus := by
  simpa [omega, mul_assoc] using rootPlus_phase (omega V0 hbar*t)

theorem concrete_nonzero_modes : rootPlus ≠ 0 ∧ projPlus ≠ projMinus := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h00 := congrFun (congrFun h 0) 0
    norm_num [rootPlus, hPlusC, hCrossC] at h00
  · intro h
    have h01 := congrFun (congrFun h 0) 1
    norm_num [projPlus, projMinus, genK, Complex.ext_iff] at h01


/-! Exact bridges to the canonical diagonal expectation and positive-energy branch. -/
def spectralBasis : M2 := !![1,1;Complex.I,-Complex.I]
def toSpectral (X : M2) : M2 := (1/2 : ℂ) • (star spectralBasis * X * spectralBasis)
def fromSpectral (X : M2) : M2 := (1/2 : ℂ) • (spectralBasis * X * star spectralBasis)

theorem spectralBasis_normalization :
    spectralBasis * star spectralBasis = (2 : ℂ) • (1:M2) ∧
    star spectralBasis * spectralBasis = (2 : ℂ) • (1:M2) := by
  constructor <;> unfold spectralBasis <;> matrix_calc

theorem spectral_roundtrip (X : M2) : fromSpectral (toSpectral X) = X := by
  unfold fromSpectral toSpectral spectralBasis
  matrix_calc

theorem Eg_as_diagExpect (X : M2) :
    Eg X = fromSpectral (TGLExt.diagExpect (toSpectral X)) := by
  unfold fromSpectral toSpectral spectralBasis TGLExt.diagExpect
  matrix_calc

theorem Eg_as_nameOp (X : M2) :
    Eg X = fromSpectral (TGLExt.nameOp TGLExt.Posto.rhoStar (toSpectral X)) := by
  rw [PostoAdendo.A1c_nameOp_rhoStar_eq_diagExpect]
  exact Eg_as_diagExpect X

theorem sourceG_density : Matrix.vecMulVec sourceG (star sourceG) = sourceRho := by
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 2)^2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h0 : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [sourceG, sourceRho, lightPlus, Matrix.vecMulVec, projPlus, genK,
      Matrix.one_apply, Complex.ext_iff] <;>
    (repeat' constructor) <;> (first | (field_simp; nlinarith [hs]) | trivial)

def Hpos (V0 : ℝ) : M2 := (V0 : ℂ) • 1 + Hg V0

theorem Hpos_spectral (V0 : ℝ) : Hpos V0 = (2*(V0 : ℂ)) • projMinus := by
  unfold Hpos
  matrix_calc

def singleJump (a : ℝ) (X : M2) : M2 :=
  let L := (a : ℂ) • projMinus
  L * X * star L - (1/2 : ℂ) • (star L*L*X + X*star L*L)

theorem singleJump_rate (a : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    singleJump a X = ((a : ℂ)^2/2) • (Eg X-X) := by
  unfold singleJump
  matrix_calc

theorem positive_parameters_inhabited : ∃ V0 hbar : ℝ, 0 < V0 ∧ 0 < hbar :=
  ⟨1, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩

end
end TGLExt.TimeGravitonMatrix

import TGLExt.TheRuleInTheContinuousMotor
import TGLExt.PhaseFrequencySeparation

/-! Exact scalar factors for the finite v394 flow. Phase clocks use an explicit
lift, not a single-valued inverse of a periodic angle. Rate and units remain
parameters; positivity is required only for decay. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
namespace TGLExt.TimeGravitonFlow
open Complex Filter Topology
noncomputable section

def exponent (rate frequency : ℝ) : ℂ := -(rate : ℂ) + (frequency : ℂ)*Complex.I

def mode (rate frequency time : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (exponent rate frequency * (time : ℂ))

theorem mode_eq_spin (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
    mode rate frequency time = IALDJones.spin rate frequency time := by
  unfold mode exponent IALDJones.spin IALDJones.coeff
  rw [Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

theorem mode_zero (rate frequency : ℝ) : mode rate frequency 0 = 1 := by
  simp [mode]

theorem mode_add (rate frequency s t : ℝ) :
    mode rate frequency (s+t) = mode rate frequency s * mode rate frequency t := by
  simp only [mode_eq_spin]
  exact IALDJones.spin_add rate frequency s t

theorem mode_ne_zero (rate frequency time : ℝ) : mode rate frequency time ≠ 0 :=
  Complex.exp_ne_zero _

theorem mode_norm (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
    ‖mode rate frequency time‖ = Real.exp (-(rate*time)) := by
  rw [mode_eq_spin]
  exact IALDJones.norm_spin rate frequency time

theorem mode_continuous (rate frequency : ℝ) : Continuous (mode rate frequency) := by
  unfold mode
  fun_prop

theorem mode_hasDerivAt (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (mode rate frequency)
      (exponent rate frequency * mode rate frequency time) time := by
  have h := (((hasDerivAt_id time).ofReal_comp).const_mul (exponent rate frequency)).cexp
  unfold mode
  simpa [mode, mul_comm] using h

theorem mode_tendsto_zero (rate frequency : ℝ) (hr : 0 < rate) :
    Tendsto (mode rate frequency) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simp only [mode_norm]
  simpa only [IALDJones.coeff, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_zero] using
    (IALDJones.coeff_tendsto_zero hr).norm

theorem module_clock (rate frequency time : ℝ) (hr : rate ≠ 0) :
    -Real.log ‖mode rate frequency time‖ / rate = time := by
  rw [mode_norm, Real.log_exp]
  field_simp

def liftedPhase (frequency time : ℝ) : ℝ := frequency*time

theorem phase_clock (omega s t : ℝ) (hω : omega ≠ 0) :
    (liftedPhase (2*omega) t - liftedPhase (2*omega) s)/(2*omega) = t-s := by
  unfold liftedPhase
  field_simp

theorem module_elapsed_clock (rate frequency s t : ℝ) (hr : rate ≠ 0) :
    -Real.log ‖mode rate frequency (t-s)‖ / rate = t-s :=
  module_clock rate frequency (t-s) hr

theorem phase_frequency_identified (a b : ℝ) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ)*Complex.I*(a : ℂ))*c =
      Complex.exp ((s : ℂ)*Complex.I*(b : ℂ))*c) : a = b :=
  ChatgptAudit.Commutation032.phase_frequency_separation a b c hc h

end
end TGLExt.TimeGravitonFlow

import TGLExt.TimeGravitonScalar
import TGLExt.TimeGravitonMatrix

/-!
# Continuous time and the graviton reading in the specified M2 model

The two off-diagonal modes carry conjugate phases. The reading Eg is the
two-block pinching, never the corner PXP. This is a constructed flow for the
specified finite generator, not an inference of a unique interpolation from
discrete samples. Time is recovered from a nonzero decaying mode or an explicit
lift of its phase. A constant reading does not count elapsed time. Parameters
and calibration to seconds have their own physical contracts.

For positive rate the limit is Eg X. The fixed space contains both projectors;
no unique pure attractor or finite-time arrival is asserted. Negative times
occur in the algebraic group formula but are not claimed physical channels.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
open Matrix Complex Filter Topology
namespace TGLExt.TimeGravitonFlow
open TimeGravitonMatrix RuleTruthContract
noncomputable section

@[simp] theorem Eg_blockPM (X : M2) : Eg (blockPM X) = 0 := by matrix_calc
@[simp] theorem Eg_blockMP (X : M2) : Eg (blockMP X) = 0 := by matrix_calc
@[simp] theorem blockPM_Eg (X : M2) : blockPM (Eg X) = 0 := by matrix_calc
@[simp] theorem blockMP_Eg (X : M2) : blockMP (Eg X) = 0 := by matrix_calc
@[simp] theorem blockPM_idem (X : M2) : blockPM (blockPM X) = blockPM X := by matrix_calc
@[simp] theorem blockMP_idem (X : M2) : blockMP (blockMP X) = blockMP X := by matrix_calc
@[simp] theorem blockPM_blockMP (X : M2) : blockPM (blockMP X) = 0 := by matrix_calc
@[simp] theorem blockMP_blockPM (X : M2) : blockMP (blockPM X) = 0 := by matrix_calc

def flow (rate omega time : ℝ) : M2 →ₗ[ℂ] M2 :=
  Eg + mode rate (2*omega) time • blockPM + mode rate (-2*omega) time • blockMP

theorem flow_apply (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    flow rate omega time X = Eg X + mode rate (2*omega) time • blockPM X +
      mode rate (-2*omega) time • blockMP X := rfl

@[simp] theorem reading_flow (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    Eg (flow rate omega time X) = Eg X := by
  simp [flow_apply, Eg_idem]

@[simp] theorem blockPM_flow (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    blockPM (flow rate omega time X) = mode rate (2*omega) time • blockPM X := by
  simp [flow_apply]

@[simp] theorem blockMP_flow (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    blockMP (flow rate omega time X) = mode rate (-2*omega) time • blockMP X := by
  simp [flow_apply]

theorem flow_zero (rate omega : ℝ) (X : M2) : flow rate omega 0 X = X := by
  simpa [flow_apply, mode_zero] using four_blocks X

theorem flow_add (rate omega s t : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    flow rate omega (s+t) X = flow rate omega s (flow rate omega t X) := by
  rw [flow_apply, flow_apply, reading_flow, blockPM_flow, blockMP_flow]
  simp only [mode_add, smul_smul]

theorem flow_reading (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    flow rate omega time (Eg X) = Eg X := by
  simp [flow_apply, Eg_idem]

theorem flow_continuous (rate omega : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    Continuous (fun time : ℝ => flow rate omega time X) := by
  simp only [flow_apply]
  exact (continuous_const.add ((mode_continuous rate (2*omega)).smul continuous_const)).add
    ((mode_continuous rate (-2*omega)).smul continuous_const)

def generator (rate omega : ℝ) (X : M2) : M2 :=
  exponent rate (2*omega) • blockPM X + exponent rate (-2*omega) • blockMP X

theorem flow_hasDerivAt (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => flow rate omega s X)
      (generator rate omega (flow rate omega time X)) time := by
  rw [generator, blockPM_flow, blockMP_flow]
  apply hasDerivAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  apply hasDerivAt_pi.mpr
  intro j
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const time (Eg X i j)).add
    ((mode_hasDerivAt rate (2*omega) time).mul_const (blockPM X i j))).add
    ((mode_hasDerivAt rate (-2*omega) time).mul_const (blockMP X i j))
  simpa only [flow_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Pi.add_def, smul_eq_mul,
    zero_add, mul_assoc] using h

theorem generator_at_zero (rate omega : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => flow rate omega s X) (generator rate omega X) 0 := by
  simpa only [flow_zero] using flow_hasDerivAt rate omega 0 X

theorem hamiltonian_commutator_blocks (V0 : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    Hg V0 * X - X * Hg V0 =
      (-2*(V0 : ℂ)) • blockPM X + (2*(V0 : ℂ)) • blockMP X := by
  matrix_calc

theorem generator_is_Hg_commutator (rate V0 hbar : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    generator rate (V0/hbar) X =
      (-Complex.I/(hbar : ℂ)) • (Hg V0 * X - X * Hg V0) +
      (rate : ℂ) • (Eg X-X) := by
  rw [hamiltonian_commutator_blocks]
  have he : Eg X-X = -blockPM X - blockMP X := by
    calc
      Eg X-X = Eg X-(Eg X+blockPM X+blockMP X) := by rw [four_blocks]
      _ = -blockPM X-blockMP X := by abel
  rw [he]
  unfold generator exponent
  push_cast
  module

theorem generator_is_GKLS (rate V0 hbar : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rate) (X : M2) :
    generator rate (V0/hbar) X =
      (-Complex.I/(hbar : ℂ)) • (Hg V0 * X - X * Hg V0) +
      singleJump (Real.sqrt (2*rate)) X := by
  rw [generator_is_Hg_commutator, singleJump_rate]
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (2*rate))^2 = 2*rate := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hc : (Real.sqrt (2*rate) : ℂ)^2 = 2*(rate : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hs
  rw [hc]
  congr 2
  ring

theorem physical_flow_hasDerivAt (rate V0 hbar time : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rate) (X : M2) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => flow rate (V0/hbar) s X)
      ((-Complex.I/(hbar : ℂ)) •
        (Hg V0 * flow rate (V0/hbar) time X - flow rate (V0/hbar) time X * Hg V0) +
       singleJump (Real.sqrt (2*rate)) (flow rate (V0/hbar) time X)) time := by
  rw [← generator_is_GKLS rate V0 hbar hr]
  exact flow_hasDerivAt rate (V0/hbar) time X

theorem flow_tendsto_reading (rate omega : ℝ) (hr : 0 < rate) (X : M2) :

  have h := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x:=Eg X)).add
    ((mode_tendsto_zero rate (2*omega) hr).smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=blockPM X)))).add
    ((mode_tendsto_zero rate (-2*omega) hr).smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=blockMP X)))
  simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero, flow_apply] using h

theorem flow_fixed_iff_reading (rate omega : ℝ) (hr : 0 < rate) (X : M2) :
    (∀ time : ℝ, flow rate omega time X = X) ↔ Eg X = X := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (flow_tendsto_reading rate omega hr X)
      (by simpa only [h] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=X) (f:=atTop)))
  · intro h time
    rw [← h, flow_reading]

theorem rootPlus_mode (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    flow rate omega time rootPlus = mode rate (2*omega) time • rootPlus := by
  simp [flow_apply, Eg_rootPlus, blockPM_rootPlus, blockMP_rootPlus]

theorem rootMinus_mode (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    flow rate omega time rootMinus = mode rate (-2*omega) time • rootMinus := by
  simp [flow_apply, Eg_rootMinus, blockPM_rootMinus, blockMP_rootMinus]

theorem rootPlus_entry (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    flow rate omega time rootPlus 0 0 = mode rate (2*omega) time := by
  rw [rootPlus_mode]
  simp [rootPlus, hPlusC, hCrossC]

theorem rootPlus_observed_clock (rate omega time : ℝ) (hr : rate ≠ 0) :

  rw [rootPlus_entry]
  exact module_clock rate (2*omega) time hr

theorem rootPlus_not_zero_at_finite_time (rate omega time : ℝ) :

  intro h
  have h00 := congrFun (congrFun h 0) 0
  rw [rootPlus_entry] at h00
  exact mode_ne_zero rate (2*omega) time h00

def coherence (X : M2) : ℂ := blockPM X 0 0

theorem coherence_flow (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :

  unfold coherence
  rw [blockPM_flow]
  rfl

theorem coherence_ratio (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) (hx : coherence X ≠ 0) :

  rw [coherence_flow]
  exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hx

theorem coherence_clock (rate omega time : ℝ) (hr : rate ≠ 0) (X : M2)
    (hx : coherence X ≠ 0) :
    -Real.log ‖coherence (flow rate omega time X) / coherence X‖ / rate = time := by
  rw [coherence_ratio rate omega time X hx]
  exact module_clock rate (2*omega) time hr

theorem transported_coherence : coherence transportedRho = Complex.I/4 := by
  have h : blockPM transportedRho = (Complex.I/4) • rootPlus := by
    rw [density_transport]
    matrix_calc
  unfold coherence
  rw [h]
  simp [rootPlus, hPlusC, hCrossC]

theorem transported_clock (rate omega time : ℝ) (hr : rate ≠ 0) :
    -Real.log ‖coherence (flow rate omega time transportedRho) /
      coherence transportedRho‖ / rate = time := by
  apply coherence_clock rate omega time hr
  rw [transported_coherence]
  exact div_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (by norm_num)

theorem fixed_projectors (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    flow rate omega time projPlus = projPlus ∧ flow rate omega time projMinus = projMinus := by
  constructor
  · rw [← Eg_projPlus, flow_reading]
  · rw [← Eg_projMinus, flow_reading]

theorem transported_limit (rate omega : ℝ) (hr : 0 < rate) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => flow rate omega t transportedRho) atTop
      (nhds ((1/2 : ℂ) • (1:M2))) := by
  simpa only [transported_reading] using flow_tendsto_reading rate omega hr transportedRho

theorem rule_preserved (target X : M2) (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    Admissible Eg target (flow rate omega time X) ↔ Admissible Eg target X := by
  unfold Admissible
  rw [reading_flow]

theorem inscription_stationary (X : M2) (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    RuleContinuousMotor.inscribe Eg Eg_idem (flow rate omega time X) =
      RuleContinuousMotor.inscribe Eg Eg_idem X := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact reading_flow rate omega time X

theorem rule_is_equality_on_inscriptions
    (target X : RuleContinuousMotor.Inscription Eg) :
    Admissible (fun z : RuleContinuousMotor.Inscription Eg => Eg z.val) target.val X ↔ X=target :=
  RuleContinuousMotor.rule_on_inscriptions_is_equality Eg target X

theorem wrong_reading_rejected (target X : M2) (rate omega time : ℝ)
    (h : Eg X ≠ target) : ¬ Admissible Eg target (flow rate omega time X) := by
  simpa only [Admissible, reading_flow] using h

end

import TGLExt.TimeGravitonFlow

/-! Explicit finite Kraus witness for nonnegative rates and times.
The certificate consists of the action as a Kraus sum and sum K* K = I.
These are exact matrix equalities, not a sampled Choi test. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
namespace TGLExt.TimeGravitonFlow
open Matrix Complex TimeGravitonMatrix
noncomputable section

def phase (theta : ℝ) : ℂ := Complex.exp ((theta : ℂ)*Complex.I)

theorem phase_star (theta : ℝ) : star (phase theta) = phase (-theta) := by
  unfold phase
  rw [Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj]
  congr 1
  simp

theorem phase_mul (theta phi : ℝ) : phase theta * phase phi = phase (theta+phi) := by
  unfold phase
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

@[simp] theorem phase_zero : phase 0 = 1 := by simp [phase]

def unitary (theta : ℝ) : M2 := phase theta • projPlus + phase (-theta) • projMinus

theorem unitary_eq_angFamily (theta : ℝ) : unitary theta = angFamily theta := by
  rw [the_angle_is_the_projection]
  simp [unitary, phase]

theorem unitary_star (theta : ℝ) : star (unitary theta) = unitary (-theta) := by
  simp [unitary, star_add, star_smul, IALDGraviton.projPlus_star, projMinus_star,
    phase_star]

theorem unitary_normalization (theta : ℝ) : star (unitary theta)*unitary theta = 1 := by
  rw [unitary_star]
  simp only [unitary, add_mul, mul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul,
    spectral_projections_are_idempotent.1, spectral_projections_are_idempotent.2,
    spectral_projections_split_the_identity.2, pm_orthogonal, smul_zero, add_zero, zero_add,
    phase_mul, neg_add_cancel, neg_neg, add_neg_cancel, phase_zero, one_smul]
  exact spectral_projections_split_the_identity.1

theorem unitary_action (theta : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    unitary theta * X * star (unitary theta) =
      Eg X + phase (2*theta) • blockPM X + phase (-2*theta) • blockMP X := by
  rw [unitary_star]
  simp only [unitary, add_mul, mul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_add, smul_smul,
    phase_mul, neg_neg, add_neg_cancel, neg_add_cancel, phase_zero, one_smul]
  have hp : theta+theta = 2*theta := by ring
  have hm : -theta + -theta = -2*theta := by ring
  rw [hp, hm]
  simp only [Eg_apply, blockPM_apply, blockMP_apply]
  abel

theorem mode_decay_phase (rate frequency time : ℝ) :
    mode rate frequency time = (Real.exp (-(rate*time)) : ℂ) * phase (frequency*time) := by
  rw [mode_eq_spin]
  rfl

def decay (rate time : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (-(rate*time))

theorem flow_convex_unitary_pinching (rate omega time : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    flow rate omega time X = (decay rate time : ℂ) •
      (unitary (omega*time)*X*star (unitary (omega*time))) +
      (1-(decay rate time : ℂ)) • Eg X := by
  rw [unitary_action, flow_apply]
  simp only [mode_decay_phase, decay]
  have hp : 2*omega*time = 2*(omega*time) := by ring
  have hm : -2*omega*time = -2*(omega*time) := by ring
  rw [hp, hm]
  module

theorem decay_range (rate time : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rate) (ht : 0 ≤ time) :
    0 ≤ decay rate time ∧ decay rate time ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)
  · unfold decay
    exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr (mul_nonneg hr ht))

def kraus0 (rate omega time : ℝ) : M2 :=
  (Real.sqrt (decay rate time) : ℂ) • unitary (omega*time)
def kraus1 (rate time : ℝ) : M2 :=
  (Real.sqrt (1-decay rate time) : ℂ) • projPlus
def kraus2 (rate time : ℝ) : M2 :=
  (Real.sqrt (1-decay rate time) : ℂ) • projMinus

theorem sqrt_sandwich (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (K X : M2) :
    ((Real.sqrt a : ℂ) • K)*X*star ((Real.sqrt a : ℂ) • K) =
      (a : ℂ) • (K*X*star K) := by
  simp only [star_smul, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt ha]

theorem sqrt_normalization (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (K : M2) :
    star ((Real.sqrt a : ℂ) • K)*((Real.sqrt a : ℂ) • K) =
      (a : ℂ) • (star K*K) := by
  simp only [star_smul, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt ha]

theorem flow_kraus (rate omega time : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rate) (ht : 0 ≤ time) (X : M2) :
    flow rate omega time X =
      kraus0 rate omega time * X * star (kraus0 rate omega time) +
      kraus1 rate time * X * star (kraus1 rate time) +
      kraus2 rate time * X * star (kraus2 rate time) := by
  have hd := decay_range rate time hr ht
  unfold kraus0 kraus1 kraus2
  rw [sqrt_sandwich _ hd.1, sqrt_sandwich _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hd.2),
    sqrt_sandwich _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hd.2), IALDGraviton.projPlus_star, projMinus_star,
    flow_convex_unitary_pinching, Eg_apply]
  push_cast
  module

theorem kraus_normalization (rate omega time : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rate) (ht : 0 ≤ time) :
    star (kraus0 rate omega time)*kraus0 rate omega time +
      star (kraus1 rate time)*kraus1 rate time +
      star (kraus2 rate time)*kraus2 rate time = 1 := by
  have hd := decay_range rate time hr ht
  unfold kraus0 kraus1 kraus2
  rw [sqrt_normalization _ hd.1, sqrt_normalization _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hd.2),
    sqrt_normalization _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hd.2), unitary_normalization,
    IALDGraviton.projPlus_star, projMinus_star, spectral_projections_are_idempotent.1,
    spectral_projections_are_idempotent.2]
  have hp := spectral_projections_split_the_identity.1
  rw [← hp]
  push_cast
  module

end
end TGLExt.TimeGravitonFlow

import TGLExt.TimeGravitonFlow
import TGLExt.PageInformation
import TGLExt.Bicommutant

/-!
# The rule as a quadratic residual of the existing reading

The reading Eg, its flow, the inscription type and the Frobenius form are
reused. No new network or dynamical hypothesis is introduced. For a target A
fixed before evaluation, residual A X is the squared Frobenius distance from
Eg X to A, not the distance from the raw state X to A. Its invariance is proved
from reading_flow; it is not assumed and is not a decreasing progress score.

An inscription is a realizable fixed target. The zero criterion and invariance
also hold for arbitrary targets, while an impossible target has positive
residual everywhere. Concrete accepted and rejected controls share the same
transported density and differ only in the target. The construction is M2;
its interpretation as a rule is the explicit representation of
RuleTruthContract. No physical confirmation or global spacetime is asserted.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
open Matrix Complex
namespace TGLExt.RuleQuadraticResidual
open TimeGravitonMatrix TimeGravitonFlow RuleTruthContract
noncomputable section

theorem purityR_nonnegative {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : 0 ≤ purityR X := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
    Complex.normSq_nonneg (X i j)

theorem purityR_zero_iff {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : purityR X = 0 ↔ X = 0 := by
  have bridge : frob X X = (purityR X : ℂ) := by
    calc
      frob X X = purity X := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = (purityR X : ℂ) := purityR_eq X
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (frob_self_eq_zero_iff X).mp
    rw [bridge, h]
    simp
  · rintro rfl
    simp [purityR]

def residual (A X : M2) : ℝ := purityR (Eg X - A)

theorem residual_nonnegative (A X : M2) : 0 ≤ residual A X :=
  purityR_nonnegative _

theorem residual_zero_iff (A X : M2) :
    residual A X = 0 ↔ Admissible Eg A X := by
  unfold residual Admissible
  rw [purityR_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero]

theorem residual_positive_iff (A X : M2) :
    0 < residual A X ↔ ¬ Admissible Eg A X := by
  constructor
  · intro hp ha
    have hz := (residual_zero_iff A X).mpr ha
    linarith
  · intro ha
    have hn := residual_nonnegative A X
    by_contra hp
    have hz : residual A X = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hp) hn
    exact ha ((residual_zero_iff A X).mp hz)

theorem residual_flow (A X : M2) (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    residual A (flow rate omega time X) = residual A X := by
  simp only [residual, reading_flow]

theorem residual_time_continuous (A X : M2) (rate omega : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun time : ℝ => residual A (flow rate omega time X)) := by
  simpa only [residual_flow] using
    (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => residual A X))

theorem residual_time_derivative_zero (A X : M2) (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => residual A (flow rate omega s X)) 0 time := by
  simpa only [residual_flow] using (hasDerivAt_const time (residual A X))

theorem inscription_has_zero_residual (A : RuleContinuousMotor.Inscription Eg) :
    residual A.val A.val = 0 := by
  exact (residual_zero_iff _ _).mpr A.property

theorem inscription_residual_zero_iff (A X : RuleContinuousMotor.Inscription Eg) :
    residual A.val X.val = 0 ↔ X = A := by
  rw [residual_zero_iff]
  change Eg X.val = A.val ↔ X = A
  rw [X.property]
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.symm

theorem impossible_anchor_positive (A : M2) (ha : Eg A ≠ A) (X : M2) :
    0 < residual A X := by
  apply (residual_positive_iff A X).mpr
  intro h
  have hi := Eg_idem X
  change Eg X = A at h
  rw [h] at hi
  exact ha hi

def anchor : M2 := (1/2 : ℂ) • (1 : M2)

theorem anchor_fixed : Eg anchor = anchor := by
  simp only [anchor, map_smul, Eg_one]

def anchorInscription : RuleContinuousMotor.Inscription Eg := ⟨anchor, anchor_fixed⟩

theorem transported_accepted : residual anchor transportedRho = 0 := by
  apply (residual_zero_iff _ _).mpr
  exact transported_reading

theorem changed_anchor_residual : residual projPlus transportedRho = 1/2 := by
  unfold residual
  rw [transported_reading, IALDGraviton.projPlus_entries]
  norm_num [purityR, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Complex.normSq_apply]

theorem transported_is_not_anchor : transportedRho ≠ anchor := by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun X : M2 => X 0 1) h
  rw [density_transport] at hc
  norm_num [PxMinus, anchor, hCrossC] at hc

theorem changed_anchor_rejected (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    ¬ Admissible Eg projPlus (flow rate omega time transportedRho) := by
  apply (residual_positive_iff _ _).mp
  rw [residual_flow, changed_anchor_residual]
  norm_num

theorem accepted_along_flow (rate omega time : ℝ) :
    residual anchor (flow rate omega time transportedRho) = 0 := by
  rw [residual_flow, transported_accepted]

theorem inhabited_and_discriminating :
    ∃ A X : M2, Eg A = A ∧ residual A X = 0 ∧ X ≠ A ∧
      residual projPlus X = 1/2 :=
  ⟨anchor, transportedRho, anchor_fixed, transported_accepted,
    transported_is_not_anchor, changed_anchor_residual⟩

end
end TGLExt.RuleQuadraticResidual

import TGLExt.LightNetStandardWedgeDataBGL
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.TensorProduct
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Completion
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend
/-!
Concrete first bosonic sector on the canonical v392 H1. The algebraic tensor
product is completed, and the two-particle space is the closed fixed subspace
of the flip. Unitaries act by the completed tensor square, restricted to that
subspace. This constructs an actual sector, not a FockCertificate, Weyl net,
Maxwell field, or general second-quantization theorem.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000
noncomputable section
open scoped TensorProduct
open UniformSpace
namespace F1Rede.BosonicTwoParticle
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ

section CompletionEquiv
variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F]

def completionEquiv (u : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F) : Completion E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Completion F :=
  u.toLinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry
    (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := E)).toLinearMap
    (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := F)).toLinearMap
    Completion.denseRange_coe Completion.denseRange_coe
    (fun x => by simp)

@[simp] theorem completionEquiv_coe (u : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F) (x : E) :
    completionEquiv u (x : Completion E) = (u x : Completion F) := by
  exact LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ x
end CompletionEquiv

abbrev AlgebraicTwo := H1 ⊗[ℂ] H1
abbrev CompletedTwo := Completion AlgebraicTwo

def flip : CompletedTwo ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] CompletedTwo :=
  completionEquiv (TensorProduct.commIsometry ℂ H1 H1)

@[simp] theorem flip_coe (x : AlgebraicTwo) :
    flip (x : CompletedTwo) = (TensorProduct.comm ℂ H1 H1 x : CompletedTwo) := by
  simp [flip]

@[simp] theorem flip_flip (x : CompletedTwo) : flip (flip x) = x := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq (flip.continuous.comp flip.continuous) continuous_id) ?_
  intro a
  simp

def symmetricSector : Submodule ℂ CompletedTwo where
  carrier := {x | flip x = x}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by intro x y hx hy; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at *; simp [hx, hy]
  smul_mem' := by intro c x hx; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at *; simp [hx]

@[simp] theorem mem_symmetricSector (x : CompletedTwo) :
    x ∈ symmetricSector ↔ flip x = x := Iff.rfl

theorem symmetricSector_closed : IsClosed (symmetricSector : Set CompletedTwo) :=
  isClosed_eq flip.continuous continuous_id

instance : CompleteSpace symmetricSector :=
  symmetricSector_closed.completeSpace_coe

def pair (x : H1) : symmetricSector :=
  ⟨((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x : AlgebraicTwo) : CompletedTwo), by simp⟩

@[simp] theorem pair_norm (x : H1) : ‖pair x‖ = ‖x‖ * ‖x‖ := by
  simp [pair]

theorem pair_ne_zero {x : H1} (hx : x ≠ 0) : pair x ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hnorm := pair_norm x
  rw [h, norm_zero] at hnorm
  exact (mul_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx) (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx)) hnorm.symm

theorem symmetricSector_nontrivial : Nontrivial symmetricSector := by
  haveI := AuditF13v31.H1_nontrivial
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : H1)
  exact ⟨⟨pair x, 0, pair_ne_zero hx⟩⟩

def tensorSquare (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) : CompletedTwo ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] CompletedTwo :=
  completionEquiv (TensorProduct.congrIsometry u u)

@[simp] theorem tensorSquare_coe (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (x : AlgebraicTwo) :
    tensorSquare u (x : CompletedTwo) =
      (TensorProduct.congr u.toLinearEquiv u.toLinearEquiv x : CompletedTwo) := by
  rw [tensorSquare, completionEquiv_coe]
  rfl

theorem tensorSquare_flip (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (x : CompletedTwo) :
    tensorSquare u (flip x) = flip (tensorSquare u x) := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq
    ((tensorSquare u).continuous.comp flip.continuous)
    (flip.continuous.comp (tensorSquare u).continuous)) ?_
  intro a
  simp only [flip_coe, tensorSquare_coe]
  congr 1
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

theorem tensorSquare_mem (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) {x : CompletedTwo}
    (hx : x ∈ symmetricSector) : tensorSquare u x ∈ symmetricSector := by
  rw [mem_symmetricSector] at hx ⊢
  rw [← tensorSquare_flip, hx]

theorem tensorSquare_inverse (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (x : CompletedTwo) :
    tensorSquare u.symm (tensorSquare u x) = x := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq
    ((tensorSquare u.symm).continuous.comp (tensorSquare u).continuous) continuous_id) ?_
  intro a
  simp only [tensorSquare_coe]
  congr 1
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

def gammaTwo (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) : symmetricSector ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] symmetricSector where
  toFun x := ⟨tensorSquare u x, tensorSquare_mem u x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨tensorSquare u.symm x, tensorSquare_mem u.symm x.property⟩
  left_inv x := by apply Subtype.ext; exact tensorSquare_inverse u x
  right_inv x := by apply Subtype.ext; simpa using tensorSquare_inverse u.symm (x : CompletedTwo)
  map_add' x y := by apply Subtype.ext; exact (tensorSquare u).map_add x y
  map_smul' c x := by apply Subtype.ext; exact (tensorSquare u).map_smul c x
  norm_map' x := (tensorSquare u).norm_map x

@[simp] theorem gammaTwo_pair (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (x : H1) :
    gammaTwo u (pair x) = pair (u x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change tensorSquare u ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x : AlgebraicTwo) : CompletedTwo) = _
  simp [pair]

theorem tensorSquare_trans (u v : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (x : CompletedTwo) :
    tensorSquare (u.trans v) x = tensorSquare v (tensorSquare u x) := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq
    (tensorSquare (u.trans v)).continuous
    ((tensorSquare v).continuous.comp (tensorSquare u).continuous)) ?_
  intro a
  simp only [tensorSquare_coe]
  congr 1
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

theorem gammaTwo_trans (u v : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) :
    gammaTwo (u.trans v) = (gammaTwo u).trans (gammaTwo v) := by
  ext x
  exact tensorSquare_trans u v x

theorem gammaTwo_refl : gammaTwo (.refl ℂ H1) = .refl ℂ symmetricSector := by
  ext x
  change tensorSquare (.refl ℂ H1) (x : CompletedTwo) = x
  refine Completion.induction_on (x : CompletedTwo)
    (isClosed_eq (tensorSquare (.refl ℂ H1)).continuous continuous_id) ?_
  intro a
  simp [tensorSquare, TensorProduct.congrIsometry_refl_refl]

end F1Rede.BosonicTwoParticle

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BosonicTwoParticle
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000
noncomputable section
open UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace F1Rede.BosonicSectors
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicTwoParticle

/-- Recursively bracketed algebraic tensor powers. We complete each entire
power and take the closed span of diagonal pure powers as its symmetric sector.
The permutation-fixed presentation is not identified by a theorem in this file.
The zero algebraic sector is the scalar field. -/
structure PreHilbert where
  carrier : Type
  [instN : NormedAddCommGroup carrier]
  [instI : InnerProductSpace ℂ carrier]
attribute [instance] PreHilbert.instN PreHilbert.instI

def powerData : ℕ → PreHilbert
  | 0 => ⟨ℂ⟩
  | n+1 => ⟨H1 ⊗[ℂ] (powerData n).carrier⟩

abbrev Algebraic (n : ℕ) := (powerData n).carrier

def algebraicGamma (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) : (n : ℕ) → Algebraic n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Algebraic n
  | 0 => LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ ℂ
  | n+1 => TensorProduct.congrIsometry u (algebraicGamma u n)

def pureAlgebraic (x : H1) : (n : ℕ) → Algebraic n
  | 0 => (1 : ℂ)
  | n+1 => x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic x n

@[simp] theorem algebraicGamma_tmul (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : H1) (y : Algebraic n) :
    algebraicGamma u (n+1) (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) = u x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] algebraicGamma u n y := by
  change TensorProduct.congrIsometry u (algebraicGamma u n) (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) = _
  simp

theorem pureAlgebraic_norm (x : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖pureAlgebraic x n‖ = ‖x‖ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => change ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = ‖x‖^0; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    change ‖(x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic x n : H1 ⊗[ℂ] Algebraic n)‖ = _
    rw [TensorProduct.norm_tmul, ih, pow_succ, mul_comm]

theorem algebraicGamma_pure (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    algebraicGamma u n (pureAlgebraic x n) = pureAlgebraic (u x) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change algebraicGamma u (n+1) (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic x n) = _
    rw [algebraicGamma_tmul, ih]
    rfl

theorem algebraicGamma_refl (n : ℕ) (x : Algebraic n) :
    algebraicGamma (.refl ℂ H1) n x = x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change TensorProduct.congrIsometry (.refl ℂ H1) (algebraicGamma (.refl ℂ H1) n) x = x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul x y => simp [ih]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

theorem algebraicGamma_trans (u v : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : Algebraic n) :
    algebraicGamma (u.trans v) n x = algebraicGamma v n (algebraicGamma u n x) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change TensorProduct.congrIsometry (u.trans v) (algebraicGamma (u.trans v) n) x =
      TensorProduct.congrIsometry v (algebraicGamma v n) (TensorProduct.congrIsometry u (algebraicGamma u n) x)
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul x y => simp [ih]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

theorem algebraicGamma_inverse (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : Algebraic n) :
    algebraicGamma u.symm n (algebraicGamma u n x) = x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change TensorProduct.congrIsometry u.symm (algebraicGamma u.symm n)
      (TensorProduct.congrIsometry u (algebraicGamma u n) x) = x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul x y => simp [ih]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

abbrev TensorHilbert (n : ℕ) := Completion (Algebraic n)
def tensorGamma (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) : TensorHilbert n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] TensorHilbert n :=
  completionEquiv (algebraicGamma u n)

@[simp] theorem tensorGamma_coe (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : Algebraic n) :
    tensorGamma u n (x : TensorHilbert n) = (algebraicGamma u n x : TensorHilbert n) :=
  completionEquiv_coe _ _

def pureCompleted (n : ℕ) (x : H1) : TensorHilbert n := pureAlgebraic x n
def algebraicSymmetricSpan (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (TensorHilbert n) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pureCompleted n))
/-- Symmetric tensors are constructed as the closed span of diagonal tensor
powers. No assumed symmetry, density, or unitary action is a field of a contract. -/
def symmetricSpace (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (TensorHilbert n) :=
  (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).topologicalClosure
abbrev Sector (n : ℕ) := symmetricSpace n
instance sectorComplete (n : ℕ) : CompleteSpace (Sector n) :=
  (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).isClosed_topologicalClosure.completeSpace_coe

theorem pureCompleted_mem (n : ℕ) (x : H1) : pureCompleted n x ∈ symmetricSpace n :=
  (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).le_topologicalClosure (Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, rfl⟩)

def pureTensor (n : ℕ) (x : H1) : Sector n := ⟨pureCompleted n x, pureCompleted_mem n x⟩

@[simp] theorem pureTensor_norm (n : ℕ) (x : H1) : ‖pureTensor n x‖ = ‖x‖ ^ n := by
  change ‖(pureAlgebraic x n : Completion (Algebraic n))‖ = _
  rw [Completion.norm_coe, pureAlgebraic_norm]

theorem sector_nontrivial (n : ℕ) : Nontrivial (Sector n) := by
  haveI := AuditF13v31.H1_nontrivial
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : H1)
  refine ⟨⟨pureTensor n x, 0, ?_⟩⟩
  intro h
  have hn := pureTensor_norm n x
  rw [h, norm_zero] at hn
  exact (pow_ne_zero n (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx)) hn.symm

theorem tensorGamma_pure (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    tensorGamma u n (pureCompleted n x) = pureCompleted n (u x) := by
  simp only [pureCompleted, tensorGamma_coe, algebraicGamma_pure]

theorem tensorGamma_mem (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) {x : TensorHilbert n}
    (hx : x ∈ symmetricSpace n) : tensorGamma u n x ∈ symmetricSpace n := by
  let S := symmetricSpace n
  have hbase : algebraicSymmetricSpan n ≤ S.comap (tensorGamma u n).toLinearMap := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change tensorGamma u n (pureCompleted n y) ∈ S
    rw [tensorGamma_pure]
    exact pureCompleted_mem n (u y)
  have hclosed : IsClosed (S.comap (tensorGamma u n).toLinearMap : Set (TensorHilbert n)) :=
    (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).isClosed_topologicalClosure.preimage (tensorGamma u n).continuous
  exact (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).topologicalClosure_minimal hbase hclosed hx

theorem tensorGamma_inverse (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : TensorHilbert n) :
    tensorGamma u.symm n (tensorGamma u n x) = x := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq
    ((tensorGamma u.symm n).continuous.comp (tensorGamma u n).continuous) continuous_id) ?_
  intro a
  simp [algebraicGamma_inverse]

def gammaSector (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) : Sector n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Sector n where
  toFun x := ⟨tensorGamma u n x, tensorGamma_mem u n x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨tensorGamma u.symm n x, tensorGamma_mem u.symm n x.property⟩
  left_inv x := by apply Subtype.ext; exact tensorGamma_inverse u n x
  right_inv x := by apply Subtype.ext; simpa using tensorGamma_inverse u.symm n (x : TensorHilbert n)
  map_add' x y := by apply Subtype.ext; exact (tensorGamma u n).map_add x y
  map_smul' c x := by apply Subtype.ext; exact (tensorGamma u n).map_smul c x
  norm_map' x := (tensorGamma u n).norm_map x

@[simp] theorem gammaSector_pure (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    gammaSector u n (pureTensor n x) = pureTensor n (u x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact tensorGamma_pure u n x

theorem tensorGamma_trans (u v : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : TensorHilbert n) :
    tensorGamma (u.trans v) n x = tensorGamma v n (tensorGamma u n x) := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq (tensorGamma (u.trans v) n).continuous
    ((tensorGamma v n).continuous.comp (tensorGamma u n).continuous)) ?_
  intro a
  simp [algebraicGamma_trans]

theorem gammaSector_trans (u v : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) :
    gammaSector (u.trans v) n = (gammaSector u n).trans (gammaSector v n) := by
  ext x
  exact tensorGamma_trans u v n x

theorem gammaSector_refl (n : ℕ) : gammaSector (.refl ℂ H1) n = .refl ℂ (Sector n) := by
  ext x
  change tensorGamma (.refl ℂ H1) n (x : TensorHilbert n) = x
  refine Completion.induction_on (x : TensorHilbert n)
    (isClosed_eq (tensorGamma (.refl ℂ H1) n).continuous continuous_id) ?_
  intro a
  simp [algebraicGamma_refl]

def vacuumSector : Sector 0 := pureTensor 0 (0 : H1)
@[simp] theorem vacuumSector_norm : ‖vacuumSector‖ = 1 := by
  exact (pureTensor_norm 0 (0 : H1)).trans (pow_zero _)
@[simp] theorem gammaSector_vacuum (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) :
    gammaSector u 0 vacuumSector = vacuumSector := by simp [vacuumSector]

def oneParticleEmbedding : H1 →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Sector 1 where
  toFun x := pureTensor 1 x
  map_add' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜 := ℂ)) ((x+y) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1:ℂ)) =
      (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜 := ℂ)) (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1:ℂ)) +
      (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜 := ℂ)) (y ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1:ℂ))
    rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
  map_smul' c x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜 := ℂ)) ((c • x) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1:ℂ)) =
      c • (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜 := ℂ)) (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (1:ℂ))
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul]
  norm_map' x := by exact (pureTensor_norm 1 x).trans (pow_one _)

theorem gammaSector_oneParticle (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (x : H1) :
    gammaSector u 1 (oneParticleEmbedding x) = oneParticleEmbedding (u x) :=
  gammaSector_pure u 1 x

end F1Rede.BosonicSectors

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space
/-! The Hilbert sum and diagonal functor of an actual family of complete Hilbert
sectors. No assertion here supplies the bosonic sectors or Weyl algebras. Those
must be constructed separately before specializing this reusable operation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
noncomputable section
open scoped ENNReal InnerProductSpace

namespace F1Rede.SectorDirectSum
variable {E : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, NormedAddCommGroup (E n)]
  [∀ n, InnerProductSpace ℂ (E n)] [∀ n, CompleteSpace (E n)]

abbrev SumSpace (E : ℕ → Type*) [∀ n, NormedAddCommGroup (E n)] := lp E 2

def diagonalFun (u : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n) (f : SumSpace E) : SumSpace E :=
  ⟨fun n => u n (f n), Memℓp.mono (lp.memℓp f).norm (fun n => by simp)⟩

@[simp] theorem diagonalFun_apply (u : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n)
    (f : SumSpace E) (n : ℕ) : diagonalFun u f n = u n (f n) := rfl

/-- Componentwise unitary action on the completed Hilbert sum. -/
def diagonal (u : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n) : SumSpace E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] SumSpace E where
  toFun := diagonalFun u
  invFun := diagonalFun (fun n => (u n).symm)
  left_inv f := by ext n; simp
  right_inv f := by ext n; simp
  map_add' f g := by ext n; simp [diagonalFun]
  map_smul' c f := by ext n; simp [diagonalFun]
  norm_map' f := by
    rw [lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal),
      lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal)]
    simp

@[simp] theorem diagonal_apply (u : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n)
    (f : SumSpace E) (n : ℕ) : diagonal u f n = u n (f n) := rfl

theorem diagonal_refl :
    diagonal (fun n => LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (E n)) =
      LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (SumSpace E) := by
  ext f n
  rfl

theorem diagonal_trans (u v : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n) :
    diagonal (fun n => (u n).trans (v n)) = (diagonal u).trans (diagonal v) := by
  ext f n
  rfl

/-- Isometric inclusion of each genuine particle sector. -/
def sectorEmbedding (n : ℕ) : E n →ₗᵢ[ℂ] SumSpace E where
  toLinearMap := lp.lsingle 2 n
  norm_map' x := lp.norm_single (by norm_num) n x

@[simp] theorem sectorEmbedding_apply (n : ℕ) (x : E n) :
    sectorEmbedding n x = lp.single 2 n x := rfl

theorem diagonal_single (u : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n) (n : ℕ) (x : E n) :
    diagonal u (sectorEmbedding n x) = sectorEmbedding n (u n x) := by
  ext k
  by_cases h : k = n
  · subst k; simp
  · simp [lp.single_apply_ne, h]

theorem vacuum_fixed (u : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n) (e : E 0)
    (he : u 0 e = e) : diagonal u (sectorEmbedding 0 e) = sectorEmbedding 0 e := by
  rw [diagonal_single, he]

theorem vacuum_norm (e : E 0) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) : ‖sectorEmbedding 0 e‖ = 1 := by
  rw [(sectorEmbedding 0).norm_map, he]

theorem different_sectors_orthogonal (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n ≠ m) (x : E n) (y : E m) :
    ⟪sectorEmbedding n x, sectorEmbedding m y⟫_ℂ = 0 := by
  rw [sectorEmbedding_apply, sectorEmbedding_apply, lp.inner_single_left]
  simp [lp.single_apply_ne, hnm]

end F1Rede.SectorDirectSum

/-! A unit vector in each particle sector produces an infinite orthonormal
family in the Hilbert sum. The application must supply these vectors from

abbrev Sectors (n : ℕ) : Type := Sector n

def vacuum : F := sectorEmbedding (E := Sectors) 0 vacuumSector
def gamma (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F :=

  change ‖sectorEmbedding (E := Sectors) 0 vacuumSector‖ = 1
  rw [(sectorEmbedding (E := Sectors) 0).norm_map, vacuumSector_norm]

  change diagonal (E := Sectors) (fun n => gammaSector (.refl ℂ H1) n) = _
  simp only [gammaSector_refl]
  exact diagonal_refl (E := Sectors)

    gamma (u.trans v) = (gamma u).trans (gamma v) := by
  change diagonal (E := Sectors) (fun n => gammaSector (u.trans v) n) = _
  simp only [gammaSector_trans]
  exact diagonal_trans (E := Sectors) (gammaSector u) (gammaSector v)

  exact F1Rede.SectorDirectSum.vacuum_fixed (E := Sectors) (gammaSector u)
    vacuumSector (gammaSector_vacuum u)

  change diagonal (gammaSector u) (sectorEmbedding 1 (oneParticleEmbedding x)) = _
  rw [diagonal_single, gammaSector_oneParticle]
  rfl

  oneParticle.norm_map x

  exact different_sectors_orthogonal (E := Sectors) 0 1 (by decide)

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : H1)

theorem measurable_of_distances {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) (hf : ∀ y, Measurable (fun x => dist (f x) y)) : Measurable f := by
  apply measurable_of_isOpen
  intro s hs
  let B : Set (Set Y) := {b | ∃ y r, b = Metric.ball y r ∧ b ⊆ s}
  have hB : ∀ b ∈ B, IsOpen b := by
    rintro b ⟨y,r,rfl,_⟩
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hBs : ⋃₀ B = s := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨b, ⟨z,r,rfl,hsub⟩,hy⟩
      exact hsub hy
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨r,hr,hsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hs y hy
      exact ⟨Metric.ball y r, ⟨y,r,rfl,hsub⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hCB,hCover⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_sUnion_countable B hB
  rw [← hBs, ← hCover, Set.preimage_sUnion]
  apply MeasurableSet.biUnion hC
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨y,r,rfl,_⟩ := hCB hb
  exact measurableSet_lt (hf y) measurable_const

variable {α β E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]

theorem memLp_section_ae (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, MemLp (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ := by
  have hint := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).mp (Lp.memLp f)
  filter_upwards [hint.prod_left_ae] with y hy
  exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).comp_measurable (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hy

noncomputable def sectionLp (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) (y : β) : Lp E 2 μ := by
  classical
  exact if h : MemLp (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ then h.toLp (fun x => f (x,y)) else 0

theorem sectionLp_coe_ae (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, (sectionLp f y : α → E) =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f (x,y) := by
  classical
  filter_upwards [memLp_section_ae f] with y hy
  simp only [sectionLp, dif_pos hy]
  exact hy.coeFn_toLp

theorem measurable_section_eLpNorm (f : α × β → E) (hf : StronglyMeasurable f) :
    Measurable (fun y => eLpNorm (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ) := by
  simp_rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)
    (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)]
  exact ((hf.enorm.pow_const _).lintegral_prod_left').pow_const _

theorem measurableSet_good_sections (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
    MeasurableSet {y | MemLp (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ} := by
  have heq : {y | MemLp (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ} =
      {y | eLpNorm (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ < ⊤} := by
    ext y
    exact and_iff_right ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).comp_measurable
      (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [heq]
  exact measurableSet_lt (measurable_section_eLpNorm f (Lp.stronglyMeasurable f)) measurable_const

theorem sectionLp_dist (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) (g : Lp E 2 μ) (y : β)
    (hy : MemLp (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ) :
    dist (sectionLp f y) g = (eLpNorm (fun x => f (x,y) - g x) 2 μ).toReal := by
  classical
  rw [sectionLp, dif_pos hy, Lp.dist_def]
  congr 1
  apply eLpNorm_congr_ae
  exact hy.coeFn_toLp.sub ae_eq_rfl

theorem sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable [IsSeparable μ] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E]
    (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) : StronglyMeasurable (sectionLp f) := by
  classical
  letI : Fact ((2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  borelize ↥(Lp E 2 μ)
  apply Measurable.stronglyMeasurable
  apply measurable_of_distances
  intro g
  have hm : Measurable (fun y => (eLpNorm (fun x => f (x,y) - g x) 2 μ).toReal) :=
    (measurable_section_eLpNorm (fun z => f z - g z.1)
      ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).sub ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable g).comp_measurable measurable_fst))).ennreal_toReal
  have hp : Measurable (fun y => if MemLp (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ then
      (eLpNorm (fun x => f (x,y) - g x) 2 μ).toReal else dist 0 g) :=
    hm.piecewise (measurableSet_good_sections f) (measurable_const (a := dist 0 g))
  convert hp using 1
  ext y
  by_cases hy : MemLp (fun x => f (x,y)) 2 μ
  · simp only [hy, if_true]
    exact sectionLp_dist f g y hy
  · simp [sectionLp, hy]

section RealInner
variable [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

theorem norm_sq_integral (f : Lp E 2 μ) :
    ‖f‖^2 = ∫ x, ‖f x‖^2 ∂μ := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, L2.inner_def]
  simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

theorem sectionLp_norm_ae (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ‖sectionLp f y‖^2 = ∫ x, ‖f (x,y)‖^2 ∂μ := by
  filter_upwards [sectionLp_coe_ae f] with y hy
  rw [norm_sq_integral]
  exact integral_congr_ae (hy.mono fun x hx => by simpa only using congrArg (fun z : E => ‖z‖^2) hx)

theorem norm_sq_disintegration (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
    ‖f‖^2 = ∫ y, ‖sectionLp f y‖^2 ∂ν := by
  rw [norm_sq_integral, integral_prod_symm]
  · exact integral_congr_ae ((sectionLp_norm_ae f).mono fun _ hy => hy.symm)
  · exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).mp (Lp.memLp f)


variable [IsSeparable μ] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E]

theorem sectionLp_memLp (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) : MemLp (sectionLp f) 2 ν := by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable f).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  have hint := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).mp (Lp.memLp f)
  exact hint.integral_prod_right.congr ((sectionLp_norm_ae f).mono fun y hy => hy.symm)

noncomputable def curryLp (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) : Lp (Lp E 2 μ) 2 ν :=
  (sectionLp_memLp f).toLp (sectionLp f)

theorem curryLp_coe_ae (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, (curryLp f y : α → E) =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f (x,y) := by
  filter_upwards [(sectionLp_memLp f).coeFn_toLp, sectionLp_coe_ae f] with y hy hz
  simpa only [curryLp, hy] using hz

theorem curryLp_norm (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) : ‖curryLp f‖ = ‖f‖ := by
  have heq : ‖curryLp f‖^2 = ‖f‖^2 := by
    rw [norm_sq_integral, norm_sq_disintegration]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [(sectionLp_memLp f).coeFn_toLp] with y hy
    exact congrArg (fun v : Lp E 2 μ => ‖v‖^2) hy
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (curryLp f), norm_nonneg f]

theorem ae_ae_reverse {p : α × β → Prop} (h : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.prod ν, p z) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (x,y) := by
  exact Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod (Measure.measurePreserving_swap.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h)

theorem curryLp_add (f g : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) : curryLp (f+g) = curryLp f + curryLp g := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [curryLp_coe_ae (f+g), curryLp_coe_ae f, curryLp_coe_ae g,
    ae_ae_reverse (Lp.coeFn_add f g), Lp.coeFn_add (curryLp f) (curryLp g)] with y hfg hf hg hadd hout
  rw [hout]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hfg, hf, hg, hadd, Lp.coeFn_add (curryLp f y) (curryLp g y)] with x hfgx hfx hgx haddx hsum
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at haddx hsum
  simpa only [Pi.add_apply, hfgx, haddx, hfx, hgx] using hsum.symm

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedField 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]

theorem curryLp_smul (c : 𝕜) (f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν)) : curryLp (c • f) = c • curryLp f := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [curryLp_coe_ae (c • f), curryLp_coe_ae f,
    ae_ae_reverse (Lp.coeFn_smul c f), Lp.coeFn_smul c (curryLp f)] with y hcf hf hsmul hout
  rw [hout]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hcf, hf, hsmul, Lp.coeFn_smul c (curryLp f y)] with x hcfx hfx hsmulx hsum
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at hsmulx hsum
  simpa only [Pi.smul_apply, hcfx, hsmulx, hfx] using hsum.symm

noncomputable def curryLinearIsometry : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν) →ₗᵢ[𝕜] Lp (Lp E 2 μ) 2 ν where
  toFun := curryLp
  map_add' := curryLp_add
  map_smul' := curryLp_smul
  norm_map' := curryLp_norm

theorem rectangle_memLp (g : Lp E 2 μ) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hsf : ν s ≠ ⊤) :
    MemLp ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' s).indicator (fun z : α × β => g z.1)) 2 (μ.prod ν) := by
  classical
  have hm := ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable g).comp_measurable measurable_fst).indicator (hs.preimage measurable_snd)
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  have hg := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable g)).mp (Lp.memLp g)
  have hs1 : Integrable (s.indicator (fun _ : β => (1:ℝ))) ν :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff hs).mpr (integrableOn_const (C := (1:ℝ)) hsf)
  have heq : (fun z : α × β => ‖(Prod.snd ⁻¹' s).indicator (fun z => g z.1) z‖ ^ 2) =
      (fun z : α × β => ‖g z.1‖ ^ 2 * s.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) z.2) := by
    funext z
    by_cases hz : z.2 ∈ s <;> simp [Set.indicator, hz]
  change Integrable (fun z : α × β => ‖(Prod.snd ⁻¹' s).indicator (fun z => g z.1) z‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod ν)
  rw [heq]
  exact hg.mul_prod hs1

theorem indicator_in_range (g : Lp E 2 μ) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hsf : ν s ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ f : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν), curryLp f = indicatorConstLp 2 hs hsf g := by
  classical
  let hrect := rectangle_memLp g hs hsf
  let f := hrect.toLp ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' s).indicator (fun z : α × β => g z.1))
  refine ⟨f, Lp.ext ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [curryLp_coe_ae f, ae_ae_reverse hrect.coeFn_toLp,
    (indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := hs) (hμs := hsf) (c := g))] with y hy hf hi
  rw [hi]
  by_cases hys : y ∈ s
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hys]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hy, hf] with x hxy hfx
    simpa [Set.indicator, hys] using hxy.trans hfx
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hys]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hy, hf, Lp.coeFn_zero (E := E) (p := 2) (μ := μ)] with x hxy hfx hz
    rw [hz]
    simpa [Set.indicator, hys] using hxy.trans hfx

variable [CompleteSpace E]

theorem curryLinearIsometry_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (curryLinearIsometry (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (μ := μ) (ν := ν)) := by
  let L := curryLinearIsometry (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (μ := μ) (ν := ν)
  apply Lp.induction (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤) (fun y => ∃ x, L x = y)
  · intro c s hs hsf
    rw [Lp.simpleFunc.coe_indicatorConst]
    exact indicator_in_range c hs hsf.ne
  · intro f g hf hg hdisj hfr hgr
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hfr
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := hgr
    exact ⟨x+y, by rw [map_add, hx, hy]⟩
  · exact L.isometry.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range

noncomputable def fubiniL2Equiv : Lp E 2 (μ.prod ν) ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] Lp (Lp E 2 μ) 2 ν :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective curryLinearIsometry curryLinearIsometry_surjective
end RealInner

namespace Canonical
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016
open AuditF13v31

/-- Actual vector-valued Fubini currification on the unchanged canonical momentum Hilbert space.
It is constructed from measurable sections, disintegration of the squared norm, and density of
finite-measure indicators; its existence is not an input field. -/
noncomputable def canonicalFub : Lp Fib 2 momentumMeasure ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] RapidityHilbert := by
  letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ Fib := InnerProductSpace.complexToReal
  exact fubiniL2Equiv (𝕜 := ℂ) (μ := (volume : Measure Transverse)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))

/-- The new equivalence really sends f(q,r) to r ↦ [q ↦ f(q,r)] almost everywhere. -/
theorem canonicalFub_sections (f : Lp Fib 2 momentumMeasure) :
    ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), (canonicalFub f r : Transverse → Fib) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun q => f (q,r) := by
  letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ Fib := InnerProductSpace.complexToReal
  exact curryLp_coe_ae f

/-- D1a.1 now has an actual partial Fourier equivalence on H1, without changing H1 or its measure. -/
noncomputable def canonicalPartialFourier : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] RapidityHilbert :=
  partialFourier canonicalFub


/-- Currification preserves the actual rapidity translation; no arbitrary Hilbert-space identification. -/
theorem canonicalFub_shift (s : ℝ) (f : Lp Fib 2 momentumMeasure) :
    canonicalFub (productRapidityShift s f) = TGLV350.Regular.shift s (canonicalFub f) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [canonicalFub_sections (productRapidityShift s f),
    TGLV350.Regular.shift_ae s (canonicalFub f),
    (measurePreserving_sub_right (volume : Measure ℝ) s).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (canonicalFub_sections f),
    ae_ae_reverse (μ := (volume : Measure Transverse)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))
      (productRapidityShift_ae s f)] with r hc hs hf hp
  rw [hs]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hc, hf, hp] with q hqc hqf hqp
  rw [hqc, hqf, hqp]
  simp only [coordinateShift, sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- The canonical orbital boost becomes translation before the partial Fourier transform. -/
theorem canonical_toRapidity_boost (s : ℝ) (f : H1) :
    canonicalFub (toRapidity (B0 s f)) = TGLV350.Regular.shift s (canonicalFub (toRapidity f)) := by
  change canonicalFub (orbitalL2Pullback 0 (orbitalScalarBoost 0 s f)) = _
  rw [orbitalScalarBoost_intertwines, canonicalFub_shift]
  rfl

/-- Fourier convention is pinned by the existing V351 translation theorem (the factor is 2*pi*s). -/
theorem canonicalPartialFourier_boost (s : ℝ) (f : H1) :
    canonicalPartialFourier (B0 s f) =
      TGLV350.Regular.characterMultiplier (2 * Real.pi * s) (canonicalPartialFourier f) := by
  change Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ TransverseFiber (canonicalFub (toRapidity (B0 s f))) = _
  rw [canonical_toRapidity_boost, TGLV350.Regular.fourier_shift]
  rfl

/-- The symbol compatible with B0(-2*pi*t) and mathlib's Fourier normalization. -/
noncomputable def canonicalSigma (ξ : ℝ) : ℝ := 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ξ

/-- The modular-group field of D1a.3 has a concrete spectral representation; no claim about J or S. -/
theorem canonical_modularGroupIsBoost : ModularGroupIsBoost canonicalPartialFourier canonicalSigma := by
  intro t f
  rw [canonicalPartialFourier_boost]
  filter_upwards [TGLV350.Regular.characterMultiplier_ae
    (2 * Real.pi * (-(2 * Real.pi * t))) (canonicalPartialFourier f)] with ξ hξ
  rw [hξ]
  congr 1
  unfold canonicalSigma
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
abbrev VH (H : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup H] := Lp H 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)

def A (c : ℝ) : VH H →L[ℂ] VH H :=
  realScalarMultiplier (spectralWeightA c) (spectral_weightA_continuous c)
    (fun x => (spectral_weightA_pos c x).le) (spectral_weightA_le_one c)
def B (c : ℝ) : VH H →L[ℂ] VH H :=
  realScalarMultiplier (spectralWeightB c) (spectral_weightB_continuous c)
    (fun x => (spectral_weightB_pos c x).le) (spectral_weightB_le_one c)
theorem A_ae (c : ℝ) (f : VH H) : A c f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (spectralWeightA c x : ℂ) • f x :=
  realScalarMultiplier_ae _ _ _ _ f
theorem B_ae (c : ℝ) (f : VH H) : B c f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (spectralWeightB c x : ℂ) • f x :=
  realScalarMultiplier_ae _ _ _ _ f

theorem scalar_selfadjoint (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (h1 : ∀ x, w x ≤ 1) : IsSelfAdjoint (realScalarMultiplier (H := H) w hw h0 h1) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr
  intro f g
  simp only [L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [realScalarMultiplier_ae w hw h0 h1 f,
    realScalarMultiplier_ae w hw h0 h1 g] with x hf hg
  change inner ℂ ((realScalarMultiplier w hw h0 h1 f) x) (g x) = inner ℂ (f x) ((realScalarMultiplier w hw h0 h1 g) x)
  rw [hf,hg]
  simp [inner_smul_left,inner_smul_right]

theorem A_selfadjoint (c : ℝ) : IsSelfAdjoint (A (H := H) c) := scalar_selfadjoint _ _ _ _
theorem B_selfadjoint (c : ℝ) : IsSelfAdjoint (B (H := H) c) := scalar_selfadjoint _ _ _ _
theorem A_injective (c : ℝ) : Function.Injective (A (H := H) c) :=
  realScalarMultiplier_injective _ _ _ _ (spectral_weightA_pos c)

theorem AB_commute (c : ℝ) : A (H := H) c * B c = B c * A c := by
  ext1 f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [A_ae c (B c f), B_ae c (A c f), A_ae c f, B_ae c f] with x hab hba ha hb
  change (A c (B c f)) x = (B c (A c f)) x
  rw [hab,hba,ha,hb,smul_smul,smul_smul,mul_comm]

theorem AB_square_sum (c : ℝ) : A (H := H) c * A c + B c * B c = 1 := by
  ext1 f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [A_ae c (A c f), B_ae c (B c f), A_ae c f, B_ae c f,
    Lp.coeFn_add (A c (A c f)) (B c (B c f))] with x haa hbb ha hb hadd
  change (A c (A c f) + B c (B c f)) x = f x
  rw [hadd]
  change (A c (A c f)) x + (B c (B c f)) x = f x
  rw [haa,hbb,ha,hb,smul_smul,smul_smul,← add_smul]
  have heq : (spectralWeightA c x : ℂ) * spectralWeightA c x +
      (spectralWeightB c x : ℂ) * spectralWeightB c x = 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast (by simpa only [pow_two] using spectral_weight_square_sum c x)
  rw [heq,one_smul]

theorem AB_positive (c : ℝ) (f : VH H) : 0 ≤ (inner ℂ (A c f) (B c f)).re := by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  change 0 ≤ RCLike.re (∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (A c f x) (B c f x))
  rw [← integral_re (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (A c f) (B c f))]
  apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
  filter_upwards [A_ae c f,B_ae c f] with x ha hb
  change 0 ≤ (inner ℂ (A c f x) (B c f x)).re
  rw [ha,hb]
  have heq : (inner ℂ ((spectralWeightA c x : ℂ) • f x)
      ((spectralWeightB c x : ℂ) • f x)).re =
      spectralWeightA c x * spectralWeightB c x * ‖f x‖^2 := by
    simp [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, Complex.mul_re, ← Complex.ofReal_pow]
    <;> ring
  rw [heq]
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (spectral_weightA_pos c x).le (spectral_weightB_pos c x).le) (sq_nonneg _)

def T (c : ℝ) : VH H →ₗ.[ℂ] VH H := boundedGraphOperator (A (H := H) c) (B (H := H) c) (A_injective (H := H) c)
theorem T_dense (c : ℝ) : Dense ((T (H := H) c).domain : Set (VH H)) :=
  bounded_graph_domain_dense (A (H := H) c) (B (H := H) c) (A_injective (H := H) c) (A_selfadjoint (H := H) c)
theorem T_selfadjoint (c : ℝ) : IsSelfAdjoint (T (H := H) c) :=
  bounded_graph_selfadjoint (A (H := H) c) (B (H := H) c) (A_injective (H := H) c) (A_selfadjoint (H := H) c) (B_selfadjoint (H := H) c)
    (AB_commute (H := H) c) (AB_square_sum (H := H) c)
theorem T_positive (c : ℝ) (f : (T (H := H) c).domain) :
    0 ≤ (inner ℂ (f : VH H) (T c f)).re :=
  bounded_graph_positive (A (H := H) c) (B (H := H) c) (A_injective (H := H) c) (AB_positive (H := H) c) f

theorem T_graph (c : ℝ) (f g : VH H) :
    (f,g) ∈ (T c).graph ↔ g =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (Real.exp (-c*x) : ℂ) • f x := by
  change (f,g) ∈ (boundedGraphOperator (A (H := H) c) (B (H := H) c) (A_injective (H := H) c)).graph ↔ _
  rw [bounded_graph_equation_iff (A (H := H) c) (B (H := H) c) (A_injective (H := H) c) (AB_commute (H := H) c) (AB_square_sum (H := H) c)]
  have hr (x : ℝ) : (spectralWeightB c x : ℂ) =
      (Real.exp (-c*x) : ℂ) * spectralWeightA c x := by exact_mod_cast spectral_weight_ratio c x
  constructor
  · intro hfg
    filter_upwards [B_ae c f,A_ae c g] with x hb ha
    have he := congrArg (fun u : VH H => u x) hfg
    rw [hb,ha,hr, mul_comm, mul_smul] at he
    exact (smul_right_injective H (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (spectral_weightA_pos c x).ne')) he.symm
  · intro hfg
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [B_ae c f,A_ae c g,hfg] with x hb ha hg
    rw [hb,ha,hg,hr,smul_smul,mul_comm]

#print axioms T_selfadjoint
#print axioms T_positive
#print axioms T_graph
end F1Rede.Wedge

  have hc := jc.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL (reflection f)

  filter_upwards [hc,hr] with x hx hrx
  change (jc.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 volume (reflection f)) x = _
  rw [hx]
  change jc ((reflection f) x) = _

  rw [hrx]

  intro f

        filter_upwards [jc.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL (reflection g)] with x hx
        change ‖(jc.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 volume (reflection g)) x‖ ≤ _
        rw [hx]
        exact (jc.norm_map ((reflection g) x)).le

def fiberConj (v : Fib) : Fib := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => star (v i))

@[simp] theorem fiberConj_apply (v : Fib) (i : Fin 2) :
    fiberConj v i = star (v i) := rfl

theorem fiberConj_involutive : Function.Involutive fiberConj := by
  intro v
  ext i
  simp

def fiberJ : Fib ≃ₛₗᵢ[starRingEnd ℂ] Fib where
  toFun := fiberConj
  invFun := fiberConj
  left_inv := fiberConj_involutive
  right_inv := fiberConj_involutive
  map_add' := by intro x y; ext i; simp [fiberConj]
  map_smul' := by intro c x; ext i; simp [fiberConj]
  norm_map' := by
    intro v
    change ‖fiberConj v‖ = ‖v‖
    simp only [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, fiberConj_apply, norm_star]

@[simp] theorem fiberJ_apply (v : Fib) (i : Fin 2) :
    fiberJ v i = star (v i) := rfl

theorem fiberJ_involutive : Function.Involutive fiberJ := fiberConj_involutive

  fiberJ.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpₗ 2 volume

theorem transverseConj_ae (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure Transverse), transverseConj f q = fiberJ (f q) :=
  fiberJ.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLp f

theorem transverseConj_involutive : Function.Involutive transverseConj := by
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [transverseConj_ae (transverseConj f), transverseConj_ae f] with q h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, fiberJ_involutive]

theorem transverseConj_norm (f : TransverseFiber) : ‖transverseConj f‖ = ‖f‖ := by
  simp only [Lp.norm_def]
  congr 1
  apply eLpNorm_congr_norm_ae
  filter_upwards [transverseConj_ae f] with q hq
  rw [hq, fiberJ.norm_map]

def transverseJ : TransverseFiber ≃ₛₗᵢ[starRingEnd ℂ] TransverseFiber where
  toFun := transverseConj
  invFun := transverseConj
  left_inv := transverseConj_involutive
  right_inv := transverseConj_involutive
  map_add' := transverseConj.map_add
  map_smul' := transverseConj.map_smulₛₗ
  norm_map' := transverseConj_norm

  transverseConj_involutive

theorem transverseJ_ae (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure Transverse), transverseJ f q = fiberJ (f q) :=
  transverseConj_ae f

theorem transverseJ_coordinates (f : TransverseFiber) :

      transverseJ f q i = star (f q i) := by
  filter_upwards [transverseJ_ae f] with q hq
  intro i
  rw [hq, fiberJ_apply]

/-! A geometric candidate: transverse reflection and exchange of the two existing
fiber components, composed with coordinate conjugation. The pointwise formula and
involution are proved. No identification with global PCT is asserted. -/

def helicitySwap : Fin 2 ≃ Fin 2 := Equiv.swap 0 1

@[simp] theorem helicitySwap_twice (i : Fin 2) : helicitySwap (helicitySwap i) = i := by
  simp [helicitySwap]

def fiberSwap : Fib ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Fib :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ helicitySwap

@[simp] theorem fiberSwap_apply (v : Fib) (i : Fin 2) :
    fiberSwap v i = v (helicitySwap i) := by
  rfl

def fiberSwappedJ : Fib ≃ₛₗᵢ[starRingEnd ℂ] Fib := fiberJ.trans fiberSwap

@[simp] theorem fiberSwappedJ_apply (v : Fib) (i : Fin 2) :
    fiberSwappedJ v i = star (v (helicitySwap i)) := rfl

theorem fiberSwappedJ_involutive : Function.Involutive fiberSwappedJ := by
  intro v
  ext i
  simp

def transverseNeg : TransverseFiber →ₗᵢ[ℂ] TransverseFiber :=
  Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ (fun q : Transverse => -q)
    (Measure.measurePreserving_neg volume)

theorem transverseNeg_ae (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure Transverse), transverseNeg f q = f (-q) :=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (Measure.measurePreserving_neg volume)

def swappedPointwise : TransverseFiber →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] TransverseFiber :=
  fiberSwappedJ.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpₗ 2 volume

theorem swappedPointwise_ae (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure Transverse), swappedPointwise f q = fiberSwappedJ (f q) :=
  fiberSwappedJ.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLp f

theorem swappedPointwise_norm (f : TransverseFiber) : ‖swappedPointwise f‖ = ‖f‖ := by
  simp only [Lp.norm_def]
  congr 1
  apply eLpNorm_congr_norm_ae
  filter_upwards [swappedPointwise_ae f] with q hq
  rw [hq, fiberSwappedJ.norm_map]

def transverseGeometricConj : TransverseFiber →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] TransverseFiber :=
  swappedPointwise.comp transverseNeg.toLinearMap

theorem transverseGeometricConj_ae (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure Transverse),
      transverseGeometricConj f q = fiberSwappedJ (f (-q)) := by
  filter_upwards [swappedPointwise_ae (transverseNeg f), transverseNeg_ae f] with q h1 h2
  change swappedPointwise (transverseNeg f) q = _
  rw [h1, h2]

theorem transverseGeometricConj_involutive : Function.Involutive transverseGeometricConj := by
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [transverseGeometricConj_ae (transverseGeometricConj f),
    (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure Transverse)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (transverseGeometricConj_ae f)] with q h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp only [neg_neg]
  exact fiberSwappedJ_involutive (f q)

theorem transverseGeometricConj_norm (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ‖transverseGeometricConj f‖ = ‖f‖ := by
  change ‖swappedPointwise (transverseNeg f)‖ = _
  rw [swappedPointwise_norm, transverseNeg.norm_map]

def transverseGeometricJ : TransverseFiber ≃ₛₗᵢ[starRingEnd ℂ] TransverseFiber where
  toFun := transverseGeometricConj
  invFun := transverseGeometricConj
  left_inv := transverseGeometricConj_involutive
  right_inv := transverseGeometricConj_involutive
  map_add' := transverseGeometricConj.map_add
  map_smul' := transverseGeometricConj.map_smulₛₗ
  norm_map' := transverseGeometricConj_norm

theorem transverseGeometricJ_involutive : Function.Involutive transverseGeometricJ :=
  transverseGeometricConj_involutive

theorem transverseGeometricJ_ae (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure Transverse), transverseGeometricJ f q = fiberSwappedJ (f (-q)) :=
  transverseGeometricConj_ae f

theorem transverseGeometricJ_coordinates (f : TransverseFiber) :
    ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure Transverse), ∀ i : Fin 2,
      transverseGeometricJ f q i = star (f (-q) (helicitySwap i)) := by
  filter_upwards [transverseGeometricJ_ae f] with q hq
  intro i
  rw [hq, fiberSwappedJ_apply]

#print axioms transverseGeometricJ_coordinates

  invFun := diagonalAntiFun (fun n => (j n).symm)
  left_inv f := by ext n; simp
  right_inv f := by ext n; simp

  · simp [lp.single_apply_ne, h]

The sectorwise continuity hypothesis is explicit; no uniform continuity in n is assumed.
