variable {E : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, NormedAddCommGroup (E n)]
  [∀ n, InnerProductSpace ℂ (E n)] [∀ n, CompleteSpace (E n)]

theorem norm_sq_eq_tsum (f : SumSpace E) : ‖f‖^2 = ∑' n, ‖f n‖^2 := by
  simpa using lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) f

theorem summable_norm_sq (f : SumSpace E) : Summable (fun n => ‖f n‖^2) := by
  simpa using (lp.memℓp f).summable (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal)

theorem sector_difference_bound (v w : ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n) (f : SumSpace E) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖v n (f n) - w n (f n)‖^2 ≤ 4 * ‖f n‖^2 := by
  have hb : ‖v n (f n) - w n (f n)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖f n‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖v n (f n)‖ + ‖w n (f n)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = 2 * ‖f n‖ := by rw [(v n).norm_map,(w n).norm_map]; ring
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 * ‖f n‖)^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hb 2
    _ = 4 * ‖f n‖^2 := by ring

/-- Strong continuity sector by sector implies strong continuity on the entire Hilbert sum. -/
theorem diagonal_strongly_continuous {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    (u : A → ∀ n, E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E n)
    (hu : ∀ n (x : E n), Continuous (fun a => u a n x))
    (f : SumSpace E) : Continuous (fun a => diagonal (u a) f) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro a0
  have ht := tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence (𝓕 := 𝓝 a0)
    (f := fun a n => ‖u a n (f n) - u a0 n (f n)‖^2)
    (g := fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ))
    (bound := fun n => 4 * ‖f n‖^2)
    ((summable_norm_sq f).mul_left 4)
    (fun n => by
      have hc : Continuous (fun a => u a n (f n) - u a0 n (f n)) :=
        (hu n (f n)).sub continuous_const
      simpa using (hc.norm.pow 2).tendsto a0)
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun a n => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact sector_difference_bound (u a) (u a0) f n))
  have hsq : Tendsto (fun a => ‖diagonal (u a) f - diagonal (u a0) f‖^2)
      (𝓝 a0) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [norm_sq_eq_tsum, lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply, diagonal_apply, tsum_zero] using ht
  have hsqrt := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hsq
  apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_norm, Real.sqrt_zero, dist_eq_norm] using hsqrt

      (S.mapEquiv (e.restrictScalars ℝ)).mulI := by
  ext x
  change x ∈ S.mulI.mapEquiv (e.restrictScalars ℝ) ↔
    x ∈ (S.mapEquiv (e.restrictScalars ℝ)).mulI
  simp only [ClosedSubmodule.mulI, ClosedSubmodule.mem_mapEquiv_iff,
    scalarSMulCLE_symm_apply, Units.smul_def, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val,
    Complex.val_UnitI, Complex.inv_I]
  change (-Complex.I) • e.symm x ∈ S ↔ e.symm ((-Complex.I) • x) ∈ S
  rw [map_smul]

/-- Standardness is proved by transport through a complex linear equivalence. -/
def transportStandard (e : L2R ≃L[ℂ] L2R) (K : StandardSubspace L2R) :
    StandardSubspace L2R where
  toClosedSubmodule := K.toClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv (e.restrictScalars ℝ)
  IsSeparating := by
    rw [← transport_mulI, ← ClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv_inf_eq,
      K.IsSeparating, ClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv_bot_eq_bot]
  IsCyclic := by
    rw [← transport_mulI, ← ClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv_sup_eq,
      K.IsCyclic, ClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv_top_eq_top]

/-- K(a) = U(a) K(0), with the existing O16 standard subspace at a=0. -/
def halfline (a : ℝ) : StandardSubspace L2R :=
  transportStandard (translationEquiv a) (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2))

theorem mem_halfline (a : ℝ) (f : L2R) :
    f ∈ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule ↔
      U (-a) f ∈ (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule :=
  ClosedSubmodule.mem_mapEquiv_iff _ _ _

theorem mem_halfline_image (a : ℝ) (f : L2R) :
    f ∈ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule ↔
      ∃ g ∈ (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule, U a g = f := by
  rw [mem_halfline]
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨U (-a) f, hf, ?_⟩
    simpa only [neg_neg] using translation_inv_apply (-a) f
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    simpa only [translation_inv_apply] using hg

theorem halfline_zero :
    (halfline 0).toClosedSubmodule =
      (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule := by
  ext f
  change f ∈ (halfline 0).toClosedSubmodule ↔
    f ∈ (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule
  rw [mem_halfline]
  simp only [neg_zero, U_zero, one_apply_eq_self]

/-- Inclusion follows from the proved O16 half-sided isotony. -/
theorem halfline_antitone {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (halfline b).toClosedSubmodule ≤ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule := by
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := (mem_halfline_image b f).mp hf
  rw [mem_halfline, ← translation_add_apply]
  exact halfline_isotony (-a+b) (by linarith) g hg

/-- Every real translation transports the actual half-line, in both directions. -/
theorem translation_covariance (t a : ℝ) (f : L2R) :
    U t f ∈ (halfline (t+a)).toClosedSubmodule ↔
      f ∈ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule := by
  rw [mem_halfline, mem_halfline, ← translation_add_apply]
  have heq : -(t+a)+t = -a := by ring
  rw [heq]

theorem translation_image (t a : ℝ) :
    (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv ((translationEquiv t).restrictScalars ℝ) =
      (halfline (t+a)).toClosedSubmodule := by
  ext f
  change f ∈ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv
    ((translationEquiv t).restrictScalars ℝ) ↔ f ∈ (halfline (t+a)).toClosedSubmodule
  rw [ClosedSubmodule.mem_mapEquiv_iff]
  change U (-t) f ∈ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule ↔
    f ∈ (halfline (t+a)).toClosedSubmodule
  have h := translation_covariance t a (U (-t) f)
  simpa only [show U t (U (-t) f) = f from by
    simpa only [neg_neg] using translation_inv_apply (-t) f] using h.symm

/-- The ray cannot supply faithful four-dimensional translations through one
linear coordinate. This is a proved negative control, not a missing import. -/
theorem no_four_dimensional_promotion (ell : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ a : Fin 4 → ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ U (ell a) = 1 :=
  lightray_not_faithful_in_four U 1 U_zero ell

theorem phase_reflection (s x : ℝ) :
    star (characterPhase s (-x)) = characterPhase s x := by
  simp only [characterPhase, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj]
  congr 1
  simp

/-- The multiplier preserves the actual domain and fixed-point equation of
Tomita. Domain membership is obtained from the proved multiplier graph. -/
theorem character_preserves_standard (c s : ℝ) (f : L2R)
    (hf : f ∈ (continuousStandardSubspace c).toClosedSubmodule) :
    characterMultiplier s f ∈ (continuousStandardSubspace c).toClosedSubmodule := by
  obtain ⟨hdom, hfixed⟩ := (continuous_standard_fixed_iff c f).mp hf
  have hgraph : (characterMultiplier s f,
      characterMultiplier s (continuousModularOperator c ⟨f, hdom⟩)) ∈
      (continuousModularOperator c).graph := by
    apply (continuous_modular_graph_iff c _ _).mpr
    filter_upwards [characterMultiplier_ae s (continuousModularOperator c ⟨f, hdom⟩),
      continuous_modular_apply_ae c ⟨f, hdom⟩, characterMultiplier_ae s f]
      with x h1 h2 h3
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1 h3
    rw [h1, h2, h3]
    ring
  have hdom' := LinearPMap.mem_domain_of_mem_graph hgraph
  apply (continuous_standard_fixed_iff c _).mpr
  refine ⟨hdom', ?_⟩
  apply Lp.ext
  have hfix := continuous_tomita_apply_ae c ⟨f, hdom⟩
  rw [hfixed] at hfix
  have hcharNeg := (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (characterMultiplier_ae s f)
  filter_upwards [continuous_tomita_apply_ae c ⟨characterMultiplier s f, hdom'⟩,
    characterMultiplier_ae s f, hcharNeg, hfix] with x h1 h2 h3 h4
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h2 h3
  change characterMultiplier s f (-x) = characterPhase s (-x) * f (-x) at h3
  change characterMultiplier s f x = characterPhase s x * f x at h2
  rw [h1, h3, star_mul, phase_reflection, h2, h4]
  ring

theorem dilation_preserves_origin (s : ℝ) (f : L2R)
    (hf : f ∈ (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule) :
    D s f ∈ (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule := by
  rw [rapidity_standard_mem, fourier_dilation]
  exact character_preserves_standard _ _ _ ((rapidity_standard_mem _ _).mp hf)

theorem dilation_origin_iff (s : ℝ) (f : L2R) :
    D s f ∈ (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule ↔
      f ∈ (rapidityStandardSubspace (2 * Real.pi^2)).toClosedSubmodule := by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have h := dilation_preserves_origin (-s) (D s f) hf
    have hinv : D (-s) (D s f) = f := by simpa only [neg_neg] using D_inv (-s) f
    rwa [hinv] at h
  · exact dilation_preserves_origin s f

theorem dilation_intertwines (s a : ℝ) (f : L2R) :
    D s (U a f) = U (Real.exp (-s) * a) (D s f) := by
  have hinv : D (-s) (D s f) = f := by simpa only [neg_neg] using D_inv (-s) f
  simpa only [hinv] using borchers_dilation s a (D s f)

/-- Exact dilation covariance of the constructed half-lines. -/
theorem dilation_covariance (s a : ℝ) (f : L2R) :
    D s f ∈ (halfline (Real.exp (-s) * a)).toClosedSubmodule ↔
      f ∈ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule := by
  rw [mem_halfline, mem_halfline]
  have heq : -(Real.exp (-s) * a) = Real.exp (-s) * (-a) := by ring
  rw [heq, ← dilation_intertwines]
  exact dilation_origin_iff s (U (-a) f)

/-- Non-vacuity follows from cyclicity and the already proved faithfulness
of the concrete null translations, without a new inhabitedness hypothesis. -/
theorem halfline_ne_bot (a : ℝ) : (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule ≠ ⊥ := by
  intro hbot
  have hc := (halfline a).IsCyclic
  have hzero : (⊥ : ClosedSubmodule ℝ L2R) = ⊤ := by
    simpa only [hbot, ClosedSubmodule.mulI, ClosedSubmodule.mapEquiv_bot_eq_bot,
      sup_bot_eq] using hc
  have all_zero (f : L2R) : f = 0 := by
    have hm : f ∈ (⊥ : ClosedSubmodule ℝ L2R) := by rw [hzero]; trivial
    exact hm
  have hu : U 1 = 1 := by
    ext1 f
    change U 1 f = f
    rw [all_zero (U 1 f), all_zero f]
  have impossible := U_faithful 1 hu
  norm_num at impossible

theorem halfline_exists_nonzero (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ f ∈ (halfline a).toClosedSubmodule, f ≠ 0 := by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply halfline_ne_bot a
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro f hf
  change f = 0
  exact h f hf

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BosonicGammaJR5
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BosonicFockContinuity
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Algebra.Exponential
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exponential
import Mathlib.Analysis.Analytic.Uniqueness
import Mathlib.Analysis.Analytic.OfScalars
/-! Exponential vectors in the previously constructed canonical bosonic Fock space.
The sectors and Hilbert direct sum are imported unchanged. This module constructs
the vectors by a proved l2 estimate; neither membership nor their inner kernel is
assumed as a field. No Weyl, Tomita, KMS, or global net theorem is asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000
noncomputable section
open UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal
namespace F1Fecho.Exponential
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicSectors F1Rede.BosonicFock

theorem pureAlgebraic_inner (x y : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    inner ℂ (pureAlgebraic x n) (pureAlgebraic y n) = (inner ℂ x y)^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => change inner ℂ (1 : ℂ) 1 = _; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    change inner ℂ (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic x n) (y ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic y n) = _
    rw [TensorProduct.inner_tmul, ih, pow_succ, mul_comm]

theorem pureTensor_inner (x y : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    inner ℂ (pureTensor n x) (pureTensor n y) = (inner ℂ x y)^n := by
  change inner ℂ (pureAlgebraic x n : Completion (Algebraic n))
    (pureAlgebraic y n : Completion (Algebraic n)) = _
  rw [Completion.inner_coe, pureAlgebraic_inner]

theorem pureAlgebraic_smul (z : ℂ) (x : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    pureAlgebraic (z • x) n = z^n • pureAlgebraic x n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => change (1 : ℂ) = z^0 • (1 : ℂ); simp
  | succ n ih =>
    change (z • x) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic (z • x) n = z^(n+1) • (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic x n)
    rw [ih, TensorProduct.smul_tmul_smul, pow_succ']

theorem pureTensor_smul (z : ℂ) (x : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    pureTensor n (z • x) = z^n • pureTensor n x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (pureAlgebraic (z • x) n : Completion (Algebraic n)) =
    z^n • (pureAlgebraic x n : Completion (Algebraic n))
  rw [pureAlgebraic_smul, Completion.coe_smul]

def weight (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹

theorem weight_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < weight n := by
  unfold weight
  positivity

theorem weight_sq (n : ℕ) : weight n ^ 2 = (n.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
  unfold weight
  rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]

theorem complex_weight_sq (n : ℕ) : (weight n : ℂ)^2 = (n.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
    congrArg (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ)) (weight_sq n)

def component (x : H1) (n : ℕ) : Sector n := (weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n x

theorem component_norm_sq (x : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖component x n‖^2 = (‖x‖^2)^n / (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
  rw [component, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (weight_pos n), pureTensor_norm,
    mul_pow, weight_sq]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
  ring

theorem component_inner (x y : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    inner ℂ (component x n) (component y n) = (inner ℂ x y)^n / (n.factorial : ℂ) := by
  change inner ℂ ((weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n x) ((weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n y) = _
  rw [_root_.inner_smul_left (pureTensor n x) ((weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n y) (weight n : ℂ),
    _root_.inner_smul_right (pureTensor n x) (pureTensor n y) (weight n : ℂ), pureTensor_inner]
  simp only [Complex.conj_ofReal, ← mul_assoc]
  rw [← pow_two, complex_weight_sq, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

theorem component_mem_lp (x : H1) : Memℓp (component x) 2 := by
  apply (memℓp_gen_iff (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal)).mpr
  have hs := NormedSpace.expSeries_div_summable (‖x‖^2)
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, component_norm_sq] using hs

def exponential (x : H1) : F := ⟨component x, component_mem_lp x⟩

@[simp] theorem exponential_apply (x : H1) (n : ℕ) : exponential x n = component x n := rfl

theorem exponential_inner (x y : H1) :
    inner ℂ (exponential x) (exponential y) = Complex.exp (inner ℂ x y) := by
  have hs := lp.hasSum_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (exponential x) (exponential y)
  simp only [exponential_apply, component_inner] at hs
  have he := NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (inner ℂ x y)
  rw [← Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ] at he
  exact hs.unique he

theorem exponential_norm_sq (x : H1) : ‖exponential x‖^2 = Real.exp (‖x‖^2) := by
  rw [F1Rede.SectorStrongContinuity.norm_sq_eq_tsum]
  simp only [exponential_apply, component_norm_sq]
  have he := NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (‖x‖^2)
  rw [← Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ] at he
  exact he.tsum_eq

end F1Fecho.Exponential

#print axioms F1Fecho.Exponential.component_mem_lp

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ExponentialVectorsR3
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Submodule
/-! Totality is derived by uniqueness of a scalar analytic power series and by
the actual closed-span definition of each existing symmetric sector. No density
assumption, alternative Fock space, or nonzero placeholder is introduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology UniformSpace
namespace F1Fecho.Exponential
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicSectors F1Rede.BosonicFock

theorem component_smul (z : ℂ) (x : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    component (z • x) n = z^n • component x n := by
  simp only [component, pureTensor_smul, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm]

def coefficient (v : F) (x : H1) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  inner ℂ (v n) (component x n)

theorem scalar_series (v : F) (x : H1) (z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n => z^n * coefficient v x n) (inner ℂ v (exponential (z • x))) := by
  have hs := lp.hasSum_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) v (exponential (z • x))
  have he : (fun n => inner ℂ (v n) (exponential (z • x) n)) =
      (fun n => z^n * coefficient v x n) := by
    funext n
    change inner ℂ (v n) (component (z • x) n) = _
    rw [component_smul]
    exact _root_.inner_smul_right (v n) (component x n) (z^n)
  rw [he] at hs
  exact hs

theorem coefficients_zero_of_orthogonal (v : F)
    (hv : ∀ x : H1, inner ℂ v (exponential x) = 0) (x : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient v x n = 0 := by
  let p := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ (coefficient v x)
  have hp : HasFPowerSeriesAt (0 : ℂ → ℂ) p 0 := by
    apply hasFPowerSeriesAt_iff.mpr
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro z
    simpa only [p, FormalMultilinearSeries.coeff_ofScalars, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply,
      hv] using scalar_series v x z
  have he := hp.apply_eq_zero n (1 : ℂ)
  simpa only [p, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq, one_pow, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one] using he

theorem pure_inner_zero_of_orthogonal (v : F)
    (hv : ∀ x : H1, inner ℂ v (exponential x) = 0) (x : H1) (n : ℕ) :
    inner ℂ (v n) (pureTensor n x) = 0 := by
  have h := coefficients_zero_of_orthogonal v hv x n
  unfold coefficient component at h
  rw [_root_.inner_smul_right (v n) (pureTensor n x) (weight n : ℂ)] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (weight_pos n)))

theorem sector_eq_zero_of_pure_inner_zero (n : ℕ) (v : Sector n)
    (hv : ∀ x : H1, inner ℂ v (pureTensor n x) = 0) : v = 0 := by
  let f : TensorHilbert n →L[ℂ] ℂ := innerSL ℂ (v : TensorHilbert n)
  have hspan : algebraicSymmetricSpan n ≤ LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change inner ℂ (v : TensorHilbert n) (pureCompleted n x) = 0
    exact hv x
  have hclosure : symmetricSpace n ≤ LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap :=
    (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).topologicalClosure_minimal hspan f.isClosed_ker
  have he : inner ℂ (v : TensorHilbert n) (v : TensorHilbert n) = 0 :=
    hclosure v.property
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact inner_self_eq_zero.mp he

theorem exponential_orthogonal_zero (v : F)
    (hv : ∀ x : H1, inner ℂ v (exponential x) = 0) : v = 0 := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  exact sector_eq_zero_of_pure_inner_zero n (v n)
    (fun x => pure_inner_zero_of_orthogonal v hv x n)

theorem exponential_total :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential)).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff.mpr
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro v hv
  change v = 0
  apply exponential_orthogonal_zero v
  intro x
  exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal' _ v).mp hv (exponential x)
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, rfl⟩)

theorem gamma_exponential (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (x : H1) :
    gamma u (exponential x) = exponential (u x) := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change gammaSector u n (component x n) = component (u x) n
  simp only [component, map_smul, gammaSector_pure]

theorem gammaJ_exponential (j : H1 ≃ₛₗᵢ[starRingEnd ℂ] H1)
    (hj : Function.Involutive j) (x : H1) :
    F1Fecho.Antilinear.gammaJ j hj (exponential x) = exponential (j x) := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change F1Fecho.Antilinear.sectorJ j hj n (component x n) = component (j x) n
  change F1Fecho.Antilinear.sectorJ j hj n ((weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n x) =
    (weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n (j x)
  rw [(F1Fecho.Antilinear.sectorJ j hj n).map_smulₛₗ (weight n : ℂ) (pureTensor n x),
    F1Fecho.Antilinear.sectorJ_pure]
  change star (weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n (j x) = _
  rw [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]

theorem exponential_zero : exponential 0 = vacuum := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change component 0 n = (lp.single (E := Sectors) 2 0 vacuumSector) n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [component, weight, vacuumSector]
  | succ n =>
    have hs : (lp.single (E := Sectors) 2 0 vacuumSector) (n+1) = 0 :=
      lp.single_apply_ne (E := Sectors) 2 0 vacuumSector (by omega)
    calc
      component 0 (n+1) = 0 := by
        apply norm_eq_zero.mp
        rw [component, norm_smul, pureTensor_norm, norm_zero, zero_pow (by omega), mul_zero]
      _ = _ := hs.symm

end F1Fecho.Exponential

import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.LinearMap
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LinearCombination
/-!
Gram-preserving transport on a total family, extended by the existing bounded
linear extension theorem. No linear independence, isometry, extension or inverse
is assumed. Totality of the target family is needed only for surjectivity.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.GramExtension

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {ι : Type*}
variable {E F : Type*}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F]

abbrev Total (f : ι → E) : Prop :=
  (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range f)).topologicalClosure = ⊤

abbrev GramEqual (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, inner 𝕜 (g i) (g j) = inner 𝕜 (f i) (f j)

theorem linearCombination_inner (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (a b : ι →₀ 𝕜) :
    inner 𝕜 (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 g a) (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 g b) =
      inner 𝕜 (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f a) (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f b) := by
  classical
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, sum_inner, inner_sum,
    inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, hg]

theorem linearCombination_norm (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (a : ι →₀ 𝕜) :
    ‖Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 g a‖ = ‖Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f a‖ := by
  rw [norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜), norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜)]
  rw [linearCombination_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg]

theorem dense_linearCombination (f : ι → E) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f) :
    DenseRange (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f) := by
  have h : Dense (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range f) : Set E) :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr hf
  change Dense (Set.range (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f))
  simpa only [← Finsupp.range_linearCombination, LinearMap.coe_range] using h

variable [CompleteSpace F]

def extensionMap (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F) : E →L[𝕜] F :=
  (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 g).extendOfNorm (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f)

theorem extensionMap_linearCombination (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f) (a : ι →₀ 𝕜) :
    extensionMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f a) = Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 g a := by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (dense_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f hf)
  exact ⟨1, fun b => by simpa [linearCombination_norm (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg b]⟩

theorem extensionMap_norm (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f) (x : E) : ‖extensionMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  refine (dense_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f hf).induction ?_
    (isClosed_eq (extensionMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g).continuous.norm continuous_norm) x
  rintro _ ⟨a,rfl⟩
  rw [extensionMap_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg hf, linearCombination_norm (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg]

def isometry (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F) (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f) : E →ₗᵢ[𝕜] F where
  toLinearMap := (extensionMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g).toLinearMap
  norm_map' := extensionMap_norm (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg hf

theorem isometry_apply (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f) (i : ι) : isometry (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg hf (f i) = g i := by
  change extensionMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g (f i) = g i
  have h := extensionMap_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg hf (Finsupp.single i 1)
  simpa only [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul] using h

variable [CompleteSpace E]

def equivalence (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f) (ht : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) g) : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] F :=
  (LinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 (ι →₀ 𝕜)).extendOfIsometry
    (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f) (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 g)
    (dense_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f hf) (dense_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) g ht)
    (linearCombination_norm (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg)

theorem equivalence_apply (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f) (ht : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) g) (i : ι) :
    equivalence (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg hf ht (f i) = g i := by
  unfold equivalence
  have h := LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq
    (LinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 (ι →₀ 𝕜))
    (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 f) (Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 g)
    (dense_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f hf) (dense_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) g ht)
    (linearCombination_norm (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg) (Finsupp.single i 1)
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.refl_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul] using h


/-- Uniqueness among continuous linear maps follows from the total source family. -/
theorem extensionMap_unique (f : ι → E) (g : ι → F)
    (hg : GramEqual (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g) (hf : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) f)
    (T : E →L[𝕜] F) (hT : ∀ i, T (f i) = g i) :
    T = extensionMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine (dense_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f hf).induction ?_
    (isClosed_eq T.continuous (extensionMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g).continuous) x
  rintro _ ⟨a,rfl⟩
  rw [extensionMap_linearCombination (𝕜 := 𝕜) f g hg hf]
  classical
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, hT]

/-- A surjective reindexing and nonzero weights do not change the algebraic span. -/
theorem span_weighted_reindex (v : ι → E) (c : ι → 𝕜) (σ : ι → ι)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0) (hσ : Function.Surjective σ) :
    Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (fun i => c i • v (σ i))) =
      Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range v) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i,rfl⟩
    exact (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range v)).smul_mem (c i)
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨σ i,rfl⟩)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hσ j
    have h : c i • v j ∈ Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (fun i => c i • v (σ i))) := by
      rw [← hi]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i,rfl⟩
    have h' := (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (fun i => c i • v (σ i)))).smul_mem (c i)⁻¹ h
    change v j ∈ Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (fun i => c i • v (σ i)))
    simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (hc i), one_smul] using h'

theorem total_weighted_reindex (v : ι → E) (c : ι → 𝕜) (σ : ι → ι)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0) (hσ : Function.Surjective σ) (hv : Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) v) :
    Total (𝕜 := 𝕜) (fun i => c i • v (σ i)) := by
  unfold Total at hv ⊢
  rw [span_weighted_reindex v c σ hc hσ]
  exact hv

end F1Fecho.GramExtension

#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.linearCombination_inner
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.linearCombination_norm
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.dense_linearCombination
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.extensionMap_linearCombination
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.extensionMap_norm
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.isometry
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.isometry_apply
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.equivalence
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.equivalence_apply

#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.extensionMap_unique
#print axioms F1Fecho.GramExtension.span_weighted_reindex

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.LinearMap
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Exponential
import Mathlib.Tactic
/-!
Displacement convention: D(f)e(g)=a(f,g)e(g+f), where
a(f,g)=exp(-inner(f,f)/2-inner(f,g)). The exponential-vector normalization
is inner(e(g),e(h))=exp(inner(g,h)). This is not an operator construction;
it proves the scalar Gram and cocycle identities consumed by that construction.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

def amplitude (f g : H) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (-inner ℂ f f / 2 - inner ℂ f g)

def phase (f g : H) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (inner ℂ f g).im)

theorem amplitude_ne_zero (f g : H) : amplitude f g ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _

theorem amplitude_zero_left (g : H) : amplitude (0:H) g = 1 := by
  simp [amplitude]

theorem amplitude_norm_form (f g : H) :
    amplitude f g = Complex.exp (-((‖f‖ : ℂ)^2)/2 - inner ℂ f g) := by
  simp [amplitude, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]

theorem gram_identity (f g h : H) :
    star (amplitude f g) * amplitude f h * Complex.exp (inner ℂ (g+f) (h+f)) =
      Complex.exp (inner ℂ g h) := by
  simp only [amplitude, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj, map_sub, map_div₀,
    map_neg, map_ofNat, inner_conj_symm, ← Complex.exp_add,
    inner_add_left, inner_add_right]
  congr 1
  ring

theorem imag_difference (z : ℂ) :
    -Complex.I * z.im = (star z - z)/2 := by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.ext_iff] <;> ring

theorem composition_identity (f g h : H) :
    amplitude g h * amplitude f (h+g) = phase f g * amplitude (f+g) h := by
  simp only [amplitude, phase, ← Complex.exp_add, inner_add_left, inner_add_right]
  rw [imag_difference, Complex.star_def, inner_conj_symm]
  congr 1
  ring

theorem phase_self_neg (f : H) : phase f (-f) = 1 := by
  have hh : (inner ℂ f f).im = 0 := inner_self_im (𝕜 := ℂ) f
  simp only [phase, inner_neg_right, Complex.neg_im, hh, neg_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero]

theorem inverse_identity (f g : H) :
    amplitude f g * amplitude (-f) (g+f) = 1 := by
  rw [composition_identity]
  have hh : (inner ℂ f f).im = 0 := inner_self_im (𝕜 := ℂ) f
  simp only [phase, inner_neg_left, Complex.neg_im, hh, neg_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, neg_add_cancel, amplitude_zero_left, mul_one]

theorem amplitude_isometry (u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (f g : H) :
    amplitude (u f) (u g) = amplitude f g := by
  simp only [amplitude, u.inner_map_map]

theorem phase_orthogonal (f g : H) (h : (inner ℂ f g).im = 0) :
    phase f g = 1 := by simp [phase,h]

end F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients

open Lean in
run_cmd do
  let env ← Elab.Command.liftCoreM getEnv
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    if (`F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients).isPrefixOf n then
      let axs ← collectAxioms n
      IO.println ("LOCAL_DECL\t" ++ n.toString ++ "\t" ++ String.intercalate "," (axs.toList.map Name.toString))
      unless axs.all (fun a => a == `propext || a == `Classical.choice || a == `Quot.sound) do
        throwError "AXIOM_AUDIT_REFUSED: {n}"
      match ci with
      | .axiomInfo _ => throwError "LOCAL_AXIOM_REFUSED: {n}"
      | _ => pure ()

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.GramTotalExtensionR4
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.WeylCoefficientsR4
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
/-! Weyl displacement constructed by Gram extension. A total exponential family
is the explicit input here; the following concrete module will supply it on the
already constructed Fock. No operator, CCR or inverse is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.WeylConstruction
open F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients F1Fecho.GramExtension
variable {H F : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [CompleteSpace F]
variable (v : H → F)
  (hkernel : ∀ g h, inner ℂ (v g) (v h) = Complex.exp (inner ℂ g h))
  (htotal : Total (𝕜 := ℂ) v)

def displaced (f g : H) : F := amplitude f g • v (g+f)

include hkernel in
theorem displaced_gram (f : H) : GramEqual (𝕜 := ℂ) v (displaced v f) := by
  intro g h
  simp only [displaced, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, starRingEnd_apply, hkernel]
  simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using gram_identity f g h

include htotal in
theorem displaced_total (f : H) : Total (𝕜 := ℂ) (displaced v f) := by
  apply total_weighted_reindex v (amplitude f) (fun g => g+f)
    (amplitude_ne_zero f) _ htotal
  intro g
  exact ⟨g-f,sub_add_cancel g f⟩

def D (f : H) : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F :=
  equivalence v (displaced v f) (displaced_gram v hkernel f) htotal
    (displaced_total v htotal f)

theorem D_apply (f g : H) : D v hkernel htotal f (v g) = amplitude f g • v (g+f) :=
  equivalence_apply v _ _ _ _ g

def W (f : H) : F →L[ℂ] F := (D v hkernel htotal f).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap

theorem W_apply (f g : H) : W v hkernel htotal f (v g) = amplitude f g • v (g+f) :=
  D_apply v hkernel htotal f g

include htotal in
theorem clm_ext_total {A B : F →L[ℂ] F} (h : ∀ g, A (v g) = B (v g)) : A = B := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine (dense_linearCombination v htotal).induction ?_
    (isClosed_eq A.continuous B.continuous) x
  rintro _ ⟨a,rfl⟩
  classical
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, h]

theorem W_zero : W v hkernel htotal 0 = 1 := by
  apply clm_ext_total v htotal
  intro g
  simp [W_apply, amplitude_zero_left]

theorem W_add (f g : H) : W v hkernel htotal f * W v hkernel htotal g =
    phase f g • W v hkernel htotal (f+g) := by
  apply clm_ext_total v htotal
  intro h
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, W_apply, map_smul,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_smul]
  rw [composition_identity]
  congr 2
  abel

theorem W_neg_mul (f : H) : W v hkernel htotal (-f) * W v hkernel htotal f = 1 := by
  rw [W_add]
  have hh : (inner ℂ f f).im = 0 := inner_self_im (𝕜 := ℂ) f
  simp only [phase, inner_neg_left, Complex.neg_im, hh, neg_zero,
    Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, one_smul, neg_add_cancel, W_zero]

theorem D_neg (f : H) : D v hkernel htotal (-f) = (D v hkernel htotal f).symm := by
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro x
  have hx := congrArg (fun T : F →L[ℂ] F => T ((D v hkernel htotal f).symm x))
    (W_neg_mul v hkernel htotal f)
  change D v hkernel htotal (-f) (D v hkernel htotal f ((D v hkernel htotal f).symm x)) = _ at hx
  simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply] using hx

theorem W_star (f : H) : star (W v hkernel htotal f) = W v hkernel htotal (-f) := by
  unfold W
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.star_eq_symm, D_neg]

theorem W_local (f g : H) (h : (inner ℂ f g).im = 0) :
    Commute (W v hkernel htotal f) (W v hkernel htotal g) := by
  have h' : (inner ℂ g f).im = 0 := by
    have hc : inner ℂ g f = star (inner ℂ f g) := (inner_conj_symm g f).symm
    rw [hc, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im, h, neg_zero]
  show W v hkernel htotal f * W v hkernel htotal g = W v hkernel htotal g * W v hkernel htotal f
  rw [W_add, W_add, phase_orthogonal f g h, phase_orthogonal g f h', one_smul, one_smul, add_comm f g]

end F1Fecho.WeylConstruction

open Lean in
run_cmd do
  let env ← Elab.Command.liftCoreM getEnv
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    if (`F1Fecho.WeylConstruction).isPrefixOf n then
      let axs ← collectAxioms n
      IO.println ("LOCAL_DECL\t" ++ n.toString ++ "\t" ++ String.intercalate "," (axs.toList.map Name.toString))
      unless axs.all (fun a => a == `propext || a == `Classical.choice || a == `Quot.sound) do
        throwError "AXIOM_AUDIT_REFUSED: {n}"
      match ci with
      | .axiomInfo _ => throwError "LOCAL_AXIOM_REFUSED: {n}"
      | _ => pure ()

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.WeylOperatorsGenericR2
/-! Functorial covariance of the constructed displacement operators. The action
on the total exponential family is explicit; covariance is derived from it. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.WeylConstruction
open F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients F1Fecho.GramExtension
variable {H F : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [CompleteSpace F]
variable (v : H → F)
  (hkernel : ∀ g h, inner ℂ (v g) (v h) = Complex.exp (inner ℂ g h))
  (htotal : Total (𝕜 := ℂ) v)

theorem inverse_on_family (u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (V : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F)
    (hV : ∀ g, V (v g) = v (u g)) (g : H) : V.symm (v g) = v (u.symm g) := by
  apply V.injective
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hV, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

theorem W_covariance (u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (V : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F)
    (hV : ∀ g, V (v g) = v (u g)) (f : H) :
    V.conjStarAlgEquiv (W v hkernel htotal f) = W v hkernel htotal (u f) := by
  apply clm_ext_total v htotal
  intro g
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply, inverse_on_family v u V hV,
    W_apply, map_smul, hV, W_apply, map_add, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have ha : amplitude f (u.symm g) = amplitude (u f) g := by
    rw [← amplitude_isometry u f (u.symm g), LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [ha]

end F1Fecho.WeylConstruction

#print axioms F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W_covariance

import TGLExt.V350DualFixedCore
import TGLExt.TheOathOnTheTower
import TGLExt.TheConjugationMapsCommutants
/-!
Generator-to-net wiring using existing commutants. The generator family W and
its star/locality/covariance laws remain explicit inputs. This file does not
construct the concrete Fock Weyl operators, a cyclic/separating vacuum, Tomita
data, a physical stress tensor or H3. It does not assert an inhabitant for that
physical realization. A noncommuting generator pair gives a nonabelian algebra.
The von Neumann algebra uses mathlib's double-commutant definition.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.WeylNet
open TGLExt TGLV350.Regular

variable {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [CompleteSpace F]

theorem starCommutant_coe_of_star_closed (S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, star x ∈ S) :
    (starCommutantAlgebra S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) = commutantSet S := by
  ext x
  change x ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ S ↔ _
  rw [StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h s hmem
    exact (h s hmem).1
  · intro h s hmem
    exact ⟨h s hmem, h (star s) (hs s hmem)⟩

def generatedAlgebra (S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) : VonNeumannAlgebra F :=
  (starCommutantAlgebra S).commutant

theorem generatedAlgebra_coe (S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, star x ∈ S) :
    (generatedAlgebra S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) = commutantSet (commutantSet S) := by
  rw [generatedAlgebra, VonNeumannAlgebra.coe_commutant,
    starCommutant_coe_of_star_closed S hs]
  rfl

theorem generators_mem (S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, star x ∈ S) :
    S ⊆ (generatedAlgebra S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) := by
  rw [generatedAlgebra_coe S hs]
  exact subset_bicommutant S

theorem generatedAlgebra_mono (S T : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, star x ∈ S) (ht : ∀ x ∈ T, star x ∈ T) (h : S ⊆ T) :
    (generatedAlgebra S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) ⊆ generatedAlgebra T := by
  rw [generatedAlgebra_coe S hs, generatedAlgebra_coe T ht]
  exact bicommutant_mono h

theorem generatedAlgebra_local (S T : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, star x ∈ S) (ht : ∀ x ∈ T, star x ∈ T)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ T, Commute x y) :
    ∀ x ∈ generatedAlgebra S, ∀ y ∈ generatedAlgebra T, Commute x y := by
  have hST : S ⊆ commutantSet T := by
    intro x hx y hy
    exact (h x hx y hy).eq.symm
  have hb := bicommutant_mono hST
  rw [commutant_triple] at hb
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, generatedAlgebra_coe S hs] at hx
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, generatedAlgebra_coe T ht] at hy
  exact hy x (hb hx)

theorem doubleCommutant_transport
    (e : (F →L[ℂ] F) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (F →L[ℂ] F)) (S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) :
    e '' commutantSet (commutantSet S) =
      commutantSet (commutantSet (e '' S)) := by
  rw [conj_commutant_of_biinverse e e.symm (fun x y => map_mul e x y)
    e.symm_apply_apply e.apply_symm_apply,
    conj_commutant_of_biinverse e e.symm (fun x y => map_mul e x y)
    e.symm_apply_apply e.apply_symm_apply]

theorem generatedAlgebra_cov (S T : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, star x ∈ S) (ht : ∀ x ∈ T, star x ∈ T)
    (e : (F →L[ℂ] F) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (F →L[ℂ] F)) (he : e '' S = T)
    (x : F →L[ℂ] F) : x ∈ generatedAlgebra S ↔ e x ∈ generatedAlgebra T := by
  have htransport : e '' (generatedAlgebra S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) =
      (generatedAlgebra T : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) := by
    rw [generatedAlgebra_coe S hs, generatedAlgebra_coe T ht,
      doubleCommutant_transport, he]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← htransport]
    exact ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← htransport] at hx
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hxy⟩ := hx
    have : y = x := e.injective hxy
    simpa [this] using hy

theorem generatedAlgebra_nonabelian (S : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, star x ∈ S)
    (h : ∃ a ∈ S, ∃ b ∈ S, a * b ≠ b * a) :
    ∃ a ∈ generatedAlgebra S, ∃ b ∈ generatedAlgebra S, a * b ≠ b * a := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hab⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a,generators_mem S hs ha,b,generators_mem S hs hb,hab⟩

variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

def generators (W : H → (F →L[ℂ] F)) (K : Submodule ℝ H) : Set (F →L[ℂ] F) :=
  W '' (K : Set H)

theorem generators_star_closed (W : H → (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hstar : ∀ f, star (W f) = W (-f)) (K : Submodule ℝ H) :
    ∀ x ∈ generators W K, star x ∈ generators W K := by
  rintro x ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨-f,K.neg_mem hf,(hstar f).symm⟩

def R (W : H → (F →L[ℂ] F)) (K : Submodule ℝ H) : VonNeumannAlgebra F :=
  generatedAlgebra (generators W K)

theorem R_mono (W : H → (F →L[ℂ] F)) (hstar : ∀ f, star (W f) = W (-f))
    (K K' : Submodule ℝ H) (h : K ≤ K') :
    (R W K : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) ⊆ R W K' :=
  generatedAlgebra_mono _ _ (generators_star_closed W hstar K)
    (generators_star_closed W hstar K') (Set.image_mono h)

theorem R_local (W : H → (F →L[ℂ] F)) (hstar : ∀ f, star (W f) = W (-f))
    (hlocal : ∀ f g, (inner ℂ f g).im = 0 → Commute (W f) (W g))
    (K K' : Submodule ℝ H)
    (h : ∀ f ∈ K, ∀ g ∈ K', (inner ℂ f g).im = 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ R W K, ∀ y ∈ R W K', Commute x y := by
  apply generatedAlgebra_local _ _ (generators_star_closed W hstar K)
    (generators_star_closed W hstar K')
  rintro x ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ y ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
  exact hlocal f g (h f hf g hg)

theorem R_cov (W : H → (F →L[ℂ] F)) (hstar : ∀ f, star (W f) = W (-f))
    (u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (e : (F →L[ℂ] F) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (F →L[ℂ] F))
    (hcov : ∀ f, e (W f) = W (u f))
    (K K' : Submodule ℝ H) (hK : ∀ f, f ∈ K ↔ u f ∈ K')
    (x : F →L[ℂ] F) : x ∈ R W K ↔ e x ∈ R W K' := by
  apply generatedAlgebra_cov _ _ (generators_star_closed W hstar K)
    (generators_star_closed W hstar K') e _ x
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro z ⟨y,⟨f,hf,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨u f,(hK f).mp hf,(hcov f).symm⟩
  · rintro z ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨W (u.symm g),⟨u.symm g,?_,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    · exact (hK (u.symm g)).mpr (by simpa using hg)
    · simpa using hcov (u.symm g)

end F1Fecho.WeylNet

/-!
The existing concrete boost on bosonic Fock restricts to an automorphism of the
generated wedge algebra when the named Weyl covariance input is supplied.
The restricted group and its implementation are constructed here. This does
not prove that this group is the vacuum modular group: that requires the
remaining Tomita/KMS realization. No concrete Weyl family or LightNetData
inhabitant is claimed here.

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.WeylFlow
open F1Fecho.WeylNet TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock
open TGL.SpecificAQFT TGLExt.ContratoQGv31 TGLExt.QGSolution

variable {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]

def restrictAutomorphism (M : VonNeumannAlgebra E)
    (e : (E →L[ℂ] E) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (E →L[ℂ] E))
    (he : ∀ x, x ∈ M ↔ e x ∈ M) : M.toStarSubalgebra ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] M.toStarSubalgebra where
  toFun x := ⟨e x, (he x).mp x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨e.symm x, (he (e.symm x)).mpr (by simpa using x.property)⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext (e.symm_apply_apply x)
  right_inv x := Subtype.ext (e.apply_symm_apply x)
  map_mul' x y := Subtype.ext (map_mul e x.val y.val)
  map_add' x y := Subtype.ext (map_add e x.val y.val)
  map_smul' r x := Subtype.ext (map_smul e r x.val)
  map_star' x := Subtype.ext (map_star e x.val)

theorem restrictAutomorphism_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra E)
    (e : (E →L[ℂ] E) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (E →L[ℂ] E))
    (he : ∀ x, x ∈ M ↔ e x ∈ M) (x : M.toStarSubalgebra) :
    ((restrictAutomorphism M e he) x).val = e x := rfl

def boostAd (t : ℝ) : (F →L[ℂ] F) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (F →L[ℂ] F) :=
  (gamma (B0 (-(2 * Real.pi * t)))).conjStarAlgEquiv

theorem boostAd_zero : boostAd 0 = StarAlgEquiv.refl := by
  simp only [boostAd, mul_zero, neg_zero, B0_zero, gamma_refl,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_refl]

theorem boostAd_add (s t : ℝ) : boostAd (s+t) = (boostAd s).trans (boostAd t) := by
  unfold boostAd
  rw [show -(2 * Real.pi * (s+t)) = -(2 * Real.pi * t) + -(2 * Real.pi * s) by ring,
    B0_add, gamma_trans, LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_trans]

variable (W : H1 → (F →L[ℂ] F))
  (hstar : ∀ f, star (W f) = W (-f))
  (hcov : ∀ (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) f,
    (gamma u).conjStarAlgEquiv (W f) = W (u f))
  (L : LightNetData)

include hstar hcov in
theorem boostAd_preserves_wedge (t : ℝ) (x : F →L[ℂ] F) :
    x ∈ R W (L.K rightWedge) ↔ boostAd t x ∈ R W (L.K rightWedge) := by
  have hk : ∀ f : H1, f ∈ L.K rightWedge ↔
      B0 (-(2 * Real.pi * t)) f ∈ L.K rightWedge := by
    intro f
    have hh := L.K_boost (-(2 * Real.pi * t)) rightWedge f
    rw [FlagNet.boost_image_rightWedge] at hh
    exact hh
  exact R_cov W hstar (B0 (-(2 * Real.pi * t))) (boostAd t)
    (hcov (B0 (-(2 * Real.pi * t)))) (L.K rightWedge) (L.K rightWedge) hk x

def wedgeFlow (t : ℝ) : (R W (L.K rightWedge)).toStarSubalgebra ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (R W (L.K rightWedge)).toStarSubalgebra :=
  restrictAutomorphism (R W (L.K rightWedge)) (boostAd t)
    (boostAd_preserves_wedge W hstar hcov L t)

theorem wedgeFlow_is_Ad (t : ℝ) (x : (R W (L.K rightWedge)).toStarSubalgebra) :
    ((wedgeFlow W hstar hcov L t) x).val =
      (gamma (B0 (-(2*Real.pi*t)))).conjStarAlgEquiv x.val := rfl

theorem wedgeFlow_zero : wedgeFlow W hstar hcov L 0 = StarAlgEquiv.refl := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change boostAd 0 x.val = x.val
  rw [boostAd_zero]
  rfl

theorem wedgeFlow_add (s t : ℝ) : wedgeFlow W hstar hcov L (s+t) =
    (wedgeFlow W hstar hcov L s).trans (wedgeFlow W hstar hcov L t) := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change boostAd (s+t) x.val = boostAd t (boostAd s x.val)
  rw [boostAd_add]
  rfl

end F1Fecho.WeylFlow

/-!
Concrete Weyl operators on the original canonical bosonic Fock, constructed
from its total exponential vectors. No Weyl/CCR, covariance or totality fields
are assumed. R(K), isotony, locality and covariance are instantiated here.
The global vacuum cyclicity below concerns K=top; it is NOT wedge cyclicity.
The restricted boost flow still takes a LightNetData as the localization input.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.ConcreteWeyl
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential
open F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients F1Fecho.GramExtension

def D (f : H1) : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F :=
  F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.D exponential exponential_inner exponential_total f

def W (f : H1) : F →L[ℂ] F :=
  F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W exponential exponential_inner exponential_total f

theorem W_exponential (f g : H1) : W f (exponential g) =
    amplitude f g • exponential (g+f) :=
  F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W_apply _ _ _ f g

theorem W_zero : W 0 = 1 := F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W_zero _ _ _

theorem W_ccr (f g : H1) : W f * W g = phase f g • W (f+g) :=
  F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W_add _ _ _ f g

theorem W_star (f : H1) : star (W f) = W (-f) :=
  F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W_star _ _ _ f

theorem W_local (f g : H1) (h : (inner ℂ f g).im = 0) : Commute (W f) (W g) :=
  F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W_local _ _ _ f g h

theorem W_covariance (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (f : H1) :
    (gamma u).conjStarAlgEquiv (W f) = W (u f) :=
  F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.W_covariance _ _ _ u (gamma u) (gamma_exponential u) f

theorem W_vacuum (f : H1) : W f vacuum = amplitude f 0 • exponential f := by
  rw [← exponential_zero, W_exponential, zero_add]

theorem vacuum_characteristic (f : H1) :
    inner ℂ vacuum (W f vacuum) = Complex.exp (-((‖f‖ : ℂ)^2)/2) := by
  rw [W_vacuum, ← exponential_zero, inner_smul_right, exponential_inner]
  simp [amplitude_norm_form, inner_zero_left, inner_zero_right]

theorem vacuum_orbit_total :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun f : H1 => W f vacuum))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
  have ht := total_weighted_reindex exponential (fun f => amplitude f 0) id
    (fun f => amplitude_ne_zero f 0) Function.surjective_id exponential_total
  simpa only [W_vacuum, id_eq] using ht

def R (K : Submodule ℝ H1) : VonNeumannAlgebra F := F1Fecho.WeylNet.R W K

theorem R_mono (K K' : Submodule ℝ H1) (h : K ≤ K') :
    (R K : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)) ⊆ R K' := F1Fecho.WeylNet.R_mono W W_star K K' h

theorem R_local (K K' : Submodule ℝ H1)
    (h : ∀ f ∈ K, ∀ g ∈ K', (inner ℂ f g).im = 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ R K, ∀ y ∈ R K', Commute x y := F1Fecho.WeylNet.R_local W W_star W_local K K' h

theorem R_covariance (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (K K' : Submodule ℝ H1)
    (h : ∀ f, f ∈ K ↔ u f ∈ K') (x : F →L[ℂ] F) :
    x ∈ R K ↔ (gamma u).conjStarAlgEquiv x ∈ R K' :=
  F1Fecho.WeylNet.R_cov W W_star u (gamma u).conjStarAlgEquiv (W_covariance u) K K' h x

theorem W_mem_R (K : Submodule ℝ H1) (f : H1) (hf : f ∈ K) : W f ∈ R K :=
  F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators_mem _ (F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators_star_closed W W_star K) ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩

theorem global_vacuum_cyclic :
    (Submodule.span ℂ ((fun a : F →L[ℂ] F => a vacuum) ''
      (R ⊤ : Set (F →L[ℂ] F)))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
  apply eq_top_iff.mpr
  rw [← vacuum_orbit_total]
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_mono
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro x ⟨f,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨W f,W_mem_R ⊤ f (Submodule.mem_top),rfl⟩

def wedgeFlow (L : TGLExt.QGSolution.LightNetData) (t : ℝ) :
    (R (L.K TGL.SpecificAQFT.rightWedge)).toStarSubalgebra ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (R (L.K TGL.SpecificAQFT.rightWedge)).toStarSubalgebra :=
  F1Fecho.WeylFlow.wedgeFlow W W_star W_covariance L t

theorem wedgeFlow_zero (L : TGLExt.QGSolution.LightNetData) :
    wedgeFlow L 0 = StarAlgEquiv.refl := F1Fecho.WeylFlow.wedgeFlow_zero W W_star W_covariance L

theorem wedgeFlow_add (L : TGLExt.QGSolution.LightNetData) (s t : ℝ) :
    wedgeFlow L (s+t) = (wedgeFlow L s).trans (wedgeFlow L t) :=
  F1Fecho.WeylFlow.wedgeFlow_add W W_star W_covariance L s t

end F1Fecho.ConcreteWeyl

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ConcreteWeylR1
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BosonicSectorContinuity
/-! Norm continuity of the actual exponential map and strong continuity of the
constructed Weyl family. The closed continuous-orbit subspace is reused from
the existing sector-continuity construction; no regularity is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology
namespace F1Fecho.ConcreteWeyl
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential
open F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients F1Rede.BosonicSectorContinuity

theorem exponential_norm_sub (x y : H1) :
    ‖exponential y - exponential x‖ = Real.sqrt
      ((Complex.exp (inner ℂ y y) - Complex.exp (inner ℂ y x) -
        (Complex.exp (inner ℂ x y) - Complex.exp (inner ℂ x x))).re) := by
  rw [norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ), inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right,
    inner_sub_right, exponential_inner, exponential_inner, exponential_inner, exponential_inner]
  rfl

theorem exponential_continuous : Continuous exponential := by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro x
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : H1 => Real.sqrt
      ((Complex.exp (inner ℂ y y) - Complex.exp (inner ℂ y x) -
        (Complex.exp (inner ℂ x y) - Complex.exp (inner ℂ x x))).re)) := by fun_prop
  have ht := hc.tendsto x
  simpa only [← exponential_norm_sub, sub_self, norm_zero, Complex.zero_re, Real.sqrt_zero] using ht

theorem amplitude_continuous (g : H1) : Continuous (fun f : H1 => amplitude f g) := by
  unfold amplitude
  fun_prop

theorem W_strongly_continuous (ψ : F) : Continuous (fun f : H1 => W f ψ) := by
  let O := continuousOrbitSpace D
  have hs : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential) ≤ O := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨g,rfl⟩
    change Continuous (fun f : H1 => D f (exponential g))
    change Continuous (fun f : H1 => W f (exponential g))
    simp only [W_exponential]
    exact (amplitude_continuous g).smul
      (exponential_continuous.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
  have ht := (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential)).topologicalClosure_minimal hs
    (continuousOrbitSpace_closed D)
  rw [exponential_total] at ht
  exact ht (Submodule.mem_top (x := ψ))

theorem W_regular (f : H1) (ψ : F) : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => W (t • f) ψ) :=
  (W_strongly_continuous ψ).comp (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)

end F1Fecho.ConcreteWeyl

#print axioms F1Fecho.ConcreteWeyl.amplitude_continuous

#print axioms F1Fecho.ConcreteWeyl.W_regular

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ConcreteWeylR1
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ConcreteWeylContinuityR2
/-!
Field convention W(f)=D(i f), with D the previously constructed displacement.
Thus W(k)Omega is proportional to e(i k). If one-particle Tomita fixes k in K,
its antilinearity sends i k to -i k, matching W(k)*Omega. This file establishes
the phase change and its algebraic consequences, not the Tomita identification.
There is no 1/sqrt(2) in this convention: the cocycle is exp(-i Im inner(f,g)).
The earlier displacement construction remains unchanged.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.FieldWeyl
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential
open F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients

def rotate (f : H1) : H1 := Complex.I • f

theorem rotate_inner (f g : H1) : inner ℂ (rotate f) (rotate g) = inner ℂ f g := by
  simp only [rotate,inner_smul_left,inner_smul_right,Complex.conj_I]
  calc
    Complex.I * (-Complex.I * inner ℂ f g) = -(Complex.I * Complex.I) * inner ℂ f g := by ring
    _ = inner ℂ f g := by simp

theorem rotate_add (f g : H1) : rotate (f+g) = rotate f + rotate g := by simp [rotate,smul_add]

theorem rotate_neg (f : H1) : rotate (-f) = -rotate f := by simp [rotate]

def W (f : H1) : F →L[ℂ] F := ConcreteWeyl.W (rotate f)

theorem W_zero : W 0 = 1 := by simp [W,rotate,ConcreteWeyl.W_zero]

theorem W_strongly_continuous (v : F) : Continuous (fun f : H1 => W f v) :=
  (ConcreteWeyl.W_strongly_continuous v).comp (continuous_const.smul continuous_id)


theorem W_star (f : H1) : star (W f) = W (-f) := by
  simp only [W,ConcreteWeyl.W_star,rotate_neg]

theorem W_ccr (f g : H1) : W f * W g = phase f g • W (f+g) := by
  simp only [W,ConcreteWeyl.W_ccr,phase,rotate_inner,rotate_add]

theorem W_local (f g : H1) (h : (inner ℂ f g).im = 0) : Commute (W f) (W g) := by
  apply ConcreteWeyl.W_local
  simpa only [rotate_inner] using h

theorem W_covariance (u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1) (f : H1) :

theorem W_vacuum (f : H1) : W f vacuum = amplitude (rotate f) 0 • exponential (rotate f) :=

theorem vacuum_characteristic (f : H1) :
    inner ℂ vacuum (W f vacuum) = Complex.exp (-((‖f‖ : ℂ)^2)/2) := by
  rw [W,ConcreteWeyl.vacuum_characteristic]
  simp [rotate,norm_smul]

def R (K : Submodule ℝ H1) : VonNeumannAlgebra F := F1Fecho.WeylNet.R W K

theorem R_local (K K' : Submodule ℝ H1)
    (h : ∀ f ∈ K, ∀ g ∈ K', (inner ℂ f g).im = 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ R K, ∀ y ∈ R K', Commute x y := F1Fecho.WeylNet.R_local W W_star W_local K K' h

    (h : ∀ f, f ∈ K ↔ u f ∈ K') (x : F →L[ℂ] F) :
    x ∈ R K ↔ (gamma u).conjStarAlgEquiv x ∈ R K' :=
  F1Fecho.WeylNet.R_cov W W_star u (gamma u).conjStarAlgEquiv (W_covariance u) K K' h x

theorem W_mem_R (K : Submodule ℝ H1) (f : H1) (hf : f ∈ K) : W f ∈ R K :=
  F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators_mem _ (F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators_star_closed W W_star K) ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩

def wedgeFlow (L : TGLExt.QGSolution.LightNetData) (t : ℝ) :
    (R (L.K TGL.SpecificAQFT.rightWedge)).toStarSubalgebra ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (R (L.K TGL.SpecificAQFT.rightWedge)).toStarSubalgebra :=
  F1Fecho.WeylFlow.wedgeFlow W W_star W_covariance L t

theorem wedgeFlow_zero (L : TGLExt.QGSolution.LightNetData) :
    wedgeFlow L 0 = StarAlgEquiv.refl := F1Fecho.WeylFlow.wedgeFlow_zero W W_star W_covariance L

theorem wedgeFlow_add (L : TGLExt.QGSolution.LightNetData) (s t : ℝ) :
    wedgeFlow L (s+t) = (wedgeFlow L s).trans (wedgeFlow L t) :=

theorem ofReal_smul_H1 (t : ℝ) (x : H1) : (t : ℂ) • x = t • x := by
  rw [show (t : ℂ) = t • (1 : ℂ) by simp [Complex.real_smul], smul_assoc, one_smul]

def realSeries (a : ℕ → ℂ) : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ ℝ ℂ :=

theorem realSeries_coeff (a : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : (realSeries a).coeff n = a n := by
  simp [realSeries, FormalMultilinearSeries.coeff]

theorem coefficients_zero_on_real_subspace (K : Submodule ℝ H1) (v : F)
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ K, inner ℂ v (exponential x) = 0) (x : H1) (hx : x ∈ K) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient v x n = 0 := by
  have hp : HasFPowerSeriesAt (0 : ℝ → ℂ) (realSeries (coefficient v x)) 0 := by
    apply hasFPowerSeriesAt_iff.mpr
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro t
    have hs := scalar_series v x (t : ℂ)
    have hz : inner ℂ v (exponential ((t : ℂ) • x)) = 0 := by
      apply hv
      rw [ofReal_smul_H1]
      exact K.smul_mem t hx
    simpa only [realSeries_coeff, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_pow, hz, Pi.zero_apply] using hs
  have he := hp.apply_eq_zero n (1 : ℝ)
  simpa [realSeries] using he

theorem pure_inner_zero_on_real_subspace (K : Submodule ℝ H1) (v : F)
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ K, inner ℂ v (exponential x) = 0) (x : H1) (hx : x ∈ K) (n : ℕ) :
    inner ℂ (v n) (pureTensor n x) = 0 := by
  have h := coefficients_zero_on_real_subspace K v hv x hx n
  unfold coefficient component at h
  rw [_root_.inner_smul_right (v n) (pureTensor n x) (weight n : ℂ)] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (weight_pos n)))

theorem analytic_pureAlgebraic (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y : H1 => pureAlgebraic y n) x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact analyticAt_const
  | succ n ih =>
    change AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y : H1 => tensorBilinear n y (pureAlgebraic y n)) x
    exact ((tensorBilinear n).analyticAt_bilinear _).comp₂ analyticAt_id ih

theorem analytic_pureCompleted (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (pureCompleted n) x := by
  exact ((Completion.toComplL (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := Algebraic n)).analyticAt _).comp

theorem zeros_on_real_frequent (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : ∀ t : ℝ, f t = 0) :

  let a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ)

  have ht : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℂ)) :=

  exact ht.frequently (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n : ℕ => hf (1 / ((n : ℝ)+1)))).frequently

  exact hf.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero isPreconnected_univ

/-! The cyclic half of standardness implies density of the complex span.
Generic Hilbert-space formulation avoids expanding a particular L2 carrier. -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000

namespace F1Fecho.StandardComplexSpan
open ClosedSubmodule
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

theorem dense (K : StandardSubspace H) :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (K.toClosedSubmodule : Set H)).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
  let p := Submodule.span ℂ (K.toClosedSubmodule : Set H)
  let C : ClosedSubmodule ℝ H :=
    { toSubmodule := p.topologicalClosure.restrictScalars ℝ
      isClosed' := p.isClosed_topologicalClosure }
  have hk : K.toClosedSubmodule ≤ C := by
    intro x hx
    exact p.le_topologicalClosure (Submodule.subset_span hx)
  have hi : K.toClosedSubmodule.mulI ≤ C := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ K.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule.map
      (scalarSMulCLE H Complex.UnitI).toLinearMap at hx
    obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := hx
    change Complex.I • y ∈ p.topologicalClosure
    exact p.topologicalClosure.smul_mem Complex.I (p.le_topologicalClosure (Submodule.subset_span hy))
  have ht : (⊤ : ClosedSubmodule ℝ H) ≤ C := by
    rw [← K.IsCyclic]
    exact sup_le hk hi
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  exact ht (by trivial : x ∈ (⊤ : ClosedSubmodule ℝ H))
end F1Fecho.StandardComplexSpan

open Filter Topology UniformSpace
namespace F1Fecho.WedgeExponential

def complexification (K : Submodule ℝ H1) : Submodule ℂ H1 where
  carrier := {z | ∃ x ∈ K, ∃ y ∈ K, z = x + Complex.I • y}
  zero_mem' := ⟨0, K.zero_mem, 0, K.zero_mem, by simp⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro a b ⟨x,hx,y,hy,rfl⟩ ⟨u,hu,w,hw,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨x+u,K.add_mem hx hu,y+w,K.add_mem hy hw,?_⟩
    module
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c z ⟨x,hx,y,hy,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨c.re • x - c.im • y, K.sub_mem (K.smul_mem _ hx) (K.smul_mem _ hy),
      c.im • x + c.re • y, K.add_mem (K.smul_mem _ hx) (K.smul_mem _ hy), ?_⟩
    have h1 : (c.re : ℂ) + Complex.I * (c.im : ℂ) = c := by
      simpa only [mul_comm] using Complex.re_add_im c
    have h2 : -(c.im : ℂ) + Complex.I * (c.re : ℂ) = c * Complex.I := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    symm
    calc
      _ = ((c.re : ℂ) + Complex.I * (c.im : ℂ)) • x +
          (-(c.im : ℂ) + Complex.I * (c.re : ℂ)) • y := by
        simp only [← ofReal_smul_H1]
        module
      _ = c • x + (c * Complex.I) • y := by rw [h1,h2]
      _ = _ := by module

theorem complexification_eq_span (K : Submodule ℝ H1) :
    complexification K = Submodule.span ℂ (K : Set H1) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro z ⟨x,hx,y,hy,rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span hx)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span hy))
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨x,hx,0,K.zero_mem,by simp⟩

theorem pure_inner_zero_on_complexification (K : Submodule ℝ H1) (v : F)
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ K, inner ℂ v (exponential x) = 0) (n : ℕ)
    (z : H1) (hz : z ∈ complexification K) :
    inner ℂ (v n) (pureTensor n z) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,rfl⟩ := hz
  let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun c => inner ℂ (v n : TensorHilbert n) (pureCompleted n (x+c•y))
  have ha : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ P Set.univ := by
    intro c _
    have hline : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun d : ℂ => x+d•y) c :=
      analyticAt_const.add (analyticAt_id.smul analyticAt_const)
    exact ((innerSL ℂ (v n : TensorHilbert n)).analyticAt _).comp
      ((analytic_pureCompleted n _).comp hline)
  have hr : ∀ t : ℝ, P t = 0 := by
    intro t
    apply pure_inner_zero_on_real_subspace K v hv
    apply K.add_mem hx
    rw [ofReal_smul_H1]
    exact K.smul_mem t hy
  exact analytic_zero_from_real P ha hr Complex.I

theorem exponential_real_subspace_orthogonal_zero (K : Submodule ℝ H1)
    (hK : (Submodule.span ℂ (K : Set H1)).topologicalClosure = ⊤)
    (v : F) (hv : ∀ x ∈ K, inner ℂ v (exponential x) = 0) : v = 0 := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  apply sector_eq_zero_of_pure_inner_zero n (v n)
  intro x
  let P : H1 → ℂ := fun y => inner ℂ (v n : TensorHilbert n) (pureCompleted n y)
  have hc : Continuous P := (innerSL ℂ (v n : TensorHilbert n)).continuous.comp
    (continuous_pureCompleted id continuous_id n)
  have hz : (complexification K : Set H1) ⊆ {y | P y = 0} :=
    fun y hy => pure_inner_zero_on_complexification K v hv n y hy
  have hcl := closure_minimal hz (isClosed_eq hc continuous_const)
  have hd : closure (complexification K : Set H1) = Set.univ := by
    rw [complexification_eq_span, ← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe, hK]
    rfl
  exact hcl (hd.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ x)

theorem exponential_real_subspace_total (K : Submodule ℝ H1)
    (hK : (Submodule.span ℂ (K : Set H1)).topologicalClosure = ⊤) :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (exponential '' (K : Set H1))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff.mpr
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro v hv
  change v = 0
  apply exponential_real_subspace_orthogonal_zero K hK v
  intro x hx
  exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal' _ v).mp hv (exponential x)
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩)

theorem standard_complex_span_dense (K : StandardSubspace H1) :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (K.toClosedSubmodule : Set H1)).topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
  F1Fecho.StandardComplexSpan.dense K

theorem standard_exponential_total (K : StandardSubspace H1) :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (exponential '' (K.toClosedSubmodule : Set H1))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
  exponential_real_subspace_total K.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule (standard_complex_span_dense K)

theorem canonical_wedge_exponential_total :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (exponential ''
      (F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.spectralOutput.KWR.toClosedSubmodule : Set H1))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
  standard_exponential_total F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.spectralOutput.KWR

def vacuumOrbit (K : Submodule ℝ H1) : Set F :=
  (fun a : F →L[ℂ] F => a vacuum) '' (R K : Set (F →L[ℂ] F))

theorem orthogonal_vacuumOrbit_zero (K : StandardSubspace H1) (v : F)
    (hv : ∀ a ∈ R K.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule, inner ℂ v (a vacuum) = 0) :
    v = 0 := by
  apply exponential_real_subspace_orthogonal_zero K.mulI.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule
    (standard_complex_span_dense K.mulI) v
  intro x hx
  change x ∈ K.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule.map
    (scalarSMulCLE H1 Complex.UnitI).toLinearMap at hx
  obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := hx
  have hw := hv (W y) (W_mem_R _ y hy)
  rw [W_vacuum] at hw
  have hp : amplitude (rotate y) 0 * inner ℂ v (exponential (rotate y)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [inner_smul_right] using hw
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_left (amplitude_ne_zero _ _)

theorem vacuum_cyclic (K : StandardSubspace H1) :
    Dense ((Submodule.span ℂ (vacuumOrbit K.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule) : Submodule ℂ F) : Set F) := by
  apply Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff.mpr
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro v hv
  change v = 0
  apply orthogonal_vacuumOrbit_zero K v
  intro a ha
  exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal' _ v).mp hv (a vacuum)
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩)

theorem vacuum_separating (K : StandardSubspace H1)
    (a : F →L[ℂ] F) (ha : a ∈ R K.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule)
    (h0 : a vacuum = 0) : a = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on (vacuum_cyclic K.symplComp)
  rintro x ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
  have hsymp : ∀ f ∈ K.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule,
      ∀ g ∈ K.symplComp.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule, (inner ℂ f g).im = 0 := by
    intro f hf g hg
    exact ClosedSubmodule.mem_symplComp_iff.mp hg f hf
  have hc := R_local _ _ hsymp a ha b hb
  change a (b vacuum) = 0
  calc
    a (b vacuum) = (a*b) vacuum := rfl
    _ = (b*a) vacuum := congrArg (fun c : F →L[ℂ] F => c vacuum) hc.eq
    _ = b (a vacuum) := rfl
    _ = 0 := by rw [h0,map_zero]

theorem canonical_wedge_cyclic :
    Dense ((Submodule.span ℂ
      (vacuumOrbit F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.spectralOutput.KWR.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule) :
      Submodule ℂ F) : Set F) :=
  vacuum_cyclic F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.spectralOutput.KWR

theorem canonical_wedge_separating (a : F →L[ℂ] F)
    (ha : a ∈ R F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.spectralOutput.KWR.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule)
    (h0 : a vacuum = 0) : a = 0 :=
  vacuum_separating F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.spectralOutput.KWR a ha h0

  /-- o núcleo de Takesaki [Takesaki 1973]. -/

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.CanonicalOutput
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.FieldWeylR3
/-! Boost invariance of the ALREADY constructed canonical standard subspace.
The spectral multiplier and conjugation are reused. No global localization net
is invented: this proves the one-wedge flow restriction directly. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.CanonicalWedge F1Rede.Canonical
open F1Rede.FiberConjugation ChatgptAudit.Continuous050 TGLV350.Regular

 theorem phase_reflection (s x : ℝ) : star (characterPhase s (-x)) = characterPhase s x := by
  simp only [characterPhase, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj]
  congr 1
  simp

theorem Js_character (s : ℝ) (f : RH) :
    Js (characterMultiplier s f) = characterMultiplier s (Js f) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hr := (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (characterMultiplier_ae s f)
  filter_upwards [F1Rede.SpectralConjugation.J_ae transverseGeometricJ transverseGeometricJ_involutive
      (characterMultiplier s f), characterMultiplier_ae s (Js f),
    F1Rede.SpectralConjugation.J_ae transverseGeometricJ transverseGeometricJ_involutive f,hr]
    with x hj hc hf hrx
  change (Js (characterMultiplier s f)) x = _ at hj
  change (Js f) x = _ at hf
  rw [hj,hc,hf,hrx,map_smulₛₗ]
  simp only [starRingEnd_apply]
  change star (characterPhase s (-x)) • _ = characterPhase s x • _
  rw [phase_reflection]

theorem Jcandidate_boost (s : ℝ) (f : H1) : Jcandidate (B0 s f) = B0 s (Jcandidate f) := by
  apply Phi.injective
  simp only [Jcandidate_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply,canonicalPartialFourier_boost]
  exact Js_character (2*Real.pi*s) (Phi f)

theorem TW_graph_boost (s : ℝ) (f g : H1) (h : (f,g) ∈ TW.graph) :
    (B0 s f,B0 s g) ∈ TW.graph := by
  apply (TW_multiplier _ _).mpr
  have hh := (TW_multiplier f g).mp h
  simp only [canonicalPartialFourier_boost]
  filter_upwards [characterMultiplier_ae (2*Real.pi*s) (Phi g),
    characterMultiplier_ae (2*Real.pi*s) (Phi f),hh] with x hg hf hfg
  rw [hg,hf,hfg]
  simp only [smul_smul,mul_comm]

theorem boost_mem_KWR (s : ℝ) (f : H1) (hf : f ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule) :
    B0 s f ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule := by
  obtain ⟨hd,hfix⟩ := (KWR_mem f).mp hf
  have hg := TW_graph_boost s f (TW ⟨f,hd⟩) (TW.mem_graph ⟨f,hd⟩)
  have hd' := LinearPMap.mem_domain_of_mem_graph hg
  have hv : TW ⟨B0 s f,hd'⟩ = B0 s (TW ⟨f,hd⟩) :=
    TW.mem_graph_snd_inj (TW.mem_graph ⟨B0 s f,hd'⟩) hg rfl
  apply (KWR_mem (B0 s f)).mpr
  refine ⟨hd',?_⟩
  change Jcandidate (TW ⟨B0 s f,hd'⟩) = B0 s f
  change Jcandidate (TW ⟨f,hd⟩) = f at hfix
  rw [hv,Jcandidate_boost,hfix]

theorem boost_mem_KWR_iff (s : ℝ) (f : H1) :
    f ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule ↔ B0 s f ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule := by
  constructor
  · exact boost_mem_KWR s f
  · intro hf
    have h := boost_mem_KWR (-s) (B0 s f) hf
    have hi : B0 (-s) (B0 s f) = f := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun u : H1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H1 => u f) (B0_add (-s) s)
      change (B0 (-s)) ((B0 s) f) = _
      have hz := hh.symm
      simp only [neg_add_cancel,B0_zero,LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply] at hz
      exact hz
    simpa only [hi] using h

def M : VonNeumannAlgebra F1Rede.BosonicFock.F := FieldWeyl.R KWR.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule

theorem boostAd_preserves (t : ℝ) (x : F1Rede.BosonicFock.F →L[ℂ] F1Rede.BosonicFock.F) :
    x ∈ M ↔ WeylFlow.boostAd t x ∈ M :=
  FieldWeyl.R_covariance (B0 (-(2*Real.pi*t))) _ _ (boost_mem_KWR_iff (-(2*Real.pi*t))) x

def flow (t : ℝ) : M.toStarSubalgebra ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] M.toStarSubalgebra :=
  WeylFlow.restrictAutomorphism M (WeylFlow.boostAd t) (boostAd_preserves t)

theorem flow_is_Ad (t : ℝ) (a : M.toStarSubalgebra) :
    ((flow t) a).val = WeylFlow.boostAd t a.val := rfl

theorem flow_zero : flow 0 = StarAlgEquiv.refl := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change WeylFlow.boostAd 0 a.val = a.val
  rw [WeylFlow.boostAd_zero]
  rfl

theorem flow_add (s t : ℝ) : flow (s+t) = (flow s).trans (flow t) := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change WeylFlow.boostAd (s+t) a.val = WeylFlow.boostAd t (WeylFlow.boostAd s a.val)
  rw [WeylFlow.boostAd_add]
  rfl

end F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow
#print axioms F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow.Jcandidate_boost
#print axioms F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow.TW_graph_boost
#print axioms F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow.boost_mem_KWR_iff
#print axioms F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow.flow
#print axioms F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow.flow_add

import TGLExt.O16.RecognitionGraph_v2
/-! Generic reuse of the pairing/closure argument in TomitaClosability.lean.
The old proof is for TowerHilbert; this adapter accepts a commuting cyclic pair
and uses exactly the existing pairTomitaGraph. It does not assert its polar data. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
noncomputable section
open Set Topology
namespace F1Fecho.PairTomita
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (M N : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (Ω : H)

def orbit : Submodule ℂ H where
  carrier := (fun a : H →L[ℂ] H => a Ω) '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
  zero_mem' := ⟨0,M.zero_mem,rfl⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro x y ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a+b,M.add_mem ha hb,rfl⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c x ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c • a,M.smul_mem ha c,rfl⟩

theorem span_orbit :
    Submodule.span ℂ ((fun a : H →L[ℂ] H => a Ω) '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) = orbit M Ω :=
  Submodule.span_eq (orbit M Ω)

theorem dense_orbit_of_dense_span
    (h : Dense ((Submodule.span ℂ ((fun a : H →L[ℂ] H => a Ω) ''
      (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))) : Set H)) :
    Dense ((fun a : H →L[ℂ] H => a Ω) '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
  rw [span_orbit] at h
  exact h

abbrev graph := ORDEM016.D6.pairTomitaGraph M Ω

variable (hc : ∀ a ∈ M, ∀ b ∈ N, Commute a b)

include hc in
theorem pairing {a b : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ M) (hb : b ∈ N) :
    inner ℂ ((star a) Ω) (b Ω) = inner ℂ ((star b) Ω) (a Ω) := by
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
  have h := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T Ω) (hc a ha b hb).eq
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply] using congrArg (fun x : H => inner ℂ Ω x) h

include hc in
theorem closure_pairing {p : H × H} (hp : p ∈ closure (graph M Ω))
    {b : H →L[ℂ] H} (hb : b ∈ N) :
    inner ℂ p.2 (b Ω) = inner ℂ ((star b) Ω) p.1 := by
  have hclosed : IsClosed {p : H × H | inner ℂ p.2 (b Ω) = inner ℂ ((star b) Ω) p.1} := by
    apply isClosed_eq <;> fun_prop
  apply closure_minimal (t := {p : H × H | inner ℂ p.2 (b Ω) = inner ℂ ((star b) Ω) p.1}) ?_ hclosed hp
  rintro p ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
  exact pairing M N Ω hc ha hb

variable (hN : Dense ((fun b : H →L[ℂ] H => b Ω) '' (N : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))))

include hc hN in
theorem closure_functional (x y z : H) (hy : (x,y) ∈ closure (graph M Ω))
    (hz : (x,z) ∈ closure (graph M Ω)) : y = z := by
  apply hN.eq_of_inner_left ℂ
  rintro v ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
  exact (closure_pairing M N Ω hc hy hb).trans (closure_pairing M N Ω hc hz hb).symm

include hc hN in
theorem closure_vertical (y : H) (hy : (0,y) ∈ closure (graph M Ω)) : y = 0 := by
  apply hN.eq_zero_of_inner_left ℂ
  rintro v ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
  simpa only [inner_zero_right] using closure_pairing M N Ω hc hy hb

theorem domain_dense (hM : Dense ((fun a : H →L[ℂ] H => a Ω) '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))) :
    Dense (Prod.fst '' graph M Ω) := by
  apply Dense.mono ?_ hM
  rintro x ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨(a Ω,(star a) Ω),⟨a,ha,rfl⟩,rfl⟩

end F1Fecho.PairTomita
#print axioms F1Fecho.PairTomita.dense_orbit_of_dense_span
#print axioms F1Fecho.PairTomita.pairing
#print axioms F1Fecho.PairTomita.closure_functional
#print axioms F1Fecho.PairTomita.closure_vertical
#print axioms F1Fecho.PairTomita.domain_dense

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.PairTomitaClosabilityR2
/-! Generic reuse of ClosedTomitaOperator.lean on the actual pair graph.
The graph is closed here and its domain is constructed. Functionality is an
explicit argument, supplied by the commuting cyclic algebra theorem. This
does not assert that its polar conjugation or modular group is a given one. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
open Set Topology
namespace F1Fecho.PairTomita
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)} {Ω : H}

theorem graph_zero : (0,0) ∈ graph M Ω := by
  refine ⟨0,M.zero_mem,?_⟩
  simp

theorem graph_add {p q : H × H} (hp : p ∈ graph M Ω) (hq : q ∈ graph M Ω) :
    p+q ∈ graph M Ω := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨a+b,M.add_mem ha hb,?_⟩
  simp [star_add]

theorem graph_conj_smul (c : ℂ) {p : H × H} (hp : p ∈ graph M Ω) :
    (c • p.1, (starRingEnd ℂ c) • p.2) ∈ graph M Ω := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨c • a,M.smul_mem ha c,?_⟩
  simp only [star_smul,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,starRingEnd_apply]

theorem graph_swap {p : H × H} (hp : p ∈ graph M Ω) : p.swap ∈ graph M Ω := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨star a,star_mem ha,?_⟩
  simp

theorem closed_graph_add {p q : H × H}
    (hp : p ∈ closure (graph M Ω)) (hq : q ∈ closure (graph M Ω)) :
    p+q ∈ closure (graph M Ω) := by
  have hl : ∀ a ∈ graph M Ω, ∀ b ∈ closure (graph M Ω), a+b ∈ closure (graph M Ω) := by
    intro a ha
    exact closure_minimal (fun b hb => subset_closure (graph_add ha hb))
      (isClosed_closure.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
  exact closure_minimal (fun a ha => hl a ha q hq)
    (isClosed_closure.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)) hp

theorem closed_graph_conj_smul (c : ℂ) {p : H × H}
    (hp : p ∈ closure (graph M Ω)) :
    (c • p.1, (starRingEnd ℂ c) • p.2) ∈ closure (graph M Ω) := by
  apply closure_minimal (t := {p : H × H |
    (c • p.1, (starRingEnd ℂ c) • p.2) ∈ closure (graph M Ω)}) ?_ ?_ hp
  · intro p hp
    exact subset_closure (graph_conj_smul c hp)
  · apply isClosed_closure.preimage
    fun_prop

theorem closed_graph_swap {p : H × H} (hp : p ∈ closure (graph M Ω)) :
    p.swap ∈ closure (graph M Ω) := by
  apply closure_minimal (t := {p : H × H | p.swap ∈ closure (graph M Ω)}) ?_ ?_ hp
  · intro p hp
    exact subset_closure (graph_swap hp)
  · exact isClosed_closure.preimage continuous_swap

def closedDomain (M : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (Ω : H) : Submodule ℂ H where
  carrier := {x | ∃ y, (x,y) ∈ closure (graph M Ω)}
  zero_mem' := ⟨0,subset_closure graph_zero⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro x z ⟨y,hy⟩ ⟨w,hw⟩
    exact ⟨y+w,closed_graph_add hy hw⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c x ⟨y,hy⟩
    exact ⟨(starRingEnd ℂ c) • y,closed_graph_conj_smul c hy⟩

def closedValue (x : closedDomain M Ω) : H := Classical.choose x.property

theorem closedValue_graph (x : closedDomain M Ω) :
    ((x : H), closedValue x) ∈ closure (graph M Ω) := Classical.choose_spec x.property

def closedTomita
    (hf : ∀ x y z : H, (x,y) ∈ closure (graph M Ω) → (x,z) ∈ closure (graph M Ω) → y=z) :
    closedDomain M Ω →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] H where
  toFun := closedValue
  map_add' x z := by
    apply hf ((x+z : closedDomain M Ω) : H)
    · exact closedValue_graph (x+z)
    · exact closed_graph_add (closedValue_graph x) (closedValue_graph z)
  map_smul' c x := by
    apply hf ((c • x : closedDomain M Ω) : H)
    · exact closedValue_graph (c • x)
    · exact closed_graph_conj_smul c (closedValue_graph x)

variable (hf : ∀ x y z : H, (x,y) ∈ closure (graph M Ω) → (x,z) ∈ closure (graph M Ω) → y=z)

theorem closedTomita_graph (x : closedDomain M Ω) :
    ((x : H),closedTomita hf x) ∈ closure (graph M Ω) := closedValue_graph x

theorem closedTomita_graph_eq :
    Set.range (fun x : closedDomain M Ω => ((x : H),closedTomita hf x)) = closure (graph M Ω) := by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact closedTomita_graph hf x
  · intro hp
    let x : closedDomain M Ω := ⟨p.1,p.2,hp⟩
    refine ⟨x,?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact hf p.1 _ p.2 (closedTomita_graph hf x) hp

theorem closedTomita_isClosed :
    IsClosed (Set.range (fun x : closedDomain M Ω => ((x : H),closedTomita hf x))) := by
  rw [closedTomita_graph_eq]
  exact isClosed_closure

theorem closedDomain_dense
    (hM : Dense ((fun a : H →L[ℂ] H => a Ω) '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))) :
    Dense (closedDomain M Ω : Set H) := by
  apply Dense.mono ?_ (domain_dense M Ω hM)
  rintro x ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨p.2,subset_closure hp⟩

theorem closedTomita_maps_domain (x : closedDomain M Ω) :
    closedTomita hf x ∈ closedDomain M Ω :=
  ⟨(x : H),closed_graph_swap (closedTomita_graph hf x)⟩

theorem closedTomita_involutive (x : closedDomain M Ω) :
    closedTomita hf ⟨closedTomita hf x,closedTomita_maps_domain hf x⟩ = x := by
  exact hf (closedTomita hf x) _ _
    (closedTomita_graph hf ⟨closedTomita hf x,closedTomita_maps_domain hf x⟩)
    (closed_graph_swap (closedTomita_graph hf x))

theorem algebra_vector_mem_domain {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ M) :
    a Ω ∈ closedDomain M Ω := ⟨(star a) Ω,subset_closure ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩⟩

theorem closedTomita_extends_adjoint {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ M) :
    closedTomita hf ⟨a Ω,algebra_vector_mem_domain ha⟩ = (star a) Ω := by
  exact hf (a Ω) _ _ (closedTomita_graph hf ⟨a Ω,algebra_vector_mem_domain ha⟩)

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ConcreteWeylR1
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BosonicGammaJR5

/-! Antiunitary covariance of the concrete displacement, derived on the total
exponential family. This is algebraic covariance, not a modular identification. -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
