namespace F1Fecho.WeylAntiunitary
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential
open F1Fecho.Antilinear F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients ChatgptAudit.Continuous050

variable (j : H1 ≃ₛₗᵢ[starRingEnd ℂ] H1) (hj : Function.Involutive j)

theorem amplitude_anti (f g : H1) : amplitude (j f) (j g) = star (amplitude f g) := by
  simp only [amplitude, antiunitary_inner_conj, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj,
    map_sub, map_neg, map_div₀, map_ofNat]

def conjugateDisplacement (f : H1) : F →L[ℂ] F where
  toFun x := gammaJ j hj (ConcreteWeyl.W f (gammaJ j hj x))
  map_add' x y := by simp only [map_add]
  map_smul' c x := by
    simp only [map_smulₛₗ, map_smul, starRingEnd_apply, star_star, RingHom.id_apply]
  cont := (gammaJ j hj).continuous.comp ((ConcreteWeyl.W f).continuous.comp (gammaJ j hj).continuous)

theorem conjugate_displacement (f : H1) :
    conjugateDisplacement j hj f = ConcreteWeyl.W (j f) := by
  apply F1Fecho.WeylConstruction.clm_ext_total exponential exponential_total
  intro g
  change gammaJ j hj (ConcreteWeyl.W f (gammaJ j hj (exponential g))) = _
  rw [gammaJ_exponential, ConcreteWeyl.W_exponential, map_smulₛₗ,
    gammaJ_exponential, ConcreteWeyl.W_exponential]
  simp only [map_add, starRingEnd_apply]
  rw [← amplitude_anti j f (j g), hj g]

theorem displacement_intertwining (f : H1) (v : F) :
    gammaJ j hj (ConcreteWeyl.W f v) = ConcreteWeyl.W (j f) (gammaJ j hj v) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun A : F →L[ℂ] F => A (gammaJ j hj v)) (conjugate_displacement j hj f)
  change gammaJ j hj (ConcreteWeyl.W f (gammaJ j hj (gammaJ j hj v))) = _ at h
  simpa only [gammaJ_involutive j hj v] using h

theorem field_intertwining (f : H1) (v : F) :
    gammaJ j hj (FieldWeyl.W f v) = FieldWeyl.W (-j f) (gammaJ j hj v) := by
  change gammaJ j hj (ConcreteWeyl.W (Complex.I • f) v) =
    ConcreteWeyl.W (Complex.I • (-j f)) (gammaJ j hj v)
  rw [displacement_intertwining]
  have h : j (Complex.I • f) = Complex.I • (-j f) := by
    rw [map_smulₛₗ]
    change (starRingEnd ℂ) Complex.I • j f = Complex.I • (-j f)
    exact (congrArg (fun z : ℂ => z • j f) Complex.conj_I).trans
      ((neg_smul Complex.I (j f)).trans (smul_neg Complex.I (j f)).symm)
  rw [h]

end F1Fecho.WeylAntiunitary

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000

namespace F1Fecho.OneParticleSymplectic
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.CanonicalWedge ChatgptAudit.Continuous050

theorem TW_on_KWR (f : H1) (hf : f ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule) :
    ∃ hd : f ∈ TW.domain, TW ⟨f,hd⟩ = Jcandidate f := by
  obtain ⟨hd,hs⟩ := (KWR_mem f).mp hf
  refine ⟨hd,?_⟩
  change Jcandidate (TW ⟨f,hd⟩) = f at hs
  have h := congrArg Jcandidate hs
  simpa only [Jcandidate_involutive (TW ⟨f,hd⟩)] using h

theorem Jcandidate_into_symplectic (g : H1) (hg : g ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule) :
    Jcandidate g ∈ KWR.symplComp.toClosedSubmodule := by
  apply ClosedSubmodule.mem_symplComp_iff.mpr
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨df,tf⟩ := TW_on_KWR f hf
  obtain ⟨dg,tg⟩ := TW_on_KWR g hg
  have hsym : TW.IsFormalAdjoint TW := by
    have h := LinearPMap.adjoint_isFormalAdjoint (T := TW) (WT_dense rootParameter)
    simpa only [LinearPMap.isSelfAdjoint_def.mp TW_selfadjoint] using h
  have hinner : inner ℂ (Jcandidate f) g = inner ℂ f (Jcandidate g) := by
    simpa only [tf,tg] using hsym ⟨f,df⟩ ⟨g,dg⟩
  have hanti : inner ℂ (Jcandidate f) g = star (inner ℂ f (Jcandidate g)) := by
    simpa only [Jcandidate_involutive g] using
      antiunitary_inner_conj Jcandidate f (Jcandidate g)
  have h := congrArg Complex.im (hinner.symm.trans hanti)
  simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_im] at h
  linarith

end F1Fecho.OneParticleSymplectic

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.RealSubspaceTotalityR5
import Mathlib.Topology.Sequences
/-!
Concrete exponential lift of a self-adjoint one-particle operator on the SAME
constructed Fock space. Its closed graph is the closure of the span of
(e(f),e(Tf)); functionality is proved from the exponential inner kernel and
self-adjointness, not assumed. This supplies an actual graph core.
Self-adjointness/positivity of the CLOSED LIFT, tensor spectral identification,
and equality with the algebra-vacuum Tomita polar operator remain unclaimed.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology
namespace F1Fecho.ExponentialLift
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Rede.BosonicSectors
open F1Fecho.Exponential F1Fecho.WedgeExponential

variable (T : H1 →ₗ.[ℂ] H1)

def coreGraph : Submodule ℂ (F × F) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun f : T.domain => (exponential f, exponential (T f))))

def closedGraph : Submodule ℂ (F × F) := (coreGraph T).topologicalClosure

theorem domain_complex_dense (hT : Dense (T.domain : Set H1)) :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (T.domain.restrictScalars ℝ : Set H1)).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
  change (Submodule.span ℂ (T.domain : Set H1)).topologicalClosure = ⊤
  rw [Submodule.span_eq]
  exact Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp hT

theorem exponential_domain_total (hT : Dense (T.domain : Set H1)) :
    (Submodule.span ℂ (exponential '' (T.domain : Set H1))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
  exponential_real_subspace_total (T.domain.restrictScalars ℝ) (domain_complex_dense T hT)

theorem one_particle_pairing (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (f g : T.domain) :
    inner ℂ (T f) (g : H1) = inner ℂ (f : H1) (T g) := by
  have h := LinearPMap.adjoint_isFormalAdjoint (T := T) hT.dense_domain
  rw [LinearPMap.isSelfAdjoint_def.mp hT] at h
  exact h f g

theorem exponential_pairing (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (f g : T.domain) :
    inner ℂ (exponential (T f)) (exponential g) =
      inner ℂ (exponential f) (exponential (T g)) := by
  rw [exponential_inner,exponential_inner,one_particle_pairing T hT f g]

theorem core_pairing (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (p : F × F) (hp : p ∈ coreGraph T)
    (g : T.domain) : inner ℂ p.2 (exponential g) = inner ℂ p.1 (exponential (T g)) := by
  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem p hp =>
    obtain ⟨f,rfl⟩ := hp
    exact exponential_pairing T hT f g
  | zero => simp
  | add p q hp hq ihp ihq => simpa only [Prod.snd_add,Prod.fst_add,inner_add_left] using congrArg₂ (·+·) ihp ihq
  | smul c p hp ih =>
    change inner ℂ (c • p.2) (exponential g) = inner ℂ (c • p.1) (exponential (T g))
    rw [inner_smul_left,inner_smul_left,ih]

theorem closed_pairing (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (p : F × F) (hp : p ∈ closedGraph T)
    (g : T.domain) : inner ℂ p.2 (exponential g) = inner ℂ p.1 (exponential (T g)) := by
  have hc : IsClosed {q : F × F |
      inner ℂ q.2 (exponential g) = inner ℂ q.1 (exponential (T g))} :=
    isClosed_eq (continuous_snd.inner continuous_const) (continuous_fst.inner continuous_const)
  apply closure_minimal (fun q hq => core_pairing T hT q hq g) hc
  rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
  exact hp

theorem closedGraph_functional (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (x y z : F)
    (hy : (x,y) ∈ closedGraph T) (hz : (x,z) ∈ closedGraph T) : y = z := by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply exponential_real_subspace_orthogonal_zero (T.domain.restrictScalars ℝ)
    (domain_complex_dense T hT.dense_domain) (y-z)
  intro g hg
  have hp : (0,y-z) ∈ closedGraph T := by simpa only [Prod.mk_sub_mk,sub_self] using (closedGraph T).sub_mem hy hz
  have h := closed_pairing T hT (0,y-z) hp ⟨g,hg⟩
  simpa only [inner_zero_left] using h

def closedDomain : Submodule ℂ F where
  carrier := {x | ∃ y, (x,y) ∈ closedGraph T}
  zero_mem' := ⟨0,(closedGraph T).zero_mem⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro x z ⟨y,hy⟩ ⟨w,hw⟩
    exact ⟨y+w,(closedGraph T).add_mem hy hw⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c x ⟨y,hy⟩
    exact ⟨c•y,(closedGraph T).smul_mem c hy⟩

def closedValue (x : closedDomain T) : F := Classical.choose x.property

theorem closedValue_graph (x : closedDomain T) :
    ((x : F),closedValue T x) ∈ closedGraph T := Classical.choose_spec x.property

def closedLift (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) : F →ₗ.[ℂ] F where
  domain := closedDomain T
  toFun :=
    { toFun := closedValue T
      map_add' := fun x z => closedGraph_functional T hT _ _ _
        (closedValue_graph T (x+z)) ((closedGraph T).add_mem (closedValue_graph T x) (closedValue_graph T z))
      map_smul' := fun c x => closedGraph_functional T hT _ _ _
        (closedValue_graph T (c•x)) ((closedGraph T).smul_mem c (closedValue_graph T x)) }

theorem closedLift_graph_eq (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) : (closedLift T hT).graph = closedGraph T := by
  ext p
  rw [LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff']
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact closedValue_graph T x
  · intro hp
    let x : closedDomain T := ⟨p.1,p.2,hp⟩
    refine ⟨x,?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact closedGraph_functional T hT p.1 _ p.2 (closedValue_graph T x) hp

theorem closedLift_isClosed (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) :
    IsClosed ((closedLift T hT).graph : Set (F × F)) := by
  rw [closedLift_graph_eq]
  exact (coreGraph T).isClosed_topologicalClosure

theorem exponential_mem_domain (f : T.domain) : exponential f ∈ closedDomain T := by
  refine ⟨exponential (T f),?_⟩
  exact (coreGraph T).le_topologicalClosure (Submodule.subset_span ⟨f,rfl⟩)

theorem closedLift_exponential (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (f : T.domain) :
    closedLift T hT ⟨exponential f,exponential_mem_domain T f⟩ = exponential (T f) := by
  apply closedGraph_functional T hT (exponential f)
  · exact closedValue_graph T ⟨exponential f,exponential_mem_domain T f⟩
  · exact (coreGraph T).le_topologicalClosure (Submodule.subset_span ⟨f,rfl⟩)

theorem closedLift_exponential_sector (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (f : T.domain) (n : ℕ) :
    (closedLift T hT ⟨exponential f,exponential_mem_domain T f⟩) n =
      (weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n (T f) := by
  rw [closedLift_exponential]
  rfl

theorem closedGraph_pairing (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (p q : F × F)
    (hp : p ∈ closedGraph T) (hq : q ∈ closedGraph T) :
    inner ℂ p.2 q.1 = inner ℂ p.1 q.2 := by
  have hcore : ∀ z ∈ coreGraph T, inner ℂ p.2 z.1 = inner ℂ p.1 z.2 := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := hz
      exact closed_pairing T hT p hp g
    | zero => simp
    | add z w hz hw ihz ihw =>
      change inner ℂ p.2 (z.1+w.1) = inner ℂ p.1 (z.2+w.2)
      rw [inner_add_right,inner_add_right,ihz,ihw]
    | smul c z hz ih =>
      change inner ℂ p.2 (c•z.1) = inner ℂ p.1 (c•z.2)
      rw [inner_smul_right,inner_smul_right,ih]
  have hc : IsClosed {z : F × F | inner ℂ p.2 z.1 = inner ℂ p.1 z.2} :=
    isClosed_eq (continuous_const.inner continuous_fst) (continuous_const.inner continuous_snd)
  apply closure_minimal hcore hc
  rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
  exact hq

theorem closedLift_isFormalAdjoint (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) :
    (closedLift T hT).IsFormalAdjoint (closedLift T hT) := by
  intro x y
  exact closedGraph_pairing T hT ((x : F),closedLift T hT x)
    ((y : F),closedLift T hT y) (closedValue_graph T x) (closedValue_graph T y)

theorem closedDomain_dense (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) : Dense (closedDomain T : Set F) := by
  have hs : Submodule.span ℂ (exponential '' (T.domain : Set H1)) ≤ closedDomain T := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩
    exact exponential_mem_domain T ⟨f,hf⟩
  apply Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  rw [← exponential_domain_total T hT.dense_domain]
  exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_mono hs

/-- Actual graph-core conclusion: approximation in BOTH graph coordinates. -/
theorem core_graph_sequence (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (x : (closedLift T hT).domain) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → F × F, (∀ n, u n ∈ coreGraph T) ∧
      Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 ((x : F),closedLift T hT x)) := by
  have hp : ((x : F),closedLift T hT x) ∈ closedGraph T := closedValue_graph T x
  have hc : ((x : F),closedLift T hT x) ∈ closure (coreGraph T : Set (F × F)) := by
    rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
    exact hp
  exact mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hc

def canonicalLift : F →ₗ.[ℂ] F :=
  closedLift F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.TW F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.TW_selfadjoint

theorem canonicalLift_closed : IsClosed (canonicalLift.graph : Set (F × F)) :=
  closedLift_isClosed _ _

theorem canonicalLift_dense : Dense (canonicalLift.domain : Set F) :=
  closedDomain_dense _ F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.TW_selfadjoint

theorem canonicalLift_exponential (f : F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.TW.domain) :
    canonicalLift ⟨exponential f,exponential_mem_domain _ f⟩ =
      exponential (F1Rede.CanonicalWedge.TW f) := closedLift_exponential _ _ f

end F1Fecho.ExponentialLift

namespace F1Fecho.ExponentialLiftPositive

private theorem graph_pairing (Q : H1 →ₗ.[ℂ] H1) (hQ : IsSelfAdjoint Q)

  have he : 2*(rootParameter/2)=rootParameter := by ring
  rw [he]

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ExponentialLiftR2

/-! Closed, densely-defined involution obtained from the exponential lift and
concrete Gamma(J). This is an actual operator on the same Fock space, with a
proved graph invariance. Equality with the Tomita operator of the Weyl algebra
and vacuum is NOT asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000

open Filter Topology
namespace F1Fecho.ExponentialTomita
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential
open F1Fecho.ExponentialLift F1Fecho.Antilinear F1Rede.CanonicalWedge
open ChatgptAudit.Continuous049 ChatgptAudit.Continuous050 AuditF13v31

abbrev JF := canonicalFockJ

theorem JF_exponential (f : H1) : JF (exponential f) = exponential (Jcandidate f) :=
  gammaJ_exponential _ _ f

theorem TW_SW (f : TW.domain) : TW ⟨SW TW Jcandidate f,SW_maps f⟩ = Jcandidate f := by
  have h := congrArg Jcandidate (SW_involutive f)
  change Jcandidate (Jcandidate (TW ⟨SW TW Jcandidate f,SW_maps f⟩)) = Jcandidate f at h
  exact (Jcandidate_involutive _).symm.trans h

def flipJ (p : F × F) : F × F := (JF p.2,JF p.1)

theorem flipJ_continuous : Continuous flipJ :=
  (JF.continuous.comp continuous_snd).prodMk (JF.continuous.comp continuous_fst)

theorem flipJ_involutive (p : F × F) : flipJ (flipJ p) = p := by
  exact Prod.ext (canonicalFockJ_involutive p.1) (canonicalFockJ_involutive p.2)

theorem coreGraph_flipJ (p : F × F) (hp : p ∈ coreGraph TW) : flipJ p ∈ coreGraph TW := by
  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem p hp =>
    obtain ⟨f,rfl⟩ := hp
    have hg : (exponential (SW TW Jcandidate f),
        exponential (TW ⟨SW TW Jcandidate f,SW_maps f⟩)) ∈ coreGraph TW :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨SW TW Jcandidate f,SW_maps f⟩,rfl⟩
    rw [TW_SW] at hg
    change (JF (exponential (TW f)),JF (exponential f)) ∈ coreGraph TW
    rw [JF_exponential,JF_exponential]
    exact hg
  | zero =>
    change (JF 0,JF 0) ∈ coreGraph TW
    rw [map_zero]
    exact (coreGraph TW).zero_mem
  | add p q hp hq ihp ihq =>
    have he : flipJ (p+q) = flipJ p + flipJ q := by
      apply Prod.ext <;> simp only [flipJ,Prod.fst_add,Prod.snd_add,map_add]
    rw [he]
    exact (coreGraph TW).add_mem ihp ihq
  | smul c p hp ih =>
    have he : flipJ (c • p) = star c • flipJ p := by
      apply Prod.ext <;> exact JF.map_smulₛₗ c _
    rw [he]
    exact (coreGraph TW).smul_mem (star c) ih

theorem closedGraph_flipJ (p : F × F) (hp : p ∈ closedGraph TW) :
    flipJ p ∈ closedGraph TW := by
  have hc : IsClosed {q : F × F | flipJ q ∈ closedGraph TW} :=
    (coreGraph TW).isClosed_topologicalClosure.preimage flipJ_continuous
  have hi : closure (coreGraph TW : Set (F × F)) ⊆ {q : F × F | flipJ q ∈ closedGraph TW} :=
    closure_minimal (fun q hq => (coreGraph TW).le_topologicalClosure (coreGraph_flipJ q hq)) hc
  apply hi
  rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
  exact hp

def Sexp : canonicalLift.domain →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] F :=
  (genericTomita canonicalLift JF).toFun

theorem Sexp_maps_domain (x : canonicalLift.domain) : Sexp x ∈ canonicalLift.domain :=
  ⟨JF x,closedGraph_flipJ ((x:F),canonicalLift x) (closedValue_graph TW x)⟩

theorem Sexp_involutive (x : canonicalLift.domain) :
    Sexp ⟨Sexp x,Sexp_maps_domain x⟩ = x := by
  have h : canonicalLift ⟨Sexp x,Sexp_maps_domain x⟩ = JF x :=
    closedGraph_functional TW TW_selfadjoint (Sexp x) _ _
      (closedValue_graph TW ⟨Sexp x,Sexp_maps_domain x⟩)
      (closedGraph_flipJ ((x:F),canonicalLift x) (closedValue_graph TW x))
  change JF (canonicalLift ⟨Sexp x,Sexp_maps_domain x⟩) = (x:F)
  rw [h]
  exact canonicalFockJ_involutive x

theorem Sexp_graph_iff (p : F × F) :
    p ∈ Set.range (fun x : canonicalLift.domain => ((x:F),Sexp x)) ↔
      (p.1,JF p.2) ∈ closedGraph TW := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
    change ((x:F),JF (JF (canonicalLift x))) ∈ closedGraph TW
    rw [canonicalFockJ_involutive]
    exact closedValue_graph TW x
  · intro hp
    let x : canonicalLift.domain := ⟨p.1,JF p.2,hp⟩
    have h : canonicalLift x = JF p.2 :=
      closedGraph_functional TW TW_selfadjoint p.1 _ _ (closedValue_graph TW x) hp
    refine ⟨x,?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · change JF (canonicalLift x) = p.2
      rw [h]
      exact canonicalFockJ_involutive p.2

theorem Sexp_closed :
    IsClosed (Set.range (fun x : canonicalLift.domain => ((x:F),Sexp x))) := by
  have he : Set.range (fun x : canonicalLift.domain => ((x:F),Sexp x)) =
      (fun p : F × F => (p.1,JF p.2)) ⁻¹' (closedGraph TW : Set (F × F)) := by
    ext p
    exact Sexp_graph_iff p
  rw [he]
  exact (coreGraph TW).isClosed_topologicalClosure.preimage
    (continuous_fst.prodMk (JF.continuous.comp continuous_snd))

theorem Sexp_dense : Dense (canonicalLift.domain : Set F) := canonicalLift_dense

theorem Sexp_exponential (f : TW.domain) :
    Sexp ⟨exponential f,exponential_mem_domain TW f⟩ = exponential (SW TW Jcandidate f) := by
  change JF (canonicalLift ⟨exponential f,exponential_mem_domain TW f⟩) = _
  rw [canonicalLift_exponential,JF_exponential]
  rfl

end F1Fecho.ExponentialTomita

#print axioms F1Fecho.ExponentialTomita.coreGraph_flipJ
#print axioms F1Fecho.ExponentialTomita.closedGraph_flipJ
#print axioms F1Fecho.ExponentialTomita.Sexp_maps_domain

#print axioms F1Fecho.ExponentialTomita.Sexp_closed

import TGLExt.V350RegularDualAction
/-! Generic regular covariant representation, faithful generated-algebra embedding
and dual action for an actual strongly continuous unitary flow. No trace or
modular-state identification is assumed or asserted. The concrete Fock flow is
an instance supplied in the separate consumer, not a claimed hypothetical one. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore
open TGLV350.Regular
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
structure UnitaryFlow (H : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] where
  U : ℝ → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H
  zero : U 0 = .refl ℂ H
  add : ∀ s t, U (s+t) = (U t).trans (U s)
  strong : ∀ v, Continuous (fun t => U t v)
variable (B : UnitaryFlow H)

def boostIso (t : ℝ) : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H := B.U t
def boostCLM (t : ℝ) : H →L[ℂ] H := (boostIso B t).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap

theorem boostIso_zero : boostIso B 0 = .refl ℂ H := B.zero

theorem boostIso_add (s t : ℝ) : boostIso B (s+t) = (boostIso B t).trans (boostIso B s) := B.add s t

theorem boostIso_neg (t : ℝ) : boostIso B (-t) = (boostIso B t).symm := by
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro v
  apply (boostIso B t).injective
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h := congrArg (fun u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H => u v) (boostIso_add B t (-t))
  have hz := h.symm
  simp only [add_neg_cancel,boostIso_zero B,LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply] at hz
  exact hz

theorem boostCLM_zero : boostCLM B 0 = 1 := by rw [boostCLM,boostIso_zero B]; rfl

theorem boostCLM_mul (s t : ℝ) : boostCLM B s * boostCLM B t = boostCLM B (s+t) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  change boostIso B s (boostIso B t v) = boostIso B (s+t) v
  rw [boostIso_add B]
  rfl

theorem boostCLM_eq_coe (t : ℝ) :
    boostCLM B t = (boostIso B t : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  rfl

theorem boostCLM_star (t : ℝ) : star (boostCLM B t) = boostCLM B (-t) := by
  rw [boostCLM_eq_coe B,LinearIsometryEquiv.star_eq_symm,boostCLM_eq_coe B,boostIso_neg B]

theorem boostIso_strong (v : H) : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => boostIso B t v) := by
  exact B.strong v

def automorphism (t : ℝ) : (H →L[ℂ] H) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := (boostIso B t).conjStarAlgEquiv

theorem boostAd_sandwich (t : ℝ) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    automorphism B t A = boostCLM B t * A * star (boostCLM B t) := by
  rw [boostCLM_eq_coe B,LinearIsometryEquiv.star_eq_symm]
  rfl

def regularUnitary (t : ℝ) : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H :=
  fibre (boostCLM B t) * shift t

theorem regular_zero : regularUnitary B 0 = 1 := by
  simp only [regularUnitary,boostCLM_zero B,fibre_one,shift_zero,mul_one]

theorem regular_mul (s t : ℝ) : regularUnitary B s * regularUnitary B t = regularUnitary B (s+t) := by
  unfold regularUnitary
  calc
    (fibre (boostCLM B s) * shift s) * (fibre (boostCLM B t) * shift t)
      = fibre (boostCLM B s) * (shift s * fibre (boostCLM B t)) * shift t := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = fibre (boostCLM B s) * (fibre (boostCLM B t) * shift s) * shift t := by rw [shift_commutes_fibre]
    _ = (fibre (boostCLM B s) * fibre (boostCLM B t)) * (shift s * shift t) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = fibre (boostCLM B (s+t)) * shift (s+t) := by rw [← fibre_mul,boostCLM_mul B,shift_mul]

theorem regular_star (t : ℝ) : star (regularUnitary B t) = regularUnitary B (-t) := by
  unfold regularUnitary
  rw [star_mul,shift_star,← fibre_star,boostCLM_star B,shift_commutes_fibre]

theorem regular_unitary (t : ℝ) : star (regularUnitary B t) * regularUnitary B t = 1 ∧
    regularUnitary B t * star (regularUnitary B t) = 1 := by
  constructor
  · rw [regular_star B,regular_mul B,neg_add_cancel,regular_zero B]
  · rw [regular_star B,regular_mul B,add_neg_cancel,regular_zero B]

theorem regular_covariance (t : ℝ) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    regularUnitary B t * fibre A * star (regularUnitary B t) =
      fibre (automorphism B t A) := by
  rw [boostAd_sandwich B,fibre_mul,fibre_mul,fibre_star]
  unfold regularUnitary
  calc
    _ = fibre (boostCLM B t) * (shift t * fibre A * star (shift (H := H) t)) *
      star (fibre (boostCLM B t)) := by simp only [star_mul,mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [shift_star,shift_fibre_sandwich]

theorem regular_strongly_continuous (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => regularUnitary B t f) := by
  have h := fibre_jointly_continuous (H := H) (Z := ℝ)
    (fun t => (boostIso B t).toLinearIsometry) (boostIso_strong B)
  have hp : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (shift (H := H) t f,t)) :=
    (shift_strongly_continuous f).prodMk continuous_id
  refine (h.comp hp).congr ?_
  intro t
  change fibre (boostIso B t).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap (shift t f) = regularUnitary B t f
  rfl

def generators (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Set (RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) :=
  (fibre '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) ∪ Set.range (regularUnitary B)

def core (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : VonNeumannAlgebra (RegularHilbert H) :=
  generatedAlgebra (generators B M)

theorem fibre_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : A ∈ M) : fibre A ∈ core B M :=
  generator_mem (Or.inl ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩)

theorem regular_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (t : ℝ) : regularUnitary B t ∈ core B M :=
  generator_mem (Or.inr ⟨t,rfl⟩)

def amplification (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : M.toStarSubalgebra →⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) :=
  fibreRepresentation.comp M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype

def embedding (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : M.toStarSubalgebra →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (core B M).toStarSubalgebra :=
  (amplification M).codRestrict (core B M).toStarSubalgebra (fun A => fibre_mem B M A A.property)

theorem embedding_injective (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Function.Injective (embedding B M) := by
  intro A B h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply fibre_injective
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

theorem core_minimal (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra (RegularHilbert H))
    (hM : ∀ A ∈ M, fibre A ∈ N) (hU : ∀ t : ℝ, regularUnitary B t ∈ N) : core B M ≤ N := by
  apply generated_minimal (generators B M) N
  intro A hA
  rcases hA with ⟨A0,hA0,rfl⟩ | ⟨t,rfl⟩
  · exact hM A0 hA0
  · exact hU t

theorem dual_on_regular (s t : ℝ) :
    dualAmbient s (regularUnitary B t) = characterPhase s t • regularUnitary B t := by
  rw [dualAmbient_apply]
  unfold regularUnitary
  calc
    _ = fibre (boostCLM B t) * (characterMultiplier s * shift t *
      star (characterMultiplier (H := H) s)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc (characterMultiplier s),characterMultiplier_commutes_fibre]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [characterMultiplier_weyl,mul_smul_comm]; rfl

theorem dual_preserves_generators (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (s : ℝ) :
    ∀ A ∈ generators B M, dualAmbient s A ∈ core B M := by
  intro A hA
  rcases hA with ⟨A0,hA0,rfl⟩ | ⟨t,rfl⟩
  · rw [dualAmbient_fibre]
    exact fibre_mem B M A0 hA0
  · rw [dual_on_regular B]
    exact (core B M).toStarSubalgebra.smul_mem (regular_mem B M t) _

def dualAction (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (s : ℝ) :
    (core B M).toStarSubalgebra ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (core B M).toStarSubalgebra :=
  generatedAutomorphism (dualAmbient s) (generators B M) (dual_preserves_generators B M s) (by
    rw [dualAmbient_symm (H := H)]
    exact dual_preserves_generators B M (-s))

theorem dualAction_zero (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : dualAction B M 0 = StarAlgEquiv.refl := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro A
  apply Subtype.ext
  change dualAmbient (H := H) 0 (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) = A
  rw [dualAmbient_zero (H := H)]
  rfl

theorem dualAction_add (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (s t : ℝ) :
    dualAction B M (s+t) = (dualAction B M s).trans (dualAction B M t) := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro A
  apply Subtype.ext
  change dualAmbient (H := H) (s+t) (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) =
    dualAmbient t (dualAmbient s A)
  rw [dualAmbient_add (H := H)]
  rfl

theorem dual_fixes_embedding (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (s : ℝ) (A : M.toStarSubalgebra) :
    dualAction B M s (embedding B M A) = embedding B M A := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact dualAmbient_fibre (H := H) s (A : H →L[ℂ] H)

theorem dual_strongly_continuous (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A : (core B M).toStarSubalgebra) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (dualAction B M s A).val f) :=
  dualAmbient_strongly_continuous (H := H) (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) f

end F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore

    regularUnitary t * star (regularUnitary t) = 1 :=
  F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.regular_unitary fockFlow t

theorem regular_strongly_continuous (f : RegularHilbert F) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => regularUnitary t f) :=
  F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.regular_strongly_continuous fockFlow f

theorem automorphism_is_concrete_boost (t : ℝ) :
    F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.automorphism fockFlow t = F1Fecho.WeylFlow.boostAd t := rfl

theorem regular_covariance (t : ℝ) (A : M.toStarSubalgebra) :
    regularUnitary t * fibre (A : F →L[ℂ] F) * star (regularUnitary t) =
      fibre ((F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow.flow t A).val) := by
  change regularUnitary t * fibre (A : F →L[ℂ] F) * star (regularUnitary t) =
    fibre (F1Fecho.WeylFlow.boostAd t A.val)
  rw [← automorphism_is_concrete_boost]
  exact F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.regular_covariance fockFlow t A.val

theorem core_minimal (N : VonNeumannAlgebra (RegularHilbert F))
    (hM : ∀ A ∈ M, fibre A ∈ N) (hU : ∀ t : ℝ, regularUnitary t ∈ N) :
    core ≤ N := F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core_minimal fockFlow M N hM hU

theorem dualAction_zero : dualAction 0 = StarAlgEquiv.refl :=
  F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.dualAction_zero fockFlow M

theorem dualAction_add (s t : ℝ) :
    dualAction (s+t) = (dualAction s).trans (dualAction t) :=
  F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.dualAction_add fockFlow M s t

theorem dual_fixes_embedding (s : ℝ) (A : M.toStarSubalgebra) :
    dualAction s (embedding A) = embedding A :=
  F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.dual_fixes_embedding fockFlow M s A

theorem dual_eigencharacter (s t : ℝ) :
    dualAction s ⟨regularUnitary t,regular_mem t⟩ =
      characterPhase s t • (⟨regularUnitary t,regular_mem t⟩ : core.toStarSubalgebra) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.dual_on_regular fockFlow s t

theorem dual_strongly_continuous (A : core.toStarSubalgebra) (f : RegularHilbert F) :
    Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (dualAction s A).val f) :=
  F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.dual_strongly_continuous fockFlow M A f

end F1Fecho.CanonicalFockRegular

      unless axs.all (fun a => a == `propext || a == `Classical.choice || a == `Quot.sound) do
        throwError "AXIOM_AUDIT_REFUSED: {n}"
      match ci with
      | .axiomInfo _ => throwError "LOCAL_AXIOM_REFUSED: {n}"
      | _ => pure ()

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.OneParticleSymplecticR2
/-! Exact one-particle symplectic duality for the already constructed standard
wedge. The reverse inclusion uses the actual self-adjoint TW and its domain;
no Haag-duality or Fock polar-identification hypothesis is introduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.OneParticleDuality
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.CanonicalWedge AuditF13v31
open ChatgptAudit.Continuous049 ChatgptAudit.Continuous050
open F1Fecho.OneParticleSymplectic

theorem symplectic_tomita_pairing (g : H1)
    (hg : g ∈ KWR.symplComp.toClosedSubmodule) (x : TW.domain) :
    inner ℂ (SW TW Jcandidate x) g = inner ℂ g (x : H1) := by
  obtain ⟨h,k,hh,hk,hx,hs⟩ :=
    domain_fixed_decomposition TW.domain (SW TW Jcandidate) SW_maps SW_involutive x
  have hhK : h ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule := hh
  have hkK : k ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule := hk
  have hg' := ClosedSubmodule.mem_symplComp_iff.mp hg
  have hreal : star (inner ℂ h g) = inner ℂ h g := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_re]
    · simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_im,hg' h hhK,neg_zero]
  have kreal : star (inner ℂ k g) = inner ℂ k g := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_re]
    · simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_im,hg' k hkK,neg_zero]
  have hswap : inner ℂ g h = inner ℂ h g := (inner_conj_symm g h).symm.trans hreal
  have kswap : inner ℂ g k = inner ℂ k g := (inner_conj_symm g k).symm.trans kreal
  rw [hs,hx,inner_sub_left,inner_smul_left,inner_add_right,inner_smul_right,hswap,kswap]
  simp only [map_neg,Complex.conj_I,neg_neg]
  ring

theorem Jcandidate_of_symplectic (g : H1)
    (hg : g ∈ KWR.symplComp.toClosedSubmodule) :
    Jcandidate g ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule := by
  obtain ⟨hd,heq⟩ := generic_adjoint_maximal TW TW_selfadjoint Jcandidate
    Jcandidate_involutive (fun x => symplectic_tomita_pairing g hg x)
  change Jcandidate g ∈ TW.domain at hd
  have hT : TW ⟨Jcandidate g,hd⟩ = g := heq
  apply (KWR_mem _).mpr
  refine ⟨hd,?_⟩
  change Jcandidate (TW ⟨Jcandidate g,hd⟩) = Jcandidate g
  rw [hT]

theorem Jcandidate_mem_symplectic_iff (g : H1) :
    Jcandidate g ∈ KWR.symplComp.toClosedSubmodule ↔ g ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [Jcandidate_involutive g] using Jcandidate_of_symplectic (Jcandidate g) h
  · exact Jcandidate_into_symplectic g

theorem Jcandidate_image_equals_symplectic :
    Jcandidate '' (KWR.toClosedSubmodule : Set H1) =
      (KWR.symplComp.toClosedSubmodule : Set H1) := by
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩
    exact Jcandidate_into_symplectic f hf
  · intro hg
    exact ⟨Jcandidate g,Jcandidate_of_symplectic g hg,Jcandidate_involutive g⟩

end F1Fecho.OneParticleDuality

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.OneParticleDualityR2
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Typeclasses.NoAtoms
/-! The canonical half-modular multiplier has no fixed vector, since its
multiplier equals one only at a Lebesgue-null singleton. Consequently its
standard wedge is not symplectically isotropic. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace F1Fecho.WedgeNonisotropic
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.CanonicalWedge F1Rede.Canonical AuditF13v31
open F1Fecho.OneParticleSymplectic F1Fecho.OneParticleDuality

theorem TW_fixed_zero (f : TW.domain) (hf : TW f = (f : H1)) : (f : H1) = 0 := by
  have hgraph : ((f : H1),(f : H1)) ∈ TW.graph := by
    simpa only [hf] using TW.mem_graph f
  have hmult := (TW_multiplier (f : H1) (f : H1)).mp hgraph
  have hzero : Phi (f : H1) = 0 := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hmult,Measure.ae_ne (volume : Measure ℝ) 0,
      Lp.coeFn_zero (TransverseFiber) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)] with x hx hxn hz
    rw [hz]
    have he : (Real.exp (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * x) : ℂ) ≠ 1 := by
      intro he
      have hr : Real.exp (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * x) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast he
      have harg := Real.exp_injective (hr.trans Real.exp_zero.symm)
      have hp : 2 * Real.pi ^ 2 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero _ Real.pi_ne_zero)
      exact hxn ((mul_eq_zero.mp harg).resolve_left hp)
    have hsm : ((Real.exp (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * x) : ℂ) - 1) • Phi (f : H1) x = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul,one_smul,← hx,sub_self]
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hsm).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr he)
  apply Phi.injective
  simpa using hzero

theorem KWR_inter_JKWR_zero (f : H1) (hf : f ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule)
    (hj : Jcandidate f ∈ KWR.toClosedSubmodule) : f = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨df,tf⟩ := TW_on_KWR f hf
  obtain ⟨dj,tj⟩ := TW_on_KWR (Jcandidate f) hj
  have tj' : TW ⟨Jcandidate f,dj⟩ = f := by simpa only [Jcandidate_involutive f] using tj
  have hsum : f + Jcandidate f = 0 := by
    apply TW_fixed_zero ⟨f + Jcandidate f,TW.domain.add_mem df dj⟩
    have h := TW.map_add ⟨f,df⟩ ⟨Jcandidate f,dj⟩
    change TW ⟨f + Jcandidate f,TW.domain.add_mem df dj⟩ = TW ⟨f,df⟩ + TW ⟨Jcandidate f,dj⟩ at h
    rw [tf,tj'] at h
    exact h.trans (add_comm _ _)
  have hjneg : Jcandidate f = -f := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (by simpa only [add_comm] using hsum)
  have hp := TW_positive ⟨f,df⟩

  intro h

  rw [h,zero_mul,phase_self_neg,add_neg_cancel,FieldWeyl.W_zero,one_smul] at hw

  norm_num at hn

    phase f g = -Complex.I ∧ phase g f = Complex.I := by
  have hs : (inner ℂ g f).im = -(Real.pi/2) := by
    rw [← inner_conj_symm g f]
    simpa only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_im,h]

    convert Complex.exp_neg_pi_div_two_mul_I using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring

  obtain ⟨f,hf,g,hg,hd⟩ := KWR_not_isotropic

  refine ⟨f,hf,t • g,KWR.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule.smul_mem t hg,?_⟩
  rw [inner_smul_right_eq_smul,Complex.smul_im]

  dsimp [t]

    ∃ b ∈ FieldWeyl.R KWR.toClosedSubmodule.toSubmodule, a*b ≠ b*a := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf,g,hg,hfg⟩ := normalized_pair
  refine ⟨FieldWeyl.W f,FieldWeyl.W_mem_R _ f hf,
    FieldWeyl.W g,FieldWeyl.W_mem_R _ g hg,?_⟩

  have hi := congrArg Complex.im he
  norm_num at hi

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.DiffContOnCl
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Basic

/-! A uniformly bounded operator family is weakly analytic if all coefficients
on a total family are analytic. Closure follows from a uniform coefficient
estimate, not from a new analyticity premise for arbitrary vectors. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology
namespace F1Fecho.BoundedWeakAnalytic
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

theorem coefficient_uniform_left (B : ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) (U : Set ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ U, ‖B z‖ ≤ 1) (v : H) (u : ℕ → H) (x : H)
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 x)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n z => inner ℂ (u n) (B z v))
      (fun z => inner ℂ x (B z v)) atTop U := by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ‖u n-x‖*‖v‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (hu.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := x))).norm.mul_const ‖v‖
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with n hn
  intro z hz
  rw [dist_comm,dist_eq_norm,← inner_sub_left]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖u n-x‖*‖B z v‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖u n-x‖*‖v‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((B z).le_opNorm v |>.trans (by nlinarith [hB z hz,norm_nonneg v])) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ < ε := hn

theorem coefficient_uniform_right (B : ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) (U : Set ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ U, ‖B z‖ ≤ 1) (v : H) (u : ℕ → H) (x : H)
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 x)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n z => inner ℂ v (B z (u n)))
      (fun z => inner ℂ v (B z x)) atTop U := by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ‖v‖*‖u n-x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (hu.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := x))).norm.const_mul ‖v‖
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with n hn
  intro z hz
  rw [dist_comm,dist_eq_norm,← inner_sub_right,← map_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖v‖*‖B z (u n-x)‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖v‖*‖u n-x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((B z).le_opNorm _ |>.trans (by nlinarith [hB z hz,norm_nonneg (u n-x)])) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ < ε := hn

theorem closed_left (B : ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ closure U, ‖B z‖ ≤ 1) (y : H) :
    IsClosed {x | DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => inner ℂ x (B z y)) U} := by
  apply isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro u x hu hx
  have ht := coefficient_uniform_left B (closure U) hB y u x hx
  exact ⟨(ht.mono subset_closure).tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.differentiableOn
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hu n).differentiableOn) hU,
    ht.continuousOn (Filter.Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hu n).continuousOn))⟩

theorem closed_right (B : ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ closure U, ‖B z‖ ≤ 1) (y : H) :
    IsClosed {x | DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => inner ℂ y (B z x)) U} := by
  apply isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro u x hu hx
  have ht := coefficient_uniform_right B (closure U) hB y u x hx
  exact ⟨(ht.mono subset_closure).tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.differentiableOn
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hu n).differentiableOn) hU,
    ht.continuousOn (Filter.Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hu n).continuousOn))⟩

theorem of_total {I : Type*} (e : I → H)
    (he : (Submodule.span ℂ (range e)).topologicalClosure = ⊤)
    (B : ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ closure U, ‖B z‖ ≤ 1)
    (ha : ∀ i j, DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => inner ℂ (e i) (B z (e j))) U) :
    ∀ x y : H, DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => inner ℂ x (B z y)) U := by
  have hd : Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (range e) : Set H) :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr he
  have hfirst (i : I) (y : H) : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => inner ℂ (e i) (B z y)) U := by
    apply (closed_right B U hU hB (e i)).closure_subset_iff.mpr ?_ (hd y)
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy => obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := hy; exact ha i j
    | zero => simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,map_zero,inner_zero_right] using (diffContOnCl_const (𝕜 := ℂ) (s := U) (c := (0:ℂ)))
    | add y z hy hz ihy ihz => simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,map_add,inner_add_right,Pi.add_def] using ihy.add ihz
    | smul c y hy ih => simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,map_smul,inner_smul_right,Pi.smul_def,smul_eq_mul] using ih.const_smul c
  intro x y
  apply (closed_left B U hU hB y).closure_subset_iff.mpr ?_ (hd x)
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := hx; exact hfirst i y
  | zero => simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,inner_zero_left] using (diffContOnCl_const (𝕜 := ℂ) (s := U) (c := (0:ℂ)))
  | add x z hx hz ihx ihz => simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,inner_add_left,Pi.add_def] using ihx.add ihz
  | smul c x hx ih => simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,inner_smul_left,Pi.smul_def,smul_eq_mul] using ih.const_smul ((starRingEnd ℂ) c)

end F1Fecho.BoundedWeakAnalytic

#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedWeakAnalytic.coefficient_uniform_right
#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedWeakAnalytic.of_total

    Lp E 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp E 2 μ :=

    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] (μ : Measure X)

  rw [hx,norm_smul]

theorem norm_sum_tmul_sq {I : Type*} [Fintype I]

    | tmul x y => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add,hx,hy]
  have h := norm_map_first_le B (TensorProduct.comm ℂ E F x)
  rw [← he,TensorProduct.norm_comm,TensorProduct.norm_comm] at h
  exact h

theorem norm_map_le (A : E →L[ℂ] G) (B : F →L[ℂ] H) (x : E ⊗[ℂ] F) :
    ‖TensorProduct.map A.toLinearMap B.toLinearMap x‖ ≤ (‖A‖ * ‖B‖) * ‖x‖ := by
  have he : TensorProduct.map A.toLinearMap B.toLinearMap x =
      TensorProduct.map A.toLinearMap (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[ℂ] H)
        (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) B.toLinearMap x) := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul x y => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add,hx,hy]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) B.toLinearMap x‖ :=
      norm_map_first_le A _
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ * (‖B‖ * ‖x‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_map_second_le B x) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

def mapCLM (A : E →L[ℂ] G) (B : F →L[ℂ] H) : E ⊗[ℂ] F →L[ℂ] G ⊗[ℂ] H :=
  (TensorProduct.map A.toLinearMap B.toLinearMap).mkContinuous (‖A‖*‖B‖) (norm_map_le A B)

theorem mapCLM_tmul (A : E →L[ℂ] G) (B : F →L[ℂ] H) (x : E) (y : F) :
    mapCLM A B (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) = A x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] B y := rfl

theorem mapCLM_norm_le (A : E →L[ℂ] G) (B : F →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖mapCLM A B‖ ≤ ‖A‖*‖B‖ :=
  (mapCLM A B).opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_map_le A B)

end F1Fecho.BoundedTensor

#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedTensor.norm_map_first_le
#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedTensor.norm_map_le
#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedTensor.mapCLM_norm_le

The algebraic tensor action is extended by continuity, restricted to the
constructed symmetric sectors, and then summed in the existing Fock space. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2200000
noncomputable section
open UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct InnerProductSpace ENNReal
namespace F1Fecho.BoundedGamma
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicSectors F1Rede.BosonicFock
open F1Fecho.Exponential

def algebraic (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) : (n : ℕ) → Algebraic n →L[ℂ] Algebraic n
  | 0 => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ
  | n+1 => BoundedTensor.mapCLM A (algebraic A n)

theorem algebraic_bound (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : Algebraic n) :
    ‖algebraic A n x‖ ≤ ‖A‖^n * ‖x‖ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => change ‖(x : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖A‖^0 * ‖x‖; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    change ‖BoundedTensor.mapCLM A (algebraic A n) x‖ ≤ _
    have hn : ‖algebraic A n‖ ≤ ‖A‖^n :=
      (algebraic A n).opNorm_le_bound (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) ih
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖A‖ * ‖algebraic A n‖) * ‖x‖ := BoundedTensor.norm_map_le A (algebraic A n) x
      _ ≤ (‖A‖ * ‖A‖^n) * ‖x‖ := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

theorem algebraic_pure (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    algebraic A n (pureAlgebraic x n) = pureAlgebraic (A x) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change BoundedTensor.mapCLM A (algebraic A n) (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] pureAlgebraic x n) = _
    rw [BoundedTensor.mapCLM_tmul,ih]
    rfl

def tensor (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) : TensorHilbert n →L[ℂ] TensorHilbert n :=
  ((Completion.toComplL : Algebraic n →L[ℂ] TensorHilbert n).comp (algebraic A n)).extend
    (Completion.toComplL : Algebraic n →L[ℂ] TensorHilbert n)

@[simp] theorem tensor_coe (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : Algebraic n) :
    tensor A n (x : TensorHilbert n) = (algebraic A n x : TensorHilbert n) := by
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.extend_eq _ Completion.denseRange_coe
    (Completion.isUniformInducing_coe _) x

theorem tensor_bound (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : TensorHilbert n) :
    ‖tensor A n x‖ ≤ ‖A‖^n * ‖x‖ := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_le (tensor A n).continuous.norm
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)) ?_
  intro y
  simpa only [tensor_coe,Completion.norm_coe] using algebraic_bound A n y

theorem tensor_pure (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    tensor A n (pureCompleted n x) = pureCompleted n (A x) := by
  simp only [pureCompleted,tensor_coe,algebraic_pure]

theorem tensor_mem (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) {x : TensorHilbert n}
    (hx : x ∈ symmetricSpace n) : tensor A n x ∈ symmetricSpace n := by
  let S := symmetricSpace n
  have hb : algebraicSymmetricSpan n ≤ S.comap (tensor A n).toLinearMap := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨y,rfl⟩
    change tensor A n (pureCompleted n y) ∈ S
    rw [tensor_pure]
    exact pureCompleted_mem n (A y)
  have hc : IsClosed (S.comap (tensor A n).toLinearMap : Set (TensorHilbert n)) :=
    (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).isClosed_topologicalClosure.preimage (tensor A n).continuous
  exact (algebraicSymmetricSpan n).topologicalClosure_minimal hb hc hx

def sector (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) : Sector n →L[ℂ] Sector n :=
  ((tensor A n).comp (symmetricSpace n).subtypeL).codRestrict
    (symmetricSpace n) (fun x => tensor_mem A n x.property)

@[simp] theorem sector_pure (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : H1) :
    sector A n (pureTensor n x) = pureTensor n (A x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact tensor_pure A n x

theorem sector_bound (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (n : ℕ) (x : Sector n) :
    ‖sector A n x‖ ≤ ‖A‖^n * ‖x‖ := tensor_bound A n x

theorem sector_contraction (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (x : Sector n) :
    ‖sector A n x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  have hpow : ‖A‖^n ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hA
  exact (sector_bound A n x).trans (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x])

def gammaFun (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (x : F) : F :=
  ⟨fun n => sector A n (x n), Memℓp.mono (lp.memℓp x).norm
    (fun n => by simpa using sector_contraction A hA n (x n))⟩

def gamma (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) : F →L[ℂ] F :=
  ({ toFun := gammaFun A hA
     map_add' x y := by apply lp.ext; funext n; exact (sector A n).map_add (x n) (y n)
     map_smul' c x := by apply lp.ext; funext n; exact (sector A n).map_smul c (x n) } : F →ₗ[ℂ] F).mkContinuous
    1 (fun x => by simpa using (lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)
      (fun n => sector_contraction A hA n (x n))))

@[simp] theorem gamma_apply (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (x : F) (n : ℕ) :
    gamma A hA x n = sector A n (x n) := rfl

theorem gamma_norm_le (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) : ‖gamma A hA‖ ≤ 1 :=
  (gamma A hA).opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num) (fun x => by
    simpa using lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)
      (fun n => sector_contraction A hA n (x n)))

theorem gamma_exponential (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (x : H1) :
    gamma A hA (exponential x) = exponential (A x) := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change sector A n ((weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n x) =
    (weight n : ℂ) • pureTensor n (A x)
  rw [map_smul,sector_pure]

theorem gamma_vacuum (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) : gamma A hA vacuum = vacuum := by
  rw [← exponential_zero,gamma_exponential,map_zero]

end F1Fecho.BoundedGamma

/-! Functorial, adjoint and density properties of the constructed bounded
second quantization on the unchanged canonical Fock. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace F1Fecho.BoundedGamma
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential

theorem gamma_commute (A B : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ 1)
    (hc : A * B = B * A) : gamma A hA * gamma B hB = gamma B hB * gamma A hA := by
  apply WeylConstruction.clm_ext_total exponential exponential_total
  intro f
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply,gamma_exponential]
  exact congrArg exponential (congrArg (fun L : H1 →L[ℂ] H1 => L f) hc)

theorem gamma_selfadjoint (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1)
    (hs : IsSelfAdjoint A) : IsSelfAdjoint (gamma A hA) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff'.mpr
  apply WeylConstruction.clm_ext_total exponential exponential_total
  intro f
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply exponential_orthogonal_zero
  intro g
  rw [inner_sub_left,ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left,
    gamma_exponential,gamma_exponential,exponential_inner,exponential_inner]
  have hi : inner ℂ (A f) g = inner ℂ f (A g) := hs.isSymmetric f g
  rw [hi,sub_self]

theorem gamma_denseRange (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1)
    (hd : DenseRange A) : DenseRange (gamma A hA) := by
  let M := (gamma A hA).range.topologicalClosure
  have he (f : H1) : exponential f ∈ M := by
    refine hd.induction_on f ((gamma A hA).range.isClosed_topologicalClosure.preimage
      ConcreteWeyl.exponential_continuous) ?_
    intro g
    apply (gamma A hA).range.le_topologicalClosure
    exact ⟨exponential g,gamma_exponential A hA g⟩
  have hs : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential) ≤ M := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨f,rfl⟩
    exact he f
  have ht := (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential)).topologicalClosure_minimal hs
    (gamma A hA).range.isClosed_topologicalClosure
  rw [exponential_total] at ht
  have hc : (gamma A hA).range.topologicalClosure = ⊤ := le_antisymm le_top ht
  exact Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr hc

theorem gamma_injective (A : H1 →L[ℂ] H1) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1)
    (hs : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hd : DenseRange A) : Function.Injective (gamma A hA) := by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  have hd' : Dense ((gamma A hA).range : Set F) := gamma_denseRange A hA hd
  have hc := Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp hd'
  have ho := Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff.mp hc
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.orthogonal_range,(gamma_selfadjoint A hA hs).adjoint_eq] at ho
  exact ho

end F1Fecho.BoundedGamma

namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalGammaPositive
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ TGLExt.ContratoQGv31 TGL.SpecificAQFT

def analyticGamma (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ forwardCone) (z : ℂ) : F →L[ℂ] F :=
  BoundedGamma.gamma (V a ha z) (V_norm a ha z)

theorem analyticGamma_norm (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ forwardCone) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖analyticGamma a ha z‖ ≤ 1 := BoundedGamma.gamma_norm_le _ _

theorem analyticGamma_exponential (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ forwardCone)
    (z : ℂ) (f : H1) : analyticGamma a ha z (exponential f) = exponential (V a ha z f) :=
  BoundedGamma.gamma_exponential _ _ f

theorem analyticGamma_boundary (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ forwardCone) (t : ℝ) :
    analyticGamma a ha t = (gamma (U1 (t • a))).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap := by
  apply WeylConstruction.clm_ext_total exponential exponential_total
  intro f
  rw [analyticGamma_exponential,V_boundary]
  exact (gamma_exponential (U1 (t • a)) f).symm

  have he : (fun z => inner ℂ (exponential f) (analyticGamma a ha z (exponential g))) =
      (fun z => Complex.exp (inner ℂ f (V a ha z g))) := by
    funext z
    rw [analyticGamma_exponential,exponential_inner]
  rw [he]
  exact Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_diffContOnCl (coefficient_analytic a ha f g)

  apply BoundedWeakAnalytic.of_total exponential exponential_total (analyticGamma a ha) upperHalf
  · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
  · intro z _
    exact analyticGamma_norm a ha z
  · exact exponential_coefficient a ha

theorem positive_energy (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ forwardCone) (ψ : F) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, DiffContOnCl ℂ G upperHalf ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → ‖G z‖ ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, G t = inner ℂ ψ (gamma (U1 (t • a)) ψ)) := by

  · refine ⟨‖ψ‖^2,fun z _ => ?_⟩

      _ ≤ ‖ψ‖*‖analyticGamma a ha z ψ‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖ψ‖*‖ψ‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (((analyticGamma a ha z).le_opNorm ψ).trans
          (by nlinarith [analyticGamma_norm a ha z,norm_nonneg ψ])) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := (pow_two _).symm
  · intro t
    change inner ℂ ψ (analyticGamma a ha (t:ℂ) ψ) = inner ℂ ψ (gamma (U1 (t • a)) ψ)
    rw [analyticGamma_boundary]
    rfl

premise is unnecessary here because the actual orbital multiplier is used. -/
theorem gamma_positive : OneParticlePositiveEnergy →
    ∀ a ∈ forwardCone, ∀ ψ : F, ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, DiffContOnCl ℂ G upperHalf ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → ‖G z‖ ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, G t = inner ℂ ψ (gamma (U1 (t • a)) ψ)) := by
  intro _ a ha ψ
  exact positive_energy a ha ψ

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BoundedTensorMapR2
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Completion
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.Basic
/-! A tensor defines a compact operator after conjugating its first slot.
The tensor is completed, while the second factor need not be complete. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
open scoped TensorProduct
open UniformSpace
namespace F1Fecho.TensorContraction
variable {E G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace ℂ G]

def evalJ (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) (a : E) : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun x := inner ℂ (J x) a
  map_add' x y := by simp [inner_add_left]
  map_smul' c x := by simp [J.map_smulₛₗ,inner_smul_left]

def raw (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) : E ⊗[ℂ] G →ₗ[ℂ] E →ₗ[ℂ] G :=
  TensorProduct.lift
  { toFun := fun a =>
      { toFun := fun b => (evalJ J a).smulRight b
        map_add' := by intro x y; ext z; simp
        map_smul' := by intro c x; ext z; simp [smul_smul,mul_comm] }
    map_add' := by intro x y; ext b z; simp [evalJ, inner_add_right, add_smul]
    map_smul' := by intro c x; ext b z; simp [evalJ, inner_smul_right, mul_smul] }

@[simp] theorem raw_tmul (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) (a : E) (b : G) (x : E) :
    raw J (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) x = inner ℂ (J x) a • b := rfl

theorem norm_raw_le (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) (z : E ⊗[ℂ] G) (x : E) :
    ‖raw J z x‖ ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖x‖ := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hz⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finite_submodule_right_of_setFinite
    ({z} : Set (E ⊗[ℂ] G)) (Set.finite_singleton z)
  letI : Module.Finite ℂ V := hV
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := Set.singleton_subset_iff.mp hz
  let e := stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ V
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := TensorProduct.eq_repr_basis_right e.toBasis y
  have hr : z = ∑ i, v i ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ((e i : V) : G) := by
    rw [← hy,← hv]
    simp [Finsupp.sum_fintype]
  have he : Orthonormal ℂ (fun i => ((e i : V) : G)) :=
    e.orthonormal.comp_linearIsometry V.subtypeₗᵢ
  have hm : raw J z x = ∑ i, inner ℂ (J x) (v i) • ((e i : V) : G) := by
    rw [hr]; simp
  have hn : ‖raw J z x‖^2 = ∑ i, ‖inner ℂ (J x) (v i)‖^2 := by
    rw [hm,@InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ]
    simp only [sum_inner,inner_sum,inner_smul_left,inner_smul_right,
      orthonormal_iff_ite.mp he]
    simp only [mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero,Finset.sum_ite_eq',map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [← RCLike.inner_apply,inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,if_pos hi]
    simp only [← RCLike.ofReal_pow,RCLike.ofReal_re]
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [hn,hr,mul_pow,F1Fecho.BoundedTensor.norm_sum_tmul_sq _ _ he,Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have h : ‖inner ℂ (J x) (v i)‖ ≤ ‖v i‖ * ‖x‖ := by
    simpa only [J.norm_map,mul_comm] using norm_inner_le_norm (J x) (v i)
  simpa only [mul_pow] using
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mpr h

def algebraic (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) (z : E ⊗[ℂ] G) : E →L[ℂ] G :=
  (raw J z).mkContinuous ‖z‖ (norm_raw_le J z)

@[simp] theorem algebraic_apply (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) (z : E ⊗[ℂ] G) (x : E) :
    algebraic J z x = raw J z x := rfl

def algebraicLinear (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) : E ⊗[ℂ] G →L[ℂ] (E →L[ℂ] G) :=
  ({ toFun := algebraic J
     map_add' := by intro x y; ext a; simp
     map_smul' := by intro c x; ext a; simp } : E ⊗[ℂ] G →ₗ[ℂ] (E →L[ℂ] G)).mkContinuous 1
     (by intro z; simpa using (algebraic J z).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg z) (norm_raw_le J z))

def algebraicCompleted (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) : E ⊗[ℂ] G →L[ℂ] (E →L[ℂ] Completion G) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ E G (Completion G) Completion.toComplL).comp
    (algebraicLinear J)

def contraction (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) : Completion (E ⊗[ℂ] G) →L[ℂ] (E →L[ℂ] Completion G) :=
  (algebraicCompleted J).extend Completion.toComplL

@[simp] theorem contraction_coe (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) (z : E ⊗[ℂ] G) :
    contraction J (z : Completion (E ⊗[ℂ] G)) = algebraicCompleted J z := by
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.extend_eq _ Completion.denseRange_coe (Completion.isUniformInducing_coe _) z

  apply contraction_eq_zero J

    (u : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E) (v : G ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] G)
    (z : Completion (E ⊗[ℂ] G)) (hz : tensorAction u v z = z) (x : E) :
    contraction J z (conjugate J u x) = completionEquiv v (contraction J z x) := by

section Complete

def reduced (J : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] E) (z : Completion (E ⊗[ℂ] G)) : E →L[ℂ] E :=

  intro x y
  change inner ℂ ((contraction J z).adjoint (contraction J z x)) y =
    inner ℂ x ((contraction J z).adjoint (contraction J z y))

    IsSelfAdjoint (part A i) := by

      star_smul,star_add,hA,neg_neg]
    norm_num [Complex.star_def,add_comm]

    rw [hc,neg_smul,← smul_neg,neg_sub]

  rcases i with ⟨s,b⟩
  rcases j with ⟨t,c⟩

      ((hA (-s) t).add_right (hA (-s) (-t))) |>.smul_left _ |>.smul_right _
  · exact ((hA s t).sub_right (hA s (-t))).add_left
      ((hA (-s) t).sub_right (hA (-s) (-t))) |>.smul_left _ |>.smul_right _
  · exact ((hA s t).add_right (hA s (-t))).sub_left
      ((hA (-s) t).add_right (hA (-s) (-t))) |>.smul_left _ |>.smul_right _
  · exact ((hA s t).sub_right (hA s (-t))).sub_left
      ((hA (-s) t).sub_right (hA (-s) (-t))) |>.smul_left _ |>.smul_right _

theorem parts_reconstruct (A : ℝ → H →L[ℂ] H) (s : ℝ) :

  have hc : Complex.I * (-Complex.I / 2) = (1/2:ℂ) := by
    field_simp

    exact bot_ne_top htop

  obtain ⟨x,hx,hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mp hχ

    ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp hx (s,false))
  have h1 := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp
    ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp hx (s,true))

  change part A (s,true) x = _ at h1
  rw [h0,h1] at he
  rw [← he,smul_smul,add_smul]

variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

def Pair (Ω : H) (α : ℝ → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) : Prop :=
  ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, DiffContOnCl ℂ G (kmsStrip 1) ∧
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ 1 → ‖G z‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, G t = inner ℂ ((star A) Ω) (α t (B Ω))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, G ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I) = inner ℂ ((star B) Ω) (α (-t) (A Ω)))

variable {Ω : H} {α : ℝ → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H} {A B D : H →L[ℂ] H}

theorem zero_left (B : H →L[ℂ] H) : Pair Ω α 0 B := by
  refine ⟨0,diffContOnCl_const,⟨0,by simp⟩,?_,?_⟩ <;>
    intro t <;> simp

theorem zero_right (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : Pair Ω α A 0 := by
  refine ⟨0,diffContOnCl_const,⟨0,by simp⟩,?_,?_⟩ <;>
    intro t <;> simp

theorem add_left (hA : Pair Ω α A B) (hD : Pair Ω α D B) : Pair Ω α (A+D) B := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,⟨CG,bG⟩,lG,uG⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,⟨CQ,bQ⟩,lQ,uQ⟩ := hD
  refine ⟨G+Q,hG.add hQ,⟨CG+CQ,?_⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · intro z h0 h1
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (bG z h0 h1) (bQ z h0 h1))
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,lG,lQ,star_add,ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,inner_add_left]
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,uG,uQ,ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,map_add,inner_add_right]

theorem add_right (hB : Pair Ω α A B) (hD : Pair Ω α A D) : Pair Ω α A (B+D) := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,⟨CG,bG⟩,lG,uG⟩ := hB
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,⟨CQ,bQ⟩,lQ,uQ⟩ := hD
  refine ⟨G+Q,hG.add hQ,⟨CG+CQ,?_⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · intro z h0 h1
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (bG z h0 h1) (bQ z h0 h1))
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,lG,lQ,ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,map_add,inner_add_right]
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,uG,uQ,star_add,ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,inner_add_left]

theorem smul_left (c : ℂ) (hA : Pair Ω α A B) : Pair Ω α (c • A) B := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,⟨C,bG⟩,lG,uG⟩ := hA
  refine ⟨c • G,hG.const_smul c,⟨‖c‖*C,?_⟩,?_,?_⟩

    simpa only [Pi.smul_apply,norm_smul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (bG z h0 h1) (norm_nonneg c)
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply,lG,star_smul,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,inner_smul_left,starRingEnd_apply,star_star,smul_eq_mul]
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply,uG,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,map_smul,inner_smul_right,smul_eq_mul]

theorem smul_right (c : ℂ) (hB : Pair Ω α A B) : Pair Ω α A (c • B) := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,⟨C,bG⟩,lG,uG⟩ := hB
  refine ⟨c • G,hG.const_smul c,⟨‖c‖*C,?_⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · intro z h0 h1
    simpa only [Pi.smul_apply,norm_smul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (bG z h0 h1) (norm_nonneg c)
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply,lG,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,map_smul,inner_smul_right,smul_eq_mul]
  · intro t
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply,uG,star_smul,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,inner_smul_left,starRingEnd_apply,star_star,smul_eq_mul]

theorem span_pair (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (h : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ B ∈ S, Pair Ω α A B)
    (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : A ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S) (hB : B ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S) :

  have hg : ∀ a ∈ S, Pair Ω α a B := by

abbrev H2 := WithLp 2 (H × H)
def coord : H2 (H := H) ≃L[ℂ] H × H := WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ H H
def diagonal (b : H →L[ℂ] H) : H2 (H := H) →L[ℂ] H2 (H := H) :=
  coord.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp ((b.prodMap b).comp coord.toContinuousLinearMap)
theorem diagonal_apply (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (w : H2 (H := H)) :
    coord (diagonal b w) = (b (coord w).1,b (coord w).2) := by
  simp [diagonal,Prod.map]
theorem diagonal_mul (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) (w : H2 (H := H)) :
    diagonal (a*b) w = diagonal a (diagonal b w) := by
  apply coord.injective
  simp [diagonal_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply]
theorem diagonal_star_pairing (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (v w : H2 (H := H)) :
    inner ℂ (diagonal b v) w = inner ℂ v (diagonal (star b) w) := by
  change inner ℂ (b (coord v).1) (coord w).1 + inner ℂ (b (coord v).2) (coord w).2 =
    inner ℂ (coord v).1 ((star b) (coord w).1) + inner ℂ (coord v).2 ((star b) (coord w).2)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]

def orbitMap (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (w : H2 (H := H)) : A →ₗ[ℂ] H2 (H := H) where
  toFun b := diagonal b w
  map_add' := by intro b c; apply coord.injective; simp [diagonal_apply,map_add]
  map_smul' := by intro c b; apply coord.injective; simp [diagonal_apply,map_smul]
def orbitSpace (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (w : H2 (H := H)) : Submodule ℂ (H2 (H := H)) :=
  (orbitMap A w).range.topologicalClosure
instance orbitSpace_complete (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (w : H2 (H := H)) :
    CompleteSpace (orbitSpace A w) := ((orbitMap A w).range.isClosed_topologicalClosure).completeSpace_coe

theorem orbit_invariant (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (w : H2 (H := H))
    (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ A) (v : H2 (H := H)) (hv : v ∈ orbitSpace A w) :
    diagonal b v ∈ orbitSpace A w := by
  have hi : ((orbitMap A w).range : Set (H2 (H := H))) ⊆
      (diagonal b) ⁻¹' (orbitSpace A w : Set (H2 (H := H))) := by
    rintro z ⟨c,rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.le_topologicalClosure
    refine ⟨⟨b*c,A.mul_mem hb c.property⟩,?_⟩
    exact diagonal_mul b c w
  have hc := closure_minimal hi (((orbitMap A w).range.isClosed_topologicalClosure).preimage (diagonal b).continuous)
  apply hc
  exact hv

theorem projection_commutes (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (w : H2 (H := H))
    (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ A) (v : H2 (H := H)) :
    (orbitSpace A w).starProjection (diagonal b v) = diagonal b ((orbitSpace A w).starProjection v) := by
  apply Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_of_inner_eq_zero
  · exact orbit_invariant A w b hb _ (Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem _ _)
  · intro z hz
    rw [← map_sub,diagonal_star_pairing]
    exact Submodule.starProjection_inner_eq_zero v _ (orbit_invariant A w (star b) (star_mem hb) z hz)

def take (i : Fin 2) : H2 (H := H) →L[ℂ] H :=
  (if i=0 then ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ H H else ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ H H).comp coord.toContinuousLinearMap
def put (i : Fin 2) : H →L[ℂ] H2 (H := H) :=
  coord.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (if i=0 then ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℂ H H else ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ H H)
theorem take_diagonal (i : Fin 2) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (v : H2 (H := H)) :
    take i (diagonal b v) = b (take i v) := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [take,diagonal_apply]
theorem diagonal_put (i : Fin 2) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (v : H) :
    diagonal b (put i v) = put i (b v) := by
  apply coord.injective
  fin_cases i <;> simp [put,diagonal_apply,map_zero]
theorem put_take_decomposition (v : H2 (H := H)) :
    put 0 (take 0 v) + put 1 (take 1 v) = v := by
  apply coord.injective
  simp [put,take]
theorem take_ext {v w : H2 (H := H)} (h : ∀ i : Fin 2, take i v = take i w) : v=w := by
  apply coord.injective
  exact Prod.ext (by simpa [take] using h 0) (by simpa [take] using h 1)

def block (P : H2 (H := H) →L[ℂ] H2 (H := H)) (i j : Fin 2) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  (take i).comp (P.comp (put j))
theorem block_commutes (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (w : H2 (H := H))
    (i j : Fin 2) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ A) :
    block (orbitSpace A w).starProjection i j * b = b * block (orbitSpace A w).starProjection i j := by
  ext x
  change take i ((orbitSpace A w).starProjection (put j (b x))) =
    b (take i ((orbitSpace A w).starProjection (put j x)))
  rw [← diagonal_put,projection_commutes A w b hb,take_diagonal]

theorem bicommutant_projection_commutes (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (a : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (ha : ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ c ∈ A, b*c=c*b) → a*b=b*a)
    (w v : H2 (H := H)) :
    (orbitSpace A w).starProjection (diagonal a v) = diagonal a ((orbitSpace A w).starProjection v) := by
  let P := (orbitSpace A w).starProjection
  have hb (i j : Fin 2) : ∀ x : H, a (block P i j x) = block P i j (a x) := by
    intro x
    exact congrArg (fun f : H →L[ℂ] H => f x)
      (ha (block P i j) (fun c hc => block_commutes A w i j c hc))
  have hp (i : Fin 2) (z : H2 (H := H)) :
      take i (P z) = block P i 0 (take 0 z) + block P i 1 (take 1 z) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← put_take_decomposition z]
    simp only [map_add]
    rfl
  apply take_ext
  intro i
  change take i (P (diagonal a v)) = take i (diagonal a (P v))
  rw [hp,take_diagonal,take_diagonal,take_diagonal,hp,map_add,hb,hb]

theorem vector_mem_orbit (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (w : H2 (H := H)) : w ∈ orbitSpace A w := by
  apply Submodule.le_topologicalClosure
  refine ⟨1,?_⟩
  apply coord.injective
  simp [orbitMap,diagonal_apply]

theorem diagonal_bicommutant_mem_orbit (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (a : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (ha : ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ c ∈ A, b*c=c*b) → a*b=b*a)
    (w : H2 (H := H)) : diagonal a w ∈ orbitSpace A w := by
  apply Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mp
  rw [bicommutant_projection_commutes A a ha]
  rw [Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr (vector_mem_orbit A w)]

theorem two_vector_density (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (a : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (ha : ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ c ∈ A, b*c=c*b) → a*b=b*a)
    (x y : H) : (a x,a y) ∈ closure {p : H × H | ∃ b ∈ A, p=(b x,b y)} := by
  let w : H2 (H := H) := coord.symm (x,y)
  have hw := diagonal_bicommutant_mem_orbit A a ha w
  have hh : coord '' ((orbitMap A w).range : Set (H2 (H := H))) ⊆
      {p : H × H | ∃ b ∈ A, p=(b x,b y)} := by
    rintro p ⟨v,⟨b,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨b,b.property,?_⟩
    simp [orbitMap,diagonal_apply,w]
  have hc := image_closure_subset_closure_image coord.continuous ⟨diagonal a w,hw,rfl⟩
  apply closure_mono hh at hc
  simpa [diagonal_apply,w] using hc

end F1Fecho.BicommutantTwoVector
#print axioms F1Fecho.BicommutantTwoVector.projection_commutes
#print axioms F1Fecho.BicommutantTwoVector.bicommutant_projection_commutes
#print axioms F1Fecho.BicommutantTwoVector.two_vector_density

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ExponentialTomitaInclusionR2
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BicommutantTwoVectorR2
/-! The complex span of the actual field Weyl operators is a unital star
algebra. Its vacuum graph is contained in the constructed exponential Tomita
graph. All operators act on the same concrete bosonic Fock space. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential
open F1Fecho.ExponentialLift F1Fecho.ExponentialTomita F1Fecho.WeylExponentialCore
open F1Rede.CanonicalWedge F1Fecho.WeylCoefficients F1Fecho.ExponentialTomitaInclusion

def finiteSpan : Submodule ℂ (F →L[ℂ] F) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators FieldWeyl.W K)
theorem generator_mem (k : H1) (hk : k ∈ K) : FieldWeyl.W k ∈ finiteSpan :=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩
theorem one_mem : (1 : F →L[ℂ] F) ∈ finiteSpan := by
  simpa only [FieldWeyl.W_zero] using generator_mem 0 K.zero_mem
theorem generator_mul_mem (k : H1) (hk : k ∈ K)
    (b : F →L[ℂ] F) (hb : b ∈ finiteSpan) : FieldWeyl.W k * b ∈ finiteSpan := by
  induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem b hb =>
    obtain ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ := hb
    rw [FieldWeyl.W_ccr]
    exact finiteSpan.smul_mem _ (generator_mem _ (K.add_mem hk hf))
  | zero => simpa only [mul_zero] using finiteSpan.zero_mem
  | add b c hb hc ihb ihc =>
    rw [mul_add]; exact finiteSpan.add_mem ihb ihc
  | smul c b hb ih =>
    rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact finiteSpan.smul_mem c ih
theorem mul_mem (a b : F →L[ℂ] F) (ha : a ∈ finiteSpan) (hb : b ∈ finiteSpan) :
    a*b ∈ finiteSpan := by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩ := ha
    exact generator_mul_mem k hk b hb
  | zero => simpa only [zero_mul] using finiteSpan.zero_mem
  | add a c ha hc iha ihc =>
    rw [add_mul]; exact finiteSpan.add_mem iha ihc
  | smul c a ha ih =>
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact finiteSpan.smul_mem c ih
theorem star_mem (a : F →L[ℂ] F) (ha : a ∈ finiteSpan) : star a ∈ finiteSpan := by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩ := ha
    rw [FieldWeyl.W_star]
    exact generator_mem _ (K.neg_mem hk)
  | zero => simpa only [star_zero (F →L[ℂ] F)] using finiteSpan.zero_mem
  | add a b ha hb iha ihb =>
    rw [StarAddMonoid.star_add a b]; exact finiteSpan.add_mem iha ihb
  | smul c a ha ih =>
    rw [star_smul]; exact finiteSpan.smul_mem (star c) ih

def finiteAlgebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (F →L[ℂ] F) where
  toSubalgebra := finiteSpan.toSubalgebra one_mem mul_mem
  star_mem' := fun ha => star_mem _ ha

theorem finite_mem_R (a : F →L[ℂ] F) (ha : a ∈ finiteAlgebra) : a ∈ FieldWeyl.R K := by
  have hs : finiteSpan ≤ (FieldWeyl.R K).toStarSubalgebra.toSubalgebra.toSubmodule := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro a ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩
    exact FieldWeyl.W_mem_R K k hk
  exact hs ha

theorem R_bicommutant_finite (a : F →L[ℂ] F) (ha : a ∈ FieldWeyl.R K) :
    ∀ b : F →L[ℂ] F, (∀ c ∈ finiteAlgebra, b*c=c*b) → a*b=b*a := by
  change a ∈ F1Fecho.WeylNet.generatedAlgebra (F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators FieldWeyl.W K) at ha
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe,F1Fecho.WeylNet.generatedAlgebra_coe _
    (F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators_star_closed FieldWeyl.W FieldWeyl.W_star K)] at ha
  intro b hb
  apply (ha b ?_).symm
  rintro c ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩
  exact (hb _ (generator_mem k hk)).symm

theorem generator_graph (k : H1) (hk : k ∈ K) :
    (FieldWeyl.W k vacuum,(star (FieldWeyl.W k)) vacuum) ∈
      Set.range (fun x : canonicalLift.domain => ((x:F),Sexp x)) := by
  apply (Sexp_graph_iff _).mpr
  have h : (exponential (Complex.I•k),exponential (Complex.I•Jcandidate k)) ∈ closedGraph TW :=
    (coreGraph TW).le_topologicalClosure (weylCore_le_core (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨k,hk⟩,rfl⟩))
  let q := amplitude (Complex.I•k) 0
  have hout : JF ((star (FieldWeyl.W k)) vacuum) = q • exponential (Complex.I•Jcandidate k) := by
    rw [FieldWeyl.W_star,FieldWeyl.W_vacuum]
    change JF (amplitude (Complex.I•(-k)) 0 • exponential (Complex.I•(-k))) = _
    rw [smul_neg,vacuum_amplitude_neg,JF.map_smulₛₗ]
    change star q • JF (exponential (-(Complex.I•k))) = _
    rw [vacuum_amplitude_star,JF_exponential,map_neg,Jcandidate.map_smulₛₗ]
    simp only [Complex.conj_I,neg_smul,neg_neg]
    rfl
  rw [hout,FieldWeyl.W_vacuum]
  exact (closedGraph TW).smul_mem q h

theorem finite_algebra_graph (a : F →L[ℂ] F) (ha : a ∈ finiteAlgebra) :
    (a vacuum,(star a) vacuum) ∈
      Set.range (fun x : canonicalLift.domain => ((x:F),Sexp x)) := by
  change a ∈ finiteSpan at ha
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩ := ha
    exact generator_graph k hk
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0,?_⟩
    simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero,map_zero,star_zero (F →L[ℂ] F),ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add a b ha hb iha ihb =>
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := iha
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := ihb
    refine ⟨x+y,?_⟩
    have h1 : (x:F)=a vacuum := congrArg Prod.fst hx
    have h2 : Sexp x=(star a) vacuum := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    have h3 : (y:F)=b vacuum := congrArg Prod.fst hy
    have h4 : Sexp y=(star b) vacuum := congrArg Prod.snd hy
    apply Prod.ext
    · change (x:F)+(y:F) = _
      rw [h1,h3]; rfl
    · change Sexp (x+y) = (star (a+b)) vacuum
      rw [map_add,h2,h4,StarAddMonoid.star_add a b]
      rfl
  | smul c a ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨c•x,?_⟩
    have h1 : (x:F)=a vacuum := congrArg Prod.fst hx
    have h2 : Sexp x=(star a) vacuum := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    apply Prod.ext
    · change c•(x:F) = _
      rw [h1]; rfl
    · change Sexp (c•x) = (star (c•a)) vacuum
      rw [Sexp.map_smulₛₗ,h2,star_smul]
      rfl

theorem R_two_vector_density (a : F →L[ℂ] F) (ha : a ∈ FieldWeyl.R K) (x y : F) :
    (a x,a y) ∈ closure {p : F × F | ∃ b ∈ finiteAlgebra, p=(b x,b y)} :=
  BicommutantTwoVector.two_vector_density finiteAlgebra a (R_bicommutant_finite a ha) x y

end F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra

#print axioms F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra.star_mem
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra.finite_mem_R
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra.R_bicommutant_finite
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra.generator_graph
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra.finite_algebra_graph
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra.R_two_vector_density

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.WeylFiniteAlgebraR4
/-! KMS is proved for the actual field-Weyl generators and their complex
finite span in the same Fock space. The one-particle continuation is derived
from the canonical multiplier and standard wedge, not assumed in this output.
Extension to the von Neumann closure is a separate graph-density argument. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalWeylKMSFinite
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Rede.CanonicalWedge
open F1Fecho.WeylExponentialCore F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra

def boostFlow (t : ℝ) : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F := gamma (B0 (2*Real.pi*t))

theorem generator_pair (f g : H1) (hf : f ∈ K) (hg : g ∈ K) :
    KMSFiniteSpan.Pair vacuum boostFlow (FieldWeyl.W f) (FieldWeyl.W g) := by
  have hs := WedgeOneParticleStrip.wedge_strip
    (⟨f,hf⟩ : KWR.toClosedSubmodule) (⟨g,hg⟩ : KWR.toClosedSubmodule)
  apply WeylStripFromCoefficient.pair_from_coefficient
    (fun t => B0 (2*Real.pi*t)) f g (CanonicalH1Strip.coefficient f g)
  · exact hs.1
  · exact hs.2.1
  · exact hs.2.2.1
  · intro t
    simpa only [mul_neg] using hs.2.2.2 t

theorem finite_pair (A B : F →L[ℂ] F)
    (hA : A ∈ finiteAlgebra) (hB : B ∈ finiteAlgebra) :
    KMSFiniteSpan.Pair vacuum boostFlow A B := by
  apply KMSFiniteSpan.span_pair (F1Fecho.WeylNet.generators FieldWeyl.W K)
    (A := A) (B := B) (hA := hA) (hB := hB)
  rintro _ ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ _ ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
  exact generator_pair f g hf hg

end F1Fecho.CanonicalWeylKMSFinite

import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Hadamard
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.LocallyUniformLimit
import Mathlib.Tactic
/-! A common bound on both horizontal edges controls the whole closed strip.
The global boundedness premise is essential to the three-lines argument. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Complex Complex.HadamardThreeLines Set
namespace F1Fecho.StripMaximum

def strip : Set ℂ := {z | 0<z.im ∧ z.im<1}
def closedStrip : Set ℂ := {z | 0≤z.im ∧ z.im≤1}

theorem norm_le_edge_bound {f : ℂ→ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0≤C)
    (hd : DiffContOnCl ℂ f strip)
    (hbound : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ closedStrip, ‖f z‖≤M)
    (hleft : ∀ z : ℂ, z.im=0 → ‖f z‖≤C)
    (hright : ∀ z : ℂ, z.im=1 → ‖f z‖≤C)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈closedStrip) : ‖f z‖≤C := by
  let g : ℂ→ℂ := fun w => f (I*w)
  have hdg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    apply hd.comp (differentiable_id.const_mul I).diffContOnCl
    intro w hw
    simpa [strip,verticalStrip,mul_im] using hw
  have hbg : BddAbove ((norm ∘ g) '' verticalClosedStrip 0 1) := by
    obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := hbound
    refine ⟨M,?_⟩
    rintro a ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩
    exact hM (I*w) (by simpa [closedStrip,verticalClosedStrip] using hw)
  have hn := norm_le_interp_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip' (f:=g)
    (a:=C) (b:=C) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)
    (z:=-I*z) (by simpa [verticalClosedStrip,closedStrip] using hz) hdg hbg
    (fun w hw => hleft (I*w) (by simpa using hw))
    (fun w hw => hright (I*w) (by simpa using hw))
  have hp (x : ℝ) : C^(1-x)*C^x=C := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add' hC (by ring_nf; norm_num : 1-x+x≠0)]
    simp
  have hzid : I * (-I*z)=z := by rw [←mul_assoc]; simp
  dsimp only [g] at hn
  rw [hzid] at hn
  simpa only [sub_zero,div_one,hp] using hn

end F1Fecho.StripMaximum
#print axioms F1Fecho.StripMaximum.norm_le_edge_bound
