import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.StripMaximumR2
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Cauchy
/-! Boundary Cauchy estimates yield an analytic bounded strip limit. This
is a closure lemma for later use with actual joint algebra/adjoint vectors. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology
namespace F1Fecho.StripUniformLimit
open F1Fecho.StripMaximum

theorem closure_strip_subset : closure strip ⊆ closedStrip := by
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro z hz; exact ⟨hz.1.le,hz.2.le⟩
  · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
      (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)

theorem strip_open : IsOpen strip :=
  (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
    (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)

theorem cauchy_of_edges (F : ℕ→ℂ→ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ n, DiffContOnCl ℂ (F n) strip)
    (hb : ∀ n, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z∈closedStrip, ‖F n z‖≤M)
    (hedge : ∀ ε>0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m≥N, ∀ n≥N,
      ∀ z : ℂ, (z.im=0 ∨ z.im=1) → ‖F m z-F n z‖≤ε) :
    UniformCauchySeqOn F atTop closedStrip := by
  apply Metric.uniformCauchySeqOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := hedge (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N,fun m hm n hn z hz => ?_⟩
  have hd' := (hd m).sub (hd n)
  have hb' : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z∈closedStrip, ‖F m z-F n z‖≤M := by
    obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := hb m
    obtain ⟨L,hL⟩ := hb n
    exact ⟨M+L,fun z hz => (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hM z hz) (hL z hz))⟩
  have he := norm_le_edge_bound (f:=fun z => F m z-F n z) (C:=ε/2)
    (by positivity) hd' hb'
    (fun z hz => hN m hm n hn z (Or.inl hz))
    (fun z hz => hN m hm n hn z (Or.inr hz)) hz
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  exact he.trans_lt (by linarith)

theorem exists_limit (F : ℕ→ℂ→ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ n, DiffContOnCl ℂ (F n) strip)
    (hb : ∀ n, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z∈closedStrip, ‖F n z‖≤M)
    (hc : UniformCauchySeqOn F atTop closedStrip) :
    ∃ f : ℂ→ℂ, TendstoUniformlyOn F f atTop closedStrip ∧
      DiffContOnCl ℂ f strip ∧ (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z∈closedStrip, ‖f z‖≤M) := by
  classical
  have hex (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈closedStrip) : ∃ a : ℂ, Tendsto (fun n => F n z) atTop (𝓝 a) :=
    cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (hc.cauchySeq hz)
  let f : ℂ→ℂ := fun z => if hz : z∈closedStrip then (hex z hz).choose else 0
  have ht : TendstoUniformlyOn F f atTop closedStrip := by
    apply hc.tendstoUniformlyOn_of_tendsto
    intro z hz
    simpa only [f,dif_pos hz] using (hex z hz).choose_spec
  have htc := ht.mono closure_strip_subset
  have hdf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f strip :=
    ⟨(ht.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le,hz.2.le⟩)).tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.differentiableOn
      (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hd n).differentiableOn) strip_open,
     htc.continuousOn (Filter.Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hd n).continuousOn))⟩
  have he := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp ht 1 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := he.exists
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := hb n
  refine ⟨f,ht,hdf,M+1,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hz' := hn z hz
  have hn' : ‖f z-F n z‖<1 := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hz'
  calc
    ‖f z‖ ≤ ‖f z-F n z‖+‖F n z‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add _ _
    _ ≤ M+1 := by linarith [hM z hz]

end F1Fecho.StripUniformLimit
#print axioms F1Fecho.StripUniformLimit.cauchy_of_edges
#print axioms F1Fecho.StripUniformLimit.exists_limit

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.StripUniformLimitR2
/-! Convergence on both real boundary lines determines a bounded analytic
limit throughout the strip. Used with graph-vector convergence, not with an
assumed bound on approximating algebra operators. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology
namespace F1Fecho.StripBoundaryLimit
open F1Fecho.StripMaximum F1Fecho.StripUniformLimit

theorem of_boundary_uniform (F : ℕ→ℂ→ℂ) (L U : ℝ→ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ n, DiffContOnCl ℂ (F n) strip)
    (hb : ∀ n, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z∈closedStrip, ‖F n z‖≤M)
    (hL : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => F n t) L atTop univ)
    (hU : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => F n ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I)) U atTop univ) :
    ∃ f : ℂ→ℂ, DiffContOnCl ℂ f strip ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z∈closedStrip, ‖f z‖≤M) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, f t=L t) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, f ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I)=U t) := by
  have hc : UniformCauchySeqOn F atTop closedStrip := by
    apply cauchy_of_edges F hd hb
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨NL,hNL⟩ := Metric.uniformCauchySeqOn_iff.mp hL.uniformCauchySeqOn ε hε
    obtain ⟨NU,hNU⟩ := Metric.uniformCauchySeqOn_iff.mp hU.uniformCauchySeqOn ε hε
    refine ⟨max NL NU,fun m hm n hn z hz => ?_⟩
    rcases hz with hz|hz
    · have he : (z.re:ℂ)=z := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hz]
      have h := hNL m (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hm) n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) z.re (mem_univ _)
      simpa only [he,dist_eq_norm] using h.le
    · have he : (z.re:ℂ)+Complex.I=z := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hz]
      have h := hNU m (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hm) n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn) z.re (mem_univ _)
      simpa only [he,dist_eq_norm] using h.le
  obtain ⟨f,ht,hf,hfb⟩ := exists_limit F hd hb hc
  refine ⟨f,hf,hfb,?_,?_⟩
  · intro t
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (ht.tendsto_at (by simp [closedStrip])) (hL.tendsto_at (mem_univ t))
  · intro t
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (ht.tendsto_at (by simp [closedStrip])) (hU.tendsto_at (mem_univ t))

end F1Fecho.StripBoundaryLimit
#print axioms F1Fecho.StripBoundaryLimit.of_boundary_uniform

import Mathlib.Tactic
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology
namespace F1Fecho.UnitaryCoefficientsUniform
variable {H X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

theorem left (U : X→H≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H) (v : H) (u : ℕ→H) (x : H)
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 x)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n t => inner ℂ (u n) (U t v))
      (fun t => inner ℂ x (U t v)) atTop univ := by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ‖u n-x‖*‖v‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (hu.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=x))).norm.mul_const ‖v‖
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with n hn
  intro t _
  rw [dist_comm,dist_eq_norm,← inner_sub_left]
  have hb : ‖inner ℂ (u n-x) (U t v)‖ ≤ ‖u n-x‖*‖v‖ := by
    simpa only [(U t).norm_map] using (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜:=ℂ) (u n-x) (U t v))
  exact hb.trans_lt hn

theorem right (U : X→H≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H) (v : H) (u : ℕ→H) (x : H)
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 x)) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n t => inner ℂ v (U t (u n)))
      (fun t => inner ℂ v (U t x)) atTop univ := by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ‖v‖*‖u n-x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (hu.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=x))).norm.const_mul ‖v‖
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with n hn
  intro t _
  rw [dist_comm,dist_eq_norm,← inner_sub_right,← map_sub]
  have hb : ‖inner ℂ v (U t (u n-x))‖ ≤ ‖v‖*‖u n-x‖ := by
    simpa only [(U t).norm_map] using (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜:=ℂ) v (U t (u n-x)))
  exact hb.trans_lt hn

end F1Fecho.UnitaryCoefficientsUniform
#print axioms F1Fecho.UnitaryCoefficientsUniform.left
#print axioms F1Fecho.UnitaryCoefficientsUniform.right
added.TGLExt/F1Fecho394/KMSGraphClosureR3.lean:
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.StripBoundaryLimitR1
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.UnitaryCoefficientsUniformR2
/-! The bounded KMS strip relation is closed in the graph vectors
(A Omega,A* Omega), separately in each algebra argument. Thus joint strong-star
vacuum density is sufficient; no operator-norm approximation is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology
namespace F1Fecho.KMSGraphClosure
open F1Fecho.StripMaximum F1Fecho.StripBoundaryLimit
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

def Pair (α : ℝ→H≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H) (x y : H×H) : Prop :=
  ∃ G : ℂ→ℂ, DiffContOnCl ℂ G strip ∧
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z∈closedStrip, ‖G z‖≤C) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, G t=inner ℂ x.2 (α t y.1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, G ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I)=inner ℂ y.2 (α (-t) x.1))

theorem closed_left (α : ℝ→H≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H) (y : H×H) :
    IsClosed {x : H×H | Pair α x y} := by
  apply isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro u x hu hx
  choose F hd hb hl ht using hu
  have hL := UnitaryCoefficientsUniform.left α y.1 (fun n => (u n).2) x.2 ((continuous_snd.tendsto x).comp hx)
  have hU := UnitaryCoefficientsUniform.right (fun t => α (-t)) y.2 (fun n => (u n).1) x.1 ((continuous_fst.tendsto x).comp hx)
  have hle : (fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => F n t) =
      (fun n t => inner ℂ (u n).2 (α t y.1)) := by funext n t; exact hl n t
  have hue : (fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => F n ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I)) =
      (fun n t => inner ℂ y.2 (α (-t) (u n).1)) := by funext n t; exact ht n t
  rw [←hle] at hL
  rw [←hue] at hU
  exact of_boundary_uniform F _ _ hd hb hL hU

theorem closed_right (α : ℝ→H≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H) (x : H×H) :
    IsClosed {y : H×H | Pair α x y} := by
  apply isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro u y hu hy
  choose F hd hb hl ht using hu
  have hL := UnitaryCoefficientsUniform.right α x.2 (fun n => (u n).1) y.1 ((continuous_fst.tendsto y).comp hy)
  have hU := UnitaryCoefficientsUniform.left (fun t => α (-t)) x.1 (fun n => (u n).2) y.2 ((continuous_snd.tendsto y).comp hy)
  have hle : (fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => F n t) =
      (fun n t => inner ℂ x.2 (α t (u n).1)) := by funext n t; exact hl n t
  have hue : (fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => F n ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I)) =
      (fun n t => inner ℂ (u n).2 (α (-t) x.1)) := by funext n t; exact ht n t
  rw [←hle] at hL
  rw [←hue] at hU
  exact of_boundary_uniform F _ _ hd hb hL hU

theorem of_dense_pairs (α : ℝ→H≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H) (S : Set (H×H))
    (h : ∀ x∈S, ∀ y∈S, Pair α x y)
    (x y : H×H) (hx : x∈closure S) (hy : y∈closure S) : Pair α x y := by
  have hfirst : ∀ a∈S, Pair α a y := by
    intro a ha
    exact (closed_right α a).closure_subset_iff.mpr (h a ha) hy
  exact (closed_left α y).closure_subset_iff.mpr hfirst hx

end F1Fecho.KMSGraphClosure
#print axioms F1Fecho.KMSGraphClosure.closed_left
#print axioms F1Fecho.KMSGraphClosure.closed_right
#print axioms F1Fecho.KMSGraphClosure.of_dense_pairs

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Dual
import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Subalgebra
import Mathlib.Analysis.LocallyConvex.SeparatingDual
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Quotient
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Quotient
/-! Real graph closure of an algebra-vector pair from simultaneous two-vector
approximation. The two-vector premise remains explicit here; a separate
bicommutant theorem must discharge it. No equality of Tomita operators is
asserted by this generic module. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology
namespace F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
local instance : InnerProductSpace ℝ H := InnerProductSpace.rclikeToReal ℂ H

def starGraph (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (Ω : H) : Submodule ℝ (H × H) where
  carrier := {p | ∃ b ∈ A, p = (b Ω, (star b) Ω)}
  zero_mem' := by
    refine ⟨0,A.zero_mem,?_⟩
    simp only [star_zero,ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    rfl
  add_mem' := by
    rintro p q ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩ ⟨c,hc,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨b+c,A.add_mem hb hc,?_⟩
    simp
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro t p ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(t:ℂ) • b,A.smul_mem hb (t:ℂ),?_⟩
    change ((t:ℂ) • b Ω,(t:ℂ) • (star b) Ω) = _
    simp

theorem mem_starGraph (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (Ω : H) (p : H × H) :
    p ∈ starGraph A Ω ↔ ∃ b ∈ A, p = (b Ω,(star b) Ω) := Iff.rfl

private theorem mem_closed_of_real_functionals {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (L : Submodule ℝ E) (hL : IsClosed (L : Set E)) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ l : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ y ∈ L, l y = 0) → l x = 0) : x ∈ L := by
  letI : IsClosed (L : Set E) := hL
  by_contra hn
  have hq : L.mkQL x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hn ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero L).mp h)
  obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := SeparatingDual.exists_ne_zero (R := ℝ) hq
  apply hl
  apply hx (l.comp L.mkQL)
  intro y hy
  change l (L.mkQL y) = 0
  have h : L.mkQL y = 0 := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero L).mpr hy
  rw [h,map_zero]

private theorem real_functional_pair (l : (H × H) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ v w : H, ∀ x y : H, l (x,y) = inner ℝ v x + inner ℝ w y := by
  let v := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm (l.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ H H))
  let w := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm (l.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ H H))
  refine ⟨v,w,?_⟩
  intro x y
  change l (x,y) = inner ℝ ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm _) x +
    inner ℝ ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm _) y
  rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply,InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
  change l (x,y) = l (x,0) + l (0,y)
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1
  exact Prod.ext (add_zero x).symm (zero_add y).symm

theorem real_inner_star_swap (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (Ω w : H) :
    inner ℝ w ((star b) Ω) = inner ℝ Ω (b w) := by
  change (inner ℂ w ((star b) Ω)).re = (inner ℂ Ω (b w)).re
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  exact inner_re_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) (b w) Ω

/-- Density is required only for the simultaneous images of two vectors.
The conclusion is closure in the real graph topology on both coordinates. -/
theorem star_pair_mem_real_closure_of_two_vector_density
    (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Ω : H)
    (h_two : ∀ x y : H, (a x,a y) ∈
      closure {p : H × H | ∃ b ∈ A, p = (b x,b y)}) :
    (a Ω,(star a) Ω) ∈ (starGraph A Ω).topologicalClosure := by
  apply mem_closed_of_real_functionals _ (starGraph A Ω).isClosed_topologicalClosure
  intro l hl
  obtain ⟨v,w,hvw⟩ := real_functional_pair l
  let g : H × H → ℝ := fun p => inner ℝ v p.1 + inner ℝ Ω p.2
  have hg : Continuous g := by fun_prop
  have hzero : ∀ b ∈ A, g (b Ω,b w) = 0 := by
    intro b hb
    have h := hl (b Ω,(star b) Ω) ((starGraph A Ω).le_topologicalClosure ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩)
    rw [hvw,real_inner_star_swap] at h
    exact h
  have hcl : closure {p : H × H | ∃ b ∈ A, p = (b Ω,b w)} ⊆ {p | g p = 0} := by
    apply closure_minimal
    · rintro p ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
      exact hzero b hb
    · exact isClosed_eq hg continuous_const
  have ha := hcl (h_two Ω w)
  rw [hvw,real_inner_star_swap]
  exact ha

theorem star_pair_mem_set_closure_of_two_vector_density
    (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Ω : H)
    (h_two : ∀ x y : H, (a x,a y) ∈
      closure {p : H × H | ∃ b ∈ A, p = (b x,b y)}) :
    (a Ω,(star a) Ω) ∈ closure {p : H × H | ∃ b ∈ A, p = (b Ω,(star b) Ω)} := by
  have h := star_pair_mem_real_closure_of_two_vector_density A a Ω h_two
  change (a Ω,(star a) Ω) ∈ (starGraph A Ω).topologicalClosure at h
  change (a Ω,(star a) Ω) ∈ closure (starGraph A Ω : Set (H × H))
  rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
  exact h

end F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity
#print axioms F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity.star_pair_mem_real_closure_of_two_vector_density
#print axioms F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity.star_pair_mem_set_closure_of_two_vector_density

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.StarGraphDensityR3
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BicommutantTwoVectorR2
/-! The two-vector premise is discharged by the finite-amplification theorem.
The remaining premise is explicit membership in the operator bicommutant.
This module does not assert a Tomita identification for a concrete Fock net. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology
namespace F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
local instance : InnerProductSpace ℝ H := InnerProductSpace.rclikeToReal ℂ H

theorem star_pair_mem_real_closure_of_bicommutant
    (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Ω : H)
    (ha : ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ c ∈ A,b*c=c*b) → a*b=b*a) :
    (a Ω,(star a) Ω) ∈ (starGraph A Ω).topologicalClosure :=
  star_pair_mem_real_closure_of_two_vector_density A a Ω
    (fun x y => BicommutantTwoVector.two_vector_density A a ha x y)

theorem star_pair_mem_set_closure_of_bicommutant
    (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Ω : H)
    (ha : ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ c ∈ A,b*c=c*b) → a*b=b*a) :
    (a Ω,(star a) Ω) ∈ closure {p : H × H | ∃ b ∈ A,p=(b Ω,(star b) Ω)} :=
  star_pair_mem_set_closure_of_two_vector_density A a Ω
    (fun x y => BicommutantTwoVector.two_vector_density A a ha x y)

/-- Any closed real graph containing the algebra-vector pairs also contains
the bicommutant-vector pair. No boundedness of the approximating operators is
claimed; the topology controls the two graph coordinates. -/
theorem closed_real_submodule_contains_bicommutant_pair
    (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Ω : H)
    (ha : ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ c ∈ A,b*c=c*b) → a*b=b*a)
    (L : Submodule ℝ (H × H)) (hL : IsClosed (L : Set (H × H)))
    (hA : ∀ b ∈ A,(b Ω,(star b) Ω) ∈ L) : (a Ω,(star a) Ω) ∈ L := by
  have h := star_pair_mem_set_closure_of_bicommutant A a Ω ha
  apply (closure_minimal (t := (L : Set (H × H))) ?_ hL) h
  rintro p ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
  exact hA b hb

end F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity
#print axioms F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity.star_pair_mem_real_closure_of_bicommutant
#print axioms F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity.star_pair_mem_set_closure_of_bicommutant
#print axioms F1Fecho.StarGraphDensity.closed_real_submodule_contains_bicommutant_pair

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.CanonicalWeylKMSFiniteR2
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.KMSGraphClosureR3
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.BicommutantStarGraphR1
/-! The actual bounded KMS condition on the von Neumann wedge algebra.
Finite Weyl sums supply analytic strips. Proved joint approximation of A Omega
and A* Omega, plus the strip maximum theorem, supplies the full closure.
The physical KMS flow is Gamma(B0(+2*pi*t)); the modular CFC convention has
negative sign. No Fock KMS or analytic-domain premise is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeKMS
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Rede.CanonicalWedge
open F1Fecho.WeylExponentialCore F1Fecho.WeylFiniteAlgebra
open F1Fecho.CanonicalWeylKMSFinite

def finitePairs : Set (F×F) :=
  {p | ∃ A∈finiteAlgebra,p=(A vacuum,(star A) vacuum)}

theorem finite_pair_graph (x y : F×F) (hx : x∈finitePairs) (hy : y∈finitePairs) :
    KMSGraphClosure.Pair boostFlow x y := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨B,hB,rfl⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨G,hd,⟨C,hC⟩,hl,hu⟩ := finite_pair A B hA hB
  exact ⟨G,hd,⟨C,fun z hz => hC z hz.1 hz.2⟩,hl,hu⟩

theorem pair_mem_closure (A : F→L[ℂ]F) (hA : A∈FieldWeyl.R K) :

The one-particle square-sum identity is used only to bound WA and WB. Its
second-quantized analogue is NOT assumed and is not generally true. -/

open scoped InnerProductSpace

open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Rede.CanonicalWedge
open F1Fecho.Exponential F1Fecho.ExponentialLift F1Fecho.BoundedGamma
open ChatgptAudit.Continuous049

theorem WAB_norm_sq (c : ℝ) (f : H1) : ‖WA c f‖^2 + ‖WB c f‖^2 = ‖f‖^2 := by
  have h := congrArg (fun L : H1 →L[ℂ] H1 => inner ℂ f (L f)) (WAB_square_sum c)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply,inner_add_right] at h
  have ha : inner ℂ (WA c f) (WA c f) = inner ℂ f (WA c (WA c f)) :=
    (WA_selfadjoint c).isSymmetric f (WA c f)
  have hb : inner ℂ (WB c f) (WB c f) = inner ℂ f (WB c (WB c f)) :=
    (WB_selfadjoint c).isSymmetric f (WB c f)
  rw [← ha,← hb] at h
  have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
  simpa [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,← Complex.ofReal_pow] using hr

theorem WA_norm_le (c : ℝ) : ‖WA c‖ ≤ 1 := by
  apply (WA c).opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num)
  intro f
  have h := WAB_norm_sq c f
  have hn := norm_nonneg (WA c f)
  have hf := norm_nonneg f
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖WB c f‖]

theorem WB_norm_le (c : ℝ) : ‖WB c‖ ≤ 1 := by
  apply (WB c).opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num)
  intro f
  have h := WAB_norm_sq c f
  have hn := norm_nonneg (WB c f)
  have hf := norm_nonneg f
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖WA c f‖]

theorem WA_denseRange (c : ℝ) : DenseRange (WA c) :=
  bounded_graph_domain_dense (WA c) (WB c) (WA_injective c) (WA_selfadjoint c)

def GB : F →L[ℂ] F := BoundedGamma.gamma (WB rootParameter) (WB_norm_le rootParameter)

  gamma_selfadjoint _ _ (WA_selfadjoint rootParameter)
theorem GB_selfadjoint : IsSelfAdjoint GB :=
  gamma_selfadjoint _ _ (WB_selfadjoint rootParameter)
theorem GAB_commute : GA * GB = GB * GA :=
  gamma_commute _ _ _ _ (WAB_commute rootParameter)
theorem GA_denseRange : DenseRange GA :=
  gamma_denseRange _ _ (WA_denseRange rootParameter)
theorem GA_injective : Function.Injective GA :=
  gamma_injective _ _ (WA_selfadjoint rootParameter) (WA_denseRange rootParameter)

theorem graph_parameters_exponential (f : H1) :
    (GA (exponential f),GB (exponential f)) ∈ closedGraph TW := by
  change (BoundedGamma.gamma _ _ (exponential f),BoundedGamma.gamma _ _ (exponential f)) ∈ _
  rw [BoundedGamma.gamma_exponential,BoundedGamma.gamma_exponential]
  apply (coreGraph TW).le_topologicalClosure
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  let v : TW.domain := boundedGraphLift (WA rootParameter) (WB rootParameter)

  apply Prod.ext

  · change exponential (TW v) = exponential (WB rootParameter f)
    congr 1
    exact bounded_graph_lift_apply _ _ _ f

  let L : F →L[ℂ] F × F := GA.prod GB
  let M := (closedGraph TW).comap L.toLinearMap
  have hs : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential) ≤ M := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨f,rfl⟩

  have ht := (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential)).topologicalClosure_minimal hs hc
  rw [exponential_total] at ht
  have hx : (GA x,GB x) ∈ closedGraph TW := ht (Submodule.mem_top (x := x))
  change (GA x,GB x) ∈ (closedLift TW TW_selfadjoint).graph
  rw [closedLift_graph_eq]
  exact hx

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.LinearPMap
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic
/-! A maximality criterion from an actual bounded parametrization of a graph.
No self-adjoint extension, resolvent estimate, or surjectivity is assumed.
The proof uses the orthogonal projection of the L2 product graph. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.BoundedGraphSelfAdjoint
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

private theorem clm_pairing (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (x y : H) :
    inner ℂ (A x) y = inner ℂ x (A y) := hA.isSymmetric x y

private theorem bounded_pair_zero (A B : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    (hAB : A * B = B * A) (hAi : Function.Injective A)
    (u v : H) (h0 : A u + B v = 0) (h1 : A v = B u) : u=0 ∧ v=0 := by
  have hc (x : H) : A (B x) = B (A x) :=
    congrArg (fun C : H →L[ℂ] H => C x) hAB
  have hu : A u = -(B v) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h0
  have hdouble : A (A u) + B (B u) = 0 := by
    rw [hu,map_neg,← h1,hc]
    exact neg_add_cancel _
  have hi : inner ℂ (A u) (A u) + inner ℂ (B u) (B u) = 0 := by
    rw [clm_pairing A hA u (A u),clm_pairing B hB u (B u),← inner_add_right,hdouble,inner_zero_right]
  have hr : ‖A u‖ ^ 2 + ‖B u‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_add,inner_self_eq_norm_sq,map_zero] using
      congrArg (RCLike.re : ℂ → ℝ) hi
  have hau : A u = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖B u‖,norm_nonneg (A u)])
  have hu0 : u=0 := hAi (by simpa only [map_zero] using hau)
  have hav : A v=0 := by simpa only [hu0,map_zero] using h1
  exact ⟨hu0,hAi (by simpa only [map_zero] using hav)⟩

private theorem graph_constraint (G : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H)
    (hs : G.IsFormalAdjoint G) (A B : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    (hgraph : ∀ x : H, (A x,B x) ∈ G.graph)
    (p : H × H) (hp : p ∈ G.graph) : A p.2 = B p.1 := by
  obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := G.mem_graph_iff'.mp hp
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := G.mem_graph_iff'.mp (hgraph x)
  have hz1 : (z:H)=A x := congrArg Prod.fst hz
  have hz2 : G z=B x := congrArg Prod.snd hz
  have h := hs z y
  rw [hz1,hz2,clm_pairing B hB x (y:H),clm_pairing A hA x (G y)] at h
  exact h.symm

private theorem adjoint_constraint (G : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H)
    (hd : Dense (G.domain : Set H)) (A B : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    (hgraph : ∀ x : H, (A x,B x) ∈ G.graph)
    (p : H × H) (hp : p ∈ G.adjoint.graph) : A p.2 = B p.1 := by
  rw [LinearPMap.adjoint_graph_eq_graph_adjoint hd] at hp
  have hh := (Submodule.mem_adjoint_iff G.graph p).mp hp
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro x
  have h := sub_eq_zero.mp (hh (A x) (B x) (hgraph x))
  rw [clm_pairing B hB x p.1,clm_pairing A hA x p.2] at h
  exact h.symm

theorem adjoint_graph_le_of_bounded_pair (G : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H)
    (hc : G.IsClosed) (hs : G.IsFormalAdjoint G)
    (hd : Dense (G.domain : Set H)) (A B : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    (hAB : A * B = B * A) (hAi : Function.Injective A)
    (hgraph : ∀ x : H, (A x,B x) ∈ G.graph) :
    G.adjoint.graph ≤ G.graph := by
  let E := WithLp 2 (H × H)
  let e : E ≃L[ℂ] H × H := WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ H H
  let L : Submodule ℂ E := G.graph.comap e.toLinearMap
  have hL : IsClosed (L : Set E) := hc.preimage e.continuous
  letI : CompleteSpace L := hL.completeSpace_coe
  intro p hp
  let w : E := e.symm p
  let q : E := L.starProjection w
  let r : E := w-q
  have hq : e q ∈ G.graph := Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem L w
  have hwrel : A (e w).2 = B (e w).1 := by
    simpa only [w,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
      adjoint_constraint G hd A B hA hB hgraph p hp
  have hqrel := graph_constraint G hs A B hA hB hgraph (e q) hq
  have hrrel : A (e r).2 = B (e r).1 := by
    change A (e (w-q)).2 = B (e (w-q)).1
    rw [map_sub]
    change A ((e w).2-(e q).2) = B ((e w).1-(e q).1)
    rw [map_sub,map_sub,hwrel,hqrel]
  have horth (x : H) : inner ℂ r (e.symm (A x,B x)) = 0 := by
    apply Submodule.starProjection_inner_eq_zero w _
    change e (e.symm (A x,B x)) ∈ G.graph
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hgraph x
  have hsum : A (e r).1 + B (e r).2 = 0 := by
    apply (inner_self_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℂ)).mp
    have h := horth (A (e r).1 + B (e r).2)
    change inner ℂ (e r).1 (A (A (e r).1+B (e r).2)) +
      inner ℂ (e r).2 (B (A (e r).1+B (e r).2)) = 0 at h
    rw [← clm_pairing A hA (e r).1 _,← clm_pairing B hB (e r).2 _,← inner_add_left] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨hu,hv⟩ := bounded_pair_zero A B hA hB hAB hAi (e r).1 (e r).2 hsum hrrel
  have hr0 : r=0 := by
    apply e.injective
    exact (Prod.ext hu hv).trans (map_zero e).symm
  have heq : w=q := sub_eq_zero.mp hr0
  have hw : e w ∈ G.graph := by rw [heq]; exact hq
  simpa only [w,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hw

theorem selfAdjoint_of_bounded_pair (G : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H)
    (hc : G.IsClosed) (hs : G.IsFormalAdjoint G)
    (hd : Dense (G.domain : Set H)) (A B : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    (hAB : A * B = B * A) (hAi : Function.Injective A)
    (hgraph : ∀ x : H, (A x,B x) ∈ G.graph) : IsSelfAdjoint G := by
  apply LinearPMap.isSelfAdjoint_def.mpr
  exact le_antisymm
    (LinearPMap.le_of_le_graph (adjoint_graph_le_of_bounded_pair G hc hs hd A B hA hB hAB hAi hgraph))
    (hs.le_adjoint hd)

end F1Fecho.BoundedGraphSelfAdjoint
#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedGraphSelfAdjoint.adjoint_graph_le_of_bounded_pair
#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedGraphSelfAdjoint.selfAdjoint_of_bounded_pair

import TGLExt.ContinuousModularSquare
import TGLExt.GenericAntilinearAdjoint
/-! The exact composition domain and graph of a partial operator square,
reusing the canonical partialSquareDomain. No selfadjointness of the square
or imaginary power identification is asserted by this algebraic lemma. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.PartialSquare
open ChatgptAudit.Continuous050
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

def input (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) : partialSquareDomain T →ₗ[ℂ] T.domain :=
  Submodule.inclusion (fun _ h => h.choose)

def square (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H where
  domain := partialSquareDomain T
  toFun := T.toFun.comp ((T.toFun.comp (input T)).codRestrict
    T.domain (fun x => x.property.choose_spec))

theorem square_graph_iff (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (x y : H) :
    (x,y) ∈ (square T).graph ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ T.domain, ∃ hTx : T ⟨x,hx⟩ ∈ T.domain, T ⟨T ⟨x,hx⟩,hTx⟩ = y := by
  rw [LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv,hy⟩
    dsimp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at hv hy
    subst x
    exact ⟨v.property.choose,v.property.choose_spec,hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx,hTx,hxy⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x,⟨hx,hTx⟩⟩,rfl,hxy⟩

theorem square_graph_iff_tomita_comp (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H)
    (J : H ≃ₛₗᵢ[starRingEnd ℂ] H) (hJ : Function.Involutive J) (x y : H) :
    (x,y) ∈ (square T).graph ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ T.domain,
        ∃ hSx : genericTomita T J ⟨x,hx⟩ ∈ (genericTomitaAdjoint T J).domain,
          genericTomitaAdjoint T J ⟨genericTomita T J ⟨x,hx⟩,hSx⟩ = y := by
  rw [square_graph_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx,hTx,hxy⟩
    refine ⟨hx,(generic_composition_domain T J hJ ⟨x,hx⟩).mpr hTx,?_⟩
    rw [generic_adjoint_comp T J hJ]
    exact hxy
  · rintro ⟨hx,hSx,hxy⟩
    have hTx := (generic_composition_domain T J hJ ⟨x,hx⟩).mp hSx
    refine ⟨hx,hTx,?_⟩
    rw [← generic_adjoint_comp T J hJ ⟨x,hx⟩ hTx]
    exact hxy

theorem square_energy (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hs : T.IsFormalAdjoint T)
    (x : (square T).domain) :
    (inner ℂ (x:H) (square T x)).re = ‖T ⟨x,x.property.choose⟩‖^2 := by
  let u : T.domain := ⟨x,x.property.choose⟩
  let v : T.domain := ⟨T u,x.property.choose_spec⟩
  change (inner ℂ (u:H) (T v)).re = _
  rw [← hs u v]
  exact (norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (T u)).symm

end F1Fecho.PartialSquare
#print axioms F1Fecho.PartialSquare.square_graph_iff
#print axioms F1Fecho.PartialSquare.square_graph_iff_tomita_comp
#print axioms F1Fecho.PartialSquare.square_energy

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.PartialSquareGraphR2
import Mathlib.Topology.Sequences
/-! Closedness of the genuine square of a closed symmetric partial operator.
The proof controls the middle graph coordinate by Cauchy--Schwarz and uses
completeness; ordinary density is not substituted for graph closedness. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology
namespace F1Fecho.PartialSquare
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

def middle (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) : (square T).domain →ₗ[ℂ] H := T.toFun.comp (input T)

theorem middle_norm_sq_le (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hs : T.IsFormalAdjoint T)
    (x : (square T).domain) : ‖middle T x‖^2 ≤ ‖(x:H)‖ * ‖square T x‖ := by
  have h := re_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) (x:H) (square T x)
  change (inner ℂ (x:H) (square T x)).re ≤ ‖(x:H)‖ * ‖square T x‖ at h
  rw [square_energy T hs x] at h
  exact h

theorem square_graph_iff_two (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (x y : H) :
    (x,y) ∈ (square T).graph ↔ ∃ z : H, (x,z) ∈ T.graph ∧ (z,y) ∈ T.graph := by
  rw [square_graph_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx,hTx,hxy⟩
    refine ⟨T ⟨x,hx⟩,?_,?_⟩
    · exact (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff T).mpr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,rfl,rfl⟩
    · exact (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff T).mpr ⟨⟨T ⟨x,hx⟩,hTx⟩,rfl,hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨z,hxz,hzy⟩
    obtain ⟨u,hu,hTu⟩ := (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff T).mp hxz
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hTv⟩ := (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff T).mp hzy
    dsimp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd] at hu hTu hv hTv
    subst x
    have ht : T u = (v:H) := hTu.trans hv.symm
    have hm : T u ∈ T.domain := ht.symm ▸ v.property
    refine ⟨u.property,hm,?_⟩
    have he : (⟨T u,hm⟩ : T.domain) = v := Subtype.ext ht
    rw [he]
    exact hTv

theorem square_formalAdjoint (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hs : T.IsFormalAdjoint T) :
    (square T).IsFormalAdjoint (square T) := by
  intro x y
  let u : T.domain := ⟨x,x.property.choose⟩
  let v : T.domain := ⟨y,y.property.choose⟩
  let Tu : T.domain := ⟨T u,x.property.choose_spec⟩
  let Tv : T.domain := ⟨T v,y.property.choose_spec⟩
  change inner ℂ (T Tu) (v:H) = inner ℂ (u:H) (T Tv)
  exact (hs Tu v).trans (hs u Tv)

theorem square_closed (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hc : T.IsClosed) (hs : T.IsFormalAdjoint T) :
    (square T).IsClosed := by
  apply IsSeqClosed.isClosed
  intro p q hp hpq
  choose v hv1 hv2 using (fun n => (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff (square T)).mp (hp n))
  have hx : Tendsto (fun n => (v n:H)) atTop (𝓝 q.1) := by
    simpa only [hv1,Function.comp_def] using (continuous_fst.tendsto q).comp hpq
  have hy : Tendsto (fun n => square T (v n)) atTop (𝓝 q.2) := by
    simpa only [hv2,Function.comp_def] using (continuous_snd.tendsto q).comp hpq
  have hmid : CauchySeq (fun n => middle T (v n)) := by
    apply Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mpr
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨Nx,hNx⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hx.cauchySeq ε hε
    obtain ⟨Ny,hNy⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hy.cauchySeq ε hε
    refine ⟨max Nx Ny,?_⟩
    intro m hm n hn
    have hxx : ‖(v m:H)-(v n:H)‖ < ε := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact hNx m (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hm) n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
    have hyy : ‖square T (v m)-square T (v n)‖ < ε := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact hNy m (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hm) n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
    have hb := middle_norm_sq_le T hs (v m-v n)
    rw [map_sub,LinearPMap.map_sub] at hb
    change ‖middle T (v m)-middle T (v n)‖^2 ≤
      ‖(v m:H)-(v n:H)‖ * ‖square T (v m)-square T (v n)‖ at hb
    have hprod : ‖(v m:H)-(v n:H)‖ * ‖square T (v m)-square T (v n)‖ < ε*ε := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ε * ‖square T (v m)-square T (v n)‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxx.le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < ε*ε := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hyy hε
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (middle T (v m)-middle T (v n))]
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hmid
  have hfirst : (q.1,z) ∈ T.graph := by
    apply hc.mem_of_tendsto (hx.prodMk_nhds hz)
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro n
    exact (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff T).mpr ⟨input T (v n),rfl,rfl⟩
  have hsecond : (z,q.2) ∈ T.graph := by
    apply hc.mem_of_tendsto (hz.prodMk_nhds hy)
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro n
    exact (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff T).mpr
      ⟨⟨middle T (v n),(v n).property.choose_spec⟩,rfl,rfl⟩
  exact (square_graph_iff_two T q.1 q.2).mpr ⟨z,hfirst,hsecond⟩

end F1Fecho.PartialSquare

#print axioms F1Fecho.PartialSquare.square_graph_iff_two

  complement_injective := modularR_complement_injective

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.PositiveRegularizedRootR3
/-! A resolvent equation from bounded graph parameters. In particular this
uses A²+B², without incorrectly imposing A²+B²=1 after second quantization. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.BoundedPairResolvent
open ChatgptAudit.UnboundedTransform016 F1Fecho.PositiveRegularized
variable {H:Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (G:H→ₗ.[ℂ]H) (hs:IsSelfAdjoint G) (A B:H→L[ℂ]H)
  (hA:IsSelfAdjoint A) (hB:IsSelfAdjoint B)
  (hgraph:∀x:H,(A x,B x)∈G.graph)

include hs hA hB hgraph in
theorem domain_relation (x:G.domain) : A (G x)=B (x:H) := by
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro y
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hv'⟩:=(LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff G).mp (hgraph y)
  calc
    inner ℂ y (A (G x)) = inner ℂ (A y) (G x) := (hA.isSymmetric y (G x)).symm
    _ = inner ℂ (v:H) (G x) := congrArg (fun z=>inner ℂ z (G x)) hv.symm
    _ = inner ℂ (G v) (x:H) := (selfadjoint_formal G hs v x).symm
    _ = inner ℂ (B y) (x:H) := congrArg (fun z=>inner ℂ z (x:H)) hv'
    _ = inner ℂ y (B (x:H)) := hB.isSymmetric y (x:H)

include hs hA hB hgraph in
theorem equation (hAB:A*B=B*A) :
    (A*A+B*B)*selfadjointSquareResolvent G hs=A*A := by
  ext x
  have h1:=domain_relation G hs A B hA hB hgraph (input G hs x)
  change A (L G hs x)=B (R G hs x) at h1
  have h2:=domain_relation G hs A B hA hB hgraph (second G hs x)
  change A (G (second G hs x))=B (L G hs x) at h2
  rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' (PositiveRegularized.equation G hs x),map_sub] at h2
  have hc (v:H) : A (B v)=B (A v) := congrArg (fun F:H→L[ℂ]H=>F v) hAB
  change A (A (R G hs x))+B (B (R G hs x))=A (A x)
  symm
  calc
    A (A x) = A (B (L G hs x)+A (R G hs x)) := congrArg A (eq_add_of_sub_eq h2)
    _ = A (A (R G hs x))+B (A (L G hs x)) := by rw [map_add,hc]; abel
    _ = A (A (R G hs x))+B (B (R G hs x)) := by rw [h1]

end F1Fecho.BoundedPairResolvent
#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedPairResolvent.domain_relation
#print axioms F1Fecho.BoundedPairResolvent.equation

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Commute
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
/-! Naturality under a bounded intertwiner, which need not be invertible.
The compact function algebra is generated densely by the coordinate and its
conjugate; no identification of different Hilbert spaces is presumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology
namespace F1Fecho.ContinuousIntertwining
variable {H K:Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {s:Set ℂ} [CompactSpace s]
variable (φ:C(s,ℂ)→⋆ₐ[ℂ](H→L[ℂ]H)) (ψ:C(s,ℂ)→⋆ₐ[ℂ](K→L[ℂ]K))
  (hφ:Continuous φ) (hψ:Continuous ψ) (V:H→L[ℂ]K)

include hφ hψ in
theorem hom_intertwine
    (hgen:V.comp (φ (.restrict s (.id ℂ)))=(ψ (.restrict s (.id ℂ))).comp V)
    (hstar:V.comp (φ (star (.restrict s (.id ℂ))))=(ψ (star (.restrict s (.id ℂ)))).comp V)
    (f:C(s,ℂ)) : V.comp (φ f)=(ψ f).comp V := by
  induction f using ContinuousMap.induction_on_of_compact with
  | const r =>
    change V.comp (φ (algebraMap ℂ C(s,ℂ) r))=(ψ (algebraMap ℂ C(s,ℂ) r)).comp V
    rw [AlgHomClass.commutes,AlgHomClass.commutes]
    ext x
    simp
  | id => exact hgen
  | star_id => exact hstar
  | add f g hf hg =>
    rw [map_add,map_add,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_add,ContinuousLinearMap.add_comp,hf,hg]
  | mul f g hf hg =>
    rw [map_mul,map_mul]
    ext x
    change V (φ f (φ g x))=ψ f (ψ g (V x))
    calc
      _ = ψ f (V (φ g x)) := congrArg (fun M:H→L[ℂ]K=>M (φ g x)) hf
      _ = _ := congrArg (ψ f) (congrArg (fun M:H→L[ℂ]K=>M x) hg)
  | frequently f hf =>
    have hc:IsClosed {g:C(s,ℂ)|V.comp (φ g)=(ψ g).comp V}:=
      isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    rw [←Set.mem_setOf (p:=fun g:C(s,ℂ)=>V.comp (φ g)=(ψ g).comp V),←hc.closure_eq]
    exact mem_closure_of_frequently_of_tendsto hf tendsto_id

include hφ hψ in
theorem hom_intertwine_selfadjoint
    (hφs:IsSelfAdjoint (φ (.restrict s (.id ℂ))))
    (hψs:IsSelfAdjoint (ψ (.restrict s (.id ℂ))))
    (hgen:V.comp (φ (.restrict s (.id ℂ)))=(ψ (.restrict s (.id ℂ))).comp V)
    (f:C(s,ℂ)) : V.comp (φ f)=(ψ f).comp V := by
  apply hom_intertwine φ ψ hφ hψ V hgen
  rwa [map_star,map_star,hφs.star_eq,hψs.star_eq]

end F1Fecho.ContinuousIntertwining

#print axioms F1Fecho.ContinuousIntertwining.hom_intertwine_selfadjoint

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ContinuousHomIntertwiningR2
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
/-! Continuous functional calculus respects bounded intertwiners between
selfadjoint operators on possibly different Hilbert spaces. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.ContinuousIntertwining
variable {H K:Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

theorem cfc_intertwine (A:H→L[ℂ]H) (B:K→L[ℂ]K)
    (hA:IsSelfAdjoint A) (hB:IsSelfAdjoint B) (V:H→L[ℂ]K)
    (hV:V.comp A=B.comp V) (f:ℂ→ℂ) (hf:Continuous f) :
    V.comp (cfc f A)=(cfc f B).comp V := by
  let s:Set ℂ:=spectrum ℂ A∪spectrum ℂ B
  letI : CompactSpace s := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp
    ((ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.isCompact_spectrum A).union
      (ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.isCompact_spectrum B))
  let iA:C(spectrum ℂ A,s):=⟨fun z=>⟨z,Or.inl z.property⟩,by fun_prop⟩
  let iB:C(spectrum ℂ B,s):=⟨fun z=>⟨z,Or.inr z.property⟩,by fun_prop⟩
  let φ:C(s,ℂ)→⋆ₐ[ℂ](H→L[ℂ]H):=
    (cfcHom hA.isStarNormal).comp (ContinuousMap.compStarAlgHom' ℂ ℂ iA)
  let ψ:C(s,ℂ)→⋆ₐ[ℂ](K→L[ℂ]K):=
    (cfcHom hB.isStarNormal).comp (ContinuousMap.compStarAlgHom' ℂ ℂ iB)
  have hφ:Continuous φ := (cfcHom_continuous hA.isStarNormal).comp iA.continuous_precomp
  have hψ:Continuous ψ := (cfcHom_continuous hB.isStarNormal).comp iB.continuous_precomp
  have ha:φ (.restrict s (.id ℂ))=A := by
    change cfcHom hA.isStarNormal (.restrict (spectrum ℂ A) (.id ℂ))=A
    exact cfcHom_id hA.isStarNormal
  have hb:ψ (.restrict s (.id ℂ))=B := by
    change cfcHom hB.isStarNormal (.restrict (spectrum ℂ B) (.id ℂ))=B
    exact cfcHom_id hB.isStarNormal
  have hmain:=hom_intertwine_selfadjoint φ ψ hφ hψ V (ha.symm ▸ hA) (hb.symm ▸ hB)
    (by rwa [ha,hb]) (.restrict s ⟨f,hf⟩)
  rw [cfc_apply f A hA.isStarNormal hf.continuousOn,
    cfc_apply f B hB.isStarNormal hf.continuousOn]
  exact hmain

end F1Fecho.ContinuousIntertwining

/-! A constructed unitary from the completed scalar L2 tensor product to vector L2.
The scalar/vector product is first proved Gram preserving. Surjectivity follows
from the actual density of simple functions, not from an assumed tensor model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal
namespace F1Fecho.TensorL2
variable {X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable (μ : Measure X)
abbrev Scalar := Lp ℂ 2 μ
abbrev Vector := Lp E 2 μ
abbrev Completed := Completion (Scalar μ ⊗[ℂ] E)

def pure (p : Scalar μ × E) : Completed (E:=E) μ := (p.1 ⊗ₜ[ℂ] p.2 : Scalar μ ⊗[ℂ] E)
def pointwise (p : Scalar μ × E) : Vector (E:=E) μ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ p.2).compLp p.1
lemma pointwise_ae (p : Scalar μ × E) : pointwise μ p =ᵐ[μ] fun x => p.1 x • p.2 :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ p.2).coeFn_compLp p.1

theorem gram : GramExtension.GramEqual (𝕜:=ℂ) (pure (E:=E) μ) (pointwise μ) := by
  intro p q
  rw [show inner ℂ (pure μ p) (pure μ q)=inner ℂ p.1 q.1 * inner ℂ p.2 q.2 by
    simp only [pure,Completion.inner_coe,TensorProduct.inner_tmul]]
  rw [L2.inner_def,L2.inner_def,← integral_mul_const]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [pointwise_ae μ p,pointwise_ae μ q] with x hp hq
  rw [hp,hq]
  simp only [inner_smul_left,inner_smul_right,RCLike.inner_apply]
  ring

theorem pure_total : GramExtension.Total (𝕜:=ℂ) (pure (E:=E) μ) := by
  let S := (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pure (E:=E) μ))).topologicalClosure
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  change x ∈ S
  refine Completion.induction_on x (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pure (E:=E) μ))).isClosed_topologicalClosure ?_
  intro a
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa only [Completion.coe_zero] using S.zero_mem
  | tmul f e => exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(f,e),rfl⟩)
  | add a b ha hb => simpa only [Completion.coe_add] using S.add_mem ha hb

lemma pointwise_indicator (c : E) {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hμs : μ s≠∞) :
    pointwise μ (indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs (1:ℂ),c)=indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs c := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [pointwise_ae μ (indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs (1:ℂ),c),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p:=2) (μ:=μ) (hs:=hs) (hμs:=hμs) (c:=(1:ℂ)),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p:=2) (μ:=μ) (hs:=hs) (hμs:=hμs) (c:=c)] with x hp h1 hc
  rw [hp,hc]
  change indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs (1:ℂ) x • c = _
  rw [h1]
  by_cases hx:x∈s <;> simp [hx]

theorem pointwise_total : GramExtension.Total (𝕜:=ℂ) (pointwise (E:=E) μ) := by
  let S := (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pointwise (E:=E) μ))).topologicalClosure
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  change x∈S
  apply Lp.induction (by norm_num : (2:ENNReal)≠∞) (fun f => f∈S) ?_ ?_
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pointwise (E:=E) μ))).isClosed_topologicalClosure x
  · intro c s hs hμs
    change indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs.ne c ∈ S
    rw [← pointwise_indicator μ c hs hμs.ne]
    exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_,rfl⟩)
  · intro f g hf hg hd hSf hSg
    exact S.add_mem hSf hSg

def unitary : Completed (E:=E) μ ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Vector (E:=E) μ :=
  GramExtension.equivalence (pure μ) (pointwise μ) (gram μ) (pure_total μ) (pointwise_total μ)

theorem unitary_pure (f : Scalar μ) (e : E) : unitary μ (pure μ (f,e))=pointwise μ (f,e) :=
  GramExtension.equivalence_apply _ _ _ _ _ _

end F1Fecho.TensorL2

#print axioms F1Fecho.TensorL2.pure_total
#print axioms F1Fecho.TensorL2.pointwise_total
#print axioms F1Fecho.TensorL2.unitary_pure

/-! Completion, associativity and factor transport on the existing Hilbert tensor norm.
All maps are defined from Gram-preserving dense algebraic families. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1400000
noncomputable section
open UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace F1Fecho.CompletedTensor
open F1Rede.BosonicTwoParticle
variable {E F G E' F' : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace ℂ G]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E']
  [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F']
abbrev CT (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] := Completion (E⊗[ℂ]F)
def pure (p : E×F) : CT E F := (p.1⊗ₜ[ℂ]p.2 : E⊗[ℂ]F)

def bilinear : E→L[ℂ]F→L[ℂ](E⊗[ℂ]F) :=
  (TensorProduct.mk ℂ E F).mkContinuous₂ 1 (by
    intro x y
    simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply,TensorProduct.norm_tmul,one_mul,le_refl])

theorem pure_total : GramExtension.Total (𝕜:=ℂ) (pure (E:=E) (F:=F)) := by
  let S := (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pure (E:=E) (F:=F)))).topologicalClosure
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  change x∈S
  refine Completion.induction_on x
    (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pure (E:=E) (F:=F)))).isClosed_topologicalClosure ?_
  intro a
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa only [Completion.coe_zero] using S.zero_mem
  | tmul x y => exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(x,y),rfl⟩)
  | add a b ha hb => simpa only [Completion.coe_add] using S.add_mem ha hb

def leftDense (p : E×F) : CT (Completion E) F := pure ((p.1:Completion E),p.2)

theorem leftDense_total : GramExtension.Total (𝕜:=ℂ) (leftDense (E:=E) (F:=F)) := by
  let S := (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (leftDense (E:=E) (F:=F)))).topologicalClosure
  have hS : IsClosed (S:Set (CT (Completion E) F)) :=
    (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (leftDense (E:=E) (F:=F)))).isClosed_topologicalClosure
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  change z∈S
  refine Completion.induction_on z hS ?_
  intro a
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa only [Completion.coe_zero] using S.zero_mem
  | tmul x y =>
    have hc : Continuous (fun v : Completion E => (v⊗ₜ[ℂ]y : CT (Completion E) F)) :=
      (Completion.continuous_coe _).comp ((bilinear (E:=Completion E) (F:=F)).flip y).continuous
    refine Completion.induction_on x (hS.preimage hc) ?_
    intro v
    exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(v,y),rfl⟩)
  | add a b ha hb => simpa only [Completion.coe_add] using S.add_mem ha hb

theorem left_gram : GramExtension.GramEqual (𝕜:=ℂ)
    (leftDense (E:=E) (F:=F)) pure := by
  intro p q
  simp only [leftDense,pure,Completion.inner_coe,TensorProduct.inner_tmul]

def collapseLeft : CT (Completion E) F ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] CT E F :=
  GramExtension.equivalence leftDense pure left_gram leftDense_total pure_total

theorem collapseLeft_pure (x:E) (y:F) :
    collapseLeft (pure ((x:Completion E),y))=pure (x,y) :=
  GramExtension.equivalence_apply _ _ _ _ _ (x,y)

def congr (u:E≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]E') (v:F≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]F') : CT E F≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]CT E' F' :=
  completionEquiv (TensorProduct.congrIsometry u v)
def comm : CT E F≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]CT F E := completionEquiv (TensorProduct.commIsometry ℂ E F)
def assoc : CT (E⊗[ℂ]F) G≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]CT E (F⊗[ℂ]G) :=
  completionEquiv (TensorProduct.assocIsometry ℂ E F G)

theorem congr_pure (u:E≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]E') (v:F≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]F') (x:E) (y:F) :
    congr u v (pure (x,y))=pure (u x,v y) := by
  simp [congr,pure]
theorem comm_pure (x:E) (y:F) : comm (pure (x,y))=pure (y,x) := by
  simp [comm,pure]
theorem assoc_pure (x:E) (y:F) (z:G) : assoc (pure (x⊗ₜ[ℂ]y,z))=pure (x,y⊗ₜ[ℂ]z) := by
  simp [assoc,pure]

def completeRight : CT E F≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]CT E (Completion F) :=
  (comm (E:=E) (F:=F)).trans ((collapseLeft (E:=F) (F:=E)).symm.trans comm)

theorem completeRight_pure (x:E) (y:F) :
    completeRight (pure (x,y))=pure (x,(y:Completion F)) := by
  change comm ((collapseLeft (E:=F) (F:=E)).symm (comm (pure (x,y))))=_
  rw [comm_pure,← collapseLeft_pure y x,LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply,comm_pure]
end F1Fecho.CompletedTensor

variable {X E F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]

  (congr (TensorL2.unitary (E:=E) μ).symm (.refl ℂ F)).trans
    (collapseLeft.trans (assoc.trans (completeRight.trans (TensorL2.unitary μ))))

    unitary μ (CompletedTensor.pure (TensorL2.pointwise μ (a,x),y))=
      TensorL2.pointwise μ (a,CompletedTensor.pure (x,y)) := by
  have h : (TensorL2.unitary (E:=E) μ).symm (TensorL2.pointwise μ (a,x))=
      TensorL2.pure μ (a,x) := by
    rw [← TensorL2.unitary_pure,LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  simp only [unitary,LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply,congr_pure,LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_refl,Function.id_def,h]
  change TensorL2.unitary μ (completeRight (assoc (collapseLeft
    (CompletedTensor.pure (((a⊗ₜ[ℂ]x : Lp ℂ 2 μ⊗[ℂ]E):Completion (Lp ℂ 2 μ⊗[ℂ]E)),y)))))=_
  rw [collapseLeft_pure,assoc_pure,completeRight_pure]
  exact TensorL2.unitary_pure (E:=CT E F) μ a (CompletedTensor.pure (x,y))

  Completion.toComplL.comp ((bilinear (E:=E) (F:=F)).flip y)
lemma attach_apply (x:E) (y:F) : attach y x=CompletedTensor.pure (x,y) := rfl

theorem separated_attach (a : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (x:E) (y:F) :
    (attach y).compLp (TensorL2.pointwise μ (a,x))=TensorL2.pointwise μ (a,CompletedTensor.pure (x,y)) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(attach y).coeFn_compLp (TensorL2.pointwise μ (a,x)),
    TensorL2.pointwise_ae μ (a,x),TensorL2.pointwise_ae μ (a,CompletedTensor.pure (x,y))] with z ha hx hy
  rw [ha,hx,hy,map_smul]
  rfl

    unitary μ (CompletedTensor.pure (f,y))=(attach y).compLp f := by
  let L : Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp (CT E F) 2 μ :=
    (unitary μ).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (Completion.toComplL.comp ((bilinear (E:=Lp E 2 μ) (F:=F)).flip y))
  let M : Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp (CT E F) 2 μ := (attach (E:=E) y).compLpL 2 μ
  change L f=M f
  refine Lp.induction (by norm_num : (2:ENNReal)≠∞) (fun f => L f=M f) ?_ ?_
    (isClosed_eq L.continuous M.continuous) f
  · intro x s hs hμs
    change unitary μ (CompletedTensor.pure (indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs.ne x,y))=
      (attach y).compLp (indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs.ne x)
    rw [← TensorL2.pointwise_indicator μ x hs hμs.ne,separated,separated_attach]
  · intro a b ha hb hd hLa hLb
    rw [map_add,map_add,hLa,hLb]

namespace F1Fecho.L2UnitaryMap
variable {X E F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

  norm_map' f := by

    congr 1

  right_inv := inverse μ U.symm

asserted here. -/

  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [CompleteSpace F]

theorem tensor_separable [SeparableSpace E] [SeparableSpace F] : SeparableSpace (CT E F) := by
  have hc : Continuous (CompletedTensor.pure (E:=E) (F:=F)) :=
    (Completion.continuous_coe _).comp ((bilinear (E:=E) (F:=F)).continuous₂.comp₂
      continuous_fst continuous_snd)
  have hs := (isSeparable_range hc).span (R:=ℂ) |>.closure
  have ht := pure_total (E:=E) (F:=F)
  change (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (CompletedTensor.pure (E:=E) (F:=F)))).topologicalClosure=⊤ at ht
  rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe,ht] at hs
  exact isSeparable_univ_iff.mp hs

variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)

def innerUnitary : CT E (Lp F 2 ν)≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]Lp (CT E F) 2 ν :=
  (comm (E:=E) (F:=Lp F 2 ν)).trans
    ((VectorTensorL2.unitary ν).trans (L2UnitaryMap.unitary ν comm))

  change L2UnitaryMap.unitary ν comm (VectorTensorL2.unitary ν (comm (CompletedTensor.pure (x,g)))) =ᵐ[ν] _
  rw [comm_pure]
  filter_upwards [L2UnitaryMap.unitary_ae ν comm (VectorTensorL2.unitary ν (CompletedTensor.pure (g,x))),
    VectorTensorL2.pure_ae ν g x] with y hy hg
  rw [hy,hg,comm_pure]

def nestedUnitary : CT (Lp E 2 μ) (Lp F 2 ν)≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]Lp (Lp (CT E F) 2 ν) 2 μ :=
  (VectorTensorL2.unitary μ).trans (L2UnitaryMap.unitary μ (innerUnitary ν))

    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, nestedUnitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)) x =ᵐ[ν] fun y=>CompletedTensor.pure (f x,g y) := by
  filter_upwards [L2UnitaryMap.unitary_ae μ (innerUnitary ν)
    (VectorTensorL2.unitary μ (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g))),VectorTensorL2.pure_ae μ f g] with x hx hf
  change nestedUnitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)) x=innerUnitary ν
    (VectorTensorL2.unitary μ (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)) x) at hx
  rw [hx,hf]
  exact innerUnitary_ae ν (f x) g

  [SeparableSpace E] [SeparableSpace F]

def unitary : CT (Lp E 2 μ) (Lp F 2 ν)≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]Lp (CT E F) 2 (ν.prod μ) := by
  letI : SeparableSpace (CT E F) := tensor_separable
  letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ (CT E F) := InnerProductSpace.complexToReal
  exact (nestedUnitary μ ν).trans (F1Rede.fubiniL2Equiv (𝕜:=ℂ)).symm

    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (fun y=>unitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)) (y,x)) =ᵐ[ν]

  letI : SeparableSpace (CT E F) := tensor_separable
  letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ (CT E F) := InnerProductSpace.complexToReal
  have hc := F1Rede.curryLp_coe_ae (unitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)))
  have he : F1Rede.curryLp (unitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g))) =
      nestedUnitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)) := by
    change F1Rede.fubiniL2Equiv (𝕜:=ℂ) (unitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)))=_
    exact LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  rw [he] at hc
  filter_upwards [hc,nestedUnitary_ae μ ν f g] with x hx hg
  exact hx.symm.trans hg

theorem unitary_ae (f:Lp E 2 μ) (g:Lp F 2 ν) :
    unitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)) =ᵐ[ν.prod μ]
      fun p=>CompletedTensor.pure (f p.2,g p.1) := by
  have hc : Continuous (CompletedTensor.pure (E:=E) (F:=F)) :=
    (Completion.continuous_coe _).comp (bilinear (E:=E) (F:=F)).continuous₂

    hc.comp_stronglyMeasurable (((Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).comp_measurable measurable_snd).prodMk
      ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable g).comp_measurable measurable_fst))
  have he := (Lp.stronglyMeasurable (unitary μ ν (CompletedTensor.pure (f,g)))).measurableSet_eq_fun hm

open MeasureTheory UniformSpace TopologicalSpace
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal

open TGLExt.ImportedSQ AuditF13v31 F1Rede.CanonicalWedge

local instance : SeparableSpace TransverseFiber := by
  letI : Fact ((2:ℝ≥0∞)≠∞) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  change SeparableSpace (Lp Fib 2 (volume : Measure Transverse))
  infer_instance

def completionCollapse {E:Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] : Completion E≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]E :=
  (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E).extendOfIsometry
    (Completion.toComplₗᵢ (𝕜:=ℂ) (E:=E)).toLinearMap (LinearMap.id)
    Completion.denseRange_coe denseRange_id (fun x=>by simp)

theorem completionCollapse_coe {E:Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (x:E) : completionCollapse (x:Completion E)=x :=
  LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ x

structure SpectralData where
  Index : Type
  [measurable : MeasurableSpace Index]
  [countable : MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Index]
  measure : Measure Index
  [sfinite : SFinite measure]
  Fiber : Type
  [normed : NormedAddCommGroup Fiber]
  [inner : InnerProductSpace ℂ Fiber]
  [complete : CompleteSpace Fiber]
  [separable : SeparableSpace Fiber]
attribute [instance] SpectralData.measurable SpectralData.countable SpectralData.sfinite
  SpectralData.normed SpectralData.inner SpectralData.complete SpectralData.separable

def data : ℕ→SpectralData
  | 0 => { Index:=ℝ,measure:=volume,Fiber:=TransverseFiber }
  | n+1 => {
      Index:=(data n).Index×ℝ
      measure:=(data n).measure.prod volume
      Fiber:=CT TransverseFiber (data n).Fiber
      separable:=TensorL2Product.tensor_separable }

abbrev Space (n:ℕ) := Lp (data n).Fiber 2 (data n).measure

def first : TensorHilbert 1≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]Space 0 :=
  (comm (E:=H1) (F:=ℂ)).trans
    ((completionEquiv (TensorProduct.lidIsometry ℂ H1)).trans
      (completionCollapse.trans Phi))

theorem first_pure (f:H1) : first (pureCompleted 1 f)=Phi f := by
  change Phi (completionCollapse (completionEquiv (TensorProduct.lidIsometry ℂ H1)
    (comm (CompletedTensor.pure (f,(1:ℂ))))))=_
  rw [comm_pure]
  simp only [CompletedTensor.pure,completionEquiv_coe,TensorProduct.lidIsometry_apply,
    TensorProduct.lid_tmul,one_smul,completionCollapse_coe]

def coordinates : (n:ℕ)→TensorHilbert (n+1)≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]Space n
  | 0 => first
  | n+1 => (completeRight (E:=H1) (F:=Algebraic (n+1))).trans
      ((congr Phi (coordinates n)).trans

theorem coordinates_succ_tmul (n:ℕ) (f:H1) (v:Algebraic (n+1)) :

  change TensorL2Product.unitary _ _
    (congr Phi (coordinates n) (completeRight (CompletedTensor.pure (f,v))))=_
  rw [completeRight_pure,congr_pure]

theorem coordinates_succ_ae (n:ℕ) (f:H1) (v:Algebraic (n+1)) :
    coordinates (n+1) (CompletedTensor.pure (f,v)) =ᵐ[(data (n+1)).measure]
      fun p=>CompletedTensor.pure (Phi f p.2,coordinates n (v:TensorHilbert (n+1)) p.1) := by
  rw [coordinates_succ_tmul]
  exact TensorL2Product.unitary_ae (E:=TransverseFiber) (F:=(data n).Fiber)
    (volume:Measure ℝ) (data n).measure (Phi f) (coordinates n (v:TensorHilbert (n+1)))

import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.Complete
import Mathlib.Tactic
/-! Scalar multipliers on an arbitrary measure space. This is the measure-space
generalization needed for tensor spectral coordinates; it does not change Fock. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1400000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace F1Fecho.ScalarL2
variable {X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable (μ : Measure X)

structure Data where
  value : X→ℂ
  measurable : AEStronglyMeasurable value μ
  bound : ℝ
  nonneg : 0≤bound
  bounded : ∀x, ‖value x‖≤bound

variable (d : Data μ)
theorem mem (f:Lp E 2 μ) : MemLp (fun x=>d.value x • f x) 2 μ :=
  (Lp.memLp f).of_le_mul (d.measurable.smul (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f))
    (Eventually.of_forall fun x=> by
      rw [norm_smul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (d.bounded x) (norm_nonneg _))

def applyLp (f:Lp E 2 μ) : Lp E 2 μ := (mem μ d f).toLp _
theorem apply_ae (f:Lp E 2 μ) : applyLp μ d f =ᵐ[μ] fun x=>d.value x • f x :=
  (mem μ d f).coeFn_toLp

def linear : Lp E 2 μ→ₗ[ℂ]Lp E 2 μ where
  toFun := applyLp μ d
  map_add' f g := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [apply_ae μ d (f+g),apply_ae μ d f,apply_ae μ d g,
      Lp.coeFn_add f g,Lp.coeFn_add (applyLp μ d f) (applyLp μ d g)] with x h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at h4 h5
    rw [h1,h5,h2,h3,h4,smul_add]
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [apply_ae μ d (c•f),apply_ae μ d f,Lp.coeFn_smul c f,
      Lp.coeFn_smul c (applyLp μ d f)] with x h1 h2 h3 h4
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at h3 h4
    simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
    rw [h1,h4,h2,h3,smul_smul,smul_smul,mul_comm]

theorem norm_apply (f:Lp E 2 μ) : ‖applyLp μ d f‖≤d.bound*‖f‖ := by
  apply Lp.norm_le_mul_norm_of_ae_le_mul
  filter_upwards [apply_ae μ d f] with x hx
  rw [hx,norm_smul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (d.bounded x) (norm_nonneg _)

def op : Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp E 2 μ := (linear μ d).mkContinuous d.bound (norm_apply μ d)
theorem op_ae (f:Lp E 2 μ) : op μ d f =ᵐ[μ] fun x=>d.value x • f x := apply_ae μ d f
theorem norm_op : ‖op (E:=E) μ d‖≤d.bound :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ d.nonneg (norm_apply μ d)

theorem op_eq (e:Data μ) (h:∀x,d.value x=e.value x) : op (E:=E) μ d=op μ e := by
  ext1 f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [op_ae μ d f,op_ae μ e f] with x hx hy
  rw [hx,hy,h]

theorem op_one (h:∀x,d.value x=1) : op (E:=E) μ d=1 := by
  ext1 f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [op_ae μ d f] with x hx
  change op μ d f x=f x
  simpa only [h,one_smul] using hx

theorem op_add (e k:Data μ) (h:∀x,k.value x=d.value x+e.value x) :
    op (E:=E) μ k=op μ d+op μ e := by
  ext1 f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [op_ae μ k f,op_ae μ d f,op_ae μ e f,
    Lp.coeFn_add (op μ d f) (op μ e f)] with x hk hd he ha
  change op μ k f x=(op μ d f+op μ e f) x
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at ha
  rw [hk,ha,hd,he,h,add_smul]

theorem op_mul (e k:Data μ) (h:∀x,k.value x=d.value x*e.value x) :
    op (E:=E) μ k=op μ d*op μ e := by
  ext1 f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [op_ae μ k f,op_ae μ d (op μ e f),op_ae μ e f] with x hk hd he
  change op μ k f x=op μ d (op μ e f) x
  rw [hk,hd,he,h,smul_smul]

theorem op_star (e:Data μ) (h:∀x,e.value x=star (d.value x)) :
    op (E:=E) μ e=star (op (E:=E) μ d) := by
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).mpr
  intro f g
  rw [L2.inner_def,L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [op_ae μ e f,op_ae μ d g] with x he hd
  rw [he,hd,inner_smul_left,inner_smul_right,h]
  simp

theorem op_injective (h:∀x,d.value x≠0) : Function.Injective (op (E:=E) μ d) := by
  intro f g he
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [op_ae μ d f,op_ae μ d g] with x hf hg
  apply smul_right_injective E (h x)
  exact hf.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun v:Lp E 2 μ=>v x) he).trans hg)

end F1Fecho.ScalarL2
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2.norm_op
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2.op_mul
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2.op_star
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2.op_injective

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.CanonicalTensorCoordinatesR4
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ScalarL2MultiplierR3
/-! The already constructed boost on the same symmetric sectors becomes
multiplication by a phase of the sum of all rapidity Fourier coordinates.
This proves the unitary-group transport, not yet the unbounded graph identity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates
open F1Rede.BosonicSectors F1Rede.BosonicTwoParticle TGLExt.ImportedSQ
open F1Rede.CanonicalWedge F1Rede.Canonical TGLV350.Regular

def rapiditySum : (n:ℕ)→(data n).Index→ℝ
  | 0 => id
  | n+1 => fun p=>p.2+rapiditySum n p.1

theorem rapiditySum_measurable (n:ℕ) : Measurable (rapiditySum n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_id
  | succ n ih => exact measurable_snd.add (ih.comp measurable_fst)

def boostData (n:ℕ) (s:ℝ) : ScalarL2.Data (data n).measure where
  value x:=characterPhase (2*Real.pi*s) (rapiditySum n x)
  measurable := ((by unfold characterPhase; fun_prop : Continuous (characterPhase (2*Real.pi*s))).measurable.comp
    (rapiditySum_measurable n)).aestronglyMeasurable
  bound:=1
  nonneg:=zero_le_one
  bounded x:=le_of_eq (characterPhase_norm _ _)

def spectralBoost (n:ℕ) (s:ℝ) : Space n→L[ℂ]Space n := ScalarL2.op _ (boostData n s)

theorem spectralBoost_ae (n:ℕ) (s:ℝ) (u:Space n) :
    spectralBoost n s u=ᵐ[(data n).measure]
      fun p=>characterPhase (2*Real.pi*s) (rapiditySum n p)•u p := ScalarL2.op_ae _ _ _

def profile (n:ℕ) (f:H1) : Space n := coordinates n (pureCompleted (n+1) f)

theorem profile_zero (f:H1) : profile 0 f=Phi f := first_pure f

theorem profile_succ_ae (n:ℕ) (f:H1) : profile (n+1) f=ᵐ[(data (n+1)).measure]
    fun p=>CompletedTensor.pure (Phi f p.2,profile n f p.1) :=
  coordinates_succ_ae n f (pureAlgebraic f (n+1))

lemma phase_x_add (s x y:ℝ) : characterPhase s (x+y)=characterPhase s x*characterPhase s y := by
  unfold characterPhase
  rw [←Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

lemma pure_smul_pair {E F:Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] (a b:ℂ) (x:E) (y:F) :
    CompletedTensor.pure (a•x,b•y)=(a*b)•CompletedTensor.pure (x,y) := by
  change (Completion.toComplL : (E⊗[ℂ]F)→L[ℂ]CompletedTensor.CT E F)
    (CompletedTensor.bilinear (a•x) (b•y))=_
  simp only [map_smul,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm b a]
  rfl

theorem profile_boost (n:ℕ) (s:ℝ) (f:H1) :
    profile n (B0 s f)=spectralBoost n s (profile n f) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [profile_zero,profile_zero,canonicalPartialFourier_boost]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [characterMultiplier_ae (2*Real.pi*s) (Phi f),spectralBoost_ae 0 s (Phi f)] with x hx hy
    exact hx.trans hy.symm
  | succ n ih =>
    have hi : profile n (B0 s f)=ᵐ[(data n).measure]
        fun p=>characterPhase (2*Real.pi*s) (rapiditySum n p)•profile n f p := by
      rw [ih]
      exact spectralBoost_ae n s (profile n f)
    have hf : Phi (B0 s f)=ᵐ[volume] fun x=>characterPhase (2*Real.pi*s) x•Phi f x := by
      rw [canonicalPartialFourier_boost]
      exact characterMultiplier_ae _ _
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [profile_succ_ae n (B0 s f),profile_succ_ae n f,
      spectralBoost_ae (n+1) s (profile (n+1) f),
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hi,Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hf]
      with p hl hr hb hi hf
    rw [hl,hb,hr,hi,hf,pure_smul_pair]
    congr 1
    exact (phase_x_add _ _ _).symm

theorem sector_boost (n:ℕ) (s:ℝ) (x:Sector (n+1)) :
    coordinates n (gammaSector (B0 s) (n+1) x : TensorHilbert (n+1))=
      spectralBoost n s (coordinates n (x:TensorHilbert (n+1))) := by
  let L:TensorHilbert (n+1)→L[ℂ]Space n:=(coordinates n).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (tensorGamma (B0 s) (n+1)).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
  let M:TensorHilbert (n+1)→L[ℂ]Space n:=(spectralBoost n s).comp (coordinates n).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hb : algebraicSymmetricSpan (n+1)≤(L-M).ker := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨f,rfl⟩
    change L (pureCompleted (n+1) f)-M (pureCompleted (n+1) f)=0
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    change coordinates n (tensorGamma (B0 s) (n+1) (pureCompleted (n+1) f))=_
    rw [tensorGamma_pure]
    exact profile_boost n s f
  have hx: (x:TensorHilbert (n+1))∈(L-M).ker:=
    (algebraicSymmetricSpan (n+1)).topologicalClosure_minimal hb (L-M).isClosed_ker x.property
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx

end F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates
#print axioms F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates.profile_boost
#print axioms F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates.sector_boost

/-! Concrete scalar multiplication for bounded second quantization on the
unchanged canonical symmetric sectors. Tensor products, not scalar addition,
are transported. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter UniformSpace
namespace F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates
open F1Rede.BosonicSectors TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.CanonicalWedge
open ChatgptAudit.Continuous049

def productWeight (w:ℝ→ℂ) : (n:ℕ)→(data n).Index→ℂ
  | 0 => w
  | n+1 => fun p=>w p.2*productWeight w n p.1

theorem productWeight_measurable (w:ℝ→ℂ) (hw:Measurable w) (n:ℕ) :
    Measurable (productWeight w n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hw
  | succ n ih => exact (hw.comp measurable_snd).mul (ih.comp measurable_fst)

theorem productWeight_bound (w:ℝ→ℂ) (hb:∀x,‖w x‖≤1) (n:ℕ) (p:(data n).Index) :
    ‖productWeight w n p‖≤1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hb p
  | succ n ih =>
    change ‖w p.2*productWeight w n p.1‖≤1
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_one₀ (hb p.2) (norm_nonneg _) (ih p.1)

def productData (w:ℝ→ℂ) (hw:Measurable w) (hb:∀x,‖w x‖≤1) (n:ℕ) :
    ScalarL2.Data (data n).measure where
  value:=productWeight w n
  measurable:=(productWeight_measurable w hw n).aestronglyMeasurable
  bound:=1
  nonneg:=zero_le_one
  bounded:=productWeight_bound w hb n

def productMultiplier (w:ℝ→ℂ) (hw:Measurable w) (hb:∀x,‖w x‖≤1) (n:ℕ) :
    Space n→L[ℂ]Space n := ScalarL2.op _ (productData w hw hb n)

theorem productMultiplier_ae (w:ℝ→ℂ) (hw:Measurable w) (hb:∀x,‖w x‖≤1)
    (n:ℕ) (u:Space n) : productMultiplier w hw hb n u=ᵐ[(data n).measure]
      fun p=>productWeight w n p•u p := ScalarL2.op_ae _ _ _

variable (A:H1→L[ℂ]H1) (w:ℝ→ℂ) (hw:Measurable w) (hb:∀x,‖w x‖≤1)
  (hAw:∀f:H1,Phi (A f)=ᵐ[volume] fun x=>w x•Phi f x)

include hAw in
theorem profile_multiplier (n:ℕ) (f:H1) :
    profile n (A f)=productMultiplier w hw hb n (profile n f) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [profile_zero,profile_zero]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hAw f,productMultiplier_ae w hw hb 0 (Phi f)] with x hx hy
    exact hx.trans hy.symm
  | succ n ih =>
    have hi : profile n (A f)=ᵐ[(data n).measure]
        fun p=>productWeight w n p•profile n f p := by
      rw [ih]
      exact productMultiplier_ae w hw hb n (profile n f)
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [profile_succ_ae n (A f),profile_succ_ae n f,
      productMultiplier_ae w hw hb (n+1) (profile (n+1) f),
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hi,Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae (hAw f)]
      with p hl hr hmul hi hf
    rw [hl,hmul,hr,hi,hf,pure_smul_pair]
    rfl

include hAw in
theorem sector_multiplier (n:ℕ) (x:Sector (n+1)) :
    coordinates n (BoundedGamma.sector A (n+1) x : TensorHilbert (n+1))=
      productMultiplier w hw hb n (coordinates n (x:TensorHilbert (n+1))) := by
  let L:TensorHilbert (n+1)→L[ℂ]Space n:=(coordinates n).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (BoundedGamma.tensor A (n+1))
  let M:TensorHilbert (n+1)→L[ℂ]Space n:=(productMultiplier w hw hb n).comp
    (coordinates n).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hbase : algebraicSymmetricSpan (n+1)≤(L-M).ker := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨f,rfl⟩
    change L (pureCompleted (n+1) f)-M (pureCompleted (n+1) f)=0
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    change coordinates n (BoundedGamma.tensor A (n+1) (pureCompleted (n+1) f))=_
    rw [BoundedGamma.tensor_pure]
    exact profile_multiplier A w hw hb hAw n f
  have hx: (x:TensorHilbert (n+1))∈(L-M).ker:=
    (algebraicSymmetricSpan (n+1)).topologicalClosure_minimal hbase (L-M).isClosed_ker x.property
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx

def weightA (c x:ℝ) : ℂ := spectralWeightA c x
def weightB (c x:ℝ) : ℂ := spectralWeightB c x
lemma weightA_measurable (c:ℝ) : Measurable (weightA c) :=
  Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (spectral_weightA_continuous c).measurable
lemma weightB_measurable (c:ℝ) : Measurable (weightB c) :=
  Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (spectral_weightB_continuous c).measurable
lemma weightA_bound (c x:ℝ) : ‖weightA c x‖≤1 := by
  simpa only [weightA,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (spectral_weightA_pos c x)]
    using spectral_weightA_le_one c x
lemma weightB_bound (c x:ℝ) : ‖weightB c x‖≤1 := by
  simpa only [weightB,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (spectral_weightB_pos c x)]
    using spectral_weightB_le_one c x

theorem sector_WA (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) (x:Sector (n+1)) :
    coordinates n (BoundedGamma.sector (WA c) (n+1) x : TensorHilbert (n+1))=
      productMultiplier (weightA c) (weightA_measurable c) (weightA_bound c) n
        (coordinates n (x:TensorHilbert (n+1))) := by
  apply sector_multiplier
  intro f
  change Phi (pull (F1Rede.Wedge.A c) f)=ᵐ[volume] _
  rw [Phi_pull]
  exact F1Rede.Wedge.A_ae c (Phi f)

theorem sector_WB (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) (x:Sector (n+1)) :
    coordinates n (BoundedGamma.sector (WB c) (n+1) x : TensorHilbert (n+1))=
      productMultiplier (weightB c) (weightB_measurable c) (weightB_bound c) n
        (coordinates n (x:TensorHilbert (n+1))) := by
  apply sector_multiplier
  intro f
  change Phi (pull (F1Rede.Wedge.B c) f)=ᵐ[volume] _
  rw [Phi_pull]
  exact F1Rede.Wedge.B_ae c (Phi f)

end F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates

open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates
open F1Rede.BosonicSectors F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Rede.CanonicalWedge
open F1Fecho.GammaGraph F1Fecho.CanonicalFockPolar F1Fecho.ExponentialLift

def Q (n:ℕ) : F→L[ℂ]Space n :=
  (coordinates n).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    ((symmetricSpace (n+1)).subtypeL.comp (lp.evalCLM ℂ Sectors 2 (n+1)))

lemma Q_apply (n:ℕ) (x:F) : Q n x=coordinates n (x (n+1):TensorHilbert (n+1)) := rfl

def aMultiplier (n:ℕ) : Space n→L[ℂ]Space n :=
  productMultiplier (weightA rootParameter) (weightA_measurable rootParameter)
    (weightA_bound rootParameter) n

def bMultiplier (n:ℕ) : Space n→L[ℂ]Space n :=
  productMultiplier (weightB rootParameter) (weightB_measurable rootParameter)
    (weightB_bound rootParameter) n

lemma Q_GA (n:ℕ) (x:F) : Q n (GA x)=aMultiplier n (Q n x) :=
  sector_WA rootParameter n (x (n+1))
lemma Q_GB (n:ℕ) (x:F) : Q n (GB x)=bMultiplier n (Q n x) :=
  sector_WB rootParameter n (x (n+1))

theorem Q_resolvent_equation (n:ℕ) (x:F) :
    aMultiplier n (aMultiplier n (Q n (modularR x)))+
      bMultiplier n (bMultiplier n (Q n (modularR x)))=
      aMultiplier n (aMultiplier n (Q n x)) := by
  have h:=congrArg (fun A:F→L[ℂ]F=>Q n (A x))
    (BoundedPairResolvent.equation canonicalLift canonicalLift_selfadjoint GA GB
      GA_selfadjoint GB_selfadjoint graph_parameters GAB_commute)
  change Q n (GA (GA (modularR x))+GB (GB (modularR x)))=Q n (GA (GA x)) at h
  simpa only [map_add,Q_GA,Q_GB] using h

theorem Q_resolvent_equation_ae (n:ℕ) (x:F) :
    (fun p=>(productWeight (weightA rootParameter) n p*productWeight (weightA rootParameter) n p+
      productWeight (weightB rootParameter) n p*productWeight (weightB rootParameter) n p)•
        Q n (modularR x) p)=ᵐ[(data n).measure]
      fun p=>(productWeight (weightA rootParameter) n p*productWeight (weightA rootParameter) n p)•
        Q n x p := by
  have h:=Q_resolvent_equation n x
  let y:=Q n (modularR x)
  let z:=Q n x
  have ha (v:Space n):aMultiplier n v=ᵐ[(data n).measure]
      fun p=>productWeight (weightA rootParameter) n p•v p := productMultiplier_ae _ _ _ _ _
  have hb (v:Space n):bMultiplier n v=ᵐ[(data n).measure]
      fun p=>productWeight (weightB rootParameter) n p•v p := productMultiplier_ae _ _ _ _ _
  filter_upwards [ha y,ha (aMultiplier n y),hb y,hb (bMultiplier n y),
    ha z,ha (aMultiplier n z),Lp.coeFn_add (aMultiplier n (aMultiplier n y))
      (bMultiplier n (bMultiplier n y))] with p ha1 ha2 hb1 hb2 hz1 hz2 hs
  have he:=congrArg (fun v:Space n=>v p) h
  change (aMultiplier n (aMultiplier n y)+bMultiplier n (bMultiplier n y)) p=
    aMultiplier n (aMultiplier n z) p at he
  rw [hs,Pi.add_apply,ha2,hb2,hz2,ha1,hb1,hz1] at he
  simpa only [smul_smul,add_smul] using he

end F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates
#print axioms F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates.Q_resolvent_equation
#print axioms F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates.Q_resolvent_equation_ae

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ScalarL2MultiplierR3
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Unique
/-! The compact continuous functional calculus acts pointwise on a scalar
multiplier over any measure space. This specializes the earlier regular-line
calculus without imposing a new spectral representation as a hypothesis. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1400000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace F1Fecho.ScalarL2
variable {X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable (μ : Measure X) (g:X→unitInterval) (hg:AEStronglyMeasurable g μ)

def compactData (f:C(unitInterval,ℂ)) : Data μ where
  value x := f (g x)
  measurable := f.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hg
  bound := ‖f‖
  nonneg := norm_nonneg _
  bounded x := f.norm_coe_le_norm (g x)

def compactRepresentation : C(unitInterval,ℂ)→⋆ₐ[ℂ](Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp E 2 μ) where
  toFun f := op μ (compactData μ g hg f)
  map_one' := op_one μ _ (fun x=>rfl)
  map_zero' := by
    ext1 u
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [op_ae μ (compactData μ g hg 0) u,Lp.coeFn_zero (E:=E) (p:=2) (μ:=μ)] with x hx hz
    change op μ (compactData μ g hg 0) u x=(0:Lp E 2 μ) x
    simpa only [compactData,ContinuousMap.zero_apply,zero_smul,hz,Pi.zero_apply] using hx
  map_add' f k := op_add μ _ _ _ (fun x=>rfl)
  map_mul' f k := op_mul μ _ _ _ (fun x=>rfl)
  commutes' c := by
    ext1 u
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [op_ae μ (compactData μ g hg (algebraMap ℂ C(unitInterval,ℂ) c)) u,
      Lp.coeFn_smul c u] with x hx hy
    change op μ (compactData μ g hg (algebraMap ℂ C(unitInterval,ℂ) c)) u x=(c•u) x
    rw [hx,hy]
    rfl
  map_star' f := op_star μ _ _ (fun x=>rfl)

theorem compactRepresentation_ae (f:C(unitInterval,ℂ)) (u:Lp E 2 μ) :
    compactRepresentation μ g hg f u =ᵐ[μ] fun x=>f (g x)•u x := op_ae μ _ u

def coordinate : C(unitInterval,ℂ) := ⟨fun x=>((x:ℝ):ℂ),by fun_prop⟩
def R : Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp E 2 μ := compactRepresentation μ g hg coordinate

theorem cfc_ae (f:ℂ→ℂ) (hf:Continuous f) (u:Lp E 2 μ) :
    cfc f (R (E:=E) μ g hg) u =ᵐ[μ] fun x=>f ((g x:ℝ):ℂ)•u x := by
  let F:=compactRepresentation (E:=E) μ g hg
  have hc : Continuous F := (F.toLinearMap.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro k
    change ‖op (E:=E) μ (compactData μ g hg k)‖≤1*‖k‖
    simpa only [one_mul,compactData] using norm_op (E:=E) μ (compactData μ g hg k))).continuous
  have he:=F.map_cfc f coordinate hf.continuousOn hc
  change F (cfc f coordinate)=cfc f (R (E:=E) μ g hg) at he
  rw [←he]
  have hv (z:unitInterval) : (cfc f coordinate) z=f ((z:ℝ):ℂ) := by
    have hv:=(ContinuousMap.evalStarAlgHom ℂ ℂ z).map_cfc f coordinate hf.continuousOn
    change (cfc f coordinate) z=cfc f ((z:ℝ):ℂ) at hv
    exact hv.trans (by simpa using cfc_algebraMap (A:=ℂ) ((z:ℝ):ℂ) f)
  filter_upwards [compactRepresentation_ae μ g hg (cfc f coordinate) u] with x hx
  rw [hx,hv]

end F1Fecho.ScalarL2
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2.compactRepresentation
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2.cfc_ae
