import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ScalarL2CalculusR4
import TGLExt.V351RegularImaginaryPowers
/-! Imaginary powers of a scalar resolvent multiplier for an arbitrary
measurable real spectral coordinate. Endpoint singularities are removed by
the existing damping/dense-range construction; no logarithm is applied by
continuous functional calculus directly at the endpoints. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace F1Fecho.ScalarL2Spectral
open F1Fecho.ScalarL2 ChatgptAudit TGLV350.Regular
variable {X E : Type} [MeasurableSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable (μ : Measure X) (h:X→ℝ) (hh:Measurable h)

def weight (x:X) : unitInterval :=
  ⟨Real.sigmoid (-h x),Real.sigmoid_nonneg _,Real.sigmoid_le_one _⟩
include hh in
lemma weight_measurable : Measurable (weight h) :=
  (continuous_sigmoid.measurable.comp hh.neg).subtype_mk

def R : Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp E 2 μ :=
  ScalarL2.R μ (weight h) (weight_measurable h hh).aestronglyMeasurable

theorem R_nonneg : 0≤R (E:=E) μ h hh := by
  let F:=compactRepresentation (E:=E) μ (weight h)
    (weight_measurable h hh).aestronglyMeasurable
  let q:C(unitInterval,ℂ):=⟨fun x=>(Real.sqrt (x:ℝ):ℂ),by fun_prop⟩
  have he : star q*q=coordinate := by
    ext x
    change star (Real.sqrt (x:ℝ):ℂ)*(Real.sqrt (x:ℝ):ℂ)=((x:ℝ):ℂ)
    simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_ofReal]
    norm_cast
    exact Real.mul_self_sqrt x.2.1
  have hmap:=congrArg F he
  rw [map_mul,map_star] at hmap
  change star (F q)*F q=R (E:=E) μ h hh at hmap
  rw [←hmap]
  exact star_mul_self_nonneg _

theorem R_le_one : R (E:=E) μ h hh≤1 := by
  apply sub_nonneg.mp
  let F:=compactRepresentation (E:=E) μ (weight h)
    (weight_measurable h hh).aestronglyMeasurable
  let q:C(unitInterval,ℂ):=⟨fun x=>(Real.sqrt (1-(x:ℝ)):ℂ),by fun_prop⟩
  have he : star q*q=1-coordinate := by
    ext x
    change star (Real.sqrt (1-(x:ℝ)):ℂ)*(Real.sqrt (1-(x:ℝ)):ℂ)=1-((x:ℝ):ℂ)
    simp only [Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_ofReal]
    norm_cast
    exact Real.mul_self_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr x.2.2)
  have hmap:=congrArg F he
  rw [map_mul,map_star,map_sub,map_one] at hmap
  change star (F q)*F q=1-R (E:=E) μ h hh at hmap
  rw [←hmap]
  exact star_mul_self_nonneg _

theorem R_injective : Function.Injective (R (E:=E) μ h hh) := by
  apply op_injective
  intro x
  change (Real.sigmoid (-h x):ℂ)≠0
  exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (Real.sigmoid_pos (-h x)))

theorem complement_injective : Function.Injective (1-R (E:=E) μ h hh : Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp E 2 μ) := by
  let F:=compactRepresentation (E:=E) μ (weight h)
    (weight_measurable h hh).aestronglyMeasurable
  have he : 1-R (E:=E) μ h hh=F (1-coordinate) := by
    rw [map_sub,map_one]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  apply op_injective
  intro x
  change (1:ℂ)-(Real.sigmoid (-h x):ℂ)≠0
  exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (Real.sigmoid_lt_one (-h x))))

def phaseData (t:ℝ) : Data μ where
  value x := modularPhase t (h x)
  measurable := (by unfold modularPhase; fun_prop : Continuous (modularPhase t)).measurable.comp hh |>.aestronglyMeasurable
  bound := 1
  nonneg := zero_le_one
  bounded x := le_of_eq (modularPhase_norm t (h x))

def phase (t:ℝ) : Lp E 2 μ→L[ℂ]Lp E 2 μ := op μ (phaseData μ h hh t)

theorem imaginaryPower_eq_phase (t:ℝ) (u:Lp E 2 μ) :
    resolventImaginaryPower (R (E:=E) μ h hh) (R_nonneg μ h hh) (R_le_one μ h hh)
      (R_injective μ h hh) (complement_injective μ h hh) t u=phase μ h hh t u := by
  refine (resolventDampingOperator_denseRange (R (E:=E) μ h hh) (R_nonneg μ h hh)
    (R_le_one μ h hh) (R_injective μ h hh) (complement_injective μ h hh)).induction
      ?_ (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) u
  rintro _ ⟨y,rfl⟩
  rw [resolventImaginaryPower_damping]
  have hd:=cfc_ae μ (weight h) (weight_measurable h hh).aestronglyMeasurable
    (fun z:ℂ=>(resolventDamping z.re:ℂ)) (by unfold resolventDamping; fun_prop) y
  change cfc (fun z:ℂ=>(resolventDamping z.re:ℂ)) (R (E:=E) μ h hh) y=ᵐ[μ] _ at hd
  rw [resolventDampingOperator_cfc _ (R_nonneg (E:=E) μ h hh).isSelfAdjoint] at hd
  have hp:=cfc_ae μ (weight h) (weight_measurable h hh).aestronglyMeasurable
    (fun z:ℂ=>resolventPhaseFunction t z.re)
    ((resolventPhaseFunction_continuous t).comp Complex.continuous_re) y
  change cfc (fun z:ℂ=>resolventPhaseFunction t z.re) (R (E:=E) μ h hh) y=ᵐ[μ] _ at hp
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hp,hd,op_ae μ (phaseData μ h hh t)
    (resolventDampingOperator (R (E:=E) μ h hh) y)] with x hp hd hx
  change resolventPhaseOperator (R (E:=E) μ h hh) t y x=
    op μ (phaseData μ h hh t) (resolventDampingOperator (R (E:=E) μ h hh) y) x
  dsimp only [resolventPhaseOperator]
  rw [hp,hx,hd]
  simp only [weight,Complex.ofReal_re,phaseData,smul_smul,
    resolventPhaseFunction_sigmoid,neg_neg,mul_comm]

end F1Fecho.ScalarL2Spectral
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2Spectral.R_nonneg
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2Spectral.complement_injective
#print axioms F1Fecho.ScalarL2Spectral.imaginaryPower_eq_phase

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.CanonicalTensorMultiplierR3
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ScalarL2ImaginaryR5
/-! Scalar identity for the actual second-quantized resolvent; no false
second-quantized square-sum normalization is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
namespace F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates
open ChatgptAudit.Continuous049

def realProduct (w:ℝ→ℝ) : (n:ℕ)→(data n).Index→ℝ
  | 0 => w
  | n+1 => fun p=>w p.2*realProduct w n p.1

lemma realProduct_pos (w:ℝ→ℝ) (hw:∀x,0<w x) (n:ℕ) (p:(data n).Index) :
    0<realProduct w n p := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hw p
  | succ n ih => exact mul_pos (hw p.2) (ih p.1)

lemma productWeight_ofReal (w:ℝ→ℝ) (n:ℕ) (p:(data n).Index) :
    productWeight (fun x=>(w x:ℂ)) n p=(realProduct w n p:ℂ) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [productWeight,realProduct,ih,Complex.ofReal_mul]

lemma product_ratio (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) (p:(data n).Index) :
    realProduct (spectralWeightB c) n p=Real.exp (-c*rapiditySum n p)*
      realProduct (spectralWeightA c) n p := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact spectral_weight_ratio c p
  | succ n ih =>
    change spectralWeightB c p.2*realProduct (spectralWeightB c) n p.1=_
    rw [spectral_weight_ratio,ih]
    change _=Real.exp (-c*(p.2+rapiditySum n p.1))*
      (spectralWeightA c p.2*realProduct (spectralWeightA c) n p.1)
    rw [mul_add,Real.exp_add]
    ring

def sumEnergy (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) (p:(data n).Index) : ℝ := -2*c*rapiditySum n p
lemma sumEnergy_measurable (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) : Measurable (sumEnergy c n) :=
  (rapiditySum_measurable n).const_mul _

def tensorR (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) : Space n→L[ℂ]Space n :=
  ScalarL2Spectral.R (data n).measure (sumEnergy c n) (sumEnergy_measurable c n)

lemma tensorR_ae (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) (x:Space n) :
    tensorR c n x=ᵐ[(data n).measure] fun p=>(Real.sigmoid (-sumEnergy c n p):ℂ)•x p :=
  ScalarL2.op_ae _ _ _

lemma scalar_resolvent_identity (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) (p:(data n).Index) :
    (productWeight (weightA c) n p*productWeight (weightA c) n p+
      productWeight (weightB c) n p*productWeight (weightB c) n p)*
      (Real.sigmoid (-sumEnergy c n p):ℂ)=
      productWeight (weightA c) n p*productWeight (weightA c) n p := by
  have hA : productWeight (weightA c) n p=(realProduct (spectralWeightA c) n p:ℂ) :=
    productWeight_ofReal (spectralWeightA c) n p
  have hB : productWeight (weightB c) n p=(realProduct (spectralWeightB c) n p:ℂ) :=
    productWeight_ofReal (spectralWeightB c) n p
  rw [hA,hB]
  norm_cast
  rw [product_ratio]
  unfold sumEnergy Real.sigmoid
  have he : Real.exp (-(c*rapiditySum n p))^2=Real.exp (-(c*rapiditySum n p*2)) := by
    rw [pow_two,←Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  field_simp
  rw [he]

lemma scalar_coefficient_nonzero (c:ℝ) (n:ℕ) (p:(data n).Index) :
    productWeight (weightA c) n p*productWeight (weightA c) n p+
      productWeight (weightB c) n p*productWeight (weightB c) n p≠0 := by
  have hA : productWeight (weightA c) n p=(realProduct (spectralWeightA c) n p:ℂ) :=
    productWeight_ofReal (spectralWeightA c) n p
  have hB : productWeight (weightB c) n p=(realProduct (spectralWeightB c) n p:ℂ) :=
    productWeight_ofReal (spectralWeightB c) n p
  rw [hA,hB]
  norm_cast
  have ha:=realProduct_pos (spectralWeightA c) (spectral_weightA_pos c) n p
  have hb:=realProduct_pos (spectralWeightB c) (spectral_weightB_pos c) n p
  positivity

end F1Fecho.TensorCoordinates

theorem Q_resolvent (n:ℕ) (x:F) : Q n (modularR x)=tensorR rootParameter n (Q n x) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Q_resolvent_equation_ae n x,tensorR_ae rootParameter n (Q n x)] with p hp hr
  rw [hr]
  apply smul_right_injective (data n).Fiber (scalar_coefficient_nonzero rootParameter n p)
  dsimp only
  rw [smul_smul,scalar_resolvent_identity]
  exact hp

theorem Q_resolvent_intertwine (n:ℕ) :
    (Q n).comp modularR=(tensorR rootParameter n).comp (Q n) := by
  ext1 x
  exact Q_resolvent n x

lemma phase_eq_boost (n:ℕ) (t:ℝ) :
    ScalarL2Spectral.phase (data n).measure (sumEnergy rootParameter n)
      (sumEnergy_measurable rootParameter n) t=spectralBoost n (-(2*Real.pi*t)) := by
  apply ScalarL2.op_eq
  intro p
  change modularPhase t (sumEnergy rootParameter n p)=
    characterPhase (2*Real.pi*(-(2*Real.pi*t))) (rapiditySum n p)
  unfold modularPhase characterPhase sumEnergy rootParameter
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

theorem Q_modularFlow (n:ℕ) (t:ℝ) (x:F) :
    Q n (actualModularFlow t x)=spectralBoost n (-(2*Real.pi*t)) (Q n x) := by
  have h:=ContinuousIntertwining.imaginaryPower_intertwine modularR (tensorR rootParameter n)
    (Q n) (Q_resolvent_intertwine n) modularR_nonneg modularR_le_one
    modularR_injective modularR_complement_injective
    (ScalarL2Spectral.R_nonneg _ _ _) (ScalarL2Spectral.R_le_one _ _ _)
    (ScalarL2Spectral.R_injective _ _ _) (ScalarL2Spectral.complement_injective _ _ _) t x
  change Q n (actualModularFlow t x)=_ at h
  calc
    Q n (actualModularFlow t x) = _ := h
    _ = ScalarL2Spectral.phase (data n).measure (sumEnergy rootParameter n)
        (sumEnergy_measurable rootParameter n) t (Q n x) :=
      ScalarL2Spectral.imaginaryPower_eq_phase _ _ _ t (Q n x)
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun L:Space n→L[ℂ]Space n=>L (Q n x)) (phase_eq_boost n t)

theorem positive_component_modularFlow (n:ℕ) (t:ℝ) (x:F) :
    (actualModularFlow t x) (n+1)=
      (F1Rede.BosonicFock.gamma (TGLExt.ImportedSQ.B0 (-(2*Real.pi*t))) x) (n+1) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (coordinates n).injective
  change Q n (actualModularFlow t x)=

      (n+1) (x (n+1)) : F1Rede.BosonicSectors.TensorHilbert (n+1))
  rw [Q_modularFlow,sector_boost]

open UniformSpace
namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalFockBW

theorem tensorGamma_zero (u:H1≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H1) (x:TensorHilbert 0) : tensorGamma u 0 x=x := by
  refine Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq (tensorGamma u 0).continuous continuous_id) ?_
  intro z
  rw [tensorGamma_coe]
  rfl

theorem gamma_zero_component (u:H1≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]H1) (x:F) : gamma u x 0=x 0 := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact tensorGamma_zero u (x 0)

theorem actualModularFlow_eq_gamma_apply (t:ℝ) (x:F) :
    actualModularFlow t x=gamma (B0 (-(2*Real.pi*t))) x := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rw [modularFlow_zero_component,gamma_zero_component]
  | succ n => exact TensorCoordinates.positive_component_modularFlow n t x

import TGLExt.V350ScalarGNSLinear
/-! Generic construction of the scalar dual-weight GNS orbit and completion.
Its algebra/vector context requires faithfulness of the original weight.
The concrete Fock instance supplies that property by its already proved lemma;
no GNS equality, injectivity, or completion result is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS
open TGLV350.Regular MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
/-- Algebra/vector inputs. Faithfulness is an already proved property in the
concrete Fock instance, not a conclusion about GNS inserted as a field. -/
structure Context (H : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] where
  algebra : VonNeumannAlgebra (RegularHilbert H)
  vacuum : RegularHilbert H
  faithful : ∀ (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H), A ∈ algebra → 0 ≤ A →
    (dualQuadraticIntegral A vacuum = 0 ↔ A = 0)
variable (D : Context H)
def finiteIdeal : Submodule ℂ D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra where
  carrier := {A | HasFiniteDualSquare A.val}
  zero_mem' := HasFiniteDualSquare.zero
  add_mem' := fun hA hB => HasFiniteDualSquare.add _ _ hA hB
  smul_mem' := fun c _ hA => HasFiniteDualSquare.smul c _ hA

theorem scalar_finite (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H)
    (hA : HasFiniteDualSquare A) : dualQuadraticIntegral (star A*A) D.vacuum < ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hA
  exact (hC D.vacuum).trans_lt
    (ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.coe_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)

/-- Square integrability of the actual dual orbit follows from the finite
weight, with the fixed positive Haar factor removed explicitly. -/
theorem scalarOrbit_memLp 
    (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H)
    (hA : HasFiniteDualSquare A) :
    MemLp (fun s : ℝ => dualAmbient s A D.vacuum) 2 := by
  have hq := scalar_finite D A hA
  simp only [dualQuadraticIntegral, dualQuadraticIntegrand_star_mul] at hq
  have hn : ENNReal.ofReal dualHaarFactor ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr dualHaarFactor_pos)
  have hi : (∫⁻ s : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖dualAmbient s A D.vacuum‖ ^ 2)) < ⊤ := by
    by_contra h
    have ht := top_unique (not_lt.mp h)
    rw [ht] at hq
    rw [ENNReal.mul_top hn] at hq
    exact (lt_irrefl _) hq
  refine ⟨(dualAmbient_strongly_continuous A D.vacuum).aestronglyMeasurable,?_⟩
  rw [eLpNorm_lt_top_iff_lintegral_rpow_enorm_lt_top (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  have he (s : ℝ) : ENNReal.ofReal (‖dualAmbient s A D.vacuum‖ ^ 2) =
      (‖dualAmbient s A D.vacuum‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm, enorm_eq_nnnorm]
  simp_rw [he] at hi
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ENNReal.rpow_two, enorm_eq_nnnorm, pow_two] using hi

/-- An orbit vector in a concrete Hilbert space. Completion of its range,
the left representation and the Tomita operator are separate constructions. -/
def scalarGNSOrbit  (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H) :=
  (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ) •
    (scalarOrbit_memLp D A.val.val A.property).toLp
      (fun s : ℝ => dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum)

theorem scalarGNSOrbit_norm_sq  (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (‖scalarGNSOrbit D A‖ ^ 2) =
      dualQuadraticIntegral (star A.val.val * A.val.val) D.vacuum := by
  have hm := scalarOrbit_memLp D A.val.val A.property
  have hi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm.1).mp hm
  have hs : ‖scalarGNSOrbit D A‖ ^ 2 = dualHaarFactor *
      ∫ s : ℝ, ‖dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum‖ ^ 2 := by
    unfold scalarGNSOrbit
    rw [norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt dualHaarFactor_pos.le,
      ← TGLV350.Fourier.integral_norm_sq_eq_L2 _ hm]
  rw [hs, ENNReal.ofReal_mul dualHaarFactor_pos.le]
  simp only [dualQuadraticIntegral, dualQuadraticIntegrand_star_mul]
  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => sq_nonneg _))]

theorem scalarGNSOrbit_ae  (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    (scalarGNSOrbit D A : ℝ → RegularHilbert H) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun s => (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ) • dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum := by
  let hm := scalarOrbit_memLp D A.val.val A.property
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ)
    (hm.toLp (fun s : ℝ => dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum)),hm.coeFn_toLp]
    with s h1 h2
  change ((Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ) • hm.toLp _) s = _
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at h1
  rw [h1,h2]

theorem scalarGNSOrbit_add  (A B : finiteIdeal D) :
    scalarGNSOrbit D (A+B) = scalarGNSOrbit D A + scalarGNSOrbit D B := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [scalarGNSOrbit_ae D (A+B),scalarGNSOrbit_ae D A,
    scalarGNSOrbit_ae D B,Lp.coeFn_add (scalarGNSOrbit D A) (scalarGNSOrbit D B)]
    with s h1 h2 h3 h4
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at h4
  rw [h1,h4,h2,h3]
  change (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ) • dualAmbient s (A.val.val+B.val.val) D.vacuum = _
  rw [dualAmbient_add_apply]
  exact _root_.smul_add (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ)
    (dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum) (dualAmbient s B.val.val D.vacuum)

theorem scalarGNSOrbit_smul  (c : ℂ) (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    scalarGNSOrbit D (c • A) = c • scalarGNSOrbit D A := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [scalarGNSOrbit_ae D (c • A),scalarGNSOrbit_ae D A,
    Lp.coeFn_smul c (scalarGNSOrbit D A)] with s h1 h2 h3
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at h3
  rw [h1,h3,h2]
  change (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ) • dualAmbient s (c • A.val.val) D.vacuum = _
  rw [map_smul]
  change (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ) • (c • dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum) = _
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

def scalarGNSLinear  :
    (finiteIdeal D) →ₗ[ℂ] RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H) where
  toFun := scalarGNSOrbit D
  map_add' := scalarGNSOrbit_add D
  map_smul' := scalarGNSOrbit_smul D

theorem scalarGNSOrbit_zero_iff  (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    scalarGNSOrbit D A = 0 ↔ A = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hq : dualQuadraticIntegral (star A.val.val * A.val.val) D.vacuum = 0 := by
      rw [← scalarGNSOrbit_norm_sq D,h]
      simp only [norm_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0),ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
    have hm := D.algebra.mul_mem
      (D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra.star_mem' A.val.property) A.val.property
    have hz := (D.faithful _ hm (star_mul_self_nonneg A.val.val)).mp hq
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (CStarRing.star_mul_self_eq_zero_iff A.val.val).mp hz
  · rintro rfl
    exact (scalarGNSLinear D).map_zero

theorem scalarGNSLinear_injective  :
    Function.Injective (scalarGNSLinear D) := by
  intro A B h
  have hz : scalarGNSLinear D (A-B) = 0 := by rw [map_sub,h,sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((scalarGNSOrbit_zero_iff D (A-B)).mp hz)


def GNSSubspace : Submodule ℂ (RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H)) :=
  (scalarGNSLinear D).range.topologicalClosure
abbrev GNSHilbert := GNSSubspace D
instance gnsCompleteSpace : CompleteSpace (GNSHilbert D) :=
  Submodule.topologicalClosure.completeSpace (scalarGNSLinear D).range

def GNSEmbedding : (finiteIdeal D) →ₗ[ℂ] GNSHilbert D :=
  (scalarGNSLinear D).codRestrict (GNSSubspace D)
    (fun A => (scalarGNSLinear D).range.le_topologicalClosure ⟨A,rfl⟩)

theorem GNSEmbedding_injective : Function.Injective (GNSEmbedding D) := by
  intro A B h
  exact scalarGNSLinear_injective D (congrArg Subtype.val h)


end F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS

#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS.scalar_finite

namespace F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNSAction
open TGLV350.Regular MeasureTheory F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS

variable (D : Context H)

def scalarGNSLeftProduct 
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    finiteIdeal D :=
  ⟨B * A.val,HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul B.val A.val.val A.property⟩

def scalarGNSAmbientAction 
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) :
    RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H) →L[ℂ]
      RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H) :=
  operatorFieldLift (dualIntegralFamily B.val)

theorem scalarGNSAmbientAction_norm_le 
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) :
    ‖scalarGNSAmbientAction D B‖ ≤ ‖B.val‖ :=
  operatorFieldLift_norm_le (dualIntegralFamily B.val)

    scalarGNSAmbientAction D B (scalarGNSOrbit D A) =

  filter_upwards [operatorFieldLift_ae (dualIntegralFamily B.val) (scalarGNSOrbit D A),
    scalarGNSOrbit_ae D A,scalarGNSOrbit_ae D (scalarGNSLeftProduct D B A)]
    with s h1 h2 h3
  change operatorFieldLift (dualIntegralFamily B.val) (scalarGNSOrbit D A) s = _
  rw [h1,h3]
  change dualAmbient s B.val (scalarGNSOrbit D A s) = _
  rw [h2]
  change dualAmbient s B.val ((↑(Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor) : ℂ) •
    dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum) =

theorem scalarGNSAmbientAction_preserves 
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) :
    ∀ v ∈ GNSSubspace D, scalarGNSAmbientAction D B v ∈ GNSSubspace D := by
  have h : Set.MapsTo (scalarGNSAmbientAction D B)
      ((scalarGNSLinear D).range : Set _) ((scalarGNSLinear D).range : Set _) := by
    rintro v ⟨A,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨scalarGNSLeftProduct D B A, (scalarGNSAmbientAction_intertwines D B A).symm⟩
  exact h.closure (scalarGNSAmbientAction D B).continuous

def scalarGNSAction  (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) :
    GNSHilbert D →L[ℂ] GNSHilbert D :=
  (scalarGNSAmbientAction D B).restrict (scalarGNSAmbientAction_preserves D B)

theorem scalarGNSAction_apply 
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) (v : GNSHilbert D) :
    (scalarGNSAction D B v).val = scalarGNSAmbientAction D B v.val := rfl

theorem scalarGNSAction_norm_le 
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) : ‖scalarGNSAction D B‖ ≤ ‖B.val‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
  intro v
  exact (scalarGNSAmbientAction D B).le_of_opNorm_le
    (scalarGNSAmbientAction_norm_le D B) v.val

theorem scalarGNSAction_intertwines 
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    scalarGNSAction D B (GNSEmbedding D A) =
      GNSEmbedding D (scalarGNSLeftProduct D B A) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact scalarGNSAmbientAction_intertwines D B A


end F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNSAction

  let f := scalarGNSLinear D

  have he : GNSEmbedding D (scalarGNSLeftProduct D B A) = GNSEmbedding D 0 :=

    RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H) :=

    (fun s => (gaussianProfile_pos s).le) gaussianProfile_le_one).comp
      (GNSSubspace D).subtypeL

theorem scalarGaussianGNSMap_norm_le (D : Context H) (v : GNSHilbert D) :
    ‖scalarGaussianGNSMap D v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ :=
  realScalarMultiplier_norm_le gaussianProfile gaussianProfile_continuous
    (fun s => (gaussianProfile_pos s).le) gaussianProfile_le_one v.val

    Function.Injective (scalarGaussianGNSMap D) := by
  intro v w h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact realScalarMultiplier_injective gaussianProfile gaussianProfile_continuous
    (fun s => (gaussianProfile_pos s).le) gaussianProfile_le_one gaussianProfile_pos h

      dualOrbitRepresentation B.val (scalarGaussianGNSMap D v) := by
  exact congrArg (fun T => T v.val)
    (realScalarMultiplier_commutes_field gaussianProfile gaussianProfile_continuous
      (fun s => (gaussianProfile_pos s).le) gaussianProfile_le_one (dualIntegralFamily B.val))

    scalarGaussianGNSMap D (GNSEmbedding D A) =
      dualOrbitRepresentation A.val.val (scalarGaussianVacuum D) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [realScalarMultiplier_ae gaussianProfile gaussianProfile_continuous
    (fun s => (gaussianProfile_pos s).le) gaussianProfile_le_one (scalarGNSOrbit D A),
    scalarGNSOrbit_ae D A,scalarGaussianVacuum_ae D,
    operatorFieldLift_ae (dualIntegralFamily A.val.val) (scalarGaussianVacuum D)]
    with s h1 h2 h3 h4
  change realScalarMultiplier gaussianProfile gaussianProfile_continuous
    (fun s => (gaussianProfile_pos s).le) gaussianProfile_le_one (scalarGNSOrbit D A) s =
    operatorFieldLift (dualIntegralFamily A.val.val) (scalarGaussianVacuum D) s
  rw [h1,h2,h4,h3]
  change (gaussianProfile s : ℂ) •
    ((Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℂ) • dualAmbient s A.val.val D.vacuum) =
    dualAmbient s A.val.val ((gaussianProfile s : ℂ) •

  rw [map_smul,map_smul]

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.RegularScalarGNSR3
import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.NonUnitalSubalgebra
/-! The initial involutive scalar-weight graph, on the actual finite-square
star domain. Density and closure are distinct conclusions, not fields. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.RegularScalarTomitaGraph
open TGLV350.Regular F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (D : Context H)

def finiteStarCore : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra where
  carrier := {A | HasFiniteDualSquare A.val ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star A.val)}
  zero_mem' := by constructor <;> simpa using (HasFiniteDualSquare.zero (H := H))
  add_mem' := by
    intro A B hA hB
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (A.val+B.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (A.val+B.val))
    exact ⟨HasFiniteDualSquare.add _ _ hA.1 hB.1,
      by simpa only [star_add] using HasFiniteDualSquare.add _ _ hA.2 hB.2⟩
  mul_mem' := by
    intro A B hA hB
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (A.val*B.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (A.val*B.val))
    exact ⟨HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul _ _ hB.1,
      by simpa only [star_mul] using HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul (star B.val) (star A.val) hA.2⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c A hA
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (c • A.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (c • A.val))
    exact ⟨HasFiniteDualSquare.smul c _ hA.1,
      by simpa only [star_smul] using HasFiniteDualSquare.smul (star c) _ hA.2⟩
  star_mem' := by
    intro A hA
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (star A.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (star A.val))
    exact ⟨hA.2,by simpa only [star_star] using hA.1⟩

def scalarGNSStarEmbedding (A : finiteStarCore D) : GNSHilbert D :=
  GNSEmbedding D ⟨A.val,A.property.1⟩

theorem scalarGNSStarEmbedding_injective : Function.Injective (scalarGNSStarEmbedding D) := by
  intro A B h
  have he := GNSEmbedding_injective D h
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun a : finiteIdeal D => a.val) he)

def scalarTomitaGraph : Set (GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D) :=
  Set.range (fun A : finiteStarCore D =>
    (scalarGNSStarEmbedding D A, scalarGNSStarEmbedding D (star A)))

theorem scalarTomitaGraph_single_valued (x y z : GNSHilbert D)
    (hy : (x,y) ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D) (hz : (x,z) ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D) : y=z := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := hz
  have hab : A=B := scalarGNSStarEmbedding_injective D
    ((congrArg Prod.fst hA).trans (congrArg Prod.fst hB).symm)
  exact (congrArg Prod.snd hA).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun C : finiteStarCore D => scalarGNSStarEmbedding D (star C)) hab).trans
      (congrArg Prod.snd hB))

theorem scalarTomitaGraph_swap (p : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D)
    (hp : p ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D) : p.swap ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D := by
  obtain ⟨A,rfl⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨star A,by simp only [star_star,Prod.swap_prod_mk]⟩

end F1Fecho.RegularScalarTomitaGraph

#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarTomitaGraph.scalarGNSStarEmbedding_injective

#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarTomitaGraph.scalarTomitaGraph_single_valued
#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarTomitaGraph.scalarTomitaGraph_swap

theorem scalarGaussianImage_separating (D : Context H)
    (B : RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H) →L[ℂ]
      RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert H))
    (hB : B ∈ dualOrbitVonNeumann D.algebra)
    (hz : B (scalarGaussianVacuum D) = 0) : B = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩ := (mem_dualOrbitVonNeumann_iff D.algebra B).mp hB
  rw [scalarGaussianVacuum_separating D A hA hz,map_zero]

theorem scalarGaussian_maps_graph (D : Context H) :
    Set.MapsTo (Prod.map (scalarGaussianGNSMap D) (scalarGaussianGNSMap D))
      (scalarTomitaGraph D)
      (vectorTomitaGraph (dualOrbitVonNeumann D.algebra) (scalarGaussianVacuum D)) := by
  rintro p ⟨A,rfl⟩
  refine ⟨dualOrbitRepresentation A.val.val,
    (mem_dualOrbitVonNeumann_iff D.algebra _).mpr ⟨A.val.val,A.val.property,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact scalarGaussianGNSMap_embedding D ⟨A.val,A.property.1⟩
  · change scalarGaussianGNSMap D
      (GNSEmbedding D ⟨(star A).val,(star A).property.1⟩) = _
    rw [scalarGaussianGNSMap_embedding]
    change dualOrbitRepresentation (star A.val.val) (scalarGaussianVacuum D) =
      (star (dualOrbitRepresentation A.val.val)) (scalarGaussianVacuum D)
    rw [map_star]

theorem scalarGaussian_maps_graph_closure (D : Context H) :
    Set.MapsTo (Prod.map (scalarGaussianGNSMap D) (scalarGaussianGNSMap D))
      (closure (scalarTomitaGraph D))
      (closure (vectorTomitaGraph (dualOrbitVonNeumann D.algebra)
        (scalarGaussianVacuum D))) := by
  apply (scalarGaussian_maps_graph D).closure
  exact (scalarGaussianGNSMap D).continuous.prodMap (scalarGaussianGNSMap D).continuous

/-- The original scalar-weight GNS graph is closable. The auxiliary graph is
used only through a continuous injective map of the original Hilbert space. -/
theorem scalarTomitaGraph_closure_vertical (D : Context H) (y : GNSHilbert D)
    (hy : (0,y) ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)) : y = 0 := by
  have hh := scalarGaussian_maps_graph_closure D hy
  have ht : (0,scalarGaussianGNSMap D y) ∈
      closure (vectorTomitaGraph (dualOrbitVonNeumann D.algebra)
        (scalarGaussianVacuum D)) := by
    simpa only [Prod.map_apply,map_zero] using hh
  have hz := vectorTomita_closure_vertical (dualOrbitVonNeumann D.algebra)
    (scalarGaussianVacuum D) (scalarGaussianImage_separating D) _ ht
  apply scalarGaussianGNSMap_injective D
  simpa only [map_zero] using hz

theorem scalarTomitaGraph_closure_single_valued (D : Context H)
    (x y z : GNSHilbert D)
    (hy : (x,y) ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D))
    (hz : (x,z) ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)) : y = z := by
  apply scalarGaussianGNSMap_injective D
  exact vectorTomita_closure_single_valued (dualOrbitVonNeumann D.algebra)
    (scalarGaussianVacuum D) (scalarGaussianImage_separating D) _ _ _
    (scalarGaussian_maps_graph_closure D hy) (scalarGaussian_maps_graph_closure D hz)

namespace F1Fecho.RegularScalarClosedTomita

noncomputable section
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {D : Context H}

local instance scalarStarCoreAdd : AddCommGroup (finiteStarCore D) :=
  (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.toNonUnitalRing (finiteStarCore D)).toAddCommGroup

local instance scalarStarCoreSMul : SMul ℂ (finiteStarCore D) where
  smul c A := ⟨c • A.val, (finiteStarCore D).smul_mem c A.property⟩

theorem scalarGNSStarEmbedding_add (A B : finiteStarCore D) :
    scalarGNSStarEmbedding D (A+B) = scalarGNSStarEmbedding D A + scalarGNSStarEmbedding D B :=
  (GNSEmbedding D).map_add ⟨A.val,A.property.1⟩ ⟨B.val,B.property.1⟩

theorem scalarGNSStarEmbedding_smul (c : ℂ) (A : finiteStarCore D) :
    scalarGNSStarEmbedding D (c • A : finiteStarCore D) = c • scalarGNSStarEmbedding D A :=
  (GNSEmbedding D).map_smul c ⟨A.val,A.property.1⟩

theorem scalarTomitaGraph_zero : (0,0) ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D := by
  refine ⟨0,?_⟩
  change (scalarGNSStarEmbedding D 0,scalarGNSStarEmbedding D (star 0)) = (0,0)
  have hz : star (0 : finiteStarCore D) = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact star_zero _
  rw [hz]
  change (GNSEmbedding D 0,GNSEmbedding D 0) = (0,0)
  simp only [map_zero]

theorem scalarTomitaGraph_add {p q : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D}
    (hp : p ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D) (hq : q ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D) :
    p+q ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D := by
  obtain ⟨A,rfl⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨B,rfl⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨A+B,?_⟩
  have hs : star (A+B) = star A + star B := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact star_add A.val B.val
  simp only [hs,scalarGNSStarEmbedding_add,Prod.mk_add_mk]

theorem scalarTomitaGraph_conj_smul (c : ℂ)
    {p : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D} (hp : p ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D) :
    (c • p.1,(starRingEnd ℂ c) • p.2) ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D := by
  obtain ⟨A,rfl⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨(c • A : finiteStarCore D),?_⟩
  have hs : star (c • A : finiteStarCore D) = star c • star A := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact star_smul c A.val
  simp only [hs,scalarGNSStarEmbedding_smul,starRingEnd_apply]

theorem scalarClosedGraph_add {p q : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D}
    (hp : p ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)) (hq : q ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)) :
    p+q ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D) := by
  have hleft : ∀ a ∈ scalarTomitaGraph D, ∀ b ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D),
      a+b ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D) := by
    intro a ha
    exact closure_minimal (fun b hb => subset_closure (scalarTomitaGraph_add ha hb))
      (isClosed_closure.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
  exact closure_minimal (fun a ha => hleft a ha q hq)
    (isClosed_closure.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)) hp

theorem scalarClosedGraph_conj_smul (c : ℂ)
    {p : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D} (hp : p ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)) :
    (c • p.1,(starRingEnd ℂ c) • p.2) ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D) := by
  apply closure_minimal (t := {q : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D |

    exact subset_closure (scalarTomitaGraph_conj_smul c hq)
  · apply isClosed_closure.preimage
    exact (continuous_fst.const_smul c).prodMk
      (continuous_snd.const_smul (starRingEnd ℂ c))

theorem scalarClosedGraph_swap {p : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D}
    (hp : p ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)) : p.swap ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D) := by
  apply closure_minimal (t := {q : GNSHilbert D × GNSHilbert D |
    q.swap ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)}) ?_ ?_ hp
  · intro q hq
    exact subset_closure (scalarTomitaGraph_swap D q hq)
  · exact isClosed_closure.preimage continuous_swap

/-- The actual domain of the closure, not the whole Hilbert space by declaration. -/
def scalarClosedTomitaDomain (D : Context H) : Submodule ℂ (GNSHilbert D) where
  carrier := {x | ∃ y, (x,y) ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D)}
  zero_mem' := ⟨0,subset_closure scalarTomitaGraph_zero⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro x z ⟨y,hy⟩ ⟨w,hw⟩
    exact ⟨y+w,scalarClosedGraph_add hy hw⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c x ⟨y,hy⟩
    exact ⟨(starRingEnd ℂ c) • y,scalarClosedGraph_conj_smul c hy⟩

def scalarClosedTomitaValue (x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D) : GNSHilbert D :=
  Classical.choose x.property

theorem scalarClosedTomitaValue_graph (x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D) :
    ((x : GNSHilbert D),scalarClosedTomitaValue x) ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D) :=
  Classical.choose_spec x.property

/-- The closed antilinear operator associated with the original finite-star-core
graph. No identification with the maximal scalar-weight domain is asserted. -/
def scalarClosedTomita (D : Context H) :
    scalarClosedTomitaDomain D →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] GNSHilbert D where
  toFun := scalarClosedTomitaValue
  map_add' x z := by
    apply scalarTomitaGraph_closure_single_valued D ((x+z : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D) : GNSHilbert D)
    · exact scalarClosedTomitaValue_graph (x+z)
    · exact scalarClosedGraph_add (scalarClosedTomitaValue_graph x) (scalarClosedTomitaValue_graph z)
  map_smul' c x := by
    apply scalarTomitaGraph_closure_single_valued D ((c • x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D) : GNSHilbert D)
    · exact scalarClosedTomitaValue_graph (c • x)
    · exact scalarClosedGraph_conj_smul c (scalarClosedTomitaValue_graph x)

theorem scalarClosedTomita_graph (x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D) :
    ((x : GNSHilbert D),scalarClosedTomita D x) ∈ closure (scalarTomitaGraph D) :=
  scalarClosedTomitaValue_graph x

theorem scalarClosedTomita_graph_eq :
    Set.range (fun x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D =>
      ((x : GNSHilbert D),scalarClosedTomita D x)) = closure (scalarTomitaGraph D) := by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact scalarClosedTomita_graph x
  · intro hp
    let x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D := ⟨p.1,p.2,hp⟩
    refine ⟨x,?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact scalarTomitaGraph_closure_single_valued D p.1 _ p.2 (scalarClosedTomita_graph x) hp

theorem scalarClosedTomita_is_closed :
    IsClosed (Set.range (fun x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D =>
      ((x : GNSHilbert D),scalarClosedTomita D x))) := by
  rw [scalarClosedTomita_graph_eq]
  exact isClosed_closure

theorem scalarClosedTomita_maps_domain (x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D) :
    scalarClosedTomita D x ∈ scalarClosedTomitaDomain D :=
  ⟨(x : GNSHilbert D),scalarClosedGraph_swap (scalarClosedTomita_graph x)⟩

theorem scalarClosedTomita_involutive (x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain D) :

import TGLExt.V350TwistedCommutantField
import TGLExt.V350ConstantFibreIdentification
/-! Generic fixed-core identification using existing V350 analytic lemmas.
The named normalizer condition is about the supplied actual unitary flow and
base algebra, not a trace or modular-state identification. Its Fock instance
is supplied separately by the already constructed wedge-invariant boost. -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.RegularCoreFixed
open MeasureTheory Filter TGLExt ChatgptAudit TGLV350 TGLV350.Regular
open F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (B : UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
variable (hM : ∀ (t : ℝ) (A : H →L[ℂ] H), automorphism B t A ∈ M ↔ A ∈ M)

theorem automorphism_symm (t : ℝ) : (automorphism B t).symm = automorphism B (-t) := by
  unfold automorphism
  rw [boostIso_neg]
  rfl

theorem boostCLM_apply (t : ℝ) (v : H) : boostCLM B t v = boostIso B t v := rfl

include hM in
theorem modularConjugation_preserves_commutant (t : ℝ)
    (D : H →L[ℂ] H) (hD : D ∈ (M).commutant) :
    automorphism B t D ∈ (M).commutant := by
  rw [VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff] at hD ⊢
  intro A hA
  have hpre : (automorphism B t).symm A ∈ M := by
    rw [automorphism_symm]
    exact (hM (-t) A).mpr hA
  have he := congrArg (automorphism B t) (hD _ hpre)
  simpa only [map_mul, StarAlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using he

theorem modularFlow_jointly_continuous :
    Continuous (fun p : H × ℝ => boostIso B p.2 p.1) :=
  continuous_prod_of_continuous_lipschitzWith _ 1
    (fun v => boostIso_strong B v)
    (fun t => (boostIso B t).lipschitz)

theorem modularConjugation_strongly_continuous (D : H →L[ℂ] H) (v : H) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => automorphism B x D v) := by
  have hn : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => boostIso B (-x) v) :=
    (boostIso_strong B v).comp continuous_neg
  have hd : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => D (boostIso B (-x) v)) := D.continuous.comp hn
  have hp : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (D (boostIso B (-x) v), x)) :=
    hd.prodMk continuous_id
  have hc := (modularFlow_jointly_continuous B).comp hp
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hc
  simpa only [boostAd_sandwich B, boostCLM_star B,
    mul_apply_eq_comp, boostCLM_apply] using hc

/-- The continuous field x ↦ Δ^(ix) D Δ^(-ix), using the same tower flow.
Its bounded lift will lie in the regular commutant when D lies in M'. -/
def twistedCommutantField (D : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    StrongIntegral.Family (H := H) where
  op := fun x => automorphism B x D
  continuous_apply := modularConjugation_strongly_continuous B D
  bound := ‖D‖
  bound_nonneg := norm_nonneg D
  norm_bound := fun x => le_of_eq (StarAlgEquiv.norm_map (automorphism B x) D)

theorem twistedCommutantField_zero (D : H →L[ℂ] H) : (twistedCommutantField B D).op 0 = D := by
  change automorphism B 0 D = D
  rw [boostAd_sandwich B, boostCLM_zero B]
  simp only [star_one, one_mul, mul_one]

theorem twistedCommutantField_intertwines (D : H →L[ℂ] H) (x t : ℝ) :

      boostCLM B t * (twistedCommutantField B D).op (x-t) := by
  change automorphism B x D * boostCLM B t =
    boostCLM B t * automorphism B (x-t) D
  rw [boostAd_sandwich B, boostAd_sandwich B,
    boostCLM_star B, boostCLM_star B]
  calc
    _ = (boostCLM B x * D) * (boostCLM B (-x) * boostCLM B t) := by
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = (boostCLM B x * D) * boostCLM B (t-x) := by
      rw [boostCLM_mul B, neg_add_eq_sub]
    _ = ((boostCLM B t * boostCLM B (x-t)) * D) * boostCLM B (-(x-t)) := by
      rw [boostCLM_mul B]

    _ = _ := by simp only [mul_assoc]

    shift_ae t (operatorFieldLift F f),

  rw [h1]
  change F.op x (fibre (boostCLM B t) (shift t f) x) =
    fibre (boostCLM B t) (shift t (operatorFieldLift F f)) x
  rw [h2,h3,h4,h5,h6]

theorem mem_regularCommutant_of_generators (T : RegularHilbert (H) →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert (H))

    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ, T * regularUnitary B t = regularUnitary B t * T) :
    T ∈ (core B M).commutant := by
  have hN : core B M ≤ starCommutantAlgebra {T} := by
    apply core_minimal B M
    · intro A hA
      change fibre A ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ {T}
      rw [StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff]
      intro B hB
      have he : B = T := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hB
      subst B
      refine ⟨hM A hA, ?_⟩
      have hs := congrArg star (hM (star A) (star_mem hA))
      rw [fibre_star] at hs
      simpa only [star_mul, star_star] using hs.symm
    · intro t
      change regularUnitary B t ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ {T}
      rw [StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff]
      intro B hB
      have he : B = T := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hB
      subst B
      refine ⟨hU t, ?_⟩
      have hs := congrArg star (hU (-t))
      simpa only [star_mul, regular_star B, neg_neg] using hs.symm
  rw [VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff]
  intro A hA
  have hm := hN hA
  change A ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ {T} at hm
  rw [StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff] at hm
  exact (hm T (Set.mem_singleton T)).1.symm

theorem twistedCommutantLift_mem (D : H →L[ℂ] H)

  · intro A hA
    apply operatorFieldLift_commutes_fibre
    intro x
    exact ((VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp
      (modularConjugation_preserves_commutant B M hM x D hD)) A hA).symm

      (twistedCommutantField_intertwines B D)

field; equality in L² is reflected before evaluation at zero. -/
include hM in
theorem fibre_mem_regularCore_iff (C : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    fibre C ∈ core B M ↔ C ∈ M := by
  constructor
  · intro hC
    rw [← VonNeumannAlgebra.commutant_commutant (M),
      VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff]
    intro D hD
    have he := (VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp
      (twistedCommutantLift_mem B M hM D hD)) (fibre C) hC
    have hzero := operatorFieldLift_commutation_reflects
      (twistedCommutantField B D) C he.symm 0
    rwa [twistedCommutantField_zero B] at hzero
  · exact fibre_mem B M C

    shift s * regularUnitary B t = regularUnitary B t * shift s := by
  unfold F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.regularUnitary
  calc
    _ = (shift s * fibre (boostCLM B t)) * shift t := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = fibre (boostCLM B t) * (shift s * shift t) := by
      rw [shift_commutes_fibre, mul_assoc]
    _ = fibre (boostCLM B t) * (shift t * shift s) := by
      rw [shift_mul, shift_mul, add_comm s t]
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_assoc]

its generators and bicommutant closure, not a decomposition theorem. -/
theorem regularCore_le_shiftCommutant :
    core B M ≤
      starCommutantAlgebra (Set.range (shift (H := H))) := by
  apply core_minimal B M
  · intro A _
    change fibre A ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ _
    rw [StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨s,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨shift_commutes_fibre s A, ?_⟩
    rw [shift_star]
    exact shift_commutes_fibre (-s) A
  · intro t
    change regularUnitary B t ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ _
    rw [StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨s,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨shift_commutes_regularUnitary B s t, ?_⟩
    rw [shift_star]
    exact shift_commutes_regularUnitary B (-s) t

theorem shift_mem_regularCommutant (s : ℝ) :
    shift s ∈ (core B M).commutant := by
  rw [VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff]
  intro X hX
  have h := regularCore_le_shiftCommutant B M hX
  change X ∈ StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ _ at h
  rw [StarSubalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff] at h
  exact (h _ ⟨s,rfl⟩).1.symm

    (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H)
    (hA : A ∈ core B M) (hfix : ∀ s : ℝ, dualAmbient s A = A) :
    A = fibre (fibreCandidate A) := by
  apply eq_fibre_of_shift_character_commutation A
  · intro t
    exact ((VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp (shift_mem_regularCommutant B M t)) A hA).symm
  · intro t
    exact (dualAmbient_fixed_iff_commutes t A).mp (hfix t)

theorem dualFixed_eq_amplified_base
    (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) :
    (A ∈ core B M ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, dualAmbient s A = A) ↔ ∃ C ∈ M, A = fibre C := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hA,hfix⟩
    have he := dualFixed_eq_fibre_candidate B M A hA hfix
    refine ⟨fibreCandidate A,?_,he⟩
    apply (fibre_mem_regularCore_iff B M hM _).mp
    rwa [← he]
  · rintro ⟨C,hC,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fibre_mem B M C hC,fun s => dualAmbient_fibre s C⟩

/-!

core of R(KWR), on L2(R; Fock), evaluated at the SAME concrete Fock vacuum.
This is a constructed nonzero scalar dual weight, not the exp(-s)-scaling trace.
Its additivity, nonnegative homogeneity, monotonicity, dual invariance and
preservation of positive monotone strong limits reuse the generic integral
lemmas. The unit has infinite weight, so the construction is nonzero.
No faithfulness, semifiniteness, tracial law, inverse-generator perturbation,
full modular implementation or Fock-to-tower equivalence is asserted here.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
open Filter Topology
open scoped ENNReal NNReal
namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalFockWeight
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock TGLV350.Regular
open F1Fecho.CanonicalFockRegular

def PositiveInput :=
  {A : RegularHilbert F →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert F // A ∈ core ∧ 0 ≤ A}

def zero : PositiveInput := ⟨0,core.zero_mem,le_rfl⟩

def one : PositiveInput := ⟨1,core.one_mem,zero_le_one⟩

def add (A B : PositiveInput) : PositiveInput :=
  ⟨A.val+B.val,core.add_mem A.property.1 B.property.1,
    add_nonneg A.property.2 B.property.2⟩

def scale (r : ℝ≥0) (A : PositiveInput) : PositiveInput :=
  ⟨((r : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.val, by
    change ((r : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.val ∈ core
    exact core.toStarSubalgebra.smul_mem A.property.1 _, by
    change 0 ≤ ((r : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.val
    apply (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive _).mpr
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive _).mp A.property.2).smul_of_nonneg
      (by exact_mod_cast r.property)⟩

def positiveDual (s : ℝ) (A : PositiveInput) : PositiveInput :=
  ⟨(dualAction s ⟨A.val,A.property.1⟩).val,
    (dualAction s ⟨A.val,A.property.1⟩).property,
    dualAmbient_nonneg s A.val A.property.2⟩

def regularFockVacuum : RegularHilbert F := testVector vacuum

theorem regularFockVacuum_norm : ‖regularFockVacuum‖ = 1 := by
  rw [regularFockVacuum,testVector_norm,vacuum_norm]

theorem regularFockVacuum_ne_zero : regularFockVacuum ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hn := regularFockVacuum_norm
  rw [h,norm_zero] at hn
  norm_num at hn

def weight (A : PositiveInput) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  dualQuadraticIntegral A.val regularFockVacuum

theorem weight_zero : weight zero = 0 := dualQuadraticIntegral_zero regularFockVacuum

theorem weight_add (A B : PositiveInput) : weight (add A B) = weight A + weight B :=
  dualQuadraticIntegral_add A.val B.val A.property.2 B.property.2 regularFockVacuum

theorem weight_scale (r : ℝ≥0) (A : PositiveInput) :
    weight (scale r A) = (r : ℝ≥0∞) * weight A := by
  have h := dualQuadraticIntegral_smul_operator (r : ℝ) r.property A.val regularFockVacuum
  change dualQuadraticIntegral (((r : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.val) regularFockVacuum =
    ENNReal.ofReal (r : ℝ) * dualQuadraticIntegral A.val regularFockVacuum at h
  change dualQuadraticIntegral (((r : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.val) regularFockVacuum = _
  simpa only [weight,ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] using h

theorem weight_mono (A B : PositiveInput) (h : A.val ≤ B.val) : weight A ≤ weight B :=
  dualQuadraticIntegral_mono A.val B.val h regularFockVacuum

theorem weight_dual_invariant (s : ℝ) (A : PositiveInput) :
    weight (positiveDual s A) = weight A :=
  dualQuadraticIntegral_dual_invariant s A.val regularFockVacuum

theorem weight_one : weight one = ⊤ :=
  dualQuadraticIntegral_one regularFockVacuum regularFockVacuum_ne_zero

theorem weight_nonzero : weight ≠ fun _ => 0 := by
  intro h
  have he := congrFun h one
  rw [weight_one] at he
  exact ENNReal.top_ne_zero he

theorem positive_cone_nontrivial : one ≠ zero := by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg weight h
  rw [weight_one,weight_zero] at he
  exact ENNReal.top_ne_zero he

theorem weight_monotone_strong_limit
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : ι → PositiveInput) (S : PositiveInput)
    (hmono : Monotone (fun i => (A i).val))
    (hlim : ∀ v, Tendsto (fun i => (A i).val v) atTop (𝓝 (S.val v))) :
    weight S = ⨆ i, weight (A i) :=
  dualQuadraticIntegral_of_monotone_strong_limit (fun i => (A i).val) S.val
    (fun i => (A i).property.2) hmono hlim regularFockVacuum

/-! Faithfulness of the actual scalar dual weight on the SAME Fock regular
core. The proof reuses the fixed-core identification and canonical variational
resolvent, then applies the already derived separating Fock vacuum. No trace,
semifiniteness or modular-group identification is assumed or concluded. -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalFockFaithfulWeight
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock TGLV350.Regular Filter

theorem boost_normalizes (t : ℝ) (A : F →L[ℂ] F) :
    F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.automorphism fockFlow t A ∈ M ↔ A ∈ M := by
  rw [automorphism_is_concrete_boost]
  exact (F1Fecho.CanonicalWedgeFlow.boostAd_preserves t A).symm

theorem fixed_core_is_base (A : RegularHilbert F →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert F) :
    (A ∈ core ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, dualAmbient s A = A) ↔ ∃ C ∈ M, A = fibre C :=
  F1Fecho.RegularCoreFixed.dualFixed_eq_amplified_base fockFlow M boost_normalizes A

theorem fixed_core_vacuum_separating
    (A : RegularHilbert F →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert F)
    (hA : A ∈ core) (hfix : ∀ s : ℝ, dualAmbient s A = A)
    (hz : A regularFockVacuum = 0) : A = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,he⟩ := (fixed_core_is_base A).mp ⟨hA,hfix⟩
  subst A
  change fibre C (testVector vacuum) = 0 at hz
  rw [fibre_testVector] at hz
  have hc0 : C vacuum = 0 := by
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← testVector_norm,hz,norm_zero]
  have hc : C = 0 := F1Fecho.WedgeCyclic.canonical_wedge_separating C hC hc0
  rw [hc]
  exact map_zero fibreRepresentation

theorem weight_faithful (A : PositiveInput) : weight A = 0 ↔ A.val = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨R,hmR,hR,hone,hlim,hfix⟩ :=
      F1Fecho.RegularCoreResolvent.exists_dualResolvent_fixed fockFlow M A.val A.property.1 A.property.2
    have hz : (R-1) regularFockVacuum = 0 := by
      change R regularFockVacuum - regularFockVacuum = 0
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (dualResolvent_fixes_zero_form_vector A.val R A.property.2 hlim _ hv)
    have hfixsub : ∀ s : ℝ, dualAmbient s (R-1) = R-1 := by
      intro s
      rw [map_sub,hfix,map_one]
    have hRone : R = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp
      (fixed_core_vacuum_separating (R-1) (core.sub_mem hmR core.one_mem) hfixsub hz)
    apply (dualQuadraticIntegral_faithful A.val A.property.2).mp
    intro v
    have hfinite := dualResolvent_limit_range_finite A.val R A.property.2 hlim v
    have hid := dualResolvent_limit_energy_identity A.val R A.property.2 hlim v
    rw [hRone] at hfinite hid
    change dualQuadraticIntegral A.val v < ⊤ at hfinite
    change (dualQuadraticIntegral A.val v).toReal = (inner ℂ v (v-v)).re at hid
    simp only [sub_self,inner_zero_right,Complex.zero_re] at hid
    calc
      dualQuadraticIntegral A.val v = ENNReal.ofReal (dualQuadraticIntegral A.val v).toReal :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hfinite)).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hid,ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
  · intro h
    change dualQuadraticIntegral A.val regularFockVacuum = 0
    rw [h]
    exact dualQuadraticIntegral_zero regularFockVacuum

end F1Fecho.CanonicalFockFaithfulWeight

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.RegularCovariantCoreR3
import TGLExt.V350RegularApproximation
/-! Generic strong regular averages, ported from V350 to the supplied actual
unitary flow; membership is in its actual generated bicommutant. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage
open MeasureTheory Filter TGLV350 TGLV350.Regular F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore
open scoped Topology
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
def regularBundledUnitary (B : UnitaryFlow H) (t : ℝ) :
    unitary (RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ]
      RegularHilbert H) :=
  ⟨regularUnitary B t, Unitary.mem_iff.mpr (regular_unitary B t)⟩

theorem regular_norm_map (B : UnitaryFlow H) (t : ℝ)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    ‖regularUnitary B t v‖ = ‖v‖ := Unitary.norm_map (regularBundledUnitary B t) v

def regularIntegralFamily (B : UnitaryFlow H) :
    StrongIntegral.Family (H := RegularHilbert H) where
  op := regularUnitary B
  continuous_apply := regular_strongly_continuous B
  bound := 1
  bound_nonneg := zero_le_one
  norm_bound := fun t => ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
    (fun v => by rw [regular_norm_map, one_mul])

/-- One-sided normalized averages of the actual regular unitaries. The value
at h=0 is zero; convergence is asserted on the punctured neighborhood. -/
def regularAverage (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ) :
    RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ]
      RegularHilbert H :=
  (h⁻¹ : ℝ) • StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral (regularIntegralFamily B) 0 h

theorem regularAverage_apply (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    regularAverage B h v = h⁻¹ • ∫ t in 0..h, regularUnitary B t v := rfl

theorem regularAverage_mem (B : UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (h : ℝ) :
    regularAverage B h ∈ core B M := by
  change ((h⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral (regularIntegralFamily B) 0 h ∈ _
  apply (core B M).toStarSubalgebra.smul_mem
  exact StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral_mem _ _ _ _ (regular_mem B M)

theorem regularAverage_norm_le_one (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ) :
    ‖regularAverage B h‖ ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hh : h = 0
  · subst h
    simp [regularAverage]
  · have hb := StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral_norm_le (regularIntegralFamily B) 0 h
    change ‖StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral (regularIntegralFamily B) 0 h‖ ≤ 1 * |h-0| at hb
    simp only [sub_zero, one_mul] at hb
    calc
      ‖regularAverage B h‖ = |h⁻¹| * ‖StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral (regularIntegralFamily B) 0 h‖ := by
        change ‖((h⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral (regularIntegralFamily B) 0 h‖ = _
        rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ |h⁻¹| * |h| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = 1 := by rw [abs_inv, inv_mul_cancel₀ (abs_ne_zero.mpr hh)]

/-- The fundamental theorem of calculus gives strong convergence without
operator-norm continuity of the unitary group. -/
theorem regularAverage_tendsto_identity (B : UnitaryFlow H)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => regularAverage B h v) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 v) := by
  have hc := regular_strongly_continuous B v
  have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
    (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 0) hc.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hc.continuousAt
  have ht := hd.tendsto_slope_zero
  simpa only [zero_add, intervalIntegral.integral_same, sub_zero,
    F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.regular_zero B, one_apply_eq_self, regularAverage_apply] using ht

theorem regularAverage_mul_tendsto (B : UnitaryFlow H)
    (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ]
      RegularHilbert H)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (A * regularAverage B h) v) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (A v)) :=
  A.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (regularAverage_tendsto_identity B v)

/-- The dual orbit of the average is the Fourier-modulated vector integral
of the same regular unitary group. -/
theorem regularAverage_dual_apply (B : UnitaryFlow H) (s h : ℝ)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    dualAmbient s (regularAverage B h) v =
      h⁻¹ • ∫ t in 0..h, characterPhase s t • regularUnitary B t v := by
  unfold regularAverage
  rw [dualAmbient_real_smul]
  change h⁻¹ • (dualAmbient s (StrongIntegral.operatorIntegral (regularIntegralFamily B) 0 h) v) = _
  rw [dualAmbient_strongIntegral_apply]
  congr 1
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro t _
  change dualAmbient s (regularUnitary B t) v = _
  rw [dual_on_regular B]
  rfl


end F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.RegularCoreAverageR2
import TGLExt.V350DualSemifiniteIdeal
/-! Plancherel evaluation of actual generic regular averages. This is the
same V350 Fourier argument on H, without substituting a different core. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2500000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight
open MeasureTheory Filter FourierTransform TGLV350 TGLV350.Regular
open F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage
open scoped FourierTransform ENNReal NNReal Topology
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
/-- The actual Hilbert-valued regular orbit restricted to a finite interval. -/
def regularOrbitCut (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    ℝ → RegularHilbert H :=
  (Set.Ioc 0 h).indicator (fun t => regularUnitary B t v)

theorem regularOrbitCut_memLp (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) (p : ℝ≥0∞) :
    MemLp (regularOrbitCut B h v) p := by
  have hc := memLp_indicator_const p measurableSet_Ioc ‖v‖
    (Or.inr (show volume (Set.Ioc 0 h) ≠ ⊤ by simp [Real.volume_Ioc]))
  apply hc.congr_norm
    ((regular_strongly_continuous B v).stronglyMeasurable.indicator measurableSet_Ioc).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 h
  · simp [ht, F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regular_norm_map B]
  · simp [ht]

theorem regularOrbitCut_integrable (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    Integrable (regularOrbitCut B h v) :=
  memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (regularOrbitCut_memLp B h v 1)

theorem regularOrbitCut_integral_norm_sq (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, ‖regularOrbitCut B h v t‖ ^ 2) = h * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
  have heq : (fun t => ‖regularOrbitCut B h v t‖ ^ 2) =
      (Set.Ioc 0 h).indicator (fun _ => ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
    funext t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 h <;> simp [regularOrbitCut, ht, F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regular_norm_map B]
  rw [heq, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc, setIntegral_const]
  simp [Measure.real, Real.volume_Ioc, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hh.le]

theorem regularAverage_dual_fourier (B : UnitaryFlow H) (s h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    dualAmbient s (regularAverage B h) v =
      h⁻¹ • (𝓕 (regularOrbitCut B h v)) (s / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
  rw [F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_dual_apply B, Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hh.le]
  have heq : (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(-2 * Real.pi * t * (s / (2 * Real.pi))) * Complex.I) •
      regularOrbitCut B h v t) =
      (Set.Ioc 0 h).indicator (fun t => characterPhase s t • regularUnitary B t v) := by
    funext t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 h
    · simp only [regularOrbitCut, Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      field_simp
    · simp [regularOrbitCut, ht]
  rw [heq, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
  rfl

theorem regularAverage_dual_sq_integrable (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    Integrable (fun s : ℝ => ‖dualAmbient s (regularAverage B h) v‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hf := Fourier.fourier_integral_memLp_two _
    (regularOrbitCut_integrable B h v) (regularOrbitCut_memLp B h v 2)
  have hi := ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hf.1).mp hf).comp_div
    (show (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity)
  simpa only [regularAverage_dual_fourier B _ h hh v, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow]
    using hi.const_mul (|h⁻¹| ^ 2)

theorem regularAverage_dual_integral_norm_sq (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    (∫ s : ℝ, ‖dualAmbient s (regularAverage B h) v‖ ^ 2) =
      (2 * Real.pi) * h⁻¹ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
  simp_rw [regularAverage_dual_fourier B _ h hh v, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow]
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖(𝓕 (regularOrbitCut B h v)) x‖ ^ 2
  have hd := Measure.integral_comp_div g (2 * Real.pi)
  change (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(𝓕 (regularOrbitCut B h v)) (x / (2 * Real.pi))‖ ^ 2) =
    |2 * Real.pi| • (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(𝓕 (regularOrbitCut B h v)) x‖ ^ 2) at hd
  rw [integral_const_mul, hd,
    Fourier.fourier_integral_norm_sq _ (regularOrbitCut_integrable B h v)
      (regularOrbitCut_memLp B h v 2), regularOrbitCut_integral_norm_sq B h hh v]
  rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hh), abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.pi)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

/-- Uniform finite form for the square of the averaging operator. The coefficient
is 1/h with the already fixed dual Haar convention, not an imposed normalization. -/
theorem regularAverage_dualQuadraticIntegral (B : UnitaryFlow H) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    dualQuadraticIntegral (star (regularAverage B h) * regularAverage B h) v =
      ENNReal.ofReal (h⁻¹ * ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
  simp only [dualQuadraticIntegral, dualQuadraticIntegrand_star_mul]
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (regularAverage_dual_sq_integrable B h hh v)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => sq_nonneg _)),
    regularAverage_dual_integral_norm_sq B h hh v,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul dualHaarFactor_pos.le]
  congr 1
  unfold dualHaarFactor
  field_simp

theorem regularAverage_dualQuadraticIntegral_lt_top (B : UnitaryFlow H)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    dualQuadraticIntegral (star (regularAverage B h) * regularAverage B h) v < ⊤ := by
  rw [regularAverage_dualQuadraticIntegral B h hh v]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top


theorem regularAverage_hasFiniteDualSquare (B : UnitaryFlow H)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) : HasFiniteDualSquare (regularAverage B h) := by
  let C : ℝ≥0 := ⟨h⁻¹, (inv_pos.mpr hh).le⟩
  have hC : ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ = (C : ℝ≥0∞) := ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal (p := C)
  refine ⟨C, fun v => ?_⟩
  rw [regularAverage_dualQuadraticIntegral B h hh v,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_pos.mpr hh).le]
  rw [hC]

theorem finiteDualLeftIdeal_strong_approximation (B : UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A : (core B M).toStarSubalgebra) :
    (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → HasFiniteDualSquare (A.val * regularAverage B h)) ∧
    (∀ h : ℝ, A.val * regularAverage B h ∈ core B M) ∧
    (∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (A.val * regularAverage B h) v) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (A.val v))) := by
  refine ⟨fun h hh => HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul _ _
    (regularAverage_hasFiniteDualSquare B h hh),
    fun h => (core B M).toStarSubalgebra.mul_mem A.property (regularAverage_mem B M h),
    fun v => (regularAverage_mul_tendsto B A.val v).mono_left ?_⟩
  exact nhdsWithin_mono _ (by intro h hh; exact ne_of_gt hh)

end F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight

/-! Actual Fock weight: order normality, an explicit finite positive element
of weight one, and a strongly dense finite-square left ideal. These statements
are on the already constructed core. No trace or modular identification follows
merely from the terminology of a dual weight. -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000

namespace F1Fecho.CanonicalFockFiniteWeight

open F1Fecho.CanonicalFockRegular F1Fecho.CanonicalFockWeight
open F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight
open scoped Topology ENNReal NNReal

theorem weight_internal_normal
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : ι → core.toStarSubalgebra) (S : core.toStarSubalgebra)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ A i) (hmono : Monotone A) (hS : IsLUB (Set.range A) S)
    (hSpos : 0 ≤ S) :
    weight ⟨S.val,S.property,hSpos⟩ =
      ⨆ i, weight ⟨(A i).val,(A i).property,hpos i⟩ :=
  dualQuadraticIntegral_preserves_internal_isLUB core A S hpos hmono hS regularFockVacuum

def averageSquare (h : ℝ) : PositiveInput :=
  ⟨star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h) * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h,
    core.mul_mem (core.toStarSubalgebra.star_mem' (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mem fockFlow M h))
      (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mem fockFlow M h),star_mul_self_nonneg (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h)⟩

theorem weight_averageSquare (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    weight (averageSquare h) = ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ := by
  change dualQuadraticIntegral (star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h) * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h)
    regularFockVacuum = _
  rw [F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight.regularAverage_dualQuadraticIntegral fockFlow h hh, regularFockVacuum_norm]
  simp

theorem exists_positive_finite_weight : ∃ A : PositiveInput, 0 < weight A ∧ weight A < ⊤ := by
  refine ⟨averageSquare 1, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [weight_averageSquare 1 zero_lt_one] <;> norm_num

theorem finiteSquare_scalar_finite
    (A : RegularHilbert F →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert F) (hf : HasFiniteDualSquare A) :
    dualQuadraticIntegral (star A * A) regularFockVacuum < ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hf
  have he := hC regularFockVacuum
  rw [regularFockVacuum_norm, one_pow, ENNReal.ofReal_one, mul_one] at he
  exact he.trans_lt ENNReal.coe_lt_top

def finiteLeftIdeal : Submodule ℂ core.toStarSubalgebra where
  carrier := {A | HasFiniteDualSquare A.val}
  zero_mem' := HasFiniteDualSquare.zero
  add_mem' := fun hA hB => HasFiniteDualSquare.add _ _ hA hB
  smul_mem' := fun c _ hA => HasFiniteDualSquare.smul c _ hA

theorem finiteLeftIdeal_left_mul (B A : core.toStarSubalgebra)
    (hA : A ∈ finiteLeftIdeal) : B*A ∈ finiteLeftIdeal :=
  HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul B.val A.val hA

theorem finite_square_strong_density (A : core.toStarSubalgebra) :
    (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → dualQuadraticIntegral
      (star (A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h) * (A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h))
      regularFockVacuum < ⊤) ∧
    (∀ h : ℝ, A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h ∈ core) ∧
    (∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage fockFlow h) v)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (A.val v))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h hh
    exact finiteSquare_scalar_finite _ (HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul A.val _
      (F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight.regularAverage_hasFiniteDualSquare fockFlow h hh))
  · intro h
    exact core.mul_mem A.property (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mem fockFlow M h)
  · intro v
    exact (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mul_tendsto fockFlow A.val v).mono_left
      (nhdsWithin_mono _ (by intro h hh; exact ne_of_gt hh))


end F1Fecho.CanonicalFockFiniteWeight

theorem scalarOrbit_memLp (A : RegularHilbert F →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert F)

import TGLExt.V350StrongBoundedApplication
import TGLExt.V350ContractionAdjointLimit
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.RegularCoreFiniteWeightR3
import TGLExt.V350RegularFiniteWeight
import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.NonUnitalSubalgebra
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 900000

namespace F1Fecho.RegularFiniteStarCore
open TGLExt TGLV350.Regular Filter
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

theorem regularAverage_star_tendsto_identity (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H)
    (v : RegularHilbert H) :
    Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h) v) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 v) :=
  contraction_adjoint_tendsto_identity _ _ (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_norm_le_one B)
    (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_tendsto_identity B) v

/-- The actual finite-square left ideal intersected with its adjoint.
No unit is asserted to have finite weight. -/
def finiteDualStarCore (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra where
  carrier := {A | HasFiniteDualSquare A.val ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star A.val)}
  zero_mem' := by
    constructor <;> simpa using (HasFiniteDualSquare.zero
      (H := H))
  add_mem' := by
    intro A B hA hB
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (A.val+B.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (A.val+B.val))
    exact ⟨HasFiniteDualSquare.add _ _ hA.1 hB.1,
      by simpa only [star_add] using
        HasFiniteDualSquare.add _ _ hA.2 hB.2⟩
  mul_mem' := by
    intro A B hA hB
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (A.val*B.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (A.val*B.val))
    exact ⟨HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul _ _ hB.1,
      by simpa only [star_mul] using
        HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul (star B.val) (star A.val) hA.2⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c A hA
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (c • A.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (c • A.val))
    exact ⟨HasFiniteDualSquare.smul c _ hA.1,
      by simpa only [star_smul] using
        HasFiniteDualSquare.smul (star c) _ hA.2⟩
  star_mem' := by
    intro A hA
    change HasFiniteDualSquare (star A.val) ∧ HasFiniteDualSquare (star (star A.val))
    exact ⟨hA.2,by simpa only [star_star] using hA.1⟩

/-- A bounded sandwich in the same N, with a finite-square factor on the
right both before and after taking the adjoint. -/
def regularSandwich (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (A : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra)
    (h : ℝ) : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra :=
  ⟨star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h) * A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h,
    (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).mul_mem
      ((F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).mul_mem
        ((F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra.star_mem' (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mem B M h)) A.property)
      (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mem B M h)⟩

theorem regularSandwich_star (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra) (h : ℝ) :
    star (regularSandwich B M A h) = regularSandwich B M (star A) h := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change star (star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h) * A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h) =
    star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h) * star A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h
  simp only [star_mul, star_star, mul_assoc]

theorem regularSandwich_mem_finiteDualStarCore (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    regularSandwich B M A h ∈ finiteDualStarCore B M := by
  have hf (X : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra) :
      HasFiniteDualSquare (regularSandwich B M X h).val :=
    HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul _ _ (F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight.regularAverage_hasFiniteDualSquare B h hh)
  refine ⟨hf A,?_⟩
  change HasFiniteDualSquare (star (regularSandwich B M A h)).val
  rw [regularSandwich_star]
  exact hf (star A)

theorem regularSandwich_norm_le (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra) (h : ℝ) :
    ‖(regularSandwich B M A h).val‖ ≤ ‖A.val‖ := by
  have hx := F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_norm_le_one B h
  have hxstar : ‖star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h)‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
    have hn : ‖star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h)‖ = ‖F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h‖ :=
      _root_.norm_star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h)
    exact hn.le.trans hx
  change ‖star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h) * A.val * F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h‖ ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (‖star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h)‖ * ‖A.val‖) * ‖F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h‖ :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (1 * ‖A.val‖) * 1 := by
      apply mul_le_mul
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxstar (norm_nonneg _)
      · exact hx
      · exact norm_nonneg _
      · exact mul_nonneg zero_le_one (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem regularSandwich_tendsto (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra)
    (v : RegularHilbert (H)) :
    Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (regularSandwich B M A h).val v) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (A.val v)) := by
  have ht := bounded_application_tendsto (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ))
    (fun h => star (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h)) 1
    (fun h => by simpa only [_root_.norm_star] using F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_norm_le_one B h)
    (fun h => A.val (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage B h v)) (A.val v) (A.val v)
    (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mul_tendsto B A.val v)
    (regularAverage_star_tendsto_identity B (A.val v))
  exact ht.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ (by intro h hh; exact ne_of_gt hh))

/-- Every core element has uniformly bounded approximants in the algebraic
star core, converging strongly together with their adjoints. -/
theorem finiteDualStarCore_strongStar_approximation (B : F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.UnitaryFlow H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A : (F1Fecho.RegularCovariantCore.core B M).toStarSubalgebra) :
    (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → regularSandwich B M A h ∈ finiteDualStarCore B M) ∧
    (∀ h : ℝ, ‖(regularSandwich B M A h).val‖ ≤ ‖A.val‖) ∧
    (∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (regularSandwich B M A h).val v) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (A.val v))) ∧
    (∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => star (regularSandwich B M A h).val v) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (star A.val v))) := by
  refine ⟨regularSandwich_mem_finiteDualStarCore B M A,regularSandwich_norm_le B M A,
    regularSandwich_tendsto B M A,?_⟩
  intro v
  change Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (star (regularSandwich B M A h)).val v)
    (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 ((star A).val v))
  simp_rw [regularSandwich_star]
  exact regularSandwich_tendsto B M (star A) v

#print axioms regularAverage_star_tendsto_identity
#print axioms finiteDualStarCore
#print axioms regularSandwich
#print axioms regularSandwich_star
#print axioms regularSandwich_mem_finiteDualStarCore
#print axioms regularSandwich_norm_le
#print axioms regularSandwich_tendsto
#print axioms finiteDualStarCore_strongStar_approximation
end
end F1Fecho.RegularFiniteStarCore

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.RegularScalarGNSStrongContinuityR1
import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.RegularScalarTomitaGraphR1
/-! Density from an actual bounded star-strong approximate identity of finite
square weight. The supplied hypotheses describe the regularizing operators;
no GNS density or closability conclusion is accepted as a field. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.RegularScalarStarDensity
open TGLV350.Regular MeasureTheory Filter F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS
open F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNSAction F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNSRepresentation
open F1Fecho.RegularScalarTomitaGraph F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNSStrongContinuity
open scoped Topology
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (D : Context H) (b : ℝ → D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra)

def leftRegularization (A : finiteIdeal D) (h : ℝ) : finiteIdeal D :=
  scalarGNSLeftProduct D (star (b h)) A

theorem leftRegularization_mem_starCore
    (hb : ∀ h, 0<h → HasFiniteDualSquare (b h).val)
    (A : finiteIdeal D) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0<h) :
    (leftRegularization D b A h).val ∈ finiteStarCore D := by
  refine ⟨(leftRegularization D b A h).property,?_⟩
  change HasFiniteDualSquare (star (star (b h).val*A.val.val))
  rw [star_mul,star_star]
  exact HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul _ _ (hb h hh)

theorem embedding_leftRegularization_tendsto
    (hbound : ∀ h, ‖(b h).val‖ ≤ 1)
    (hstrong : ∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => star (b h).val v) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v))
    (A : finiteIdeal D) :
    Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => GNSEmbedding D (leftRegularization D b A h))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (GNSEmbedding D A)) := by
  have hb : ∀ h, ‖(star (b h)).val‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro h
    change ‖star (b h).val‖ ≤ 1
    rw [norm_star]
    exact hbound h
  have hs : ∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (star (b h)).val v)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 ((1 : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra).val v)) := hstrong
  have ht := scalarGNSRepresentation_tendsto_of_uniformly_bounded D
    (fun h => star (b h)) 1 1 hb hs (GNSEmbedding D A)
  rw [map_one] at ht
  have he : (fun h : ℝ => GNSEmbedding D (leftRegularization D b A h)) =
      (fun h => scalarGNSRepresentation D (star (b h)) (GNSEmbedding D A)) := by
    funext h
    exact (scalarGNSAction_intertwines D (star (b h)) A).symm
  rw [he]
  exact ht

theorem starEmbedding_denseRange
    (hb : ∀ h, 0<h → HasFiniteDualSquare (b h).val)
    (hbound : ∀ h, ‖(b h).val‖ ≤ 1)
    (hstrong : ∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => star (b h).val v) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v)) :
    DenseRange (scalarGNSStarEmbedding D) := by
  have hs : Set.range (GNSEmbedding D) ⊆ closure (Set.range (scalarGNSStarEmbedding D)) := by
    rintro v ⟨A,rfl⟩
    apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto (embedding_leftRegularization_tendsto D b hbound hstrong A)
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h hh
    apply subset_closure
    exact ⟨⟨(leftRegularization D b A h).val,leftRegularization_mem_starCore D b hb A h hh⟩,rfl⟩
  intro v
  exact (closure_minimal hs isClosed_closure) ((GNSEmbedding_denseRange D) v)

theorem graph_domain_dense
    (hb : ∀ h, 0<h → HasFiniteDualSquare (b h).val)
    (hbound : ∀ h, ‖(b h).val‖ ≤ 1)
    (hstrong : ∀ v, Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => star (b h).val v) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v)) :
    Dense (Prod.fst '' scalarTomitaGraph D) := by
  apply (starEmbedding_denseRange D b hb hbound hstrong).mono
  rintro x ⟨A,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨(scalarGNSStarEmbedding D A,scalarGNSStarEmbedding D (star A)),⟨A,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
end F1Fecho.RegularScalarStarDensity

#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarStarDensity.leftRegularization_mem_starCore
#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarStarDensity.embedding_leftRegularization_tendsto
#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarStarDensity.starEmbedding_denseRange
#print axioms F1Fecho.RegularScalarStarDensity.graph_domain_dense

  F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight.regularAverage_hasFiniteDualSquare fockFlow h hh

open scoped ENNReal
namespace F1Fecho.OrbitalSpatial
open ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016

abbrev Spatial := WithLp 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × ℝ)

def spatialChart : MomentumCoordinates ≃ᵐ Spatial :=
  (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 Transverse)
    (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ)).trans
      (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × ℝ))

theorem spatialChart_preserving : MeasurePreserving spatialChart momentumMeasure volume := by
  exact ((PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 2)).prod
    (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ))).trans
      (WithLp.volume_preserving_toLp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℝ)

theorem spatialChart_norm_sq (p : MomentumCoordinates) :
    ‖spatialChart p‖^2 = p.1 0^2+p.1 1^2+p.2^2 := by
  rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  change ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 p.1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖^2 + ‖p.2‖^2 = _
  simp [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq,Fin.sum_univ_two,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]

    energy (transverseMass m p.1) p.2 = Real.sqrt (m^2+‖spatialChart p‖^2) := by
  unfold energy
  rw [transverseMass_sq,spatialChart_norm_sq]
  congr 1
  ring

    MomentumCoordinates ≃ᵐ MomentumCoordinates :=
  spatialChart.trans (Q.toMeasurableEquiv.trans spatialChart.symm)

  spatialChart_preserving.trans (Q.measurePreserving.trans spatialChart_preserving.symm)

  rw [energy_spatialChart,energy_spatialChart,spatialAction_chart,Q.norm_map]

  unfold orbitalWeight
  rw [spatialAction_energy]

    (μ : Measure X) (r : X→X) (hr : MeasurePreserving r μ μ)
    (w : X→ℝ≥0∞) (hw : Measurable w) (hi : ∀x,w (r x)=w x) :

  refine ⟨hr.measurable,?_⟩

  apply spatialChart.injective
