/-! Local finiteness of the unchanged massless orbital measure, including
the integrable singularity at zero momentum. No regularity is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
namespace F1Fecho.OrbitalSpatial
open ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016

theorem momentum_norm_le_energy (p : MomentumCoordinates) :
    ‖p‖ ≤ energy (transverseMass 0 p.1) p.2 := by
  let e := energy (transverseMass 0 p.1) p.2
  have he : 0 ≤ e := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have he2 : e^2 = p.1 0^2+p.1 1^2+p.2^2 := by
    dsimp only [e]
    rw [energy_spatialChart,Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity),spatialChart_norm_sq]
    ring
  have h0 : |p.1 0| ≤ e := abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 1),sq_nonneg p.2],
    by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 1),sq_nonneg p.2]⟩
  have h1 : |p.1 1| ≤ e := abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 0),sq_nonneg p.2],
    by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 0),sq_nonneg p.2]⟩
  have h2 : |p.2| ≤ e := abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 0),sq_nonneg (p.1 1)],
    by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 0),sq_nonneg (p.1 1)]⟩
  change max ‖p.1‖ ‖p.2‖ ≤ e
  refine max_le ?_ (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h2)
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg he).mpr
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · change |p.1 0| ≤ e
    exact h0
  · change |p.1 1| ≤ e
    exact h1

def masslessDensity (p : MomentumCoordinates) : ℝ :=
  1 / energy (transverseMass 0 p.1) p.2

theorem masslessDensity_bound (p : MomentumCoordinates) :
    ‖masslessDensity p‖ ≤ 1 * ‖p‖ ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) := by
  by_cases hp : p=0
  · subst p
    simp [masslessDensity,energy,transverseMass]
  · have hn : 0 < ‖p‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hp
    have he := momentum_norm_le_energy p
    have hepos := hn.trans_le he
    rw [one_mul,Real.rpow_neg_one]
    simpa only [masslessDensity,one_div,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hepos.le)]
      using (inv_le_inv₀ hepos hn).mpr he

theorem masslessDensity_locallyIntegrable : LocallyIntegrable masslessDensity momentumMeasure := by
  letI : momentumMeasure.IsAddHaarMeasure := by unfold momentumMeasure; infer_instance
  have hd : Module.finrank ℝ MomentumCoordinates = 3 := by
    simp [MomentumCoordinates,Transverse,Module.finrank_prod,Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
  apply locallyIntegrable_of_norm_le_rpow (by omega : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ MomentumCoordinates)
    (C := 1) (α := 1) (by rw [hd]; norm_num)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall masslessDensity_bound)
  apply Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  unfold masslessDensity energy transverseMass
  fun_prop

instance orbital_zero_finiteOnCompacts : IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (orbitalMeasure 0) := by
  constructor
  intro K hK
  rw [orbitalMeasure,withDensity_apply _ hK.measurableSet]
  exact (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    (fun p => by change 0 ≤ 1 / energy (transverseMass 0 p.1) p.2; unfold energy; positivity))).mp
      (masslessDensity_locallyIntegrable.integrableOn_isCompact hK).hasFiniteIntegral

instance orbital_zero_locallyFinite : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (orbitalMeasure 0) := inferInstance
instance orbital_zero_innerRegular : (orbitalMeasure 0).InnerRegularCompactLTTop := inferInstance

end F1Fecho.OrbitalSpatial

theorem spatialIsometry_inverse (m : ℝ) (Q : Spatial ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Spatial)

  change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (spatialAction Q.symm.symm) _
    (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (spatialAction Q.symm) _ f) = f
  rw [← Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply]
  have he : (spatialAction Q.symm ∘ spatialAction Q.symm.symm) = id := by
    funext p

  LinearIsometryEquiv.ofLinearIsometry (spatialIsometry m Q)
    (spatialIsometry m Q.symm).toLinearMap
    (by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro f
      change spatialIsometry m Q (spatialIsometry m Q.symm f) = f
      simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm] using spatialIsometry_inverse m Q.symm f)
    (by apply LinearMap.ext; intro f; exact spatialIsometry_inverse m Q f)

      fun p => f (spatialAction Q.symm p) :=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (spatialAction_orbital Q.symm m)

    spatialUnitary (E := E) m (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Spatial) =

  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro f
  change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (spatialAction (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Spatial).symm) _ f = f
  have he : (spatialAction (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Spatial).symm : MomentumCoordinates→MomentumCoordinates) = id := by

  simp only [he,Lp.compMeasurePreserving_id_apply]

  rw [← Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply]
  have he : (spatialAction (Q.trans R).symm : MomentumCoordinates→MomentumCoordinates) =

  simp only [he]

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.ExponentialTotalityR4
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ExpDeriv
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LinearCombination
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.LinearPMap
/-! The annihilation map on the actual canonical Fock exponential domain.
Well-definedness is proved by differentiating the already proved exponential
inner kernel. No boundedness, creation operator, physical smearing, stress tensor,
or Maxwell equation is assumed or asserted. The domain is dense and concrete. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.Annihilation
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential

def synthesize : (H1 →₀ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] F := Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ exponential
def weighted (f : H1) : (H1 →₀ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] F :=
  Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ (fun g => inner ℂ f g • exponential g)

theorem weighted_kernel (f : H1) (c : H1 →₀ ℂ) (hc : synthesize c = 0) :
    weighted f c = 0 := by
  classical
  apply exponential_orthogonal_zero
  intro h
  have hz (z : ℂ) :
      (∑ g ∈ c.support, c g * Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g + z * inner ℂ f g)) = 0 := by
    have hv := congrArg (fun v : F => inner ℂ (exponential (h + (star z) • f)) v) hc
    simpa only [synthesize,Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,Finsupp.sum,
      inner_sum,inner_smul_right,exponential_inner,inner_add_left,inner_smul_left,
      starRingEnd_apply,star_star,inner_zero_right] using hv
  have hd : HasDerivAt
      (fun z : ℂ => ∑ g ∈ c.support, c g * Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g + z * inner ℂ f g))
      (∑ g ∈ c.support, c g * (Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g) * inner ℂ f g)) 0 := by
    apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum
    intro g hg
    simpa only [id_eq,zero_mul,add_zero,one_mul] using
      (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).mul_const (inner ℂ f g)).const_add
        (inner ℂ h g)).cexp.const_mul (c g)
  have he : (∑ g ∈ c.support, c g * (Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g) * inner ℂ f g)) = 0 := by
    have hf : (fun z : ℂ => ∑ g ∈ c.support, c g * Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g + z * inner ℂ f g)) =
        (fun _ : ℂ => 0) := funext hz
    rw [hf] at hd
    exact hd.unique (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℂ) (0 : ℂ))
  have hi : inner ℂ (exponential h) (weighted f c) = 0 := by
    simpa only [weighted,Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,Finsupp.sum,
      inner_sum,inner_smul_right,exponential_inner,mul_comm (inner ℂ f _) ] using he
  exact (inner_eq_zero_symm).mp hi

theorem weighted_eq_of_synthesize_eq (f : H1) (c d : H1 →₀ ℂ)
    (h : synthesize c = synthesize d) : weighted f c = weighted f d := by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← map_sub]
  apply weighted_kernel
  rw [map_sub,h,sub_self]

def domain : Submodule ℂ F := LinearMap.range synthesize

def preimage (x : domain) : H1 →₀ ℂ := Classical.choose x.property
theorem preimage_spec (x : domain) : synthesize (preimage x) = x := Classical.choose_spec x.property

def onDomain (f : H1) : domain →ₗ[ℂ] F where
  toFun x := weighted f (preimage x)
  map_add' x y := by
    rw [← map_add]
    apply weighted_eq_of_synthesize_eq
    rw [map_add,preimage_spec,preimage_spec,preimage_spec]
    rfl
  map_smul' z x := by
    change weighted f (preimage (z • x)) = z • weighted f (preimage x)
    rw [← map_smul]
    apply weighted_eq_of_synthesize_eq
    rw [map_smul,preimage_spec,preimage_spec]
    rfl

def annihilation (f : H1) : F →ₗ.[ℂ] F where
  domain := domain
  toFun := onDomain f

theorem exponential_mem_domain (g : H1) : exponential g ∈ domain := by
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single g 1, ?_⟩
  simp [synthesize]

theorem annihilation_exponential (f g : H1) :
    annihilation f ⟨exponential g, exponential_mem_domain g⟩ = inner ℂ f g • exponential g := by
  change weighted f (preimage ⟨exponential g,exponential_mem_domain g⟩) = _
  have h := weighted_eq_of_synthesize_eq f
    (preimage ⟨exponential g,exponential_mem_domain g⟩) (Finsupp.single g 1)
    (by rw [preimage_spec]; simp [synthesize])
  simpa [weighted] using h

theorem domain_eq_span : domain = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range exponential) := by
  exact Finsupp.range_linearCombination ℂ

theorem domain_dense : Dense (domain : Set F) := by
  apply Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr
  rw [domain_eq_span]
  exact exponential_total

theorem vacuum_mem_domain : vacuum ∈ domain := exponential_zero ▸ exponential_mem_domain 0

theorem annihilation_vacuum (f : H1) : annihilation f ⟨vacuum,vacuum_mem_domain⟩ = 0 := by
  have h := annihilation_exponential f 0
  simpa only [exponential_zero,inner_zero_right,zero_smul] using h

theorem exponential_ne_zero (g : H1) : exponential g ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hi := exponential_inner g g
  rw [h,inner_zero_right] at hi
  exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _ hi.symm

theorem annihilation_nonzero (f : H1) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    annihilation f ⟨exponential f,exponential_mem_domain f⟩ ≠ 0 := by
  rw [annihilation_exponential]
  exact smul_ne_zero (fun h => hf (inner_self_eq_zero.mp h)) (exponential_ne_zero f)

end F1Fecho.Annihilation

#print axioms F1Fecho.Annihilation.annihilation_exponential
#print axioms F1Fecho.Annihilation.domain_dense
#print axioms F1Fecho.Annihilation.annihilation_vacuum
#print axioms F1Fecho.Annihilation.annihilation_nonzero

theorem operator_le_of_sub_nonneg {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : 0 ≤ B-A) : A ≤ B := sub_nonneg.mp h

theorem dualOrbitRepresentation_nonneg {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    0 ≤ dualOrbitRepresentation A := by
  have h := OrderHomClass.monotone (dualOrbitRepresentation (H := H)) hA
  simpa only [map_zero] using h

variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

theorem scalarGNSRepresentation_nonneg (D : Context H)
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    0 ≤ scalarGNSRepresentation D B := by
  have ha := dualOrbitRepresentation_nonneg B.val hB
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive,
    ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff_complex] at ha ⊢
  intro v
  exact ha v.val

theorem scalarGNSRepresentation_monotone (D : Context H) :
    Monotone (scalarGNSRepresentation D) := by
  intro A B h
  have hp := scalarGNSRepresentation_nonneg D (B-A) (sub_nonneg.mpr h)
  rw [map_sub] at hp
  exact operator_le_of_sub_nonneg _ _ hp

/-- Normality in order of the actual representation on H_I. The strong limit
is constructed from the internal supremum, rather than supplied as a premise. -/
theorem scalarGNSRepresentation_preserves_positive_isLUB (D : Context H)
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (T : ι → D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra)
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ T i) (hmono : Monotone T)
    (hB : IsLUB (Set.range T) B) :
    IsLUB (Set.range (fun i => scalarGNSRepresentation D (T i)))
      (scalarGNSRepresentation D B) := by
  have hbound : ∀ i, ‖(T i).val‖ ≤ ‖B.val‖ := fun i =>
    CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_nonneg_of_le (hpos i) (hB.1 (Set.mem_range_self i))
  obtain ⟨Blim, _, _, hlim, _, hD⟩ := vonNeumann_exists_positive_isLUB
    D.algebra T hpos hmono ‖B.val‖ (norm_nonneg _) hbound
  have hDB : Blim = B := hD.unique hB
  subst Blim
  apply ChatgptAudit.Expectation047.monotone_strong_limit_isLUB
    (fun i => scalarGNSRepresentation D (T i))
  · intro i j hij
    exact scalarGNSRepresentation_monotone D (hmono hij)
  · exact scalarGNSRepresentation_tendsto_of_uniformly_bounded D T B ‖B.val‖ hbound hlim

/-- The same statement for all nonempty directed positive subsets of N.
This theorem does not identify the maximal scalar GNS domain or prove KMS. -/
theorem scalarGNSRepresentation_preserves_positive_directed_isLUB (D : Context H)
    (S : Set D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra)
    (B : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra)
    (hne : S.Nonempty) (hdir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) S)
    (hpos : ∀ A ∈ S, 0 ≤ A) (hB : IsLUB S B) :
    IsLUB (scalarGNSRepresentation D '' S) (scalarGNSRepresentation D B) := by
  letI : Nonempty S := hne.to_subtype
  letI : IsDirectedOrder S := hdir.isDirectedOrder
  have hrange : Set.range (fun A : S => (A : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra)) = S := by
    ext A
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Subtype.exists, exists_prop, exists_eq_right]
  have hnet := scalarGNSRepresentation_preserves_positive_isLUB D
    (fun A : S => (A : D.algebra.toStarSubalgebra)) B
    (fun A => hpos A A.property) (fun _ _ h => h) (hrange.symm ▸ hB)
  have himage : Set.range (fun A : S => scalarGNSRepresentation D A.val) =
      scalarGNSRepresentation D '' S := by
    ext A
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_image, Subtype.exists, exists_prop]
  rw [himage] at hnet
  exact hnet

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

positive energy spectrum and clock. beta is a parameter; no numerical value
is inserted. A device identification, its measured rates and its energy zero
are not consequences of this scalar algebra. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 500000
namespace F1Fecho.RootRateFrequency
noncomputable def rootRate (beta hbar high low : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  beta * (Real.sqrt high-Real.sqrt low)^2 / (2*hbar)
noncomputable def phaseFrequency (hbar high low : ℝ) : ℝ := (high-low)/hbar

theorem phase_pos (hbar high low : ℝ) (hh : 0<hbar) (he : low<high) :
    0 < phaseFrequency hbar high low := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr he) hh

theorem ratio_factor (beta hbar high low : ℝ) (hh : 0<hbar)
    (hl : 0≤low) (he : low<high) :
    rootRate beta hbar high low / phaseFrequency hbar high low =
      (beta/2) * ((Real.sqrt high-Real.sqrt low)/(Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low)) := by
  have hhigh : 0<high := lt_of_le_of_lt hl he
  have hs : Real.sqrt low<Real.sqrt high := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt hl he
  have hp : 0<Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hhigh) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hd : high-low=(Real.sqrt high-Real.sqrt low)*(Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low) := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hl, Real.sq_sqrt hhigh.le]
  unfold rootRate phaseFrequency
  rw [hd]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hh,ne_of_gt hp,sub_ne_zero.mpr hs.ne']
  <;> ring

theorem ratio_bounds (beta hbar high low : ℝ) (hb : 0<beta) (hh : 0<hbar)
    (hl : 0≤low) (he : low<high) :
    0 < rootRate beta hbar high low / phaseFrequency hbar high low ∧
    rootRate beta hbar high low / phaseFrequency hbar high low ≤ beta/2 := by
  rw [ratio_factor beta hbar high low hh hl he]
  have hs := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt hl he
  have hp : 0<Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hl he)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hratio : (Real.sqrt high-Real.sqrt low)/(Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low) ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one hp).mpr
    linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg low]
  constructor
  · exact mul_pos (div_pos hb (by norm_num)) (div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hs) hp)
  · nlinarith [div_pos hb (show (0:ℝ)<2 by norm_num)]

theorem upper_bound_iff_ground_zero (beta hbar high low : ℝ)
    (hb : 0<beta) (hh : 0<hbar) (hl : 0≤low) (he : low<high) :
    rootRate beta hbar high low / phaseFrequency hbar high low = beta/2 ↔ low=0 := by
  rw [ratio_factor beta hbar high low hh hl he]
  have hp : 0<Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hl he)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hr : (Real.sqrt high-Real.sqrt low)/(Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low)=1 := by
      nlinarith [div_pos hb (show (0:ℝ)<2 by norm_num)]
    have hs : Real.sqrt high-Real.sqrt low=Real.sqrt high+Real.sqrt low :=
      (div_eq_one_iff_eq (ne_of_gt hp)).mp hr
    have hz : Real.sqrt low=0 := by linarith

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ConjTranspose
import Mathlib.Tactic
/-!
The one-excitation jump already written in the device/clock contract is
J=|b><a|+|c><b| on the basis (a,b,c). This file formalizes the existing
Schrodinger-picture obstruction: its isolated dissipator is not unital,
whereas every Hermitian-jump dissipator annihilates the identity.
Thus no change by a unital algebra equivalence, even with nonzero time scaling,
identifies these isolated generators. This does not exclude a dilation,
effective reduction, additional balancing channels, or the full device model.
It does not concern the always-unital Heisenberg dual of a trace-preserving map.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 500000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.DeviceRootObstruction
open Matrix
abbrev M := Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ

def dissipator (L ρ : M) : M :=
  L * ρ * Lᴴ - (1/2 : ℂ) • (Lᴴ * L * ρ + ρ * Lᴴ * L)

theorem dissipator_one (L : M) : dissipator L 1 = L*Lᴴ-Lᴴ*L := by
  simp only [dissipator,mul_one,one_mul,smul_add,← add_smul]
  norm_num

theorem hermitian_jump_annihilates_one (L : M) (hL : Lᴴ=L) : dissipator L 1 = 0 := by
  rw [dissipator_one,hL,sub_self]

def deviceJump : M := fun i j => if (i.val=1 ∧ j.val=0) ∨ (i.val=2 ∧ j.val=1) then 1 else 0

theorem device_jump_on_one : dissipator deviceJump 1 = (fun i j => if i.val=j.val then (if i.val=0 then -1 else if i.val=2 then 1 else 0) else 0) := by
  rw [dissipator_one]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [deviceJump,Matrix.mul_apply,Fin.sum_univ_three,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]

theorem device_jump_not_unital : dissipator deviceJump 1 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun A : M => A 2 2) h
  rw [device_jump_on_one] at he
  norm_num at he

def generator (H L : M) (rate : ℂ) (ρ : M) : M :=
  -Complex.I • (H*ρ-ρ*H) + rate • dissipator L ρ

theorem generator_one (H L : M) (rate : ℂ) :
    generator H L rate 1 = rate • dissipator L 1 := by
  simp [generator]

theorem no_unital_conjugacy (H K L : M) (hL : Lᴴ=L)
    (rate otherRate : ℂ) (hrate : rate ≠ 0) (e : M ≃ₐ[ℂ] M) :
    ¬ ∀ ρ : M, generator H deviceJump rate ρ = e (generator K L otherRate (e.symm ρ)) := by
  intro h
  have he := h 1
  simp only [map_one,generator_one,hermitian_jump_annihilates_one L hL,
    smul_zero,map_zero] at he
  have hv := congrArg (fun A : M => A 2 2) he
  rw [device_jump_on_one] at hv
  simp at hv
  exact hrate hv

end F1Fecho.DeviceRootObstruction

exponentials. Only their previously proved continuity and Gram kernel are used.
No creation operator or vector differentiability is a premise. -/

open Complex Metric
namespace F1Fecho.Creation
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ F1Rede.BosonicFock F1Fecho.Exponential

theorem map_circleIntegral {E G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℂ G] [CompleteSpace G]
    (L : E →L[ℂ] G) (v : ℂ → E) (hv : CircleIntegrable v 0 1) :
    L (∮ z in C(0,1), v z) = ∮ z in C(0,1), L (v z) := by
  unfold circleIntegral
  rw [← L.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hv.out]
  congr 1
  funext t
  exact L.map_smul _ _

def integrand (f g : H1) (z : ℂ) : F := (1 / z^2) • exponential (g + z • f)

theorem integrand_integrable (f g : H1) : CircleIntegrable (integrand f g) 0 1 := by
  apply ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable (by norm_num)
  have hn : ∀ z ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) 1, z^2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz
    apply pow_ne_zero
    intro he
    simpa [he] using hz
  exact (continuousOn_const.div (continuousOn_id.pow 2) hn).smul
    ((ConcreteWeyl.exponential_continuous.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))).continuousOn)

def creationVector (f g : H1) : F :=
  (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∮ z in C(0,1), integrand f g z

theorem exponential_inner_creationVector (h f g : H1) :
    inner ℂ (exponential h) (creationVector f g) =
      inner ℂ h f * Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g) := by
  let L : F →L[ℂ] ℂ := innerSL ℂ (exponential h)
  let v : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g + z * inner ℂ h f)
  have hd (z : ℂ) : HasDerivAt v
      (Complex.exp (inner ℂ h g + z * inner ℂ h f) * inner ℂ h f) z := by
    simpa only [v,id_eq,one_mul] using
      (((hasDerivAt_id z).mul_const (inner ℂ h f)).const_add (inner ℂ h g)).cexp
  have hv : DifferentiableOn ℂ v (closedBall 0 1) :=
    fun z _ => (hd z).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hc := DifferentiableOn.deriv_eq_smul_circleIntegral (c := 0) (R := 1)
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) hv
  have hm : (fun z => L (integrand f g z)) = fun z => (1/z^2) • v z := by
    funext z
    simp only [L,integrand,innerSL_apply_apply,inner_smul_right,exponential_inner,
      inner_add_right,inner_smul_right,v,smul_eq_mul]
  change L ((2*Real.pi*I:ℂ)⁻¹ • ∮ z in C(0,1), integrand f g z) = _
  rw [map_smul,map_circleIntegral L _ (integrand_integrable f g),hm]
  simp only [sub_zero] at hc
  rw [hc,(hd 0).deriv]
  simp only [zero_mul,add_zero,smul_smul,inv_mul_cancel₀ two_pi_I_ne_zero,one_smul]
  exact mul_comm _ _

end F1Fecho.Creation

def creationCombination (f : H1) : (H1 →₀ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] F :=

theorem inner_creationCombination (f h : H1) (c : H1 →₀ ℂ) :
    inner ℂ (exponential h) (creationCombination f c) =
      inner ℂ h f * inner ℂ (exponential h) (synthesize c) := by
  classical
  simp only [creationCombination,synthesize,Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,Finsupp.sum,
    inner_sum,inner_smul_right,exponential_inner_creationVector,exponential_inner,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g hg
  ring

theorem creationCombination_kernel (f : H1) (c : H1 →₀ ℂ) (hc : synthesize c = 0) :
    creationCombination f c = 0 := by
  apply exponential_orthogonal_zero
  intro h
  apply inner_eq_zero_symm.mp
  rw [inner_creationCombination,hc,inner_zero_right,mul_zero]

theorem creationCombination_eq (f : H1) (c d : H1 →₀ ℂ)
    (h : synthesize c = synthesize d) : creationCombination f c = creationCombination f d := by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← map_sub]
  apply creationCombination_kernel
  rw [map_sub,h,sub_self]

  toFun x := creationCombination f (preimage x)
  map_add' x y := by
    rw [← map_add]
    apply creationCombination_eq
    rw [map_add,preimage_spec,preimage_spec,preimage_spec]
    rfl
  map_smul' z x := by
    change creationCombination f (preimage (z • x)) = z • creationCombination f (preimage x)
    rw [← map_smul]
    apply creationCombination_eq
    rw [map_smul,preimage_spec,preimage_spec]
    rfl

  domain := domain
  toFun := creationOnDomain f

theorem creation_exponential (f g : H1) :
    creation f ⟨exponential g,exponential_mem_domain g⟩ = creationVector f g := by
  change creationCombination f (preimage ⟨exponential g,exponential_mem_domain g⟩) = _
  have h := creationCombination_eq f (preimage ⟨exponential g,exponential_mem_domain g⟩)
    (Finsupp.single g 1) (by rw [preimage_spec]; simp [synthesize])
  simpa [creationCombination] using h

    inner ℂ (weighted f c) (synthesize d) =
      inner ℂ (synthesize c) (creationCombination f d) := by
  classical
  change inner ℂ (∑ h ∈ c.support,c h • (inner ℂ f h • exponential h)) (synthesize d) =
    inner ℂ (∑ h ∈ c.support,c h • exponential h) (creationCombination f d)
  simp only [sum_inner,inner_smul_left,inner_creationCombination,inner_conj_symm]

  have h := finite_pairing f (preimage x) (preimage y)
  rw [preimage_spec,preimage_spec] at h
  exact h

theorem creation_le_annihilation_adjoint (f : H1) : creation f ≤ (annihilation f).adjoint :=
  (annihilation_creation_formalAdjoint f).le_adjoint domain_dense

theorem annihilation_le_creation_adjoint (f : H1) : annihilation f ≤ (creation f).adjoint :=

theorem annihilation_has_closed_extension (f : H1) :

    annihilation_le_creation_adjoint f⟩

theorem creation_has_closed_extension (f : H1) :
    ∃ T : F →ₗ.[ℂ] F, T.IsClosed ∧ creation f ≤ T :=
  ⟨(annihilation f).adjoint,LinearPMap.adjoint_isClosed domain_dense,

    inner ℂ (exponential h) (oneParticle f) = inner ℂ h f := by
  change inner ℂ (exponential h) (lp.single 2 1 (oneParticleEmbedding f)) = _
  rw [lp.inner_single_right]
  change inner ℂ (component h 1) (pureTensor 1 f) = _
  have hw : (weight 1 : ℂ) = 1 := by norm_num [weight]
  rw [component,hw,one_smul]
  exact (pureTensor_inner h f 1).trans (pow_one _)

theorem creationVector_zero (f : H1) : creationVector f 0 = oneParticle f := by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply exponential_orthogonal_zero
  intro h
  apply inner_eq_zero_symm.mp
  rw [inner_sub_right,exponential_inner_creationVector,exponential_inner_oneParticle]
  simp

theorem creation_vacuum (f : H1) : creation f ⟨vacuum,vacuum_mem_domain⟩ = oneParticle f := by
  have h := creation_exponential f 0
  simpa only [exponential_zero,creationVector_zero] using h

def segal (f : H1) : F →ₗ.[ℂ] F where
  domain := domain
  toFun := ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) • (onDomain f + creationOnDomain f)

theorem segal_formal_selfadjoint (f : H1) : (segal f).IsFormalAdjoint (segal f) := by
  intro x y
  change inner ℂ (((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) • (annihilation f x + creation f x)) (y : F) =
    inner ℂ (x : F) (((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) • (annihilation f y + creation f y))
  rw [inner_smul_left,inner_smul_right,inner_add_left,inner_add_right]
  rw [annihilation_creation_formalAdjoint f x y,

namespace F1Fecho.OrbitalSpatial
open TGLExt ChatgptAudit.WignerOrbit016 ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016

def longitudinalUnit : Spatial := spatialChart (0,1)

theorem longitudinalUnit_norm : ‖longitudinalUnit‖=1 := by
  have h := spatialChart_norm_sq ((0 : Transverse),1)
  change ‖longitudinalUnit‖^2=0^2+0^2+1^2 at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg longitudinalUnit]

theorem lorentz_time_column_norm (L : LorentzGrp) :
    (lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0)^2=1+‖spatialPart (lorentzLinear L timeBasis)‖^2 := by
  have h := orbitPairing_lorentz L timeBasis timeBasis
  rw [orbitPairing_spatial] at h
  change (lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0)*(lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0)-
    inner ℝ (spatialPart (lorentzLinear L timeBasis)) (spatialPart (lorentzLinear L timeBasis))=
    orbitPairing timeBasis timeBasis at h
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h
  have hb : orbitPairing timeBasis timeBasis=1 := by
    change (1:ℝ)*1-0*0-0*0-0*0=1
    norm_num
  rw [hb] at h
  nlinarith

theorem boost_time_column (s : ℝ) :
    (theBoost s).val.mulVec timeBasis=![Real.cosh s,Real.sinh s,0,0] := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [theBoost,boostMat,timeBasis,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Fin.sum_univ_four]

theorem spatialPart_boost_time (r : ℝ) :
    spatialPart ((theBoost (Real.arsinh r)).val.mulVec timeBasis)=r • longitudinalUnit := by
  rw [boost_time_column,Real.sinh_arsinh]
  change spatialChart (![0,0],r)=r • spatialChart ((0 : Transverse),1)
  have hz : (![0,0] : Transverse)=0 := by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hz,←spatialChart_smul]
  congr 1
  simp

theorem spatialLorentz_mem_generated (Q : Spatial≃ₗᵢ[ℝ]Spatial) :
    spatialLorentz Q ∈ generatedLorentz := by
  let q : SpatialOrthogonal := Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm Q
  have hq : Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv q=Q := Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply Q
  have h := spatial_mem_generated q
  change spatialLorentz (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv q) ∈ generatedLorentz at h
  rwa [hq] at h

theorem future_lorentz_mem_generated (L : LorentzGrp)
    (hf : 0 < lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0) : L ∈ generatedLorentz := by
  let v := spatialPart (lorentzLinear L timeBasis)
  let r := ‖v‖
  let s := Real.arsinh r
  let w := r • longitudinalUnit
  have hn : ‖w‖=‖v‖ := by
    simp only [w,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg v),longitudinalUnit_norm,mul_one,r]
  let Q : Spatial≃ₗᵢ[ℝ]Spatial := (ℝ ∙ (w-v))ᗮ.reflection
  have hQ : Q w=v := Submodule.reflection_sub hn
  have hc : Real.cosh s=lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0 := by
    rw [Real.cosh_arsinh]
    have ht : 1+r^2=(lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0)^2 := (lorentz_time_column_norm L).symm
    rw [ht,Real.sqrt_sq hf.le]
  let B : LorentzGrp := spatialLorentz Q*theBoost s
  have hB : B ∈ generatedLorentz :=
    generatedLorentz.mul_mem (spatialLorentz_mem_generated Q) (boost_mem_generated s)
  have hcol : B.val.mulVec timeBasis=L.val.mulVec timeBasis := by
    change (spatialMatrix Q*boostMat s).mulVec timeBasis=L.val.mulVec timeBasis
    rw [←Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,spatialMatrix_mulVec]
    apply spacetime_ext
    · change (boostMat s).mulVec timeBasis 0=lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0
      change ((theBoost s).val.mulVec timeBasis) 0=_
      rw [boost_time_column]
      exact hc
    · rw [spacetimeSpatial_rotation]
      change Q (spatialPart ((theBoost (Real.arsinh r)).val.mulVec timeBasis))=v
      rw [spatialPart_boost_time]
      exact hQ
  have hfix : lorentzLinear (B⁻¹*L) timeBasis=timeBasis := by
    change ((B⁻¹).val*L.val).mulVec timeBasis=timeBasis
    rw [←Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,←hcol,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,←lorentzGrp_mul_val,
      inv_mul_cancel,lorentzGrp_one_val,Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hrest := lorentz_fixed_time_mem_generated (B⁻¹*L) hfix
  have h := generatedLorentz.mul_mem hB hrest
  simpa only [←mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel,one_mul] using h

def futureLorentzUnitary (L : LorentzGrp) (hf : 0 < lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0) :=
  generatedUnitary ⟨L,future_lorentz_mem_generated L hf⟩

theorem futureLorentzUnitary_U1 (L : LorentzGrp) (hf : 0 < lorentzLinear L timeBasis 0)
    (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (f : TGLExt.ImportedSQ.H1) :
    futureLorentzUnitary L hf (TGLExt.ImportedSQ.U1 a f)=
      TGLExt.ImportedSQ.U1 (L.val.mulVec a) (futureLorentzUnitary L hf f) :=
  generatedUnitary_U1 ⟨L,future_lorentz_mem_generated L hf⟩ a f

end F1Fecho.OrbitalSpatial

theorem exists_nonzero_graph_input : ∃ x y : GNSHilbert, x≠0 ∧ (x,y) ∈ initialGraph := by

  let a : core.toStarSubalgebra := ⟨star B*B,
    core.mul_mem (core.toStarSubalgebra.star_mem'
      (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mem fockFlow M 1))
      (F1Fecho.RegularCoreAverage.regularAverage_mem fockFlow M 1)⟩

      simpa only [weight,averageSquare,inv_one,ENNReal.ofReal_one,a,B] using

    HasFiniteDualSquare.left_mul (star B) B
      (F1Fecho.RegularCoreFiniteWeight.regularAverage_hasFiniteDualSquare fockFlow 1 zero_lt_one)
  have hs : HasFiniteDualSquare (star a.val) := by
    have he : star a.val=a.val := IsSelfAdjoint.star_mul_self B
    exact he.symm ▸ hf
  let A : starDomain := ⟨a,hf,hs⟩
  refine ⟨scalarGNSStarEmbedding weightContext A,
    scalarGNSStarEmbedding weightContext (star A),?_,⟨A,rfl⟩⟩
  intro h
  have he : F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS.GNSEmbedding weightContext ⟨a,hf⟩ =
      F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS.GNSEmbedding weightContext 0 := by
    exact h.trans (F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS.GNSEmbedding weightContext).map_zero.symm
  have hz := F1Fecho.RegularScalarGNS.GNSEmbedding_injective weightContext he
  exact ha (congrArg Subtype.val hz)

import TGLExt.V350AntilinearAdjointGraph
import TGLExt.V350AntilinearComposition
import TGLExt.V350ClosedAntilinearResolvent
import TGLExt.V350PositiveSurjectiveResolvent
import TGLExt.V350PartialPositiveResolvent
import TGLExt.V351ResolventImaginaryContinuity
/-! The positive selfadjoint operator S_nu^* S_nu and its bounded resolvent
on any Hilbert space carrying a closed dense antilinear involution. Its domain is the exact adjoint
composition domain. No equality with regular or geometric modular flow is
inserted; the scalar weight is not called a scaled trace. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxErrors 2
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.ClosedTomitaOperator
open TGLExt TGLV350.Regular
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
structure Input (H : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] where
  domain : Submodule ℂ H
  operator : domain →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] H
  dense : Dense (domain : Set H)
  closed : IsClosed (Set.range (fun x : domain => ((x : H), operator x)))
  maps_domain : ∀ x : domain, operator x ∈ domain
  involutive : ∀ x : domain, operator ⟨operator x,maps_domain x⟩ = x
variable (A : Input H)
local instance : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.instLoewnerPartialOrder (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H)
abbrev scalarClosedTomitaDomain := A.domain
abbrev scalarClosedTomita := A.operator
 theorem scalarClosedTomita_domain_dense : Dense (scalarClosedTomitaDomain A : Set H) := A.dense
 theorem scalarClosedTomita_is_closed : IsClosed (Set.range (fun x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain A => ((x:H),scalarClosedTomita A x))) := A.closed
 theorem scalarClosedTomita_maps_domain (x:scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) : scalarClosedTomita A x ∈ scalarClosedTomitaDomain A := A.maps_domain x
 theorem scalarClosedTomita_involutive (x:scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) : scalarClosedTomita A ⟨scalarClosedTomita A x,scalarClosedTomita_maps_domain A x⟩ = x := A.involutive x
def scalarTomitaAdjointDomain : Submodule ℂ (H) :=
  maximalAntilinearAdjointDomain (H := H) (scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) (scalarClosedTomita A)

/-- The maximal complex-antilinear adjoint of the same closed operator on the given Hilbert space. -/
def scalarTomitaAdjoint : H →ₛₗ.[starRingEnd ℂ] H :=
  maximalAntilinearAdjoint (H := H) (scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) (scalarClosedTomita A)
    (scalarClosedTomita_domain_dense A )

theorem scalarTomitaAdjoint_pairing (y : scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A)
    (x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) :
    inner ℂ (scalarClosedTomita A x) (y : H) =
      inner ℂ (scalarTomitaAdjoint A y) (x : H) :=
  maximalAntilinearAdjoint_pairing (H := H) _ _ _ y x

theorem scalarTomitaAdjoint_maximal {y z : H}
    (h : ∀ x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain A,
      inner ℂ (scalarClosedTomita A x) y = inner ℂ z (x : H)) :
    ∃ hy : y ∈ scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A, scalarTomitaAdjoint A ⟨y,hy⟩ = z :=
  maximalAntilinearAdjoint_maximal (H := H) _ _ _ h

theorem scalarTomitaAdjoint_domain_iff (y : H) :
    y ∈ scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A ↔ ∃ z : H,
      ∀ x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain A,
        inner ℂ (scalarClosedTomita A x) y = inner ℂ z (x : H) := Iff.rfl

theorem scalarTomitaAdjoint_isClosed :
    IsClosed (Set.range (fun y : scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A =>
      ((y : H),scalarTomitaAdjoint A y))) :=
  maximalAntilinearAdjoint_isClosed (H := H) _ _ _


/-- The composition domain is exactly x in D(S) with Sx in D(S†). -/
def scalarTomitaSquareDomain : Submodule ℂ (H) :=
  antilinearPreimageDomain (H := H) (scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) (scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A)
    (scalarClosedTomita A)

def scalarTomitaSquareInput : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A →ₗ[ℂ]
    scalarClosedTomitaDomain A :=
  antilinearPreimageInput (H := H) _ _ _

theorem scalarTomitaSquareInput_coe (x : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A) :
    (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x : H) = x := rfl

theorem scalarTomitaSquareInput_image_mem (x : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A) :
    scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x) ∈ scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A :=
  antilinearPreimageInput_mem (H := H) _ _ _ x

def scalarTomitaSquareAdjointInput : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ]
    scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A :=
  antilinearPreimageMap (H := H) _ _ _

/-- The actual complex-linear composition. Self-adjointness is not part of
this definition and must be proved separately. -/
def scalarTomitaSquare : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H where
  domain := scalarTomitaSquareDomain A
  toFun := (antilinearComposite (scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) (scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A)
    (scalarClosedTomita A) (scalarTomitaAdjoint A).toFun).toFun

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_domain_iff (x : H) :
    x ∈ (scalarTomitaSquare A).domain ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ scalarClosedTomitaDomain A,
        scalarClosedTomita A ⟨x,hx⟩ ∈ scalarTomitaAdjointDomain A := Iff.rfl

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_apply (x : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A) :
    scalarTomitaSquare A x = scalarTomitaAdjoint A
      ⟨scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x),
        scalarTomitaSquareInput_image_mem A x⟩ := rfl

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_pairing (x : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A)
    (y : scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) :
    inner ℂ (scalarTomitaSquare A x) (y : H) =
      inner ℂ (scalarClosedTomita A y)
        (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x)) :=
  (scalarTomitaAdjoint_pairing A (scalarTomitaSquareAdjointInput A x) y).symm

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_symmetric :
    (scalarTomitaSquare A).IsFormalAdjoint (scalarTomitaSquare A) := by
  intro x y
  calc
    _ = inner ℂ (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A y))
        (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x)) :=
      scalarTomitaSquare_pairing A x (scalarTomitaSquareInput A y)
    _ = (starRingEnd ℂ) (inner ℂ
        (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x))
        (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A y))) :=
      (inner_conj_symm (𝕜 := ℂ)
        (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A y))
        (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x))).symm
    _ = (starRingEnd ℂ) (inner ℂ (scalarTomitaSquare A y) (x : H)) :=
      congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (scalarTomitaSquare_pairing A y (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x)).symm
    _ = _ := inner_conj_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) (x : H) (scalarTomitaSquare A y)

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_quadratic (x : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A) :
    (inner ℂ (x : H) (scalarTomitaSquare A x)).re =
      ‖scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x)‖^2 := by
  calc
    _ = (inner ℂ (scalarTomitaSquare A x) (x : H)).re :=
      inner_re_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) (x : H) (scalarTomitaSquare A x)
    _ = (inner ℂ (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x))
        (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x))).re :=
      congrArg Complex.re (scalarTomitaSquare_pairing A x (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x))
    _ = _ := (norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x))).symm

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_positive (x : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A) :
    0 ≤ (inner ℂ (x : H) (scalarTomitaSquare A x)).re := by
  rw [scalarTomitaSquare_quadratic A]
  exact sq_nonneg _

#print axioms scalarTomitaSquareDomain
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquareInput
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquareInput_coe
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquareInput_image_mem
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquareAdjointInput
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_domain_iff
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_apply
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_pairing
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_symmetric
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_quadratic
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_positive

/-- The full range of I+S†S is obtained from the same closed graph of S. -/
theorem scalarTomitaSquare_resolvent_surjective (z : H) :
    ∃ x : (scalarTomitaSquare A).domain,
      (x : H)+scalarTomitaSquare A x=z := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := closedAntilinear_complex_resolvent (H := H)
    (scalarClosedTomitaDomain A) (scalarClosedTomita A)
    (scalarClosedTomita_is_closed A ) z
  obtain ⟨hy,hval⟩ := scalarTomitaAdjoint_maximal A hx
  let w : scalarTomitaSquareDomain A := ⟨(x : H),x.property,hy⟩
  refine ⟨w,?_⟩
  change (x : H)+scalarTomitaAdjoint A ⟨scalarClosedTomita A x,hy⟩=z
  rw [hval]
  abel

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_domain_dense :
    Dense ((scalarTomitaSquare A).domain : Set (H)) :=
  positive_surjective_resolvent_domain_dense (H := H) (scalarTomitaSquare A)
    (scalarTomitaSquare_positive A) (scalarTomitaSquare_resolvent_surjective A)

/-- Actual self-adjointness on the composition domain, not a separate model. -/
theorem scalarTomitaSquare_selfadjoint : IsSelfAdjoint (scalarTomitaSquare A) :=
  positive_surjective_resolvent_selfadjoint (H := H) (scalarTomitaSquare A)
    (scalarTomitaSquare_positive A) (scalarTomitaSquare_resolvent_surjective A)
    (scalarTomitaSquare_symmetric A)

theorem scalarTomitaSquare_isClosed : (scalarTomitaSquare A).IsClosed :=
  (scalarTomitaSquare_selfadjoint A).isClosed

theorem scalarClosedTomita_zero_only (x : scalarClosedTomitaDomain A)
    (hz : scalarClosedTomita A x=0) : (x : H)=0 := by
  have hh : (⟨scalarClosedTomita A x,scalarClosedTomita_maps_domain A x⟩ :
      scalarClosedTomitaDomain A)=0 := Subtype.ext hz
  have hi := scalarClosedTomita_involutive A x
  rw [hh,map_zero] at hi
  exact hi.symm

/-- The positive self-adjoint composition has no zero vector in its kernel
apart from zero; no spectral gap is asserted. -/
theorem scalarTomitaSquare_zero_only (x : (scalarTomitaSquare A).domain)
    (hz : scalarTomitaSquare A x=0) : (x : H)=0 := by
  have hq := scalarTomitaSquare_quadratic A x
  rw [hz,inner_zero_right] at hq
  have hn : ‖scalarClosedTomita A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x)‖=0 :=
    (sq_eq_zero_iff).mp hq.symm
  exact scalarClosedTomita_zero_only A (scalarTomitaSquareInput A x) (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)

#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_resolvent_surjective
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_domain_dense
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_selfadjoint
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_isClosed
#print axioms scalarClosedTomita_zero_only
#print axioms scalarTomitaSquare_zero_only

/-- A bounded resolvent of the actual S†S, on the same scalar GNS Hilbert space. -/
def scalarTomitaResolvent : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  partialPositiveResolvent (H := H) (scalarTomitaSquare A) (scalarTomitaSquare_positive A)
    (scalarTomitaSquare_resolvent_surjective A)

/-! Strongly continuous imaginary powers of the actual positive operator
S_nu^* S_nu, on the Hilbert space of a closed dense antilinear involution. The complement of
its bounded resolvent is injective because the square has trivial kernel.
This is not an identification with the regular conjugation group, KMS, or
an exp(-s)-scaled trace. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxErrors 2
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.ClosedTomitaFlow
open TGLExt TGLV350.Regular
open F1Fecho.ClosedTomitaOperator
variable {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (A : Input H)
local instance : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.instLoewnerPartialOrder (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H)

theorem scalarTomitaResolvent_complement_injective :
    Function.Injective (1-scalarTomitaResolvent A : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
  intro x y h
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  have hz : (1-scalarTomitaResolvent A : H →L[ℂ] H) (x-y)=0 := by
    rw [map_sub,h,sub_self]
  have hfix : scalarTomitaResolvent A (x-y)=x-y := by
    change (x-y)-scalarTomitaResolvent A (x-y)=0 at hz
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm
  obtain ⟨z,hzv,heq⟩ := scalarTomitaResolvent_equation A (x-y)
  have he : (z:H)=x-y := hzv.trans hfix
  have hd : scalarTomitaSquare A z=0 := by
    rw [he] at heq
    exact add_left_cancel (heq.trans (add_zero (x-y)).symm)
  exact he.symm.trans (scalarTomitaSquare_zero_only A z hd)
/-- Imaginary powers of the same S†S, defined by its already identified resolvent.
No identification with the regular modular automorphism is claimed here. -/
def scalarTomitaImaginaryPower (t : ℝ) : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H :=
  resolventImaginaryPower (H := H) (scalarTomitaResolvent A) (scalarTomitaResolvent_nonneg A)
    (scalarTomitaResolvent_le_one A) (scalarTomitaResolvent_injective A)
    (scalarTomitaResolvent_complement_injective A) t

theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_damping (t : ℝ) (x : H) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A t (resolventDampingOperator (H := H) (scalarTomitaResolvent A) x)=
      resolventPhaseOperator (H := H) (scalarTomitaResolvent A) t x :=
  resolventImaginaryPower_damping (H := H) _ _ _ _ _ t x

/-- The dense-range identity uniquely specifies this operator among bounded maps. -/
theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_unique (t : ℝ)
    (U : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hU : ∀ x, U (resolventDampingOperator (H := H) (scalarTomitaResolvent A) x)=
      resolventPhaseOperator (H := H) (scalarTomitaResolvent A) t x) (x : H) :
    U x=scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A t x := by
  refine (resolventDampingOperator_denseRange (H := H) (scalarTomitaResolvent A)
    (scalarTomitaResolvent_nonneg A) (scalarTomitaResolvent_le_one A)
    (scalarTomitaResolvent_injective A) (scalarTomitaResolvent_complement_injective A)).induction ?_
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) x
  rintro _ ⟨y,rfl⟩
  rw [hU,scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_damping A]

theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_zero (x : H) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A 0 x=x :=
  resolventImaginaryPower_zero (H := H) _ _ _ _ _ x

theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_add (s t : ℝ) (x : H) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A s (scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A t x)=
      scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A (s+t) x :=
  resolventImaginaryPower_add (H := H) _ _ _ _ _ s t x

theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_strongly_continuous (x : H) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A t x) :=
  resolventImaginaryPower_strongly_continuous (H := H) _ _ _ _ _ x

theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_inverse (t : ℝ) (x : H) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A (-t) (scalarTomitaImaginaryPower A t x)=x := by
  rw [scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_add A,neg_add_cancel,scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_zero A]

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.LinearPMap
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic
/-! A closed symmetric operator is self-adjoint when both actual adjoint
nonreal eigenspaces vanish. Proof by projection onto its closed L2 graph.
No self-adjoint extension or resolvent surjectivity is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

 theorem selfAdjoint_of_no_deficiency (G : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H)
    (hc : G.IsClosed) (hs : G.IsFormalAdjoint G) (hd : Dense (G.domain : Set H))
    (hplus : ∀ x : H, (x,Complex.I • x) ∈ G.adjoint.graph → x=0)
    (hminus : ∀ x : H, (x,-Complex.I • x) ∈ G.adjoint.graph → x=0) :
    IsSelfAdjoint G := by
  have hsub := hs.le_adjoint hd
  apply LinearPMap.isSelfAdjoint_def.mpr
  apply le_antisymm _ hsub
  apply LinearPMap.le_of_le_graph
  intro p hp
  let E := WithLp 2 (H × H)
  let e : E ≃L[ℂ] H × H := WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ H H
  let L : Submodule ℂ E := G.graph.comap e.toLinearMap
  have hL : IsClosed (L : Set E) := hc.preimage e.continuous
  letI : CompleteSpace L := hL.completeSpace_coe
  let w : E := e.symm p
  let q : E := L.starProjection w
  let r : E := w-q
  have hq : e q ∈ G.graph := Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem L w
  have hr : e r ∈ G.adjoint.graph := by
    change e (w-q) ∈ G.adjoint.graph
    rw [map_sub]
    apply G.adjoint.graph.sub_mem
    · simpa only [w,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hp
    · exact LinearPMap.le_graph_of_le hsub hq
  have horth (x : G.domain) : inner ℂ r (e.symm ((x:H),G x))=0 := by
    apply Submodule.starProjection_inner_eq_zero w _
    change e (e.symm ((x:H),G x)) ∈ G.graph
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using G.mem_graph x
  let u := (e r).1
  let v := (e r).2
  have hswap : (v,-u) ∈ G.adjoint.graph := by
    rw [LinearPMap.adjoint_graph_eq_graph_adjoint hd,Submodule.mem_adjoint_iff]
    intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := G.mem_graph_iff'.mp hab
    have hx1 : (x:H)=a := congrArg Prod.fst hx
    have hx2 : G x=b := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    rw [← hx1,← hx2]
    have hh := horth x
    change inner ℂ u (x:H) + inner ℂ v (G x)=0 at hh
    have hh' := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) hh
    simp only [map_add,map_zero,inner_conj_symm] at hh'
    simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd,inner_neg_right,sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact (add_comm _ _).trans hh'
  have hm : u+Complex.I • v=0 := by
    apply hminus
    have hh := G.adjoint.graph.add_mem hr (G.adjoint.graph.smul_mem Complex.I hswap)
    convert hh using 1
    ext <;> simp [u,v,smul_add,smul_smul,neg_smul,Complex.I_sq] <;> module
  have hp' : u-Complex.I • v=0 := by
    apply hplus
    have hh := G.adjoint.graph.sub_mem hr (G.adjoint.graph.smul_mem Complex.I hswap)
    convert hh using 1
    ext <;> simp [u,v,smul_sub,smul_smul,neg_smul,Complex.I_sq] <;> module
  have hu : u=0 := by
    have h2 : (2:ℂ) • u=0 := by
      calc
        (2:ℂ) • u=(u+Complex.I • v)+(u-Complex.I • v) := by module
        _=0 := by rw [hm,hp',add_zero]
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  have hv : v=0 := by
    rw [hu,zero_add] at hm
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_left Complex.I_ne_zero
  have hr0 : r=0 := by
    apply e.injective
    exact (Prod.ext hu hv).trans (map_zero e).symm
  have he : w=q := sub_eq_zero.mp hr0
  have hw : e w ∈ G.graph := by rw [he]; exact hq
  simpa only [w,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hw

end F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion
#print axioms F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion.selfAdjoint_of_no_deficiency

import TGLExt.F1Fecho394.DeficiencyCriterionR5
/-! Adjoint and closure identities for densely defined symmetric operators.
The final criterion proves essential self-adjointness from actual deficiency
spaces, rather than assuming a self-adjoint extension. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

theorem submodule_adjoint_closure (L : Submodule ℂ (H × H)) :
    L.topologicalClosure.adjoint = L.adjoint := by
  ext p
  rw [Submodule.mem_adjoint_iff,Submodule.mem_adjoint_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h a b hab
    exact h a b (L.le_topologicalClosure hab)
  · intro h a b hab
    have hc : IsClosed {q : H × H | inner ℂ q.2 p.1 - inner ℂ q.1 p.2=0} :=
      isClosed_eq ((continuous_snd.inner continuous_const).sub
        (continuous_fst.inner continuous_const)) continuous_const
    have hs : _root_.closure (L : Set (H × H)) ⊆
        {q : H × H | inner ℂ q.2 p.1-inner ℂ q.1 p.2=0} := by
      apply hc.closure_subset_iff.mpr
      rintro ⟨x,y⟩ hxy
      exact h x y hxy
    exact hs hab

theorem adjoint_closure (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hd : Dense (A.domain : Set H))
    (hc : A.IsClosable) : A.closure.adjoint=A.adjoint := by
  have hd' : Dense (A.closure.domain : Set H) := hd.mono A.le_closure.1
  apply LinearPMap.eq_of_eq_graph
  rw [LinearPMap.adjoint_graph_eq_graph_adjoint hd',
    ← hc.graph_closure_eq_closure_graph,submodule_adjoint_closure,
    LinearPMap.adjoint_graph_eq_graph_adjoint hd]

theorem symmetric_closable (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hd : Dense (A.domain : Set H))
    (hs : A.IsFormalAdjoint A) : A.IsClosable :=
  (LinearPMap.adjoint_isClosed hd).isClosable.leIsClosable (hs.le_adjoint hd)

theorem closure_le_adjoint (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hd : Dense (A.domain : Set H))
    (hs : A.IsFormalAdjoint A) : A.closure ≤ A.adjoint := by
  apply LinearPMap.le_of_le_graph
  rw [← (symmetric_closable A hd hs).graph_closure_eq_closure_graph]
  exact (LinearPMap.adjoint_isClosed hd).closure_subset_iff.mpr
    (LinearPMap.le_graph_of_le (hs.le_adjoint hd))

theorem closure_formal_selfadjoint (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (hd : Dense (A.domain : Set H))
    (hs : A.IsFormalAdjoint A) : A.closure.IsFormalAdjoint A.closure := by
  have hd' : Dense (A.closure.domain : Set H) := hd.mono A.le_closure.1
  have hsub : A.closure ≤ A.closure.adjoint := by
    rw [adjoint_closure A hd (symmetric_closable A hd hs)]
    exact closure_le_adjoint A hd hs
  intro x y
  let z : A.closure.adjoint.domain := ⟨x,hsub.1 x.property⟩
  have hh := LinearPMap.adjoint_isFormalAdjoint hd' z y
  have he : A.closure x=A.closure.adjoint z := hsub.2 rfl
  rw [← he] at hh
  exact hh

theorem essentialSelfAdjoint_of_no_deficiency (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H)
    (hd : Dense (A.domain : Set H)) (hs : A.IsFormalAdjoint A)
    (hplus : ∀ x : H, (x,Complex.I • x) ∈ A.adjoint.graph → x=0)
    (hminus : ∀ x : H, (x,-Complex.I • x) ∈ A.adjoint.graph → x=0) :
    IsSelfAdjoint A.closure := by
  have hc := symmetric_closable A hd hs
  apply selfAdjoint_of_no_deficiency A.closure hc.closure_isClosed
    (closure_formal_selfadjoint A hd hs) (hd.mono A.le_closure.1)
  · simpa only [adjoint_closure A hd hc] using hplus
  · simpa only [adjoint_closure A hd hc] using hminus

end F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion

import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.RealDeriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ExpDeriv
import Mathlib.Tactic
/-! A bounded scalar orbit cannot have a nonzero real exponential growth
rate. Used to eliminate adjoint deficiency vectors of a unitary generator. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion

theorem bounded_growth_zero (f : ℝ → ℂ) (a C : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt f ((a:ℂ)*f t) t)
    (hb : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) : f 0=0 := by
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (Real.exp (-a*t):ℂ)*f t
  have hg (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt g 0 t := by
    have he := (((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (-a)).exp).ofReal_comp
    have hh := he.mul (hd t)
    convert! hh using 1 <;> simp [g,Pi.mul_apply] <;> ring
  have hconst (t : ℝ) : (Real.exp (-a*t):ℂ)*f t=f 0 := by
    simpa [g] using is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun t => (hg t).differentiableAt)
      (fun t => (hg t).deriv) t 0
  have hsolve (t : ℝ) : (Real.exp (a*t):ℂ)*f 0=f t := by
    rw [← hconst t,← mul_assoc,← Complex.ofReal_mul,← Real.exp_add]
    simp
  by_contra hf
  have hn : 0<‖f 0‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hf
  have hC : 0≤C := le_trans (norm_nonneg (f 0)) (hb 0)
  let u := C/‖f 0‖+1
  have hu : 0<u := by dsimp [u]; positivity
  let t := Real.log u/a
  have hat : a*t=Real.log u := by dsimp [t]; field_simp
  have hnorm : ‖f t‖=u*‖f 0‖ := by
    rw [← hsolve t,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
      hat,Real.exp_log hu]
  have ht := hb t
  rw [hnorm] at ht
  have hu' : u*‖f 0‖=C+‖f 0‖ := by dsimp [u]; field_simp <;> ring
  rw [hu'] at ht
  linarith

end F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion

noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion
open Complex
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (U : ℝ → H →L[ℂ] H) (c : ℝ)
variable (hzero : ∀ x : H, U 0 x=x)
variable (hadd : ∀ s t : ℝ, ∀ x : H, U (s+t) x=U s (U t x))
variable (hnorm : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ x : H, ‖U t x‖=‖x‖)
variable (hinv : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ x : A.domain, U t (x:H) ∈ A.domain)
variable (hder : ∀ x : A.domain, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => U t (x:H))
  ((I*(c:ℂ)) • A x) 0)

include hadd hder in
theorem invariant_orbit_derivative (x : A.domain) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => U s (x:H))
      ((I*(c:ℂ)) • A ⟨U t (x:H),hinv t x⟩) t := by
  have hh := hder ⟨U t (x:H),hinv t x⟩
  have hh' : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => U s (U t (x:H)))
      ((I*(c:ℂ)) • A ⟨U t (x:H),hinv t x⟩) (t-t) := by simpa using hh
  have hs := hh'.comp_sub_const t t
  convert! hs using 1
  funext s
  rw [← hadd,sub_add_cancel]

include hzero hadd hnorm hinv hder in
theorem adjoint_imaginary_eigen_zero (hd : Dense (A.domain : Set H)) (hc : c≠0)
    (y : A.adjoint.domain) (a : ℝ) (ha : a≠0)
    (he : A.adjoint y=(I*(a:ℂ)) • (y:H)) : (y:H)=0 := by
  apply hd.eq_zero_of_inner_left ℂ
  intro x hx
  let v : A.domain := ⟨x,hx⟩
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => inner ℂ (y:H) (U t x)
  have hf (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f (((c*a:ℝ):ℂ)*f t) t := by
    have ht := invariant_orbit_derivative A U c hadd hinv hder v t
    have hp := (((innerSL ℂ (y:H)).restrictScalars ℝ).hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt t ht
    have hpair := LinearPMap.adjoint_isFormalAdjoint hd y ⟨U t x,hinv t v⟩
    rw [he,inner_smul_left] at hpair
    change HasDerivAt f (inner ℂ (y:H) ((I*(c:ℂ)) • A ⟨U t x,hinv t v⟩)) t at hp
    rw [inner_smul_right,← hpair] at hp
    convert! hp using 1
    simp only [map_mul,Complex.conj_I,Complex.conj_ofReal,Complex.ofReal_mul]
    simp only [f]

    simp
  have hb (t : ℝ) : ‖f t‖ ≤ ‖(y:H)‖*‖x‖ := by
    calc
      ‖f t‖ ≤ ‖(y:H)‖*‖U t x‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
      _=‖(y:H)‖*‖x‖ := by rw [hnorm]

theorem invariant_unitary_essentialSelfAdjoint (hd : Dense (A.domain : Set H))
    (hs : A.IsFormalAdjoint A) (hc : c≠0) : IsSelfAdjoint A.closure := by
  have hn (a : ℝ) (ha : a≠0) (x : H)
      (h : (x,(I*(a:ℂ)) • x) ∈ A.adjoint.graph) : x=0 := by
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := A.adjoint.mem_graph_iff'.mp h
    have hy1 : (y:H)=x := congrArg Prod.fst hy
    have hy2 : A.adjoint y=(I*(a:ℂ)) • x := congrArg Prod.snd hy
    have hz := adjoint_imaginary_eigen_zero A U c hzero hadd hnorm hinv hder hd hc
      y a ha (by rw [hy1]; exact hy2)
    exact hy1.symm.trans hz
  apply essentialSelfAdjoint_of_no_deficiency A hd hs
  · simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one,mul_one] using hn 1 one_ne_zero
  · simpa only [Complex.ofReal_neg,Complex.ofReal_one,mul_neg,mul_one] using hn (-1) (by norm_num)

end F1Fecho.DeficiencyCriterion
